articleTitle: Structure Safety Evaluation of Transmission Corridor Considering Micro-landform Under Super Typhoon Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is important to evaluate the fragility of transmission corridors for power grid planning and operation in typhoon environment. This paper proposes a method to evaluate the structure safety of the transmission corridors considering micro-landform during typhoon. According to the meteorological stations' measured wind speed, a typhoon near-surface wind field model for assessing the towers' structural safety is proposed. First, since the damaged towers are mainly concentrated in the valley area, two damage mechanism of transmission towers in flat and valley area are analyzed. By modeling the micro-landform of valley as well as the wind speed at the exit of the valley, both the vortex wind speed and the radius of the vortex area can be obtained, which can be utilized to analyze the structure safety of the transmission towers. It has been shown that the funneling effect of the valley is the key factor to incur the outage of the transmission corridors during typhoon. Accordingly, two outage probability curves under vortex and normal wind are calculated separately. Based on the proposed safety evaluation method, the analysis of fragility of transmission corridors in F province under the influence of Meranti in 2016 is demonstrated. The results show the proposed method is effective, and it is promising for applications in power industry sector.

articleTitle: A Control Strategy for Static Var Generator to Regulate Voltage in Distribution Network Under High Penetration of Photovoltaic
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With more and more distributed photovoltaics connected to the rural distribution network, voltage problems appear because of the dual volatility of the photovoltaic and the load. Static var generator is considered prior to other reactive power compensation devices due to its excellent reactive power regulation performance in voltage regulation. The voltage regulation principle of static var generator is firstly analyzed. N ext, the voltage problems are analyzed and summarized under the situation that the penetration of photovoltaic has already reached a high level. Take the startup of the air source heat pump as an illustration. After that, a control strategy for static var generator is proposed and it can be divided into four modes: the mode of load, the mode of photovoltaic, the mode of air source heat pump and the mode of reduction in power loss. Then some indexes of voltage regulation are proposed to check the effectiveness of the strategy. They are voltage improvement indicator, virtual increase of photovoltaic, energy loss reduction rate and air source heat pump optimization rate. Finally, the simulation results show that the presented control method regulates the voltage greatly, alleviates the voltage dip well, reduces the network energy loss slightly, and helps to continue to install a certain capacity of photovoltaic in the future.

articleTitle: Dynamic Parameters Tracking and Voltage Sag Source Location in the Distribution System with DG
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage sag is one of the most important power quality problems causing sensitive equipment to malfunction and many industrial process interruptions. The penetration of distributed generation (DG) into distribution networks make it is more difficult to locate the sag source reliably. The problem of sag source location in distribution system with DG is studied in this paper. First, an adaptive nonlinear filter (ANF) is proposed for processing non-stationary signal during sag. Later synchronized phasor measurement based ANF is realized to get phasor's phase and amplitude dynamicly during transient, and a time-varying dynamic phasor model is constructed. Then, system parameters tracking for upstream and downstream system model of the complex distribution system with DG is analyzed. Finally, the mechanism of source location is founded by studying the relation of parameters variation and voltage variation, and a quantitative criterion are derived for sag source location. To validate the proposed method, a simulation of 35 kV distributing system with DG is used. The result is significant for the customers and suppliers to solve the issue between them, and be helpful to compensate voltage sag and remove the disturbance source.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Architecture Design of Stream Computing for the Dispatch and Control System of the Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Physical distribution and logical unification are the crucial features of the future power grid dispatch system, which requires transmitting, processing and storing massive amounts of information. However, the traditional centralized system cannot meet these requirements. Therefore, this paper introduces the big data distribution stream processing technology, and proposes a stream computing framework suitable for the dispatch and control system of the power grid, including task definition, communication queue management, task assignment, task monitoring and task migration. Aiming at solving the problem of poor system extensibility caused by the high coupling of model data and real-time data in current SCADA system, a data decoupling method based on the separation of the dynamic date and static data is proposed, and the task decomposition of real-time data processing is adopted as a case study of the stream computing framework for the dispatch system. The stream computing framework can continuously process the borderless acquired data, and meet the requirements of real-time data distribution storage and interaction for the wide-area dispatch system of the power system.

articleTitle: A Transmission Passage Expansion Planning Method Considering Uncertainties and Clusters of Multi-. Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The access of distributed generations (DG) such as wind power and photovoltaics, and the volatility of the load will cause complex uncertainties in the transmission network, which can make certain influence on the transmission performance of the power network. This paper proposed a transmission passage expansion planning method considering both uncertainties and clusters of multi-scenarios. Firstly construct a multi-scenario model with LHS algorithm to deal with the impact of fluctuation of load and uncertainties of DG, and reduce the numbers of operation scenes with Affinity propagation (AP) clustering algorithm. Then a two-layer optimization model of transmission passage expansion is established, aiming at improving the economy and DG capacity of the transmission network. The case study results show that the planning method proposed in this paper can effectively improve the DG consumption capacity and ensure the economic benefits and stability of the transmission network.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Control of Controllable Micro-Source in Micro-Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To overcome the shortcomings of the centralized control method, such as large calculation, strong communication dependency and poor system reliability. First, based on the traditional IEEE14 standard network topology, this paper introduces the controllable micro-source consist of PV and energy storage basic units. Micro-source cost model and constraints of photovoltaic renewable power generation unit, controllable flexible load, energy storage unit and so on are established. Next, consensus algorithm with no leader of two different communication coefficients D and M, N (CANLD and CANLMN) are finished when controllable micro-sources are inserted into micro-grid, and finally the eigenvalue perturbation method is used to prove the convergence of two different consensus algorithms. The results of the case study show that the two different multi-agent non-leader algorithms with traditional energy and controllable microsources incremental cost as the consistency variable can satisfy the optimal economic objective in microgrid and CANLMN can reach the incremental cost consistency of each micro-source with smaller computation and faster speed.

articleTitle: Low Voltage Ride-through of PV System Based on APFF
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at problems of two-stage photovoltaic (PV) grid-connected system including inverter overcurrent and large fluctuation of DC-side capacitor voltage when the grid voltage drops, a low voltage ride-through optimization control strategy based on active power feed forward (APFF) mode is proposed. This mode is relied on the principle of two-stage PV system max power point track and double PI grid-connected control strategy. The key of mode is to calculate active power reference of inverter and a proper duty cycle of DC/DC converter to adjust the output power of PV array to maintain the power balance of the first-stage and second-stage modules at the moment of power grid voltage sags. This strategy can implement current limitation, inject reactive power to grid and suppress fluctuation of DC side capacitor voltage. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed strategy are verified by MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Distributed Wind Turbine Integrating Energy Storage System Optimal Planning Based on Trilateral Interest Subjects
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integration of distributed generation may have a great impact on the stable operation of power system. Aimed at the distributed wind turbine (WT) integrating energy storage system (ESS) planning in medium voltage distribution network, an optimal planning method considering the benefits of distribution network company, WT owner and power consumer is proposed. Besides, a scheduling strategy adopting the reactive power adjustment capacity of WT inverter and power control system of ESS is presented. The demand response is also considered in the proposed method. The planning model is solved by NSGA-II, and more practical schemes of the site and capacity of distributed WT and ESS as well as the trading price between distribution network company and WT owner can be acquired.

articleTitle: Coordinate Control Study for Dynamic Partitioning and Load Shedding in UHVDC Receiving-End Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The safe and stable operation of the power grid is an important prerequisite for supporting the healthy development of the Energy Internet. With the rapid development of UHVDC and power load, it is becoming increasingly complex in the operation and control of receiving-end power grid. Load shedding is an effective emergency measure to ensure safe and stable operation of the power grid after grid failure with high economic and social impacts. To decrease the amount of load shedding it is necessary to study dynamic partition of power grid for some emergencies which have low speed demand. When there are more than one dynamic partition proposal to solve the emergency, the best one should be taken with multi-objective decision making. When the emergency cannot be solved by dynamic divisional technology only, to reduce the loss of the grid and consider the electric safety accidents, the coordination between dynamic partition and load shedding should be taken into account. According to the simulations of actual cases, with the coordination between dynamic partition of the grid and load shedding, the power grid can be secure and stable with less amount load shedding.

articleTitle: Decoupling Analysis of Additional Loss of Key Equipment in Low Voltage Distribution Network Under Complex Power Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the expansion of smart grid, rapid development of new energy and extensive application of impact and nonlinear loads, the problems of power quality, such as harmonic, three-phase unbalance, voltage deviation, voltage fluctuation and flicker, are becoming more and more serious. The loss calculation of distribution network under the disturbance of composite power quality is the basis of analyzing the line loss composition, formulating the loss reduction measures and realizing the economic operation of power grid. At present, more than half of the power loss in China's distribution network is generated in the low-voltage distribution network. In this paper, the calculation model of loss of key equipment in low voltage distribution network under complex power quality disturbance is deduced theoretically, and it is simulated and verified by MATLAB. On this basis, a decoupling method of complex power quality disturbance is proposed, which decouples the additional loss of the key equipment under the complex power quality disturbance, and the correctness of the decoupling method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: High Impact Low Frequency Peak Load Analysis using Extreme Value Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent decades, the demand for electricity continues to rise and the power grid has become increasingly saturated. It is of great significance to analyse and predict the yearly peak load (YPL) in order to maintain the grid stability. In this paper, the generalized extreme value (GEV) theory is employed to analyse the distributions of YPL so as to build a prediction model. By applying the method to YPL data from 1970 to 2014 in the UK, the data is processed for the sake of excluding the impact of grid scale variations. Then, four types of fitting diagnostic graphs are used to check the goodness-of-fit of both the GEV distribution and the Weibull distribution model. Thereafter, an YPL prediction model based on the GEV distribution is proposed. With this forecast model, it is capable to predict the probability as well as the maximum relative future value based on the historic data. Meanwhile, the future YPL value can be easily calculated from the predicted results. Finally, by comparing the predicted YPL to actual data, the feasibility of this GEV-based prediction model of YPL is verified.

articleTitle: Current Limiting Protection Scheme for Multi-Terminal DC Grids Based on Transient Boundary Voltage
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Multi-terminal DC grids based on voltage source converters (VSCs) are widely recognized as a feasible solution to cope with increasing electricity demand and high penetration of new renewable energy sources. The VSCs are vulnerable to DC line faults due to the high discharge current of DC-link capacitance. The high current would damage the insulation of DC cable, and subsequently destroy the anti-parallel diodes during freewheeling stage. In this paper, a current limiting protection scheme, which includes a current limiting circuit and a fault detection method based transient boundary voltage, for multi-terminal DC grids. The current limiting circuit is proposed to suppress the fault current within the interrupting capability of hybrid DC circuit breakers (HCB). The fault detection method is proposed to achieve fast and reliable fault detection of DC line. Comparisons with some conventional protection methods reveal the promising performance of proposed fault detection method. Simulation results of several cases have been verified the effectiveness of the proposed protection scheme, and indicate that the faulted DC line can be identified correctly and quickly, and the non-fault system is able to recover to normal operation immediately after fault clearance without power interruption.

articleTitle: Quantitative Risk Assessment and Control Method for Photovoltaic-integrated Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of smart grid, operation and control methods of power grid are more abundant and flexible, which makes contribution to solve the uncertain risks introduced by photovoltaic (PV) power plants, and also puts forward higher requirements for the decision-making effects of power grid. This paper first analyzes the role of three measures in the regulation and control of photovoltaic-integrated power system from the perspective of security and economy, namely inverter phase modulation, grid dynamic segmentation, and distributed power flow controller (DPFC). Then, taking DPFC as an example, a quantitative risk assessment and control method for photovoltaic-integrated power system is proposed. This method takes into account the uncertainty of photovoltaic output and the regulatory costs to quantify the operational control risk and control effect of the PV-integrated power system. Finally, IEEE RTS79 test system is established to verify the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Quantitative Study on the Support and Restriction of Energy to the Economy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy is an important supporting factor for social progress and economic development. The scientific development of energy systems has received worldwide attention, and theoretical research on energy supply and demand development is also deepening. This paper starts with China's energy data from 1997 to 2007 and discusses the relationship between energy structure, energy price, energy efficiency and economic development. Then the entropy weight method was used to establish an evaluation method for the relationship between energy saving and emission reduction and economic development. Finally, a prediction model of energy demand was established by using SPSS and verified by the real statistics.

Author Keywords: ARIMA model(Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average Model)

articleTitle: Analysis of Power User Behavior Based on Big Data Technology: A Review
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power industry is one of the important fields in the application of big data technology. Power big data is generated in every link of power production and contains rich commercial and social values. It is necessary to implement the analysis of electric power user behavior based on big data technology. This paper presents a comprehensive study on the analysis of power user behavior based on big data. The characteristics and application challenges of electric power big data are first introduced, followed by the extraction of power user side big data processing mode. Finally, this paper focuses on the main methods of data mining and analysis and discusses the clustering analysis algorithms to make better analysis of electric power user behavior.

articleTitle: Multi - Energy Resources Planning for Data Center Operation and Residential Heating
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With data centers surging worldwide, its enormous energy consumption, especially for the computational equipment, is required to deal with nowadays. Similarly, the building energy utilization is ever-increasing in most of the nations. Considering that most power used for IT servers of data center would, in turn, produce a vast amount of waste heat, one main perspective is to harvest the waste heat to offset the heat demand of residential building within a microgrid. Under this consideration, a MILP problem is formulated and discussed for optimization of the planning for the operation strategies of data center, generation units and residential building as an organization, aiming to minimize the operation cost and enhance the energy efficiency to its full extent. The results demonstrate the individual contribution of each supply in both power and heat section and confirm the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: SDAE-Based Probabilistic Stability Analysis of Wind Integrated Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for investigating the stability of the power system in presence of significant amounts of wind generation using stochastic differential algebraic equations (SDAEs). Contrary to the traditional approach of modelling the stochasticity only in the initial conditions, the SDAE-based method (SDAEM) describes wind power variation as a continuous stochastic process. Next, the model of a doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) grid-connected power system is also expressed as a SDAE. Finally, the probabilistic small signal stability (PSSS) and the probabilistic transient stability (PTS) conditions are defined. A single machine infinite bus (SMIB) system and a 16-machine, 68-bus system are used as the test systems for this analysis. The results indicate that SDAEM is more accurate and reliable in describing the system conditions in presence of stochastic inputs, and thus can be used to decide the right course of controller action.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Modeling Analysis of Microgird System Based on the “Emergence”
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The uncertainty of microgrid operation is increasing by the access of renewable energy sources such as wind power and photovoltaic. Modeling method based on probabilistic distribution is difficult to get information about microgrid operation characteristics. To solve this problem, we propose an uncertainty modeling analysis method of microgrid system based on the emergence. Firstly, we introduce the concept of emergence and emergence modeling method based on constrained generating procedure. Then, we propose a microgrid emergence system model based on constrained generating procedure. We define the mechanism composition of microgrid emergence system and corresponding state transition function in detail. Finally, in numerical results, we analysis the uncertainty factors, as well as their influence on microgrid operation, based on the data provided by the emergence model. In this way, the validity of the proposed modeling method is testified.

articleTitle: Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation strategy for early warning of low frequency oscillation based on WAMS
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Low-frequency oscillations (LFO) have essential impact on the power system. To detect LFO and send out warning timely, the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation strategy which is based on WAMS for early warning of LFO is proposed in this paper. The evaluating index of LFO is constructed on the basis of LFO characteristics at first. Then, to forecast the future power fluctuation value, the BP neural network prediction algorithm is used in designing learning mechanism of steady-state power fluctuation. The sliding window is adopted when calculating indexes of LFO. Further, the judgment matrix is obtained according to analytic hierarchy process. Subsequently, by introducing the membership function, the comprehensive evaluation model is built. Finally, the safety grade of power system can be calculated. The fuzzy comprehensive evaluation strategy for early warning of LFO is obtained according to the safety grade. The data in WAMS are utilized to verify the effectiveness of the proposed LFO comprehensive early warning strategy.

articleTitle: Deviation Electricity Settlement Method Based on Multi-index Fuzzy Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: China's electricity market is in a transitional period dominated by forward trades. Since the trading deviation is inevitable, the current methods of electricity settlement are difficult to prevent the market participants deviating from generation plans effectively. What's more, the pricing mechanism of deviation electricity is not reasonable. In this paper, the settlement method of forward market in a transitional period is taken as the research object. First, the fuzzy evaluation model of forward electricity trade is established with regards to the characteristics of forward electricity contracts, such as types, periods and prices of contracts. Then we formulate the adjustment factor of the allocation rates depended on results of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model and use it to correct the original allocation rates based on proportion of electricity quantity. The result of the test example shows the validity and practicability of the proposed method. The assessment of the validity of the proposed method Practicality. Compared with current methods, the proposed method considers the contract type, period, price and quantity of each trade rather than a single factor. The result of the allocation is more reasonable since it can punish the deviation properly and guarantee the reasonable profit of generation corporations, which is conducive to the efficient implementation of settlement work in the transitional stage.

articleTitle: Lean Network Management Based on Power Grid Equipment Operation Efficiency Analysis Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: State grid Tianjin electric power company carries out lean grid management research based on grid management statistical analysis based on power grid equipment operation efficiency analysis platform. Firstly, this paper introduces the construction process of power grid equipment operation efficiency analysis platform. Secondly, this paper introduces lean management strategy of power grid, based on the constructed operation efficiency analysis platform of power grid equipment, which deepens its application in power grid management. Finally, this paper analyzes the effect of the project results, from the aspects of economic benefit and social benefit. This project can realize lean analysis of grid equipment running efficiency and asset efficiency, and to play a better role for data statistics, on supporting effect of operation and management decision making.

articleTitle: Investment Decision for Distribution Network: A Correlation-Based Optimization Method
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problems in traditional investment planning and achieve precise investment decision of distribution network, based on the sample data, the correlation mining methods of the reconstruction measures and voltage qualification rate, such as neural network method, are applied to analyze the relationship between different types of reconstruction measures and voltage qualification rate. Next, the investment model is established respectively aiming at maximizing the improvement of voltage qualification rate and minimizing the total investment cost, by which the effects of different measures on benefits of distribution network can be analyzed. Considering multi-agent access in the investment of distribution network, the optimal investment schemes that based on the Correlation-based Optimization Method can be decided. Finally, an example is given to verify the rapidity, feasibility and effectiveness of the investment model.

articleTitle: Cross Time Zone Power System Planning and Economic Competitiveness Comparison of Regulation Resources: A Case Study on China-Germany
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Cross time zone grid interconnection is the key part of global energy interconnection. Different time zones have certain complementarities in load demand and new energy power output. In power systems with high new energy power generation proportions, cross time zone grid interconnections are more important. The complementary features of cross time zone load demand and new energy power output are quantified in this paper, and the peak-shaving benefits brought by the cross time zone interconnections are calculated. A combined inter-country cross time zone power system planning between China and Germany is carried out on this basis, while the economic competitiveness of interconnected grid regulation, peak-shaving power supply, pumped storage and battery energy storage are compared.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Benefits Evaluation of “Coal-to-Electricity” Project Based on Combination Weighting-TOPSIS Method
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: “Coal-to-electricity” project can effectively reduce the air pollution in the northern China, and their benefits evaluation can reasonably reflect the effect of the projects. According to the present situation of the “coal-to-electricity” projects in a northern city, the evaluation index system is put forward to estimate the benefits of the projects with the aspects of economic benefits, social benefits and operation status of the distribution networks. A statistic method - TOPSIS (technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution) is used to evaluation and analysis. In this method, the index system is weighted by the combination of analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and entropy weighting method. In the evaluation system of “coal-to-electricity” project, combination weighting - TOPSIS method can sort the different projects based on the distance between their comprehensive benefits and the positive and negative ideal solution. After the analysis of “coal-to-electricity” region with poor benefits, some recommendations can be given. Three actual project examples are applied for the evaluation system, and then the evaluation result of the examples is compared. Finally, the result is analyzed, while some improvement measures are put forward in these examples, which can give the reference and the guidance for the further implementation of the projects.

articleTitle: Design of a precise load shedding system and its simulation test method
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper introduces the design of a precise load shedding system and its simulation test method. The precision load shedding system is part of the grid safety and stability control system. It is mainly used to coordinate the comprehensive configuration of power grid resources and loads, realize mutual interaction between power supply, power grid and user load, and improve the emergency response capability of the grid for UHV faults. Through the classification, grading and sub-regional management of the load resources, the real-time precise control of the interruptible load of the classified users can be realized by the dispatching direct command. This paper mainly studies the architecture, strategy and communication protocols of each level of the system. In addition, the algorithm of the load shedding strategy of the control terminal was studied. Finally, a simulation test method for precise load shedding system is proposed in RTDS environment, which has certain reference significance for the safety and stability control of large power grid, micro-grid and distributed energy.

articleTitle: Detection and Location of Large-Scale Earth Potential Fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Earth potential can be induced by many factors such as high-voltage direct current transmission, geomagnetic disturbance, and stray current of the metro system. Both power systems and pipelines can be affected by such earth potential interference, which results in a series of negative effects and significant economic losses. This paper presents the modeling of a typical case of point-type interference and proposes a new interfering source locating method based on differential evolution algorithm. The optimization of transformer neutral current measuring units is investigated, thus it can be economical and efficient for locating as well as the forecast and suppression of the side effects of earth potential interference. The methods and conclusions of the paper also provide the key ideas for the detection and location of other forms of interfering sources, which will be investigated the the near future of the authors.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Coincidence Feeder Automation Method Considering the Processing of Single Phase to Ground Fault
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the problems existing in the current feeder automation (FA), such as over reliance on communication, difficulty in security protection, and self adaptation of fixed value parameters, etc, an adaptive coincidence FA method is proposed in this paper considering the processing of single phase to ground fault. Based on the transient characteristic detection principle of single-phase grounding, the strategy of tripping after loss of voltage and over current, quick break and latching after closing and over current, tripping and latching after short-time power supply is formulated. Combined with substation protection, FA logic is designed to achieve location, isolation and non fault area power supply restoration of large current fault and single phase to ground fault in multi branch and multi contact distribution network based on primary and secondary integrated equipments of distribution network. Finally, a simulation test platform based on real time digital simulator (RTDS) is built to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: Primary and secondary integrated equipment of distribution grid

articleTitle: Ubiquitous Urban Computing for Smart City Based on Space-Time Load Distribution Information
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to make up for the deficiency of urban computing theories and technologies based on smart grid information, a ubiquitous urban computing framework for smart city is proposed in this paper. Based on robust principal component analysis and stochastic configuration network, this paper established an electric customer portrait method facing space-time load distribution information. Based on the electric customer portrait method, the shared bicycle and shop location resettlement applications of our proposed ubiquitous urban computing technology were performed. Experimental results demonstrated that, this proposed technology is quite helpful to combine information and calculate near-optimal solution for the demand scenes of smart city, solving the modern city challenges and creating new value growth points for electric power enterprises in China.

articleTitle: Benefit Evaluation Indicators and Methods for Regional Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The regional energy Internet is coupled with natural gas, hot and cold, transportation and other technologies complement with the power system as the core. That helps multi-energy advantages complement each other and makes the entire system green and efficient. It is of great significance to promote the transformation of energy structure and promote China's energy revolution. The extraction of key indicators of different aspects of regional energy Internet, and the research of comprehensive benefit evaluation is an important issue that needs to be solved urgently. Firstly, considering the regional energy Internet economic benefits, environmental benefits, social benefits, the indicators with universal adaptability are extracted from the energy link, equipment link, distribution network link and user link. Then the analytic hierarchy process is used to determine the weight of the indictors, and the comprehensive state of the regional energy Internet is obtained by the fuzzy mathematics theory and the improved evidence reasoning. Finally, the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed method are verified by practical examples, and the development level of regional energy Internet in the example is accurately evaluated. Corresponding suggestions for the development of China's regional energy Internet are provided.

articleTitle: Research on Power Marketing Mode from the Perspective of Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a product of the deep integration of Internet technology and spiritual and energy systems, Energy Internet has been highly valued by all countries in the world and is an important fulcrum for promoting the energy revolution. Moreover, the power system has become the core of the energy Internet layout with its strategic position in the field of energy utilization and has gradually gained wide consensus. This paper starts with the evolution trend of power marketing under the background of energy internet, and analyzes the changes and reforms brought by the energy Internet to the electricity market and power marketing services. At the same time, it studies the direction of power enterprise's marketing transformation in the era of energy Internet, analyzes the implementation direction of the new mode of building power service for power companies, and provides a new way for power companies to deal with the market competition of energy internet.

articleTitle: A Distribution Network Islanding Strategy Based on Topological Characteristics to Improve System Resiliency
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the penetration of smart grid technologies, the reliability and stability of modern power systems could be further improved. However, large-scale power outages could still be caused when the power system is exposed to extreme conditions. The utilization of distributed generators (DGs) has risen significantly in the power system, and it plays a critical role to modernize the current power grid. The emerging smart grid technology, which attempts to enable more resilient power systems with DGs, makes a quick and efficient restoration of power systems possible. In this paper, DGs are introduced to enhance the restoration efficiency and success rate at the preliminary stage of network restoration. Then, the effect of DG's switching in points on areas of restoration islands in distribution network is investigated. Furthermore, based on the topological characteristics of scale-free networks and the discrete particle swarm optimization (DPSO) algorithm, an islanding scheme which aims to restore as many important loads as possible is proposed. The DGs are turned out to be effective resiliency resources for power system restoration. This paper will provide some useful insight into enhancing the power system resiliency in the face of extreme events such as natural or man-made disasters.

articleTitle: Long-Term Co-Optimized Generation and Transmission Expansion Planning with Renewables in Complicated Environments
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a new approach for solving the multi-year co-optimized generation and transmission expansion planning problem with renewable energy resources in geographic information systems (GIS). The proposed optimization model is to determine when (which year), where (which cell), and what (which type) generators and transmission lines will be built for minimizing the sum of investment costs, operation costs (including energy and emission costs), and load shedding costs during the planning horizon. Prevailing constraints include power balance requirements, branch limits, power limits of generators, and construction limits of cells. A two-step approach to combine Dijkstra's algorithm and mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) is introduced for solving the large-scale optimization problem. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is validated by numerical case studies on a 9-bus system.

Author Keywords: co-optimized generation and transmission expansion planning

articleTitle: Discussion on the System of Electricity Price Charge System Based on Power Quality
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase of sensitive loads, power quality management has become an important indicator of power services. In order to solve the problem of power quality pricing between the supplier and the user, this paper proposes an effective method of hierarchical pricing based on power quality, which can provide different levels of power quality according to different customers. In this paper, a set of power quality evaluation model based on analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is established firstly, and then a hierarchical power quality pricing model is established. Considering the phenomenon of fuzzy pricing, a cost optimization design model of power supply side is established. Particle swarm optimization (PSO) is used to optimize the model, and the correctness of the optimization is verified by simulation. Finally, taking Linshu County Power Supply Company as an example, the corresponding power supply scheme is proposed, and the feasibility of the method is verified.

articleTitle: A Value-Tracing Approach to Smart Grid Demonstration Project Assessment
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Non-commonality of the assessment method due to the diversity of member types and characteristics seriously causes deviation in overall and accurate diagnosis of smart grid demonstration project. Taken multilateral participant into consideration, the proposed method models the cost and benefit, according to the direct and indirect value flow, which is based upon the relationship between devices, service and added value. The application of value-tracing in a practical case shows that, compared with conventional power grid benefit calculation methods, value flow analysis makes smart grid assessment more precise and more actual because it calculates indirect value of multiple subjects and members.

articleTitle: Error and Risk Prediction Based Active Power Control for Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to wind power forecasting error, active power control may not satisfy the control objective. By analysis, the main reason is the asymmetry of power forecasting error. For this, an active power control strategy considering the asymmetry of wind power forecasting error is proposed. Using historical data, wind power forecasting error and its confidence interval are estimated. And confidence interval of wind power forecasting is introduced to establish the optimization model for dispatching active power among wind farms. Then the asymmetry power forecasting error can be compensated by the model. Based on this, operation risk is introduced to optimize the power distribution strategy. Then a simulation is designed using actual data of one wind power base in China. The results show that the proposed strategy is reasonable and effective to improve the performance of active power control of wind power and reduce the risk of power shortage.

articleTitle: Optimization of DC Terminal Location for UHVDC Hierarchical Connection to Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large grid interconnection is an important form of Energy Internet. Ultra-high voltage direct current (UHVDC) plays an increasingly important role in the interconnection of large power grids, which helps to optimize the allocation of resources in a wide area. UHVDC hierarchical connection mode, in which the UHVDC inverter station connects to different voltage level AC system, provides an effective means to evacuate the high-capacity power of UHVDC access to the load center. DC terminal location selection is a multi-objective decision problem. Considering the characteristics and influence of UHVDC hierarchical connection to power grid, the comprehensive evaluation indexes are established in this paper, on the basis of which DC terminal location selection strategy by the use of Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) method. Finally, an actual project of UHVDC hierarchical connection to system is taken for an example and four different UHVDC hierarchical connection schemes are discussed in this paper. The result shows that effective decision support for UHVDC hierarchical terminal location planning can be provided with the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Optimization Method of Dynamic VAR Compensation for Multi-infeed HVDC-AC Receiving System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The influence of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) on AC-DC system is not considered in most optimization problem of dynamic var compensation. A two-stage optimization method of dynamic var compensation for multi-infeed HVDC-AC receiving system is proposed in this paper. The first stage is partition. In partition stage, a sensitivity-controlled partition method for AC-DC system var compensation is proposed considering the influence of the multi-infeed HVDC system. The second stage is optimization. In optimization stage, for each area, there are three steps: 1) the trajectory violation integral index considering HVDC commutation failure is analyzed; 2) the optimization objective considering both the voltage trajectory sensitivity integral and economic cost factors is established; and 3) the imperialistic competitive algorithm (ICA) is improved and utilized to solve the optimization problems of the dynamic VAR compensation allocation for each sub-area. Finally, the applicability and effectiveness of the proposed method are illustrated using the Guangdong power system as test system.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Analysis for the Space-Charge-Free Electric Field on ±1100kV UHVDC Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, four methods of calculating the surface electric field of the bipolar HVDC transmission lines were compared. To study the influence factors on the space-charge-free electric field of the bundle surface quantitatively, which include conductor radius, bundle spacing, polar distance and the height of conductors, sensitivity analysis method was introduced. Two sensitivity indexes were calculated to describe the influence of the transmission line parameters, namely the local sensitivity and the global sensitivity based on partial derivative. The work done in this paper can provide a useful preference for further ±1100kV UHVDC transmission lines design.

articleTitle: Severity Analysis of Voltage Sag Considering Multi-Factor Attributes
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the intensive use of sensitive equipment, voltage sags have gradually become one of the most important power quality problems. Analysis of multi-factor attributes after voltage sags occurs can not only guide the planning, equipment selection, operation and maintenance of power supply engineering, but also can provide a theoretical basis for effectively assessing the risks and severity of users' encounter with power quality incidents, and combing the existing problems of technology and management level. In this paper, the “contribution” ranking method is proposed for multi-factor attributes that affect voltage sags. First, the multi-factor attributes of voltage sags are enumerated and divided into intrinsic and exogenous attributes. Then, the analytic hierarchy process is used to calculate the weight of multi-factor causal attributes. Finally, in combination with the actual engineering data, the voltage sag under multifactor causal attributes is analyzed using the equipment compatibility index as the standard, and the sag severity of the equipment under multi-factor attributes is analyzed to achieve the sort of multi-factor attribute severity. The feasibility of this method is verified by Matlab simulation.

articleTitle: Dual-Q Theory Based Optimal Ordering Method for Distribution Network Planning Projects Considering Strong Couplings
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the dual-Q theory, an optimal ordering methodology for distribution network planning projects (DNPP) is proposed considering the coupling characteristics among the DNPPs. Firstly, the fuzzy relation theory is introduced to analyze the benefit coupling relationship among DNPPs and construct a relationship matrix. Secondly, with the coupling characteristics among the DNPPs considered, and taking the Weingartner optimization selection model as the prototype, the dual-Q theory based optimal ordering model for DNPP is presented. In the proposed optimal ordering model, the objective function is to maximize the reduction of system average interruption duration index (SAIDI), the constraints include budget limits, project periods and other conditions, and the decision variables include the selected projects and their construction period. Finally, simulations on an actual case and comparisons with conventional method are performed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed dual-Q theory based optimal ordering method.

articleTitle: Field test study on regulation performance of hydropower units bearing large-scale wind power fluctuations
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In northwest of China, large-scale renewable energy sources, such as wind power (WP) and photovoltaic (PV), with uncertainties and intermittent characteristics, are transmitted through ultra-high voltage direct current (UHV DC) transmission lines and are bundled with conventional power supplies. Reducing curtailment and improving the consumption of large-scale wind power is one of the main tasks of grid companies. In this paper, a field test plan of arranging hydropower units to compensate the wind power across wild region was designed, while the QiShao high-voltage DC is used as a typical application scenario under the assumption that UHV DC operating in the “wind-and-photovoltaic mode. A field test of WP-hydropower joint operation involving multiple hydropower units was carried out. Results show that (1) the hydropower units can compensate the total wind power fluctuations from the WP sending grid on the one minute-scale; (2) the WP-hydropower joint operation can track the combined power generation adjustment target.

articleTitle: Users Energy Consumption Behavior Analysis for Integrated Energy System Based on Spark Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The future energy utilization will move towards the user-centered integrated energy system, which is of great significance to analyze the behaviour of user-side energy consumption. Firstly, this paper constructs the Spark-BIRCH algorithm based on balanced iterative reducing and clustering using hierarchies analysis(BIRCH) and Spark platform. Secondly, according to the clustering results of user's energy consumption behaviour, a multi-threaded prediction model (Spark-DBN) for user energy demand is constructed by combining the Spark platform and the Deep Belief Neural Network(DBN). Finally, the proposed parallel clustering algorithm and multi-threaded demand forecasting model are validated and simulated by numerical example, and the results show that the constructed Spark-BIRCH user behavior clustering method has high accuracy and validity, the method has excellent performance, which effectively saves time cost. In addition, the Spark-DBN prediction model has smaller prediction errors and higher accuracy than the single prediction model. The simulation results has verified the validity ad feasibility of the two models.

articleTitle: Calculation method of New Energy Access Capacity Under Harmonic
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale development and utilization of new energy sources, mainly wind power and solar photovoltaic power generation, are on the rise all over the world. Wind power generation and solar photovoltaic power generation are two special types of harmonic sources. Large-scale wind power generator and photovoltaic generating units access to grid will bring not negligible harmonic problems. This paper focuses on the harmonic superposition coefficient and simultaneous coefficient for wind power and photovoltaic power generation. Finally, the harmonic limit allocation method of wind power and solar photovoltaic power generation grid and the calculation method of access capacity under harmonic constraints were given.

articleTitle: Research on the Operation Strategy of Distributed Micro-grid Based on Power Electronic Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC microgrid has more advantages than AC microgrid, and it will become the main means of renewable energy in a centralized grid connection. The structure characteristics and operation modes of an active distribution network (ADN) and connected distributed DC microgrid are fully considered in a multipoint distributed distribution system. Thus, this study uses the power electronic transformer (PET) to realize the peer-to-peer control of a DC microgrid, which reduces the complexity of the entire control system. Five operation modes of the DC microgrid are also designed, and real-time power flow optimization of the distribution network is conducted by using PET. The aim is to minimize the total operating cost of the ADN with the DC microgrid. The optimal operation strategy is realized through distribution network control and multi DC microgrid cooperative optimization operation. The example simulation shows that the method proposed in this paper can reflect the advantages of PET and DC microgrid in absorbing distributed energy, cutting the peak, filling the valley, and realizing the power flow optimization of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Network Integrated Graphical Browsing and Alarm Monitoring Based Wide-area Service Bus
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that existing smart grid dispatching control system monitoring is not comprehensive enough, and the integrated collaboration processing capability is weak. Based on the extensive using of CIM/G standard and wide-area service bus technology, and considering the requirements of large-scale operation system construction, this article presents the design and application of wide-area service bus based network integrated graphical browsing and alarm monitoring function, which meets the requirements of physical distribution, logic unification, fast accessing, seamless browsing and operation that data information should have. It achieves a high efficient integration and optimization of physically distributed data information and alarm messages. This function has been applied to the Smart Grid Dispatching Control System of Shanghai, which improves the global cognition and synchronous perception of the safe operation of large-scale power grid.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Study on Spray Evaporation Process of Desulfurization Wastewater in Flue Duct
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Spraying flue gas desulfurization (FGD) wastewater into flue duct is a promising technology to achieve zero discharge of wastewater by evaporation in thermal power plants. In this study, a substantiated combined Eulerian-Lagrangian mathematical model is developed to calculate the thermo-fluid behavior of the FGD wastewater in the flue gas during evaporating process. In order to increase the amount of FGD wastewater to be treated at the same time and avoid the scale and corrosion on flue duct walls, the mounting spacing between two nozzles and the safe mounting spacing between nozzles and flue duct wall are analyzed. Then the effect of nozzle characteristics on droplets evaporation is studied, such as the flow rate, full cone angle and direction of a spray nozzle. Based on the achieved numerical results, a Least-Square Support Vector Machine (LSSVM) model is introduced to forecast the evaporation rate of droplets. The results show that the maximum evaporation rate of droplets can be obtained by spaying droplets in the co-flow direction of flue gas. An optimized arrangement of multiple nozzles having small flow rate is proposed to improve the droplets evaporation rate. The proposed LSSVM model can expeditiously predict the evaporation rate of droplets along the flue duct with high accuracy. All the findings of the present study can be used to guide the design of spraying FGD wastewater treatment technology.

articleTitle: A Method of Distance Protection Setting Calculation for AC/DC Hybrid Receiving-end Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to minimize the operational risk of the AC/DC hybrid receiving-end grid, a method of distance protection setting calculation considering DC operation safety is proposed in this paper. The characteristics and function of main protection and backup protection of AC power network are analyzed, based on which the contradiction between sensitivity, speed and selectivity of distance protection in AC / DC hybrid power network is analyzed. Although the widely used step by step coordination principle satisfies the sensitivity and selectivity, it can not satisfy the quick action and is easy to cause the DC blocking accident. Moreover, a simplified distance protection setting calculation method satisfying sensitivity and speed is proposed in this paper, which ensures the safe operation of DC and greatly reduces the operational risk of power grid. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the actual example of Shandong power grid.

articleTitle: Research on Evolution Strategy of Classical and Quantum Key Integrating Applications Oriented to Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to ensure the security of information communication, an evolution strategy of classical and quantum key integrating applications oriented to virtual power plant (VPP) is proposed. Firstly, the VPP's information communication model is established. Secondly, the evolution strategy of classical and quantum key integrating applications is designed. Finally, the VPP's information communication system and the corresponding service data model are established, and the quantum key application schemes are determined after finishing the estimation of the VPP's service traffic and QKD generation rate, and the performance of key integrating strategy is simulated by adopting OPENSSL and NS3 software. The simulation results show that the proposed evolution strategy can well satisfy the quantum key optimal applications within intraday scheduling, and thus greatly enhances the information security level in VPPs.

articleTitle: A Security-constrained Flexible Demand Scheduling Strategy based on Robust Optimization with Box Set
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Driven by the challenge of keeping supply and demand balance all the time, using the flexible demand as an additional participation in the power grid dispatching and decision-making processes is a crucial issue in accommodating wind power. Firstly, flexible demand scheduling cost and the demand response uncertainty cost is considered simultaneously in the objective function. Secondly, the static algorithm was proposed to calculate the amount of flexible demand. On this basis, an optimization flexible demand scheduling model considering network security is established. Finally, the validity and feasibility of the model are analyzed with a numerical test system. The simulation results demonstrate that by employing the proposed strategy the flexible demand can efficiently accommodate wind power with security constraint satisfied.

articleTitle: Regional Distribution Network Planning Method Based on Electric Vehicle Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Because of its special energy driving mode, electric vehicles can effectively reduce pollution emissions and improve energy efficiency, so it is developing rapidly in recent years. However, as a new type of load, it brings social benefits and brings a series of challenges to the planning and operation of the power grid. With the gradual improvement of electric vehicle penetration, its impact on the power grid is also increasing. Therefore, in future power grid planning, it is necessary to fully consider the impact of electric vehicles, so as to make the power grid more adaptable. According to this, this paper first studies the influence factors of the electric vehicle load, and establishes the corresponding prediction model. Based on the prediction model, it selects the model parameters which can not only reflect the model parameters, but also facilitates the acquisition of observable measurement, so that the electric vehicle load in the region can be accurately predicted. On the basis of the results of load forecasting, a regional distribution network economic planning model is established to guide the selection of transformer in the power supply area, to improve the adaptability and economy of the power grid, and to further promote the development of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on Two-Stage Coordinated Electric Vehicles Dissipating Wind Power Distribution Strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the coordinated operation of wind power, thermal power and electric vehicles, the paper studies the profit distribution of three-party cooperation based on cooperative game theory. Considering the influence of wind power output prediction deviation on the coordinated dispatching of electric vehicles and thermal power units to wind power, a two-stage optimal scheduling strategy combining day-to-day collaborative planning and intraday correction is proposed. Based on the maximum profit of the alliance, the three-party alliance, two-party alliance and non-alliance optimization scheduling model of the two-phase under the day-to-day period are constructed. The profit results of each optimized scheduling in the day are used as the allocation basis, and the Shapley value, Banzhaf value and Solidarity value allocation strategy are adopted. The three-party alliance profit distribution is carried out, and the core theoretical indicators and the MDP (Modified Disruption Propensity) indicators are set to discriminate the possibility of cooperation and the intensity of cooperation intention under each allocation strategy. The mixed-integer programming technique and CPLEX optimization software are used to simulate the simulation. The results show that the three-party joint model can promote the consumption and development of wind power, and the cooperation under the Shapely value allocation strategy can be established. The cooperation intentions of all members of the alliance are strong.

articleTitle: Cuckoos-Search Based Hosting Capacity Calculation for Distributed Grid-Connected Photovoltaic Generation Considering Economic Cost
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of photovoltaic (PV) industry, the access scale and mode of distributed PV system will directly affects the PV development strategy as well as the planning, expansion and reconstruction of distribution system. The optimization model is given in which the objective is the maximum of net profit for PVs' access. Cuckoos Search (CS) algorithm is proposed as the optimization algorithm. The economic benefits of PVs' access are analyzed in the IEEE standard examples from the points of installation location, load type of access point and cost coefficient of distributed PV. Finally, the access principle is proposed to ensure the maximum net benefits of distributed PV. The IEEE standard examples show that the model given in this paper can effectively calculate the maximum acceptable capacity considering the benefit and cost of distributed PV.

articleTitle: Method on Video Optimal Transmission in On-site Operation Monitoring System of Electrical Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the existing problems in the supervision of on-site operation of electrical power system, an on-site operation monitoring and command system is designed. The on-site video is transmitted to command center via servicer by wireless network. But due to the instability of wireless network bandwidth, the real-time transmission of video can' t be guaranteed. Even the transmission delay is long and the frames are lost seriously. In order to make the video transmission real-time and integrity, a video optimal transmission method based on the frame similarity is proposed. On the basis of the characteristics of H.264 video coding mode, the frame similarity parameter is marked to distinguish the frame importance. The network bandwidth changes is monitored in real time and the Prio-Drop scheduling algorithm is presented, so the important frames can be transmitted in advance. The test indicates that the optimal transmission method can improve the decoding quality of transmitted video, and achieve the requirements of real-time video transmission, which provided the technical guidance for enhancing the power supervision and strengthening emergency command.

articleTitle: Steady-State Model of Energy Stations Considering Thermodynamic Properties
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A steady-state model that considers thermodynamic properties and the topology of the combined cooling heat and power energy stations is presented. This model, based on components, can describe the relationship between the heat, cold and electricity output and the gas consumed of an energy station more accurately. The components conclude two typical forms of trigeneration, combined cycle gas turbine and internal combustion engine with gas-fired chillers are introduced. The proposed model considers both the thermal characteristics and the topology of the components of the energy station. Several test cases of energy stations based on the former two types of trigeneration demonstrate the accuracy of this model.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Method/for Evaluating Wind Power Heating Improving the Accommodation Capacity of Renewable Energy Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind power heating, as a new form of wind power utilization, uses surplus wind power at low load for thermal power stations, which is expected to alleviate the wind power curtailment in North China in winter. However, current evaluation of the effect of this model is lacking and with single perspective. The current research fails to guide the planning for the future development of the heat-power combined system. In this paper, a multi-process probabilistic model is established through probabilistic production simulation on medium and long-term time scale. Then, this paper analyzes the operation mechanism of wind power heating and its impact on power and thermal systems, and establishes the accommodation effect evaluation model. The simulation results show that the model can effectively calculate the effectively accommodated power at different powers and operation times of the thermal power station, and prove the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Table of Contents
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: power grids; distributed power generation; optimisation; power engineering computing; distribution networks; wind power plants; power generation economics; power markets; HVDC power transmission; power generation control.

publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Presents an index of the authors whose articles are published in the conference proceedings record.

articleTitle: Research on Power Internet of Things Architecture for Smart Grid Demand
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the characteristics of power Internet of Things and its application scenarios, and meeting the needs of smart grid for communication coverage and data acquisition, a full-service ubiquitous power Internet of Things architecture covering terminal, gateway, network, platform, application, security and other capabilities is constructed. And design a full-service ubiquitous power Internet of Things standard system, formulate related key technical standards, guide the planning, design and construction of the power Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Short-term Load Forecasting Model of GRU Network Based on Deep Learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Along with the development of power system, power load forecasting plays a more and more important role. It is not only an important part of power system dispatching, operation and planning, but also the foundation of economic operation and safe operation of power system. However, power load data generally have the characteristics of complexity and nonlinearity. At present, most forecasting methods, which are based on the traditional linear statistical theory, can not consider the time series and the nonlinear characteristics of load data at the same time. In this paper, a short term load forecasting model, GRU (gated recurrent unit) network is proposed, which is the variant of LSTM(long short term memory) being based on long and short memory neural network, and the simulation prediction is carried out by using the power load data of a region in Heilongjiang province. Comparing the prediction results with the traditional ones, it is proved that the error of GRU model is lower and the prediction effect is better.

articleTitle: Short-term Load Forecasting Based on GBDT Combinatorial Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When using a single model for short-term electric load forecasting, the prediction results are easily affected by unexpected events and fall into local optimization. In this paper, a short-term load forecasting method based on combinatorial optimization of Gradient Boosting Decision Tree (GBDT) is proposed. Based on the single model, the optimal combination is established, and a GBDT load forecasting model is established. The above method is used to predict a total of 96 point loads in a certain area in southern China with 15 minutes as time interval. Compared with the Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average Model (ARIMA), Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) methods., the effectiveness of the method is proved.

articleTitle: Blockchain and Edge Computing Based Vehicle-to-Grid Energy Trading in Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy deficiency and carbon emission are two increasingly grave issues recently. Energy Internet (EI), as a promising solution, has received extensive attentions globally. Among numerous key technologies and practice of EI, vehicle to grid (V2G) provides a feasible solution to reduce the level of demand-supply mismatch by leveraging the bidirectional energy-trading capabilities of electric vehicles (EVs). In this paper, we propose a secure and efficient V2G energy trading framework by exploring blockchain and edge computing. First, we develop a consortium blockchain-based secure energy trading mechanism for V2G. Then, edge computing has been incorporated to improve the successful probability of block creation. The computational resource allocation problem is modeled as a two-stage Stackelberg leader-follower game, and the optimal strategies are obtained by using the backward induction approach. Finally, the performance of the proposed framework is validated via numerical results and theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Hybrid AC-DC System on a Cloud Computing Based Simulation Platform - CloudPSS
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of UHVDC and UHVAC techniques, China has gradually formed a complex power grid based on an UHV hybrid AC-DC system. As the transient phenomena of such a network becomes more complicated, it is vital to analyze the hybrid AC-DC system through accurate numerical simulation tools. In this paper, a cloud computing-based simulation platform, i.e. CloudPSS, is introduced. The fast start-up strategy for the hybrid AC-DC system electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulation on CloudPSS is proposed. Then, the EMT model of a test case combing IEEE 39-bus standard system with the CIGRE HVDC benchmark is built on the CloudPSS platform. Benefits from the fast start-up strategy, the EMT model of the hybrid AC-DC system can be initialized directly from provided load flow data. Test results validates the correctness of the model and indicates the effectiveness and practicability of the fast start-up strategy of CloudPSS.

articleTitle: Totem-Pole Bridgeless Boost PFC Converter Based on GaN HEMT for Air Conditioning Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a GaN-based totem-pole bridgeless boost Power-Factor-Correction (PFC) converter for air conditioning applications. Based on the small signal modeling, the power level transfer function of totem-pole bridgeless boost PFC converter is derived by the state-space averaging method. The control strategy of the voltage and the current loops is proposed to meet the design requirement, and the Bode diagram is given to verify the performance of the control strategy. Finally, an 800W GaN-based totem-pole bridgeless boost PFC converter prototype is developed with 98% efficiency and 0.99 input power factor. The effectiveness of the control strategy has been verified.

articleTitle: A Survey on Wi-Fi HaLow Technology for Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wi-Fi HaLow is a wireless networking protocol: IEEE 802.11ah, which was published on May 10th 2017. The technology's low power consumption competes with LoRa, ZigBee, Bluetooth. It uses sub 1 GHz (S1G) license-exempt bands, allowing the creation of large groups of stations or sensors, to provide extended range Wi-Fi networks and support the concept of Internet of Things (IoT). This paper gives an overview of the Wi-Fi HaLow technology, which is able to solve the weakness of Wi-Fi in penetrability and transmission distance up to 1km at the default transmission power of 200mW.

articleTitle: Phase Identification of Smart Meters by Spectral Clustering
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Phase identification is important for the safe operation of distributed power grid, and a data-driven phase identification approach has been proposed in this paper, in which the OpenDSS (Open distribution system simulator) is used to perform power flow analysis on a real distribution feeder-European Low Voltage Test Feeder. The spectral clustering is used to identify phases of users/smart meters. Verification by European Low Voltage Test Feeder in different settings. The phase identification accuracy of proposed method is over 95% when the voltage sampling period is no more than 1 hour in the case of complete data set. Results indicate that the proposed method performs better than the constrained k-means method when the sampling period exceeds 15 minutes.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Assessment of Power Systems Using Cost-sensitive Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a deep learning approach with cost-sensitive loss function for transient stability assessment (TSA). Firstly, multiple generator variables after disturbance are utilized as the original inputs. Secondly, the convolutional neural network (CNN) is applied for automatic feature extraction and regression model building for TSA. The generated TSA model can provide more accurate transient stability index than the fully-connected neural network and support vector regression model. Moreover, a cost-sensitive loss function is proposed to reduce the misdetection of instability. Case studies are conducted on the New England 10-machine 39-bus system to verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: DC Fault Detection and Classification Approach of MMC-HVDC Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Because the adaptive learning degree of the existing protection scheme in MMC-HVDC system is low, a novel DC fault detection and classification scheme based convolutional neural network(CNN) is proposed. The approach is divided into CNN DC fault detection model (model I) and CNN DC fault classification model (model II). The wavelet logarithmic energy entropy (WLEE) is applied as the input layer in model I for extracting the confusion degree of transient current frequency. Meanwhile, the wavelet low frequency components act as the input of model II to represent the trend of transient current.
