As an artificial intelligent(AI) approach, the approach proposed has high adaptive learning rate, can accurately detect the new faults based on the existing fault training dataset. The two-terminal 21-level MMC-HVDC system is established in PSCAD/EMTDC to verify this scheme. The simulation results indicate this protection scheme can detect and classify MMC-HVDC DC transmission line fault with high speed and accuracy in different fault conditions.

articleTitle: User-Centric Peer-to-Peer Energy Trading Mechanisms for Residential Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing prevalence of distributed generation, energy trading in distribution side starts to attract academic attentions. This paper proposes two user-centric pricing strategies for facilitating peer-to-peer energy trading in residential microgrids: Unified Pricing (UP) strategy and Identified Pricing (IP) strategy. The proposed strategies aim to maximize the profit of small-scale distributed energy resources owners while taking into account the user's life convenience and solar photovoltaic uncertainty. UP strategy includes a centralized market pool that determines the market clearing price at a regular time interval; IP strategy identifies each energy transaction with difference on different time based on consumers' bid. The auction algorithm is used for solving the energy allocation to achieve best social welfare in the community microgrid. Numerical studies based on 15 simulated residential users are conducted to validate the reasonability and effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: A Non-Cooperative Game Based Charging Power Dispatch in Electric Vehicle Charging Station and Charging Effect Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Charging station powered by renewables combines both the renewables and electric vehicles, and has much possibility to be a key charging infrastructure. As the number of electric vehicles increase, recharging problem will become urgent and prominent. So satisfying more charging demand at same time is expected for charging station. In this paper, we present a charging station integrated with photovoltaic system/battery storage/grid-tied system power dispatch method for electric vehicles in an electric vehicle charging station, and this method based on the non-cooperative game achieves dynamically adjusting the charging power. The outstanding advantage is this method can provide charging service for all electric vehicles at the same time, especially in the situation where available charging power is limited. Comparing to the commonly used constant charging scheme, the simulation results showed that the proposed charging method can achieve higher charging service rate and higher utilization of charging pole inside charging station.

articleTitle: Study on HVDC commutation failure and voltage compensated variable slope VDCOL control
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, through the analysis of HVDC commutation failure mechanism, the influence of commutation voltage reduction on commutation failure is studied. Based on this, a method which can restrain commutation failure and subsequent commutation failure and improve the recovery performance of the system is studied, that is voltage compensation slope VDCOL control strategy. Through modeling and Simulation on CIGRE HVDC benchmark test system, the validity of voltage compensated variable slope VDCOL control strategy is verified. Variable slope VDCOL is beneficial to reduce the probability of HVDC commutation failure.

articleTitle: Study on Transient Overvoltage of Wind Farm Caused by Fault of HVDC System and Its Suppression Measures
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Faults such as DC commutation failure and DC blocking will generate transient overvoltage at the converter station, and the transient overvoltage will be transitive. If the DC system sending end is a wind farm, transient overvoltage may cause wind turbines overvoltage and then off-gird. The reasons of transient overvoltage caused by commutation failure and DC blocking faults are analyzed. The mechanism of overvoltage that may cause wind turbines off-gird is elaborated. The simulation analyzes wind farm overvoltage under different fault conditions of HVDC, and verifies the effectiveness of measures to suppress transient overvoltage.

articleTitle: Conceptual Framework of Blockchain-based Electricity Trading for Neighborhood Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Future electricity distribution grids will host a considerable share of variable renewable energy sources, such as roof photo voltaic and small wind power. The households will progressively become prosumers playing an active role on localized peer-to-peer electricity trading. This paper proposes a conceptual framework that enables households to autonomously exchange energy with neighbors based on blockchain techniques, aimed to locally balancing renewable energy production.

articleTitle: Research on a Cross-Domain Authentication Scheme Based on Consortium Blockchain in V2G Networks of Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an important part of the smart grid, the Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) can provide various auxiliary services for the power grid and promote the use of renewable resources. However, there are various kinds of attacks in the V2G network. Based on consortium blockchain, this paper proposes a cross-domain authentication scheme for the security threat in the V2G network. This paper designs the trust model and the system architecture, and describes the scheme in detail. The signature and authentication of the scheme adopt the SM9 identity-based cryptographic algorithm. This scheme utilizes the fact that block chain technology is not easy to tamper with. It uses a hash algorithm to verify the certificate, reducing the number of public key algorithm signatures and verifications, making the solution efficient and scalable. The introduction of block chain technology provides new ideas and methods for solving the security problems in the Smart Grid.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Supply Restoration in Active Distribution Networks with Soft Open Points
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The flexible interconnection technology based on soft open points (SOPs) provides opportunities to improve the operating level of active distribution networks (ADNs). The capability to achieve fast supply restoration is one of the important advantages of SOPs. This paper proposes a hybrid bi-level optimization method for multi-objective supply restoration in the ADNs with SOPs. The model of supply restoration for minimizing the out-of-service loads, the number of switch operations, and the network losses, is established. The model is formulated as a typical mixed integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) problem, taking the power outputs of SOPs and switch states as controllable variables. The optimization method based on fast non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) and primal-dual interior-point method (PDIPM) is developed to solve it. NSGA-II is employed to reconfigure the switch states. For the network topology reconfigured by NSGA-II, an AC/DC OPF based on PDIPM is conducted to obtain the minimum power losses and to ensure the system operation constraints satisfied. A modified IEEE 33-node test system is carried out to demonstrate the effectiveness of this method. Results show that the application of SOPs effectively reduces the healthy out-of-service loads, and simplifies the switching operations required.

articleTitle: Research on Short-Circuit Currents Calculation Method Considering Dynamic Reactive Power Support of Renewable Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the renewable generation target and the continuously increasing electrical demand, a large number of wind farms and solar photovoltaic (PV)plants are being planned in China. As the electricity fault characteristics of inverter-interfaced renewable energy sources are different from the traditional synchronous generators. The fault circuit contributions are getting more and more attention from engineers. In this paper, the short-circuit calculation method considering dynamic reactive power support of renewable energy systems is proposed. Through a large number of calculations, the factors affecting short-circuit currents and trends of short-circuit current under different voltage drop depths are discussed. The results presented by this paper provide the reference for future research on control and protection of power systems with high penetration of renewable energies.

articleTitle: State Estimation for Integrated Energy System Containing Electricity, Heat and Gas
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to alleviate environmental pollution and improve utilization efficiency of end-used energy, integrated energy system (IES) becomes an important direction of energy structure adjustment in China. And combined electricity, heat and gas generation has developed rapidly. It is necessary to monitor combined electricity, heat and gas networks. As an ordinary way to monitor electricity network, state estimation can also be introduced in heat and gas network. Firstly, models of electricity, heat and natural gas networks in IES are established. Then IES multi-energy flow model is built. Considering coupling components in combined networks, state estimation for combined system was realized. Comparison between combined and separate state estimations was presented after Monte-Carlo experiments. Generally, combined state estimation is more accurate and gives global solution as basis of security evaluation, scheduling and dispatch of combined electricity and heat networks.

articleTitle: The Enlightenment of Foreign Power Market Reform Experience to China's Power Market Construction
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the deepening of power market reforms, power sales companies have mushroomed throughout the country. The types of transactions that the power sales companies can participate in have also gradually increased, and a variety of service types such as contract power transfer transaction have also been added. Under this background, there are more and more uncertain factors in the market. Once the side of power sale is released, the situation in the transaction process will be very complicated, and the power market will face multiple risks. To this end, the operating mechanism of the power sales market must be studied as soon as possible. This article analyzes and summarizes the development history of the electricity market in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Northern Europe. Based on this, it proposes the inspiration of the foreign sales market development experience to the construction of China's electricity sales market, compares and analyzes the electricity market models of various countries, and finally some suggestions are put forward for the construction of China's electricity market.

articleTitle: Cloud Motion Forecasting and Cloud Base Height Estimation Using Two Low-Cost Sky Cameras
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Passing cloud results in rapid irradiance changes. The intermittency of PV output power has drawn serious concern as the PV system installation increases. Consequently, power ramp-rate control (PRRC) is introduced as the regulation to limit significant power fluctuations. These requirements are driving an increasing demand for ultra short-term PV power forecasting. Sky imager has been used as an effective tool to predict the cloud motion, then to forecast the PV power. However, the high cost of sky imager system and low update frequency are still hindering its application in PRRC. The estimation of cloud base height (CBH) is also a challenging using sky imager. In this paper, a low-cost cloud motion tracking system has been developed. Ultra short-term cloud motion forecasting has been achieved in seconds level which can be used in PRRC application. The proposed cloud tracking method improves the forecasting accuracy by multiple cloud centroid tracking. Secondly, a novel sky camera based CBH estimation method is proposed. The effectiveness of the proposed CBH estimation method has been verified by experiment results.

articleTitle: The Smart Thermostat of HVAC Systems Based on PMV-PPD Model for Energy Efficiency and Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a smart thermostat based on ISO7730 standard's thermal comfort model-PMV-PPD model for improving energy efficiency and saving energy. In the smart thermostat, the desirable comfort level (PPD) set by consumers determines the ON/OFF state of the air-conditioner and the control signal is the predicted mean vote (PMV), which is calculated with indoor temperature, human factors and other climate index for precisely estimating people's comfort level. Besides, the potential of applying demand response is discussed theoretically by installing the purposed smart thermostats as a remote controller in order to shave the aggregate peak load of BVAC systems. Finally, a second-order Equivalent Thermal Parameter (ETP) model is applied to simulate 1000 residents in MATLAB/Simulink to test this method. The results have shown that by installing the smart thermostats, energy saving is up to 11.5%.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Surge Protective Device for Solar Panels
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Researchers for decades have utilized solar radiation as a sustainable renewable energy source. In this regard, Photovoltaic (PV) panels are satisfying the production of green energy and clean power. Frequently, these panels need to install on rooftops outdoor fields for maximum sun light feeding, thereby high-energy conversion to electricity. However, such PV systems installations are prone to direct or indirect lightning strikes. Herein, an impulse generator is designed to produce 750 V pulses for low voltage side to test the validity of our proposed surge protective device (SPD) as type-2. Moreover, the impulse generator provides 1.2/50μ<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$s$</tex> and 8/20μ<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$s$</tex> normalized voltage and current pulses, respectively. This approach controls the over-voltage caused by indirect lightening and thus protect solar panel systems. Furthermore, in the design of SPD, different components such as gas-discharge tube, transient voltage suppresser, metal oxide Varistor and Zener diodes are used to manage the impulse voltage at acceptable level. These results further highlighting the validity of implemented hardware.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Algorithm to Harvest Maximum Power from Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) systems are gradually becoming the key renewable source of electrical energy. But the nonlinear characteristics of the PV module require special techniques to harvest maximum power. The techniques used to track the Maximum Power Point (MPP) from the nonlinear I-V characteristics through power electronic circuits are known as Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) techniques. Although enormous MPPT techniques have been anticipated in literature, each endures its own advantages and disadvantages. This paper proposes a novel hybrid technique to enhance the performance of Incremental conductance (InC) technique. Our proposed technique removes the limitations of InC under rapid changing environmental condition. It improves the efficiency and reduces the oscillation power loss under steady state. A hybrid combination of variable-step sized Incremental Conductance with Fractional Short Circuit Current (FSCC) technique is proposed in this research work. Initially, the FSCC forces the PV system to work near MPP and then InC technique track the exact peak. Matlab/Simulink software is used to implement the proposed hybrid technique. Finally, the results verify its superior performance under rapidly changing environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Short- Term Prediction of Wind Power Based on Adaptive LSTM
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the randomness and uncertainty characteristics of wind power time series, a wind power prediction method based on the multivariable adaptive long short-term memory (Adaptive LSTM) is proposed. Firstly, in the case where many influencing factors of wind power coexist, the Pearson correlation analysis method is used to extract the influencing factors that have strong correlation with wind power as the prediction model input. Secondly, in order to overcome the shortcomings of subjective setting of super-parameters during the LSTM predictive model training. it is proposed to use genetic algorithm (GA) to optimize the hyperparameters of predictive models. At the same time, in order to avoid falling into the hyper-parameters local optimum, the genetic algorithm is improved to obtain the optimal prediction model. By comparing the example data with the prediction results of various prediction methods, it is verified that the proposed adaptive LSTM prediction model is not only effective but also has higher wind power prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Operation Management of Power Grid System with Renewable Energy Sources and Energy Storage System Integrations
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Sudan is a large country because of the large territory and the distance between communities are simply too great, a full- scale power grid is almost impossible to realize. As a result, the construction of small Island power grids in remote areas has been developed. The country shows favorable conditions for the generation of electricity by renewable energies such as wind and solar. Nyala city has been chosen as a preferred wind farm location because the power supply by the existing diesel power plant is expensive due to high costs for fuel transport and the reliability of power supply is low due to uncertain fuel provision. This paper presents a formulation of security-constrained unit commitment (SCUC) with diesel generation and integration of wind power and solar photovoltaic with the compressed air energy storage system (CAES) for Nyala city power plant. The proposed system is formulated as a mixed-integer programming, which is solved in CPLEX 12.7.0. and the results show that the proposed model is suitable for renewable integrations into the power grid system with energy storage systems.

articleTitle: Single-Phase Ground Fault Traveling Wave Line Selection Method and Line Selection Device Field Test
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the grounding line selection technology is applied to the field. Under a substation model, the SL-0l grounding line selection device is used for small current system, and multiple tests are carried out in the field, and the corresponding waveform analysis is carried out. In this paper, the principle of small current system single-phase ground fault line selection based on transient traveling wave is studied, and the influence of neutral grounding method on traveling wave line selection method is analyzed. The corresponding device hardware and software algorithm is designed to solve the high frequency problem. Field test results and waveform analysis show that under the existing technical conditions, it is feasible to use high-speed sampling technology and wavelet algorithm for traveling wave selection. SL-0l traveling wave line selection device can meet the needs of the site.

articleTitle: Research of Photovoltaic Systems MPPT Based on Improved Grey Wolf Algorithm Under Partial Shading Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The power-voltage (P-V) characteristic of photovoltaic (PV) arrays under partial shading conditions (PSC) displays multiple peaks. The conventional maximum power point tracking (MPPT) techniques are not often able to distinguish between global and local maximum power point and have continuous fluctuation that occur can lead to power frequency oscillations at maximum power point. The intelligent algorithm has great changes in voltage in the process of searching the global maximum power point (GMPP). Therefore, an improved grey wolf algorithm (IGWO) is proposed in this paper. Aiming at the nonlinear characteristics between the PV array output voltage and boost circuit duty cycle, take a nonlinear change on the convergence factor of GWO, and the location update adopting adaptive adjustment strategy, reducing the magnitude change of the voltage in the search process. Simulation results show that the proposed method improves the tracking efficiency to 99.88%. The voltage change range is reduced to 158V, and the tracking time is shortened by 0.46s compared with that of GWO.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment of Distribution Network Considering Cyber Attacks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of the smart grid, a large number of intelligent sensors and meters have been introduced in distribution network, which will inevitably increase the integration of physical networks and cyber networks, and bring potential security threats to the operating system. In this paper, the functions of the information system on distribution network are described when cyber attacks appear at the intelligent electronic devices (lED) or at the distribution main station. The effect analysis of the distribution network under normal operating condition or in the fault recovery process is carried out, and the reliability assessment model of the distribution network considering cyber attacks is constructed. Finally, the IEEE-33-bus distribution system is taken as a test system to presented the evaluation process based on the proposed model.

articleTitle: An Ultra-Short-Term Wind Power Forecasting Approach Based on Wind Speed Decomposition, Wind Direction and Elman Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accurate prediction of wind power is significant in the field of wind power. However, wind power has strong nonlinearity and non-stability, which will bring a strong difficulty to predict it accurately. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a wind power prediction approach using wind direction, wind speed components and Elman neural network (Elman NN). The wind speed series is decomposed by wavelet packet decomposition (WPD) and ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD). The decomposed wind components and wind direction are used to realize wind power component prediction through Elman neural network. Another Elman NN is used to merge wind power components under the guidance of wind direction to obtain forecasting wind power. The forecasting result shows that (a) the wind power forecasting approach using wind speed components and wind direction has good forecasting performance; (b) the fusion Elman neural network for wind power components can make the forecasting result more accurate.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonic Characteristics and Harmonic Counteraction Problem of EV Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The development and popularization of electric vehicles (EV) are inseparable from the construction of charging stations, but EV chargers are nonlinear loads, which will bring harmonic pollutions to the power grid. In this case, research on harmonic problems of charging station has practical significance. In this paper, model of a single charger and charging station were established. The variation law of harmonic ratio (HRI), total harmonic distortion (THD) and total demand distortion (TDD) of current with the number of chargers are analyzed under the same charging power or different powers respectively. Then, the mechanism of harmonic counteraction among chargers was analyzed and simulated. The simulation results in this paper showed that: with every charger in the charging station running at the same power, the harmonic current caused by each charger is exactly the same, thus there is no harmonic counteraction; when the operating power of chargers are different, the harmonic amplitude and TDD reduced compared with that under the same power. There exists harmonic counteraction among chargers. In addition., harmonic counteraction is more obvious in higher harmonic orders.

articleTitle: A Protection Scheme Based on Positive Sequence Fault Component for Active Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the high penetration of distributed generations (DGs), the conventional radial distribution network is becoming an active distribution network (ADN). In general, DGs can be divided into two types: rotating type distributed generations (RTDGs) and inverter-interfaced distributed generations (IIDGs). Compared with RTDGs, the fault characteristics of IIDGs are more complex. This will reduce the reliability and sensitivity of traditional overcurrent protection. To provide effective protection for active distribution network, a novel protection scheme based on positive sequence fault component (PSFC) of current is proposed in this paper. This scheme uses the amplitude ratio of PSFC at the two ends of the protected line as the operating quantity, and uses the phase difference of PSFC to construct the threshold. This scheme fully reflects the advantages of PSFC, such as reflecting all types of faults, not affected by the load, sensitive under the condition of high resistance fault. Finally, a simulation modeling based on PSCAD is set up to verify the feasibility of the proposed protection scheme.

articleTitle: The Design of Fixed Bird-Repellent Fitting for Eliminating Bird Damage in Substations
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Birds pose a considerable threat to the safe operation of substations. A bird's nest is often found on the frame of the substation. In this case, failure may occur at any time due to bird damage if no effective measures are taken in time. In order to solve the problem of perplexing bird damage in substations for a long time, this paper develops a new type of bird-repellent fitting that contains two parts: trapezoid metal plate and u-shape support fitting. By installing new type bird-repellent fitting at the nests in the frame, it is nearly impossible for birds to build nests, thus, bird damage is controlled.

articleTitle: Multi-energy Coordination and Schedule Considering large-scale electric vehicles penetration
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The paper propose a novel multi-energy management strategy considering the energy storage and electric vehicles(EVs) participation. Power grid load fluctuates violently because of the intermittence of renewable energy. Data center(DC) energy consumption is taken into account and sustainability supplied by a priority of renewable energy source(RES) in this paper. The priority of a large number of EVs for scheduling is calculated and formed a charge/discharge priority list of schedule EVs. And then based on this.the renewable energy scheduling algorithm(RESA) and optimal charging/discharging control strategy of EVs are presented couple with comprehensively considering the state of multienergy output and real-time grid load. The overall energy management strategy aims to minimize the power fluctuation of grid. The simulation results demonstrate that the strategy proposed could effectively neutralize the intermittence of renewable energy and balance the load fluctuation of power grid to some extent. Meanwhile the EVs users' requirement for routine use could be flexibly satisfied.

articleTitle: Operation Risk Assessment of AC/DC Hybrid Distribution System Based on Two-Point Estimation Method
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The operation risk assessment of AC/DC hybrid distribution system is of important to determine the operational status of the system and realize risk-based optimal scheduling. In this paper, a risk assessment method for AC/DC hybrid distribution network with fully consideration of VSC control modes is presented. In order to ensure the rapidity and accuracy of the assessment, a probabilistic power flow calculation based on two-point estimation method is proposed. The proposed two-point estimation method uses only two calculations of the deterministic power flow to calculate the statistical moments of the power flow solution, thus effectively reducing the calculation time of risk assessment. Finally, an AC/DC hybrid distribution network with three AC distribution areas and one DC network is employed to validate the proposed method. By comparing the results with Monte Carlo method, the validity of the model and method proposed in this paper is verified.

articleTitle: The Energy Efficiency Prediction Method Based on Gradient Boosting Regression Tree
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The prediction of building energy efficiency is the key technology in building integrated energy management services. The results of energy efficiency prediction directly reflect the changes of energy efficiency of buildings under the current management level and management strategy. Data analysis can provide guidance for improving management level and adjusting management strategy. Firstly, according to the characteristics of building energy efficiency, an algorithm model of gradient-lifting regression tree is constructed; then, a method of building energy efficiency prediction based on Gradient Boosting Regression Tree model is designed, which is based on a large number of historical data, and established through feature extraction and iterative learning. To satisfy the operational requirements of the model, the first and two derivative of the customized objective function are defined. Finally, the predicted results are explained and analyzed by using LIME with an example, which provides a basis for the formulation of alternative strategy and the improvement of energy efficiency management level.

articleTitle: Analysis of Transformer Abnormal Heating Based on Infrared Thermal Imaging Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of infrared heating thermal imaging technology, it plays more and more important role in fault diagnosis of power equipment. In order to facilitate on-site troubleshooting of power transformers, this paper firstly introduces the structure of common faults locations (Military Cap and end screen) and then analyzes common heating faults of transformers combined with practical cases using infrared detection technology. It can be seen that infrared detection technology is very convenient and practical for transformer fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Combined Electricity-Gas-Heat Energy Internet Scheduling with Power-To-Gas and Renewable Power Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a promising utilization for the future development of energy, the Energy Internet is receiving more attention. In the Energy Internet, electricity, gas, heat and other energy forms are utilized and coupled together. A combined electricity-gas-heat Energy Internet scheduling method is proposed in this paper. The renewable power uncertainty is modeled based on recently proposed truncated versatile distribution and involved in the scheduling model, in which the renewable power cost is considered by underestimation and overestimation penalty. The overall economy is achieved by fully considering the power-to-gas devices, combined heat and power generators and gas-fired boilers. Numerical studies for the day-ahead BES scheduling in an industrial peak are presented to demonstrate the merits of the proposed method. Results show that by capturing renewable power uncertainty, the system cost could be greatly reduced. The energy and gas storage could both greatly contribute to reduce the cost of renewable power uncertainty.

articleTitle: A Method of Electricity Consumption Behavior Analysis Based on Rough Set Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For data mining on big data of electricity consumption in smart grid, cluster analysis is used to extract information value and optimize strategy of demand response. Compulsively attributing electricity consumption behavior to the class whose center is closest to, existing methods have deficiencies when a behavior has characteristics of multiple classes. Therefore, a method of electricity consumption behavior analysis in smart grid based on rough set fuzzy clustering is proposed. By introducing rough set, the result of clustering is expressed as lower approximation set and upper approximation set to retain data information on the characteristics. Case study shows that the method is effective to improve clustering accuracy rate, and provide a precise description of target group for demand response.

articleTitle: Scheduling Strategies of Smart Community with Load Aggregator-based Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to obtain more demand response resources to take part in the scheduling of public grid, load aggregator can be used to explore demand response ability. In this paper, household appliances in smart community are divided into 4 types according to the consumption characteristics of appliances. And then, a dispatching model of load aggregator is formulated to finish the reduction amount of energy demand which is planned by dispatching center of public grid. Simulation result shows that load aggregator can reasonably control users' appliances and peak to average ratio (PAR) of public grid can be also reduced.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Development Status and Problems of China's Offshore Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing attention of countries on clean energy and renewable energy power generation, the development of renewable energy in China, especially wind energy, has been progressing rapidly, which has become an extremely important part of China's energy development. China's offshore wind energy resources are abundant, and it has unique advantages in developing offshore wind power. However, compared with onshore wind power, the development of offshore wind power faces some new problems and challenges. This paper systematically sorts out the development status and future planning of offshore wind power installed capacity in China, combines the resource conditions of offshore wind power and the progress of project construction in some areas, and studies the difficulties and problems existing in the development of offshore wind power projects, and proposes to promote China's sea. The measures for wind power development are expected to provide reference for the effective use of offshore wind energy resources and the construction of large offshore wind farms in the future.

articleTitle: A Virtual Inertia Control Strategy for Dual Active Bridge DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Dual active bridge (DAB) DC-DC converter replaces the Buck/Boost circuit for its advantages such as electrical isolation, buck and boost in voltage with high ratio and high-power applications, which has been widely used in energy storage systems. In view of the DC bus voltage vulnerable to power fluctuation in DC micro-grids, a virtual inertial control method for DAB DC-DC converter is proposed in this paper. Analogized with the virtual synchronous generator to be introduced to increase the inertia of the AC microgrid, the virtual inertia control is proposed on the basis of the original dual phase shift control of the converter. When the power in a DC microgrid fluctuates, the energy storage system will provide inertia power support to strengthen the DC microgrid inertia and suppress the DC bus voltage fluctuation. In the proposed inertia control, the first-order inertia link is used to substitute the differential link to avoid high-frequency interference to the input signal. Finally, the DC microgrid model is built by Matlab/Simulink and the time domain simulation is carried out. It has been verified that the control strategy put forward can suppress abrupt change of the DC bus voltage during power fluctuation effectively, but slow down its recovery process. Appropriate control parameters can make the proposed control strategy work better.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Microgrid Cluster Simulation Based on RTDS
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In areas with abundant distributed energy, the trend of microgrid cluster is becoming more and more obvious. In order to achieve the real-time simulation of operation status, and to verify the coordination control and energy management strategies of microgrid cluster, this paper builds up a microgrid cluster model based on the demonstration project of Sanli Yizhong, covering photovoltaic, fan, gas turbine, fuel cell, etc. The operation status of grid-tied and islanding are simulated and the fault information is collected, so as to verify the validity of the microgrid cluster model.

articleTitle: Combined Power- Water Flow Analysis of Regional Integrated Electricity and Water Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Multi-energy system has been a rising concept in recent years and there has been considerable research work on combined analysis, planning and operation of integrated power, natural gas and heating networks to explore the potential synergic benefits from multi-energy utilization. However, the integration of electricity and water networks is seldom considered in existing researches although these two networks are intrinsically coupled by components such as electric-motor-driven pumps (E-pumps). This paper, therefore, proposes to study the combined power-water flow analysis of integrated electricity and water networks (IEWN). With a focus on the regional IEWN composed of unbalanced power distribution system and municipal water network, the power-water flow problem is formulated with E-pumps being the coupling component and then the problem is solved utilizing Newton-Raphson method and Hardy-Cross method. Numerical results from a testing system that composes of a 33-bus distribution system and a 9-node water system are used to verify the integrated power-water flow analysis proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Heavy Load and Overload Distribution Transformer in Regional Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Heavy load and overload distribution transformers will have a heavy effect on power supply reliability and quality service. In this paper, heavy load and overload of 10kV distribution transformers in regional power grid of Hubei Province from January 2017 to June 2018 are analyzed from different dimensions, including time and area. The risk prediction of 10kV distribution transformations during the peak summer period in 2018 is carried out, including heavy load, overload, high failure rate and low voltage. The conclusions can provide a reference for better understanding of heavy load and overload distribution transformer and guiding operation and planning of distribution network.

articleTitle: Study on Group Control Charging System and Cluster Control Technology of Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, China's electric vehicle scale is growing very rapid. Along with the integration of “Internet +” technology, the electric vehicle charging service has gradually changed from the construction of charging facilities to the improvement of charging infrastructure utilization efficiency. The charging device of the existing charging stations usually takes the one-to-one mode, that is one power unit with one charging terminal. However, this one-to-one mode cannot expand the charging power and allocation the power flexibly, which leads to the low charging infrastructure utilization rate, difficult in upgrading of charging equipment and improving user demand. The intensive design idea in traditional substation, switch station and other places has gained popularity and the promotion, if it could be applied to the field of electric vehicle charging, charging infrastructure benefits of efficiency, improving the user experience will be of great difference. In view of this, in this paper, a preliminary study of the electric vehicle charging group control system and cluster control technology is proposed, in which the overall design of group control system is firstly given, then the application scenario electric vehicle charging group control system is analyzed, and finally the cluster control technology is analyzed in detail. The research results can provide scheme support for the cluster control of widely connected charging facilities.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy for Transient Performance Improvement of LCC Based HVDC Transmission System with STATCOM Under Weak AC Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: LCC based HVDC transmission system linked to the weak AC grid suffers from severe operational problems like continuous occurrence of commutation failure and longer fault recovery time during various fault conditions. In order to cope with these operational problems different FACTS devices are used. However, to get better results there is a need of proper coordinated control strategy (CCS) between FACTS devices and HVDC system. This paper presents a novel CCS between LCC based HVDC transmission system and STATCOM. The configured CCS is based on employing extinction angle of the LCC-HVDC system, implementation of drop rate limiter and reactive power control mode of STATCOM. The CCS is developed in PSCAD/EMTDC and various transient simulations are performed in order to validate its effectiveness on transient performance of the study system. The analysis shows that CCS can improve the transient performance of HVDC system by enhancing the commutation failure immunity index (CFII), reducing the risk of occurrence of commutation failure in inverter station and significantly improve the fault recovery performance during single and three phase AC faults.

articleTitle: Improvement in the Efficiency of Inverter Involved in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The topic of research “Improvements in the efficiency of the inverter involved in microgrid” is very versatile. The microgrid is one of the most prevalent areas of present research. Role of an inverter in a microgrid is very important. Our focus on the smart consumption which is the important part of microgrid. This research paper develops an approach to improve the fundamental voltage magnitude and phase angle output based on dead time (DT) compensation method for inverters. The Industrial load is comprised of running Induction motors (IM) and generators etcetera. 90 percent of an industrial load depends on induction motors. The running induction motor (IM) gives way to the abundant amount of power losses. Additionally., the parametric values of induction motors are improved and controlled by Variable Frequency Drives (VFD). Furthermore., Fundamental Voltage Magnitude is decreased without compensation and is increased after the dead time compensation technique is used. Similarly., Phase Angle output is distorted without dead time compensation and improved after dead time compensation. The designed system model is simulated for useful graphs. These results are analyzed and compared with primitive work.

articleTitle: Automatic Demand Response Strategy of Local Pure Electric Vehicle With Battery Energy Storage System Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Blockchain is a decentralized basic data architecture and distributed computing paradigm that is gradually recognized by everyone with the rise of digital cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin. The application of blockchain technology in the energy field has been extensively explored because of its characteristics and the development needs of the energy Internet. This paper provides a solution for the automatic demand response of pure electric vehicle with battery energy storage system based on blockchain technology, which firstly introduces the fit between blockchain and the system, then constructs the node model of the system, and studies the price formation mechanism, finally the automatic demand response strategy based on blockchain technology is constructed.

articleTitle: Circulating Current Suppressing and AC Faults Ride-Through Capability Analysis of Zhoushan MMC-MTDC System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The paper introduces the general situation of the world's first five-terminal modular multilevel converter direct current transmission project- Zhoushan modular multilevel converter multi-terminal direct current (MMC-MTDC) transmission project. The overall structure and major function of its control system are analyzed and summarized. Based on the research of circulating current suppressing control strategy and AC fault ride-through strategy of MMC-MTDC control system, several experiments were performed to analyze the circulating current suppressing effect of MMC-MTDC system and the fault ride-through capability of MMC-MTDC system under four kinds of faults, including AC single phase grounding, AC two-phase grounding, AC two-phase short-circuit and AC three-phase short-circuit. The research result provides technical support and theoretical guarantee for operation security of Zhoushan MMC-MTDC system.

Author Keywords: Voltage Source Converter Multi-terminal Direct Current (VSC-MTDC)

articleTitle: A Novel Virtual Inertial Control Strategy for Double-Stage PV Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With an increasing penetration of PV generation in the electrical grid, the increasing replacement of large conventional synchronous generators by PV generation will result in short frequency regulation capability due to the reduced system inertia response. It is urgent for PV generation to take part in frequency regulation spontaneously. A virtual inertia control strategy based on the dynamic of high voltage DC capacitor for double-stage grid-connected PV generation is proposed in this paper. The influence of control parameters on virtual inertia control strategy is also analyzed. Finally, the theoretical analysis and control strategy are verified by simulation results. The results show that PV generation can provide more support power in the process of frequency sag when the integral coefficient of Boost converter voltage control loop is increase to slow down the dynamics response of DC voltage.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage Exceeding Limits of Active Distribution Network Caused by Distributed Photovoltaic
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, distributed power sources represented by photovoltaics are being widely connected to the distribution network gradually with their clean and flexible power generation methods. The output of the distributed photovoltaic is easily affected by environmental factors, and this uncertainty will have a huge impact on the economics and reliability of the distribution network. Aiming at the problem of voltage exceeding limits caused by distributed photovoltaic access to active distribution network, this paper introduces the influence on the reliability of distribution network when distributed photovoltaic grid-connected, details the change of distribution network voltage after distributed photovoltaic grid-connected, and analyzes the control strategy of photovoltaic inverter. Also, the simulation model of photovoltaic power supply into distribution network system is established, explores the voltage variation of different line length, voltage load and conductor cross-sectional area after distributed photovoltaic access. The simulation results show that the problem of the voltage exceeding limits of the active distribution network caused by photovoltaic grid connection can be solved by photovoltaic inverter control effectively.

articleTitle: The Causes of Fire and Explosion of Lithium Ion Battery for Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Lithium batteries have been rapidly popularized in energy storage for their high energy density and high output power. However, due to the thermal instability of lithium batteries, the probability of fire and explosion under extreme conditions is high. This paper reviews the causes of fire and explosion of lithium-ion batteries from the perspective of physical and chemical mechanism.

articleTitle: Pilot Protection Method Based on S Transform Energy Relative Entropy for UHVDC Line
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The existing travelling wave protection for UHVDC line has low reliability under the high-resistance faults. A novel pilot protection method for UHVDC line based on S-transform energy relative entropy (STERE) has been proposed in this paper. Firstly, this paper analyzes the direction features of transient currents and voltage at the rectifier and inverter sides while internal and external faults occurred. Secondly, the STERE is used to represent the direction feature. Then the internal faults are distinguished from the external faults by using differences between STERE of both line terminals. Simulations based on PSCAD/EMTDC results indicate that the proposed protection method can recognize internal faults quickly and reliably under various fault conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Capacity Configuration for Distributed Generation of Island Micro-Grid with Wind/Solar/Battery/Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The accessing of renewable energy, such as wind and solar energy which is abundant on the island, can effectively alleviate increasingly serious problem of power shortage,creating conditions for the construction of an independent micro-grid. In order to meet the load demand in island micro-grid, this paper proposed the operation and control strategy of the isolated micro-grid system with wind/solar/battery/diesel engine based on the analysis of the basic characteristics of every distributed generation in the system. The corresponding mathematical model was built on the objective functions of minimizing the system total cost and maximizing the power supply reliability and it is constrained by the system power balance and the distributed generation output. The mathematical analytic method was adopted to optimize the number of every distributed generation in the micro-grid. The simulation was conducted on an island using the proposed model to obtain the optimal capacity configuration for distributed generation of the micro-grid, proving the model effective.

articleTitle: A Partition Coordinated and Optimized Operation Design for Power Grid Wide Area Coordination and Interaction Service
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traditional power grid has operated as the regional level way, which has to face with the problems of nonuniform interaction mechanism and non-timely data sharing, then leads that the large-scale power grid can not operate well with global coordinated optimization. According to the objective functions and constraint conditions of large-scale power grid coordinated operation, this paper adopts the wide-area cloud bus technology to coordinate the operation status of each regional power gird. Within each region, our proposed design employs the improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm combined with simulated annealing idea, to design the problem solution of minimizing the power loss in the region. This design in the paper aims to solve the problems of unified model, optimized operation and data sharing between cross-region and cross-level large-scale power grid, which provides a reference for the dispatching operation level of the whole power grid.

articleTitle: Resources Planning Strategies for Data Center Microgrid Considering Water Footprints
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the Internet wildly used among the world, social networking is incredibly heavily used. Data center, as the computing services supplier, is skyrocketing and exploding. Many researches have paid attention to the power consumption and carbon emission. Embarrassingly few of the existing studies focused on the water usage of the data center, despite of the enormity. Large data center operators should make significant strides in slashing the water usage. In this paper, a stochastic resource planning scheme is proposed to minimize the total cost for the microgrid considering the uncertainties of the renewables, wholesale electricity price and the power load. The results of the numerical case show the effectiveness of this model.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Matching Scheme of Renewable Energy Based on Renewable Energy Consumption Ability
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale development of new energy., the issue of new energy consumption has gradually emerged. Under the premise of guaranteeing reliable integration of solar and wind power., and maintaining stable and safe operation of the power grid., renewable energy acceptability of the grid may be different from grid strengths., power structures., or load levels. In order to comprehensively coordinate power supply resources of the grid., reasonably arrange the development scale and construction timing of new energy sources., ensure the scientific development and effective use of new energy power generation. In this paper., take Qinghai Power Grid as an example. The paper analyzes the new energy abandonment rate and consumption capacity of photovoltaic wind power from 2017 to 2019., puts forward the influence of different load levels., different delivery curves on consumption capacity of photovoltaic wind power. According to wind power generation characteristics., photovoltaic power generation characteristics., wind and solar complementary characteristics, based on new energy consumption capacity, the paper also puts forward the grid connection scheme that are the priority development of photovoltaic., the priority development of wind power., and the optimal ratio of wind and solar power. At last., the paper can give constructive advice for the follow-up new energy connection scheme to reduce renewable power abandonment.

Author Keywords: optimal ratio of wind and solar power

articleTitle: Electromechanical Modeling of the Direct-Driven Wind Turbine Generator Considering the Stochastic Component of Wind Speed
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes an electromechanical model of the direct-driven wind turbine generator considering the stochastic component of wind speed. The proposed model is implemented as a user-defined model in the Dynamic Simulation Program (DSP) developed by China Southern Electric Power Research Institute (SEPRI). All the electromagnetic dynamics, mechanical dynamics and controller dynamics which may influence the power system stability are taken into consideration, and are divided into eight blocks, to obtain an open and accurate model. Specially, the stochastic components of the wind speed are generated by the spectrum models of turbulences, i.e., Kaimal model and Von Karman model, which make this wind turbine generator model a flexible and convenient simulation tools for the power system stability study considering the uncertainty and volatility of the wind power generation.

articleTitle: Characteristic Analysis of Primary Frequency Modulation in Power System Under Different Types of Active Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large scale accessing of wind power to the grid, the power system will withstand different types of active disturbances. In other words, in addition to the traditional step change of the active power caused by the generator outages or sudden change of load, the random fluctuation of the wind power will also cause a distinct deviation of the system frequency. Since different types of disturbances will cause different frequency response characteristics, it inevitably puts forward higher requirements for the optimal configuration of the primary frequency modulation capacity and governor parameters to synchronous generators in the system. For this reason, based on the electromechanical dynamic model which equivalent to the single machine, this paper analyzes the different characteristics of the primary frequency modulation under the step type likes generator outages or sudden change of load and the sinusoidal form likes wind power fluctuation. At the same time, the simulation results of the IEEE 3-machine 9-bus system based on the DIgSILENT further show that the governor aimed at single type active disturbance can not better adapt to other types. This paper will lay the foundation for the primary frequency optimizing configuration of the power system which considering multiple types of active disturbances.

articleTitle: Optimal Intraday Rolling Operation Strategy of Integrated Energy System with Multi-Storage
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traditional energy systems face the problems of low energy utilization rate, expensive energy cost and inaccuracy prediction of day-ahead renewable energy power output and load demand. On this account, an optimal intraday rolling operation strategy of integrated energy system (IES) is formulated in this paper. First, mathematical models of multi-type equipment in the IES are established and their operation character and energy flow character are analyzed. Then, the rolling strategy model is formulated aiming at minimizing the intraday operation cost of integrated energy system and giving equipment more economic and reasonable operation scheme. Case study result proves that with multi-storage the intraday rolling operation strategy of integrated energy system could improve economic efficiency and reliability of energy system effectively.

articleTitle: Passivity-Based Control of DC-DC Boost Power Converter for MPPT used in DC Microgrid Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC microgrid systems can operate in both; islanded mode or grid-connected mode through a common DC bus, where the photovoltaic (PV) array supplying power to the DC bus by means of the dc-dc boost power converter. In grid-connected mode, the DC-bus voltage is kept constant by grid-connected control-loop using dc-ac power converter. To this end, the input voltage of the dc-dc boost power converter must be controlled so as to impose the operating point of the PV array provided by the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm. Thus, this paper presents a robust nonlinear control strategy using passivity-based control (PBC) to track a reference voltage provided by the MPPT algorithm of the dc-dc boost power converter used in DC microgrid systems. Based on the energy shaping and the damping injection technique, the PBC strategy provides a property of energy dissipation as well as robust voltage control. This control strategy ensures large signal stability as well as fast recovery performance of the system during irradiance changes. MATLAB simulation and OPAL-RT real time simulator results are presented to verify the control performance of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Power and energy balance of active distribution network considering operation-control strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid deelopment of demand-side response and active distribution network, the new method to power and energy balance is becoming more and more important. In this paper, the architecture of power and energy balance in active distribution network is proposed, which consists of three parts: load and generation forecasting, power and energy balance. Moreover, capacity-load ratio guidance is modified combined with the peak shaving potential and trusted capacity. Besides, the energy balance method considering the operation-control of distributed energy is proposed. Finally, through numerical analysis, the feasibility and practicability of the model are verified.

articleTitle: Smooth Switching Control Strategy for Microgrid Based on State Following Controller
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the low-voltage microgrid, due to current-shock and DC-side voltage fluctuations during on-grid or off-grid switching, a smooth switching control strategy based on state-following controller for microgrid is proposed in this paper. An improved pre-synchronization control is researched when dual-mode control at switching on-grid and off-grid is used for microgrid. At the same time, designed as a negative feedback, the output of the PQ controller or droop controller is input of the other controller to form two different smooth switching control methods with synchronous following. Simulation experiments verify the effectiveness that the proposed method can effectively suppress instantaneous current and voltage impact of the on-grid and off-grid switching, and ensure the smooth switching of microgrid operation.

articleTitle: A Blockchain Based Access Authentication Scheme of Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy Internet provides important support to power transmission and substation distribution links, security is particularly significant. However, access authentication centralized to the certification center has brought great pressure on computing and communications. In this paper, a distributed authentication scheme for the energy Internet is proposed based on the blockchain technology, which is decentralized and undeniable. A PBFT consensus mechanism is implemented with the Shamir threshold secret sharing mechanism. Experiments show that the scheme can effectively improve the concurrent access efficiency of Energy Internet terminals.

articleTitle: A Novel Frequency Regulation Strategy for Single-Stage Grid-Connected PV Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of PV generation, the synchronous generator space with rotational inertia has been crowded out. At the same time the reserve capacity of primary frequency regulation is decreased and the disturbance rejection ability is weakened. There is an urgent need to study PV generation actively taking part in power grid frequency regulation. This paper uses the single-stage PV generation as the research target, and proposes a novel system frequency support strategy based on the active power reserve, which introduces a f@ \pmbU\pmbdc compensation link to the DC-link voltage control loop of voltage source converter (VSC). The linear relationship between the DC-link voltage of PV array and frequency deviation is established in this paper. When the system frequency changes, the DC-link voltage reference U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dcref</sub>will be corrected by the f-U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dc</sub>compensation link and then the VSC will control the PV generation increase or decrease the power to counterbalance the grid frequency variation. The effectiveness of the control strategy is verified by the simulation results in time domain.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Pattern Recognition Algorithm Based on Sparse Self - coding and Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traditional partial discharge pattern recognition method has low recognition accuracy or long training time. In this paper, a new PD pattern recognition method is proposed. The PRPS map of the PD signal is extracted as the input data. The feature extraction and dimension reduction of the PRPS map are realized based on the Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) to obtain low-dimensional feature space that can express the original data highly. The Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) network is used as a classifier to realize the classification of PD. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm not only has a high accuracy of pattern recognition but also has a fast training speed.

articleTitle: A Cascaded Spatial Transformer Network for Oriented Equipment Detection in Thermal Images
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Equipment detection is a fundamental step towards automatic diagnosis in electric power industry. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to detect equipment parts, which are often oriented in thermal images due to the use of hand-held thermographic cameras. The proposed approach integrates a cascaded spatial transformer network (STN) and a proposal-driven detection network together. The introduces a rotation transform globally so that the rigid body constraint between parts is implicitly considered. Moreover, the cascaded scheme is also robust to large variation in orientation. The designed STN and the detection network are first trained separately to get good initialization weights. Further, these two networks are fine-tuned in an end-to-end manner. Experiments demonstrate that both the cascaded scheme and the highly boost the detection performance.

articleTitle: Security-Based Load Shedding Strategy Considering the Load Frequency Dependency in Island Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Load shedding is the last resort to prevent frequency and voltage from continuous drops when severe power imbalance occurs. With the high penetration of distributed generator (DG), the load shedding scheme are confronted with new challenges. Conventionally, the nonessential load would be cut off based on offline decision. However, this offline load shedding optimization exists some problems requiring further discussion. In one hand, the optimal load shedding scheme are designed based on either one of frequency and voltage security, which can not have good performance in real operation and may lead to severe contingency. In the other hand, load characteristics and DG model, which have significant influence in frequency and voltage performance, are not taken into account in offline optimization. In this paper, the discretized model of dynamic system frequency response (SFR) is considered to make appropriate load shedding plan. Different DG switching models are discussed and applied in offline optimization. The proposed model aims to minimize the expected load shedding amount as well as maintain the frequency and voltage under the security region. Numerical experiments in modified IEEE 33-bus system demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Integrated Energy System Based on Electrical-Thermal Energy Flow
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Safety and reliability are the basic requirements of integrated energy systems (IES). It is of great significance to carry out risk assessment research to ensure the reliability of energy supply of IES. In this paper, an electrical-thermal energy flow model with steam as the heat medium and its calculation algorithm are proposed firstly. Then the IES risk assessment hierarchy considering interests of both the system operator and users is designed, and the IES risk assessment procedure based on electrical-thermal energy flow is proposed. The results of the test case show that the proposed assessment method can effectively identify the overall risk of the multienergy flow system.

articleTitle: Research on Traditional Power Grid Enterprise Transforming to Energy Internet Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, the internet economy is springing up exuberantly, and the new round of energy revolution and digital revolution are integrated and advance shoulder to shoulder; the iteration cycle of technical innovation is gradually shortened; and various new patterns, new businesses and new modes emerge in an endless stream. Facing new situation and new change, it has been a major strategic subject for power grid enterprise to determine the future development direction and to realize transformation and upgrading. Based on the profound influence brought by the new round of energy revolution, scientific industrial revolution and social governance revolution, the thesis analyzes development trend and motivation of power grid enterprise transforming to energy internet enterprise systematically, researches the connotation of energy internet and energy internet enterprise profoundly, and states the path of transformation and upgrading of power grid enterprise to energy internet enterprise from multiple dimensions, i.e. strategic adjustment, power grid upgrading, technical revolution and business transformation, thus providing decision-making reference for innovative development of power grid enterprise under the new trend.

articleTitle: An Comprehensive Assessment Model for the Distribution Network with the New Type of Loads Based on the TOPSIS Method
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For decision makers, this paper proposes a method which integrates the secondary indicators into the first-level indicators and applies the TOPSIS comprehensive evaluation method to the comprehensive evaluation of the distribution network. The results show that this method has better accuracy and can meet the needs of comprehensive evaluation of distribution network.

articleTitle: Study on Transmission Planning of Combined Wind and Storage System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The characteristics of wind power generation and the technical breakthrough of energy storage equipment make it possible to put large-scale energy storage equipment into the power grid. The change of the output mode of the wind storage combined system will inevitably affect the operation of the system. The output power curve of the combined system of wind storage and storage system is segmented in the research cycle, and the optimized output strategy is formulated. Other thermal power units use the optimal economic dispatching principle to calculate the force value with the combined system of wind storage. The transmission planning model of the wind-storage joint system is established with the goal of maximizing the total benefit of the system. The example uses the typical sunrise force curve of the wind farm and the improved IEEE-18 node system. The artificial fish swarm algorithm (ASFA) is used to determine the cost and optimal transmission of the wind storage combined system 1, 2, 4 and 8 respectively. Comparing the cost of each segmented system, it can be seen that the transmission planning scheme at the time of the four-segment output is shorter than that of the transmission plan without the energy storage, the investment is reduced, and the total system benefit is the largest. The example proves that it is feasible to invest in energy storage equipment in the power grid and operate in a certain way to effectively reduce transmission investment and improve the economics of the system.

articleTitle: Study on Peaking Ability and Operation Safety of Thermal Power Unit in Peak Load Regulation of Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the demand for renewable energy access to the grid grows gradually, the peaking function of thermal power unit in grid system is increasingly highlighted. This paper analyzed the security problems of thermal power unit load, and to carry out the load test at 8 units. We analyzed the safety index, including hearth negative pressure fluctuations, water-cooled wall temperature, axial displacement of turbine, and found that some existing units can achieve 60%-70% peaking capacity without flexibility transformation. The negative pressure of some units fluctuates greatly, which reflects the poor stability of the boiler in the low load stage.

articleTitle: A power flow analysis method for the integrated electricity-heat system in distribution network based on forward/backward iterations
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an efficient way for improving utilization efficiency of energy sources and reducing the environmental pollutions, integrated energy system has gained rapid development. Meanwhile, traditional power flow calculation methods, which are focused on the electric power system, may fail to satisfy the need of analyzing coupled energy flow. In this paper, an integrated electricity-heat power flow method in distribution network is proposed. Firstly, models of electricity and heat networks are established in this paper. On this basis, an integrated electricity-heat power flow matrix is built, which is based on thermal model and a direct load flow method. Moreover, forward/backward iterations are utilized to solve the integrated electricity-heat power flow problem. The feasibility and effectiveness as well as accuracy, efficiency and robustness are simulated on a real distribution network.

articleTitle: Soft-Switching Analysis of Isolated Bidirectional LC Series Resonant DC-DC Converter with Phase-Shift Control
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Isolated bidirectional dc-dc converter has become the common topology of the key DC distribution equipment such as solid-state DC transformer in many systems of DC microgrid and AC/DC hybrid distribution network due to bidirectional active power flow control, high reliability and high power density. In this paper, IBDC is taken as subject investigated. Based on the fundamental harmonic analysis, the influence of harmonics on resonant current is considered. According to the modeling for the fundamental and harmonics, discussion on voltage gain, switching frequency and phase-shift angle is analyzed for soft switching characteristics and harmonic current. Finally, the simulation and experiment verify the correctness of theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Energy Management for Smart Energy Hub Considering Gas Dispatch Factor and Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the energy optimization management method in the integrated energy system with the smart energy hub. Firstly, the basic models of the smart energy hub and the user are established considering demand response and the impact of the gas dispatch factor of the smart energy hub on its profit to realize the coupling of electricity, heating and gas. Then an optimization model based on Stackelberg game is designed, in which the smart energy hub acts as the leader and the user acts as the follower. The optimization goal is the maximization of the two profits, and the game stops until the equilibrium solution finally achieved. Finally, for the typical case, in the MATLAB environment to solve the problem with the fixed dispatch factor and the changeable dispatch factor. The strategy of the smart energy hub and the user, the maximum profit of the two are obtained. The rationality of the results is analyzed based on the result.

articleTitle: Research on Power Flow Algorithm of LCC and VSC Hybrid Multi-Terminal AC-DC System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: LCC and VSC are essentially different in the steady-state model and working principle.
