It integrates the functions of transformers and various converters, and obtains flexible control abilities. It is significant to conduct a comprehensive feasibility study of utilizing flexible substations in distribution systems in China. Basic structure of the flexible substation is stated, and its multiple using patterns and characters are put forward. Issues including application scenarios, location selection, capacity determination, storage allocation, protection setting, insulation coordination, information communication and power quality for using flexible substations in practical distribution systems in China are proposed and discussed. Case study on Zhangbei flexible substation demonstration project design is conducted, and the results indicate the feasibility and flexibility of the flexible substation application.

articleTitle: Integration of Prosumers' Flexibilities in Distribution Network Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasing numbers of prosumers, which consists of multiple DERs, brings new opportunities and challenges to the operation of the distribution network. To harvest the prosumers' flexbilities, distribution system operator needs innovative methods, since i) decision variables of the dispatching model is too large to compute efficiently; ii) individual prosumer's privacy is difficult to be protected. Therefore, we present a unified quantitative model for multiple DERs, i.e., virtual battery (VB) model, and integrate multiple DERs into the prosumer cluster in the nodal unit to participate in the day-ahead optimal scheduling for distribution system operator (DSO). In this paper, we propose a day-ahead optimal scheduling model for DSO whose objective is to minimize the electricity purchasing cost in the day-ahead market under the guidance of the price mechanism of peak-valley electricity price. The security constrains are also considered in the model. Moreover, the non-convex network constraints are relaxed in the model, so that it can be solved by the second-order cone programming (SOCP). Then we can obtain the day-ahead scheduling with the minimum electricity cost of the total users, while meeting the network constraints. Finally, case studies are provided to demonstrate the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Post-evaluation Method and Index System for Energy Internet Projects Based on Attribute Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the promotion of green energy revolution and the strong support of policies, the development and construction of energy internet projects are booming in China. Post-evaluation for power grid projects can find the problems, put forward suggestions for improvement and guide the future project process management, which has an important role to realize the closed-loop and lean management. Considering the green, clean and efficient requirements of energy internet, this paper puts forward a post-evaluation method with its index system for energy internet projects based on attribute theory. Considering implementation process, effect and benefit, environment and social benefit, sustainability, a hierarchical multi-dimensional post-evaluation index system of energy internet project is established. Based on attribute theory, a post-evaluation method is proposed, including single index attribute measure, the index weight calculation and multi-attribute post-evaluation comprehensive evaluation method. Through the evaluation and analysis of energy internet engineering projects, case studies prove that this evaluation method can find out the problems existing in the project and analyze the causes of the problems, which is beneficial to guide the company's future investment direction and decision-making, and achieve accurate investment.

articleTitle: Research on the Isolated Bidirectional DC/DC Converter for Small Energy Router
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of power electronics technology, compared with AC and DC power distribution network, the energy router has tremendous potential for its obvious advantage and make a significant contribution to the energy internet. Firstly the key devices of the energy router is discussed and the network framework of the small energy router in user layer is proposed. Then the research status of isolated bidirectional DC/DC converter(IBDC) is reviewed systematically. Subsequently the circuit topology of dual-active-bridge(DAB) and resonant full-bridge are analyzed in detail, the corresponding control strategies are studied and the characteristics of above mentioned converters are also summarized. Finally the key issues of the power electronic transformer(PET) or solid state transformer(SST) to be solved urgently are also pointed for energy router application. Conclusions will provide essential theoretical and practical basis for industry application of future energy router.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Valuation of Virtual Power Plant in Multiple Electricity Markets
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Virtual Power Plant (VPP) is a flexible representation of a portfolio of distributed energy resources (DER) that allows them providing services to power systems and participating in electricity markets. This paper investigates a comprehensive valuation method of VPP and the units of DER in VPP for seeking the way to implement it in a real market environment. The applications of VPP in different electricity markets such as spot energy market, bilateral contracts, balancing market, spinning reserves and reactive power market are discussed. A cooperative game theoretical method is proposed to fairly share the market profit among the DER units in VPP. Numerical results derived from market simulation have shown the value of VPP in different markets and the effectiveness of the proposed valuation method.

articleTitle: Review of Coordinated Control Strategy for AC/DC Hybrid Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: AC/DC Hybrid Microgrid is an important part of Smart Grid in the future. It has prominent advantages in solving the energy crisis and environment. Compared with AC microgrid and DC microgrid, hybrid microgrid has high reliability, low construction and operation costs, and strong adaptability to various sources and loads. However, the development of AC/DC hybrid microgrid is hindered by power exchange and coordination control caused by various operation modes. This paper introduces the development of microgrid and outlines the coordinated control strategies and methods for AC, DC and hybrid microgrids. This paper summarizes the commonly used control strategies from the aspects of equipment, sub-microgrid and inter-microgrid control, and analyzes the application characteristics and existing problems of each method. Finally, the problems existing in the development and application of AC/DC hybrid microgrid are analyzed and prospected.

articleTitle: Application of Fog Architecture Based on Multi-agent Mechanism in CPPS
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the cyber-physic power system (CPPS) scenario, an increasing number of new devices, such as large-scale electric meters, embedded controllers and powerful computing devices are introduced into the power system. However, the architecture of present power system limits the seamless integration of the information system and physical systems. In this paper, a decentralized CPPS-fog architecture is proposed to address this issue. The proposed architecture distributes computing, communication storage, and control these services to the edge network along the cloud-to-thing continuum while the latter is commonly used in the smart grid. By applying the new architecture to the power system, the intelligence resources of the power system are effectively allocated to the parts closer to end users. Moreover, the realtime monitoring, on-line simulation, information integration, large-scale distributed control, and information security protection are easily achieved. The feasibility and advantages of the CPPS-fog architecture are demonstrated by the application in an island micro CPPS grid project.

articleTitle: A Robust Three-Phase Power Flow for Active Distribution Network Embedded Autonomous Voltage Regulating Strategies
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale distributed generators (DGs) penetrated into the active distribution network (ADN) impact the voltage profile significantly. Autonomous voltage control strateges simulation becomes an crucial issue in the ADN steady state analysis. Conventional Newton-Raphson or fixed point iteration based power flow convergence failure is frequently incurred by heuristic Q-limit adjustment of DGs and voltage band regulation of step voltage regulator (SVR). To cope with these issues, mixed complementarity problem (MCP) is formulated to model the Q-limit issue of voltage controlled DGs and voltage regulation of SVR etc.. To improve the convergence of the proposed method, nonlinear equations are linearized with Newton algorithm and then fast Lemke algorithm are utilized to solve the linear complementarity programming model (LCP). The effectiveness and better performance of the proposed method under operation off-limit of DGs and tap adjustment of SVRs were validated using unbalanced IEEE 4, 34, 123 test feeder and other large practical three-phase network test case.

articleTitle: Consensus Based Distributed Solution of Economic Dispatch Problem for a Micro-Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper economic dispatch problem (EDP) of a micro-grid structure is studied using distributed consensus algorithm based on graph theory. In a power system economic dispatch ensures the optimal power utilization by finding an identical value of incremental cost for each bus. So, the incremental cost is adopted as a consensus term while using local information of mismatch between active power generation and total load demand as feedback in order to solve EDP in this paper. The proposed scheme is fully distributed and requires no leader or central control for achieving consensus. Various cases are used to study the effectiveness of proposed scheme. Simulation results conclude that incremental cost converges to its optimal value whether load demand is varying or generators plug-and-play.

articleTitle: A Robust and Model Predictive Control Based Energy Management Scheme for Grid-Connected Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the number and scale of microgrids that connected to the main grid have grown obviously in recent years, and furthermore as the output of renewable energy and the level of user load in microgrids are usually uncertain, how to maintain the economic operation of microgrids while reducing microgrids' potential impact on the main grid has become a challenging problem. An energy management scheme which combines the robust optimization approach and model predictive control approach is proposed to cope with this problem. The proposed scheme divides the energy management work into two stages: a day-ahead stage and an intraday stage. In the day-ahead stage an energy management model is proposed to get the interaction plan between the main grid and the microgrid, and the robust optimization approach is utilized to deal with the uncertainties of renewable energy and user load. In the intra-day stage the model predictive control approach is adopted to cope with the updated predictive information in order to keep the real-time power balance of microgrids and reach this system's economic operational goal, in which the deviation between the interaction plan and the actual result of interaction is especially penalized to reduce the negative impact on the main grid. At last, the effectiveness of the proposed scheme of energy management for grid-connected microgrids is validated by simulation results, and comparison has also been conducted with other two schemes.

articleTitle: A novel unreliability tracing model for buck power systems based on contingency screening
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The unreliability tracing method is an efficient tool to quantify the risk contribution of components and identify the weak parts of power system. However, the tracing process faces the same complexity concern as reliability evaluation of a bulk power system. To address this problem, this paper proposes a novel unreliability tracing method with a contingency screening model and a new tracing principle. Firstly, the bilevel contingency screening model can screen the most severe contingency, which can perform as a substitution of State enumeration (SE) and the Monte Carlo (MC) simulation in reliability evaluation. Meanwhile, the new tracing principle is proposed to incorporate the influence of failure components on load shedding so that the masking phenomenon in the tracing process can be avoided. A similar contingency reduction technique is also developed to facilitate the analysis process. Case studies on the RBTS and RTS demonstrate that the proposed method is effective in terms of accuracy and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Two-stage Robust Optimal Dispatch Method Considering Wind Power and Load Correlation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of variable renewable generations, power systems are facing new problems of safety and economic operation. This paper proposes a two-stage robust security-constrained unit commitment (SCUC) method considering wind power and load correlation, which minimizes the operation cost while guaranteeing that the robust solution can be adaptively and securely adjusted in response to continuous load and wind uncertainty intervals as well as discrete generation and transmission contingency security criteria. In addition, this paper also considers the correlation of the change between wind power and load, and proposes a sample correlation elimination method based on Cholesky decomposition to eliminate the non-existent extreme scenes and reduce the conservativeness of the robust solutions. The proposed model is solved by the combination of modified Benders decomposition (BD) method and column-and-constraint generation (C&CG) algorithm, which decompose the original problem into a master UC problem for the base case and security checking subproblems for uncertainties. Numerical simulations on the modified IEEE 118-bus system illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed robust SCUC model for the secure and economic operation of power systems under various uncertainties.

articleTitle: Dynamic Bayesian Network based Reliability Evaluation of Supervision and Control System in Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on analysis of operating mechanism of smart substation supervision and control system (SSCS), Dynamic Bayesian Network (DBN) was introduced to evaluate the reliability of SSCS. First, function of SSCS was divided into three types, and corresponding functional reliability block diagrams (RBD) were established. Secondly, the DBN model and its solution of SSCS were implemented based on the functional RBD. Finally, a study case was presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results show that dynamic characteristics of SSCS could be well described by DBN and hence provide reference for the system configuration optimization, and fault diagnoses.

articleTitle: Online Identification of Transient Stability and Unstable Generators Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Machine learning methods have been considered as a promising method for online transient stability analysis. This paper presents a deep learning approach for transient stability prediction and unstable generator identification based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The post-disturbance dynamic responses of all the generators are utilized as the input features. A binary classification CNN model is generated for transient stability prediction. And a multi-class classification CNN model is built for unstable generator identification. Moreover, the multi-class CNN model can provide the unstable probability of each generator using the probability outputs and the label information. Comprehensive studies are conducted on the New England 10-machine 39-bus system to verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Study on Cascade Hydropower Stations Coordinated Optimal Scheduling Model Considering Transmission Section Capacity Limitation and Target Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A high proportion of hydropower grids have been formed in the southwestern region. In the flood season, hydropower projects crowd out the transmission channels, affecting the safety of the grid and causing serious spilled water electrity. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a coordinated optimal scheduling model for cascade hydropower stations considering transmission section capacity limitation and target generation. The model takes the largest amount of power generation and the minimum amount of spilled water electricity as the objective function, and considers the transmission section capacity limitation as well as the power generation target quantity constraint. To solve this model, the nonlinear constraints are transformed into linear constraints, thus facilitating the solution. At last, case study is carried out on a provincial power grid located in Southwest of China. The results show that the proposed method can handle complex transmission constraints, and use the different regulation ability of hydropower plants to achieve greater total electricity absorption and effectively reduce spilled water electricity.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Scheduling of Combined Natural Gas and Electricity System with Mid-and Long-Term Electricity Contract Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the background of further electricity market reforms and rapidly increasing penetration of gas-fired units in China, it is of economic and environmental importance to construct combined natural gas and electricity system with mid-and long-term electricity contract decomposition. The traditional scheduling model of combined natural gas and electricity system does not account for the problem of contract decomposition, and its scheduling plan formulation deviates from the actual application requirements. In this paper, the nested optimization of mid-and long-term electricity contract decomposition is considered in the scheduling model. For the case that the decomposition results may be non-executable in the scheduling plan, a method based on Lagrange multiplier is proposed for the first time to find the infeasible factor. And a coordinated optimization method is proposed to eliminate the infeasible power quantities, accounting for the effectiveness of medium and long-term transactions. In addition, the second-order cone relaxation method is adopted to linearize the nonlinear boundary of natural gas flow. Case study results verify the rationality and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Local Consumption of DG in Multiple Energy Forms for Facility Agriculture with Time-Shifting Loads
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Facility agricultural load demands are constantly growing in rural areas of China, whereas large capacities of distributed solar generation in these areas are causing power quality problems when solar power is transferred back to the power grid. As a result, the most efficient way to handle both problems is supplying agricultural loads with distributed solar generation. Due to the stochastic and intermittent characteristics of solar power and weak structure of rural power grid, this paper proposes local consumption as the way to achieve the aforementioned goal. As facility agriculture greenhouse is getting more and more prevalent in modern agriculture, the intelligent agricultural loads with time-shifting characteristic are considered. Besides, the energy form of facility agricultural loads is various. Heat, electricity and information networks are all tightly interconnected to form an Energy Internet. Energy router is then introduced to coordinate the energy and information flows in the system, as well as to monitor and manage the operations of distributed generation and loads. The model of each component and the control model are established. Based on the concept of demand response, a local consumption control strategy has then been presented to actively adjust time-shifting loads to the change of distributed solar generation. At last, an example analysis is given to verify the effectiveness of the established models and local consumption control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Power Information Hybrid Simulation Technology of DC Distribution Network Based on Multi-terminal Flexible DC
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The multi-terminal flexible DC distribution network can realize the power supply of distributed power supply and the flexible operation of multiple DC loads, which is an important development direction of the future DC distribution network. The coordinated control and communication coordination of each converter station and multi-converter is the key to the safety and stability of DC distribution network. Therefore, in view of the physical information coupling characteristics of multi-terminal flexible DC systems, considering the coordinated control stability characteristics and information interaction capabilities between multi-terminal flexible converter stations, a master-slave control strategy based on multi-site cooperative communication is proposed. Then, combined with the real-time power simulation system RT-LAB and the network simulation tool OPNET, a power information hybrid real-time simulation platform for multi-terminal flexible DC distribution network is constructed to analyze the power information interaction process in different communication environments and its application to DC distribution network. Finally, with the Suzhou Four-Terminal Flexible DC Network Project as an example, the effectiveness of the proposed coordinated control strategy and power information hybrid simulation platform is verified by setting network communication congestion and delay in typical scenarios such as fault-locking and DC load disturbance of the master-slave converter station.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Configuration Optimization for Isolated Microgrid with Mobile Energy Storage and Shiftable Load
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The configuration of isolated microgrids is of great significance for military outliers built in remote islands and high mountains. To address practical concerns, mobile energy storage system and shiftable load are specifically introduced to represent military battery pack and oxygen generation/seawater desalination unit, respectively, in this study. Then an optimal configuration model for isolated microgrids with multi-objectives is proposed, and it is tackled with an improved preference-incentive co-evolution algorithm (PICEA-ng). Numerical simulation validates the effectiveness of our proposed model and algorithm based on practical data. Finally, the role of the mobile energy storage and shiftable load on influencing the optimization objectives of the microgrid system is analyzed.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation of centralized protection system in smart substation considering impact of communication message
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The impact of communication message has not yet been effectively considered in the reliability assessment of the centralized protection system in smart substations. To address this issue, first, a method to evaluate the reliability of communication messages was proposed by analyzing the transmission mechanism of the communication message. Subsequently, based on the centralized protection system in D2-1-type smart substations, contrastive analysis focusing on the impact of messages on protection reliability under different networking modes and protection strategies was carried out. Finally, virtual local area network (VLAN) was applied to demonstrate its capability to improve the reliability of protective messages. The result shows that, the distributed protection is subject to the message reliability, whereas the centralized protection is not apparently affected by the message reliability. The reliability of protection systems is also impacted by different networking modes, and VLAN is conducive to improving the protection system reliability.

articleTitle: Incorporating Optimal Transmission Switching in Unit Commitment with a Probabilistic Spinning Reserve Criterion
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The optimal transmission switching (OTS) looks to find the optimal network topology. This new control functionality enhances the power system flexibility to adapt to the future changing conditions. This paper incorporates the OTS in the unit commitment problem with a probabilistic reserve criterion, here the spinning reserve (SR) is determined by minimizing the total cost where the cost related to the expected load not served (ELNS) is penalized in the objective function. To reduce the computational complexity, a transmission line categorization scheme is introduced for screening a small set of switchable lines, and the maximum number of switchable lines is determined by a heuristic procedure. By doing so, the computation efficiency can be greatly improved. The case studies illustrate the validity and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Shunt Active Filter for Extenuation of Harmonics by Compact Fluorescent Lamp Drives
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Compact fluorescent lamp (CFL) drives exhibit a highly non-liner characteristic. The current drawn by CFL lamps is non-sinusoidal and rich in harmonics. Effect of individual CFL units installed alongside larger linear loads is trivial. However, a large number of CFL lamps installed with smaller linear loads cause measurable harmonic distortion in current. Active power filters (APF) are a popular method of reducing harmonic distortion. APFs are much used in industry for extenuation of harmonics created by six pulse rectifiers and AC drives. Estimating the harmonic component of load current is essential to the performance of active power filters. While harmonic current estimation methods are developed for larger industrial harmonic loads, their performace with smaller loads as CFLs varies. This work explores the effectiveness of the instantaneous reactive power theory (IRPT) and stationary frame method in estimating harmonic component current drawn by CFLs. An active power filter is then modeled in Simulink using stationary frame method and its performance evaluated with six pulse rectifier load as well as three phase unbalanced CFL load.

articleTitle: Study on the recovery strategy of Multi-Terminal HVDC after the fault
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Multi-Terminal HVDC (MTDC) technology is one of the most important meathods to realize cross-regional and long-distance power transmission. The MTDC system generally takes use of power electronics technology based on the Voltage Source Converter and Pulse Width Management technology. Compared with the traditional DC transmission system, the MTDC system suppresses the generation of harmonics in the system. In fact, active power and reactive power are independently decoupled to realize four-quadrant operation in the MTDC system. At the same time, the rapid development of MTDC systems brings a big challenge to the fault isolation technology and the recovery strategy of the MTDC system. At present, the technology of DC circuit breakers in China is still not mature, and the converter commonly used in projects can not realize the isolation of DC faults in a very short time. Besides, after faults are cleared, the DC system needs to be precharged to resume itself. Thus, technology we make use of nowadays will be relatively weak in terms of the fault isolation technology and the recovery/restart strategy. At present, most research of domestic and foreign scholars mainly focus on fault isolation technology of the MTDC system. Fortunately, lots of outstanding results have been achieved in related fields. However, there are few studies on the recovery strategy of MTDC systems. Therefore, based on the analysis of characteristics of the DC fault appeared in MTDC systems, a four-port ring network DC transmission system model is established to study the main questions in the recovery strategy of MTDC system after the DC fault.

articleTitle: The optimization of household and apartment energy management system
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper state the optimization of household and apartment energy management system. The content propose 4 parts: the introduction including the background and the theory of household and apartment energy management systems; the design of household energy management (HEM) optimization systems which include the hardware implementation and software application; some case studies are discussed to illustrate the optimization results are effective, for instance it shows clearly that bills are reduced after optimize process; the final conclusions are indicated in the end. The mathematical model was built to solve the optimization problem. The usage of appliances are automatically changed by the system depend on the day-ahead electrical price. The control algorithm is depend on the mixed integer linear programming (MILP). Power balance is the most core idea of the system, since the shared battery system is raised and played as an important role in the control strategy. 4 households are combined together by using one shared battery storage system, which promote the optimization results. There are four case studies are supposed in this paper, which reflected in the impact of different price mechanism; the impact of critical load; the impact of battery size and the impact of generation part. These case studies are comprehensive discussed to certify the optimization effect is obvious.

articleTitle: Robust Economic Dispatch of Grid-connected AC/DC Hybrid Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the uncertainties from renewable energy sources and loads, the paper presents a novel two-stage robust optimal economic dispatch model for grid-connected AC/DC hybrid microgrids. The model is decomposed into a master and slave min-max-min problem with mixed integer linear structure. A robust economic dispatch result is obtained by using the column-and-constraint generation algorithm(C&CG) to solve the day-ahead optimization problem for AC/DC hybrid microgrids, which minimizes the daily operating cost. A case study is conducted to further demonstrate the effectiveness and capability of the proposed model in this paper for the operation dispatching of AC/DC hybrid microgrids.

articleTitle: Short-Term Power Load Forecasting for Larger Consumer Based on TensorFlow Deep Learning Framework and Clustering-Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper tackles a new challenge in high precision load forecasting of larger consumer with the background of electric power big data. The proposed short-term power load forecasting method is based on TensorFlow deep learning framwork and clustering-regression model. Proposed scheme firstly clustering the users with different electrical attributes and then obtains the “load curve of each cluster”, which is considered as the properties of a regional total load, and represents the features of various types of consumers. Furthermore, the “clustering-regression” model is used to forecast the power load of the certain region, which is implemented by TensorFlow deep learning framework. Extensive experiments show that the proposed scheme can predict reasonably the short-term power load and has excellent robustness. Comparing with the traditional model, the proposed method has a higher efficiency in dealing with large-scale data set and can be effectively applied to the power load forecasting.

articleTitle: Framework Design of Load Aggregators Participating in Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the market concept is gradually introduced into the power system, the attention and interaction on the demand side have been promoted to a new level, and the interests of participants in power system are gradually diversified. Load aggregator plays a more and more important role as an important coordinating organization between the power grid side and the user side. Based on the load classification, the definition of load aggregator is given, and the current situation of electricity market in China is reviewed and analyzed. The relationship between load aggregators and other market entities is analyzed, and the load aggregators are involved in the power supply. The key issues in the market are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: A Quadratic Constraint Quadratic Estimation Model for Three-Phase Distribution Network State Estimation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a quadratic constraint quadratic estimation (QCQE) model for three-phase distribution network state estimation. The proposed model takes into account the measurements collected by SCADA and phasor measurement units (PMUs). Rectangular coordination is adopted to decompose phasor measurement values and state variables into real and imaginary parts. By introducing intermediate variables and quadratic equality constraints, the measurement models proposed are quadratic polynomial in order to establish QCQE model, which can be solved by suitable optimization algorithm with sparse techniques. This method can decouple the modeling and the algorithm implementation of state estimation, reducing repeating work and enhancing the efficiency of algorithm implementation significantly. Numerical tests on the IEEE 33-bus system demonstrate that the proposed method is robust and efficient.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Cloud Energy Management for Wide Area Integrated Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The future energy Internet presents an explosive access situation, and cloud computing technology will play an important role in the energy management field of the energy Internet. In this paper, the key technologies of the cloud energy management for the wide area integrated energy Internet are studied. The basic functional framework of the cloud virtual energy management center and the content of the cloud services are proposed. At the same time, the following key technologies are analyzed, including information interface technology to protect user privacy and information security, highly customizable multi energy integrated optimization scheduling model and solution method, and cloud computing resource virtualization technology. Through the research of this paper, the structure system, function positioning and key technology of the cloud energy management are clarified, which provide a new solution for the operation and management of the wide area integrated energy system in the future. It can significantly reduce the cost of construction and operation, provide customized energy services for the wide range of users, and improve the efficiency of energy utilization.

articleTitle: An optimization method of Voiceprint Recognition based on user portrait
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voiceprint is an important component of creating a user portrait. Voiceprint Recognition can determine user's identification. However, speech signals in the customer service system are processed by encoded with compression for effective transmission and storage. The low-bit rate codec results that the performance of Voiceprint Recognition system dramatically reduces. What is more, the speech number of each customer is not adequate. In order to solve the problem, this paper proposes a model compensation method. The method uses a test utterance with expectation maximization (EM) algorithm to estimate the distortion model and the UBM is adjusted to match the codec type of the test utterance. Voiceprint Recognition experiments are conducted. The results show that the proposed method is able to dramatically improve the performance of the system.

articleTitle: An Optimal Dispatch Strategy for Distributed Micro-Grids
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Grid structure is changing rapidly in light of current energy policies with the addition of more renewable sources for reduction of carbon emission. Decentralized and low voltage grid are promising approaches to integrate non-dispatchable renewable resources as compared to centralized. It is a recent trend to install local micro-generation like microturbine, fuel cell and energy storage system to reduce microgrids' dependency on main grid and intermittent effect of renewable units. Due to the increasing variety of energy resources with different characteristics, dispatch scheduling is getting more challenging. The authors propose a scheduling solution from an operator's point of view. The main objective of the study is to minimize the cost and emissions caused due to each microgrid. Further, it is observed that transmission losses are reduced for sale and purchase from the main grid.

articleTitle: Voltage Control Method Based on Coordinative Optimization of User Energy Saving and Power Loss Reduction in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Both distribution network power loss and users' energy cost are taken into account in voltage control in this paper. According to the voltage characteristics of load and network loss, the feasibility of optimizing the users' energy cost and power loss by voltage control is discussed. On this basis, a voltage control model based on coordinative optimization of load and loss reduction of distribution network is established, considering the regulation capability and cost of on load tap changer (OLTC) transformers, distributed generators (DG) and capacitors. The improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to obtain the optimal regulation capacity of the voltage regulating equipment at all times of a day. A topology simplification method of distribution network is studied to improve the practicability of the method. The simulative results of the actual distribution network verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Modeling of a Two-Stage Photovoltaic System for Grid Code Compatibility
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A complete modeling of two-stage photovoltaic (PV) system operating under large grid disturbances is developed in this study. The grid-integrated PV system are expected to operate through low voltage and provide grid reinforcement by delivering the reactive current during voltage dips, as per most grid standards. Proper current references generation and appropriate controllers design are basis for the effective realization of low voltage ride-through (LVRT) capability. Accordingly, a complete LVRT strategy based on Chinese grid code is developed for PV system under large grid disturbances to enhance power quality and stability. The developed scheme contains the current references computation technique to achieve the provisions of grid code and to guarantee seamless function for PV system under abnormal grid conditions with current amplitude limit functions. Numerous field tests and simulations are performed to evaluate the efficacy of the developed strategy.

articleTitle: A Microgrid Coordinated Energy Management Approach Based on NARMA-L2 Model
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This papers presents a distributed cooperative management approach for microgrid using NARMA-L2 model. The ping control, a distributed control approach that only needs partial information of the microgrid, is introduced at first. Considering the difficulties of determining the ping control parameters of dynamic model of distributed generation, NARMA-L2 model is adopted then. The reference value generator within the cooperative control model is determined using gradient descent searching algorithm. To evaluate the performance of proposed distributed cooperative management approach, a microgrid model including four distributed generators is established as the testbed. The simulation results of difference scenarios have shown that the proposed control method has good control performance in realizing the target of power sharing and fast voltage recovery within the microgrid.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Risk Assessment Technology in Grid Switching Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The grid switching operation may cause power system accidents. Dispatchers need to conduct risk assessment on switching operations to enhance the operational security. Currently the dispatchers lack an effective risk assessment method. This paper first proposes a risk index severity function based on improved utility theory, improving the accuracy of the risk severity indicator by setting the slope of the index loss coefficient curve in different overshoot and overload intervals. Then the concept of the optimal risk assessment area unit is proposed, accurately reflecting the impact of a specific operation on the grid by dividing the evaluation area unit to exclude the interference data. The paper also proposes a dynamic risk indicator threshold depending on the optimal risk assessment area unit, which makes the risk assessment focused and discriminative. Finally, the case analysis proves the correctness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Leverage Effect of Large Capacity Centralized Heat Storage for Wind Power Consumption
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large scale electric heat storage is very obvious to improve the power dissipation of the power grid. However, there are few quantitative studies on its function, especially the quantification of the improvement of the regulating capacity of the thermal power plant. In this paper, the working principle and dispatching strategy of large capacity heat storage device installed in a large thermal power plant are briefly introduced and analyzed. This paper proposes a lever analysis method for heat storage devices before and after input, as well as during the beginning and the end of heating. The relationship between the capacity of heat storage device and the demand of heat network and the constraint of power grid is discussed. Combined with the actual case, the lever multiplier of regulation capacity of the heat storage device relative to the heat storage capacity and before heat storage input is analyzed. The regulation capacity of heat storage device to thermal power plant during heating period is quantified, which is of great significance to fully understand the role of heat storage technology in the elimination of wind power in the northern region.

articleTitle: Allocation the Benefit of Electric Power Alternative using Cooperative Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Implementing electric power alternative (EPA), which aims to replace fossil energy with electric power in terminal energy consumption, is important to respond to the Chinese national policy of energy-saving and environment-protection. In order to allocate EPA benefits to participants in a fair and equitable manner and further encourage end-users to participate in EPA, this paper introduces the cooperative-game-based methods to allocate EPA benefits among all participants. Firstly, this paper makes a quantification for the economic benefits and environmental benefits of EPA in terms of the operation cost and emission reduction. Then we discuss the allocation of the EPA benefits by using nucleolus and Shapley value method, respectively. Finally, the proposed cooperative-game-based allocation methods are applied to a numerical example power system, and efficiency and rationality of the methods are verified.

articleTitle: Medium and Long Term Electricity Demand Forecasting of Different Industries Based on Deep Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accurate medium and long-term load forecasting plays an important role in the planning, construction and operation of power system. In this paper, a medium and long term electricity demand forecasting method of different industries based on deep belief network is put forward. In order to cope with many complicated factors in medium and long term electricity demand forecasting, the proposed method takes advantage of powerful function modeling ability of deep belief network and selects a number of quantifiable main influencing factors as input variables, and establishes a medium and long term electricity demand forecasting model based on deep belief network for each load types classified of different industries. Simulation example shows that the proposed method has higher prediction accuracy than the traditional neural network algorithm.

articleTitle: Technology of Satellite-Ground Combined Video Transmission Based on Quantum Key Distribution
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traditional key generation distribution system will not meet the demands of the power industry for extremely high security levels. The quantum key distribution system has been constructed in China power industry, but its range of service is limited now. To extend the range of the service, a satellite and ground combined technology for video transmission is proposed in this paper. Based on the existing communication resources of the power industry, the quantum key distribution technology is used in this satellite and ground combined video transmission services. The high security level protection of video transmission via quantum key is realized. Quantum signal rapid rectifying technique and quantum relay technology are used to overcome many technical difficulties such as multi-relay node and hybrid network of buried optical cable and overhead optical cable. It has achieved a significance progress in the application of quantum key distribution technology in the power industry.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Service Auto Expansion and Fusing Technology for Dispatching and Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of the ultra-high voltage power grid, the service structure of the current power grid dispatching and control system has been unable to meet the urgent needs of the dispatching organization for service state perception and service control. A service management center is set up to realize real-time monitoring of the dynamic quality information of the service and obtain the health of the dispatching system service. The service automatic expansion and contraction technology to cope with the peak of service requests is proposed, which automatically increases or decreases service entities and makes full use of system resources. The service fusing technology that calls for competition is proposed, and service fusing decision algorithm and self-healing mechanism are proposed, which can effectively prevent the systemic risk from the extreme situation from the system service call level, and ensure the smooth operation of the system as a whole. At present, the research results are running well in the verification system, and the service control level of the dispatching and control system has been effectively improved. The next step of the project promotion will provide a powerful guarantee for the security, stability and efficient operation of the power grid dispatching and control system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Faults and Protection Schemes for Magnetically Controlled Shunt Reactor
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we investigated the MCSR simulation model installed on EHV bus from a protection point of view. Different types of faults are identified that may occur on the electromagnetic part of MSCR, based upon its locations. The faults are applied to a simulation model while closely monitoring the behavior of fault current, voltage, and their sequence components at different points. Due to the unique structural design of MCSR, separate protection schemes are adopted for each winding. In view of the damage of turn-to-turn fault and limited electrical protection schemes for its detection, special attention is given for such types of faults inside power and control windings, and an algorithm is proposed to identify the faulted winding in case of a turn-to-turn fault.

articleTitle: Research on Wind & Thermal Power Joint Bidding Strategy Considering Penalties for Wind Power's Bidding Deviation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the growing maturity of wind power technologies and the decrease of wind power construction costs, wind power producers, who are always price takers, gradually become the market participants with strategic bidding capacity in electricity market. However, wind power producers should be responsible for the loss caused by bidding deviation when they participate in electricity market due to uncertainty of wind power, which can cut down their benefits. In order to study the bidding strategies of the wind power producers in day-ahead market, a wind & thermal power joint (W&T) bidding model considering penalties for wind power's bidding deviation was established based on supply function equilibrium approach, in which Monte-Carlo method and backward reduction were used to simulate future wind power. In addition, particle swarm optimization method is used to solve the model. Compared with the independent bidding, a simulation example showed that wind & thermal power joint bidding can effectively improve the revenues of wind power producers, especially increase the incomes from day-ahead market, so that the initiative of wind power producers in day-ahead market can be greatly enhanced.

articleTitle: A Power Network Planning Method with Coal-to-Electricity Considering Technical and Economical Adaptability
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A power network planning method with coal-to-electricity considering technical and economical adaptability is proposed in this paper to effectively solve the problem that traditional planning method does not consider the influence of coal-to-electricity. First, a technical and economical analysis model considering is set up, which breaks through the modeling difficulties of coal-to-electricity. The scale and specific household distribution of coal-to-electricity is quantitatively determined. Meanwhile, the investment composition, added electricity price and investment payback period are calculated, which provide useful advice for implementing coal-to-electricity and formulating subsidy policies. Besides, an engineering solution method based on multi-factors adaptability analysis is proposed to universally and practically solve the above model. Eventually, an actual application is shown to further illustrate the proposed model.

articleTitle: A Closed Loop Operation Analysis Software Based on the Integrated Model of the Entire Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The closed loop operation is a common method to improve power supply reliability of distribution network. When a distribution network dispatcher performs a closed loop operation, a large circulating current may be triggered if a suitable operating point cannot be selected, which will cause the protection action and deteriorate the reliability of the power supply and the stability of the system's safe operation. Closed loop operation risk analysis software can provide good technical support for dispatchers. However, because the existing analysis software is always hard to obtain the complete grid model and equipment parameters, the equivalent model can only be used for approximate calculation, which makes the analysis performance discounted. Therefore, a closed loop operation analysis software based on the integrated model of the entire power grid is proposed in this paper. The software is based on the state estimation results obtained from the wide area service bus. The case studies demonstrate that it can establish an entire grid-based integrated calculation model and provide basic data analysis for the electromagnetic loop checking, so that the centralized analysis and decision making of the closed loop operation can be supported and the accuracy of the electromagnetic loop can be improved.

articleTitle: Research of Stability Control Strategy at the Sending End of UHVDC After Block Fault
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Block fault of ultra-high-voltage direct current (UHVDC) for large-scale renewable energy long distance transmission will have a significant impact on sending end power grid. To study the stability control strategy at the sending end power grid, firstly, characteristics of sending end power grid and the impact of start-up mode of bundled thermal power on transient voltage after the block fault of UHVDC are studied using Hami-Zhengzhou UHVDC as an example. Secondly, a thorough analysis of the effects of different AC filters removal schemes in converter stations and types of shutting-off generators on transient voltage rise is presented, and the control time coordination issue of these two types of controls is studied as well. Finally, principles and methods for decision-making of stability control strategy for UHVDC block fault are proposed, which could provide valuable reference for follow-up studies on UHVDC.

articleTitle: Review on distribution network planning methods considering large-scale access of flexible load
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of active distribution network and demand-side response, the effective utilization of large-scale flexible load is one of the main trends of the future distribution network development. In this paper, Energy Internet demonstration park has become the focus of international academy and industry. In this paper, shortcomings of the existing methods and new methods in load forecasting, power, and energy balance and planning evaluation are proposed, which emphasize mostly on the impact of flexible load on the distribution network. Then, the planning optimization method considering flexible load is discussed, and the relevant theoretical results are summarized from the aspect of uncertainty, multi-objective and multi-agent. Finally, the relevant technologies of future distribution network planning are prospected.

articleTitle: Economic Impact of Distributed Photovoltaic Network Capacity on Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on distributed photovoltaic control of distribution network harmonic, reactive power compensation, network loss and energy saving and emission reduction benefits, the economic impact of distributed photovoltaic grid connection on power system is studied. And calculate the specific cost-benefit for different distributed photovoltaic grid-connected capacity, providing reference for regional distributed photovoltaic planning.

articleTitle: Research on the Problems and Countermeasures on the Reform of Transmission and Distribution Price
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since the 21st century, with the fast development of social economy, the demand for electric power increased rapidly. The reform pace must be accelerated to meet the needs of social economy. This paper at first describes the basic practice and effects of the transmission and distribution price reforms in China, then analyzes the reform issues from command economy theory, makes rectification and improvement plans to provide valuable reference to the deepening reforms.

articleTitle: Network Parameter Estimation for District Heating System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we explore the network parameter estimation in the district heating systems (DHS). A parameter estimation model using multiple operation_different conditions is proposed. The roughness and the heat transfer coefficient of each pipeline of supply and return networks are estimated. The topology of the DHS is analyzed to calculate the number of the conditions acquired. A quantitative analysis of the temperature measurement error is also developed. Two case studies are carried out to verify the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Secondary Control for Power Sharing in a Standalone Microgrid under Unequal Feeder Impedance and Complex Loads
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: AC Microgrids (MG) play significant roles in maintaining the stability of the conventional power system. A MG may contain linear, nonlinear and unbalanced loads whose nature of energy consumption can result in distorted voltage causing system instability. In the MG, the discrepancy in feeder impedance and complexity of loads results in poor power sharing. Therefore, this research focusses on the poor power sharing arising from the above stated conditions. The hierarchical control consisting of the proportional integral resonance (PIR) and adaptive virtual impedance-based compensation primary and secondary control for power sharing in a stand-alone AC MG is proposed and verified in MATLAB/Simulink. The results demonstrate that the DG units in the MG achieve balanced power sharing in transient and steady-state operation despite the difference in feeder impedances. In addition, a slight deviation in frequency and voltage magnitude caused by the conventional droop control is restored using the secondary control.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Scheduling of Thermal Generation under Air Quality Ecological Compensation System Considering Wind Power Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the air quality ecological compensation (AQEC) system, the government provides financial incentives to lower air quality indexes (AQIs). For thermal power plants, integrating the temporally and spatially differentiated impacts on regional AQI into day-ahead generation scheduling can result in an optimal AQEC. Thus, this paper proposes a win-win unit commitment and power dispatch model for the government and generation companies under the AQEC system. The model incorporates the Gaussian puff dispersion of multiple air pollutants and stochastic wind power scenarios into the security-constrained unit commitment (SCUC) model, and the AQEC prices for differentiated thermal units are calculated based on regional population and AQI level. With the objective function of maximizing total AQEC, the SCUC model is formulated as a mixed-integer programming problem. Case studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model in reducing regional AQI in a hybrid thermal and wind power system. Furthermore, the impacts of AQEC price and wind generation on AQI abatement are quantitatively analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Power Price Pricing Method of Distribution Network Nodes Considering Energy Saving and Emission Reduction of Distributed Power Sources and Market Game Behavior
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the market environment in which the distribution business is released in an orderly manner, the market behavior of the distributed power generation (DG) operating entity will further increase the uncontrollability of its output. The main body of the distribution network needs to intervene and control the output of the DG to a certain extent by using electricity prices and other means to reduce the uncertainty caused by the distributed power access. To this end, this paper proposes a distribution network node price pricing method based on the market cooperation game concept, considering the distribution of gas emission reduction tasks in distribution networks, according to the priority of gas emission reduction and distribution network operation subject income, Applying its best coping strategy to the calculation of node price to compensate the price of distributed power units participating in energy conservation and emission reduction, improve the control and management level of distribution network operators for a single distributed power unit and multiple distributed power unit combinations in the region.

articleTitle: Calculation and Consumption Method of Multi-Time Period Abandoned Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: China has already become a big country in wind power. It not only has the largest installed capacity in the world, but also has the largest amount of electricity generated. In particular, the disposable wind power is also the highest. In 2016, the power of the abandoned wind reached 49.6 billion kWh. In order to solve the large amount of abandoned wind power problems in the rapid development of wind power, this paper proposes models for annual and daily abandonment rule of wind power in the power grid and the analytical model of the maximum abandoned wind capacity and the maximum wind power law. Combined with practical examples, it reveals the rules of abandoning the wind in the northern power grid, which has important guiding significance for understanding the abandoned wind power and selecting the type of energy storage technology for abandoned wind.

articleTitle: Power System Transient Stability Assessment Based on Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A novel method of power system transient stability assessment based on principal component analysis is proposed. Firstly, rotor angles after fault removal measured by wide area measurement system (WAMS) are utilized as the original data. Secondly, do principal component analysis on these data., obtaining the covariance matrix and its eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Next, PCA transform is used to construct principal component virtual generator. After that, equal area criterion (EAC) is used to evaluate the transient stability of the first principal component virtual generator, which is consistent with the stability of the original system. Case studies are conducted on the New England 10-machine 39-bus system, IEEE 16-machine 68-bus system and Northeast Power Coordinated Council 48-machine 140-bus system respectively to verify the similarity of transient stability between the original system and the first component virtual generator.

Author Keywords: the first principal component virtual generator

articleTitle: Bidding Strategy of Power Generation Enterprises in Hunan Medium and Long-Term Trading Market
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Combined with the background of power market reform, this paper first analyzes the big environment of Hunan power market. Secondly, from the three links before, during and after the transaction, the decision-making strategies of power generation companies in medium and long-term transactions were studied, and a relatively complete quotation system was established. It has certain reference significance for power generation enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Energy-Storage Capacity Optimal Configuration Based on Scenario Analysis and Seven-spot Ladybird Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: One of pivotal question in wind/photovoltaic/energy storage system is the optimal configuration of energy-storage capacity. Regarding this question, a method for configuring the power and capacity of a single energy storage medium is proposed in grid-connected system of renewable energy. Firstly, the models of wind power, photovoltaics and storage are built, respectively. And then it establishes the objective function of energy-storage capacity's optimal configuration to minimize the sum of the initial investment cost and operating cost of energy storage, and resolves it based on scenario analysis and seven-spot ladybird optimization (SLO). Finally, a large number of cases are analyzed based on combined power generation system of wind/photovoltaics /battery storage hybrid power system and the effectiveness of the energy storage configuration strategy and high efficiency of algorithm are demonstrated through results of simulation.

articleTitle: Analytical Method for Power Grid Dispatching Centralized Thermal Storage to Reduce Wind Abandoned Rate
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to achieve clean heating and reduce the rate of abandoned wind, the northern region has invested in various heat storage devices, especially the large-capacity heat storage devices invested by thermal power plants to improve adjustment flexibility. In this paper, the calculation method of electric power consumed by large-capacity heat storage device and the calculation method of electric power abandonment wind power are proposed. The relationship between the input timing of the heat storage device and the timing of abandoning wind is researched, and the delay of deep peak shaving of the unit after the input of the heat storage device is discussed. It has been verified by actual data, and it has a demonstration effect on the consumption of wind power through thermal storage in the northern region.

articleTitle: Adjustable Robust Dynamic Economic Dispatch of Renewable Energy Considering Statistical Information
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Robust economic dispatch is a secure and effective approach to account for uncertainties of renewable energy. But because of the fluctuation and intermittent of renewable generation, the conservativeness of robust model is bound to produce additional regulation cost. In this paper, a conservativeness-adjustable robust economic dispatch (CA-RED) approach is proposed to reduce the conservativeness of robust dispatch (RD) by varying the pre-defined confidence level referring to dispatcher's acceptability to risk. With accuracy statistical information of the forecast error fitted by Gaussian mixture model (GMM), all constraints with uncertain variables are converter to linear constraints and the problem can be solved by convex optimization which is ultra-efficient. Numerical Test results show that the proposed method is effective in reducing the allocation of reserve and the conservativeness of RD with controllable risk level.

articleTitle: Heating Operation Scheduling Mode and Optimization based on Wind Power and Regenerative Electric Boiler in Xinjiang
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of wind power industries in Xinjiang, the large-scale abandoned wind power caused by insufficient local consumption capacity has become increasingly prominent. In winter, the operation of traditional cogeneration units take up a lot of load space, which makes the wind aggravation phenomenon more serious. This paper adopts a new heating system based on wind power and regenerative electric boiler combined heating to solve this problem. Firstly, the feasibility of developing wind power for heating in Xinjiang is analyzed. Then, based on the characteristics of randomness and uncontrollability of wind power, the wind power coordinated with regenerative electric boiler for heating optimization scheduling is established with consideration of the robust constraints,. Finally, an example analysis of a new electric heating project in Xinjiang area is carried out to demonstrate the effectiveness of the model and the economic and environmental benefits of using electric heating in Xinjiang.

articleTitle: Distributed Energy Storage System Planning in the Distribution Network Considering the Reactive Power Capability and Network Reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presented a mixed-integer second order conic programming (SOCP) model for the distributed energy storage system (DESS) planning in the distribution network. Aimed at minimizing the present value of total investment of DESSs and operation costs of distribution network with high DG penetration, active and reactive power regulation and reconfiguration of the distribution network in different periods were investigated simultaneously. The proposed model used second order conic relaxation to enlarge the feasible region and make the optimal problem convex. Effectiveness of the model was tested on the Wulong distribution network, which is a practical network with high hydroelectric penetration. Result of DESS planning in the distribution network was compared with the simulation of distribution network operation without DESSs. Besides, the effectiveness of SOC relaxation was verified.

articleTitle: Discussion on the distributed intelligent development of energy internet
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy Internet is a major innovation in energy development, it involves the concept of Internet of Things, all the existing energy information (distributed generation, supply, consumption) can be connected through the network, get timely feedback, and select control according to demand. Energy development has undergone a micro-energy network, centralized supply, and then to distributed, decentralized, and to achieve ubiquitous state. Now in the distribution of the need for energy stations, there need to achieve synergy among the distribution energy. The Energy Internet distributed collaboration requires artificial intelligence to support its distribution, and distributed optimization synergy in turn requires a lot of artificial intelligence tools. Blockchain technology, as a distributed and shared database technology, has been applied to the concept of energy Internet because of its centrality, transparency, fairness and openness.

articleTitle: Research on power grid fault diagnosis based on model matching and AI correction method with multi-dimensional data
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A power grid fault diagnosis method based on model matching and AI correction method with multi-dimensional data is proposed to solve the problem that the mathematical model and operation of the current fault diagnosis method are complicated and the diagnosis result is difficult to explain. Firstly, the mathematical model of fault coding is established. Then, the method of correcting the misinformation of alarm information by discrete Hopjield neural network is introduced. Then the standard fault feature library of the single line is established by K-means clustering method, and the method of fault type identification is given. Finally, the actual grid fault is taken as an example to verify the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Coordinated Calculation Method of Abandoned Large-Scale Wind Heat Storage for Heating
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The state encourages clean heating, and electric heating is an important component. However, the cost of conventional electricity consumption is high. If the abandoning wind power is used, it not only eliminates wind power but also reduces the cost of electric heating. Taking an actual power grid as an example, this paper proposes a coordinated dispatching strategy for abandoned wind heat storage for heating by studying the total amount of abandoned wind, heat storage capacity and heating capacity. This has great practical significance for a power grid with abandoned large-scale wind power and large-scale heat storage.

articleTitle: Analog Signal Malfunction Detection System of Audio-Distributing Frame Based on RFID/GPRS Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to effectively solve the problem of judging the operation of the analog distribution signal of the audio distribution frame and the working condition of the connected cable, the analog signal fault detection system of the audio distribution frame based on RFID/GPRS technology is designed. The hardware part of the system includes ADSP21060 processor, RFID reading and writing module, video acquisition module, audio distribution frame analog signal fault detector, etc. The communication operation and maintenance personnel can simulate the substation, business network, and power supply station on duty according to this system. Signal fault detection and processing. The system is easy to use, greatly reducing the workload of front-line personnel, and is suitable for detecting the analog signal of the audio distribution frame and the fault of the connected cable.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment with High Distributed Generations Penetration Considering the Interaction of Transmission and Distribution Grids
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the integration of distributed generations and expanding loads, the uncertainty has become significant in power systems. To achieve exact evaluation of the operation security, a risk based assessment method considering the coordination of transmission and distribution networks is proposed in this paper. The probability models of power system components are proposed to approximate the uncertainty. To achieve voltage and branch power flow, global power flow (GPF) is calculated using a master-slave-splitting method to consider the coordinated operation of transmission and distribution networks. The risk assessment index is established considering both voltage and power flow security. A risk assessment process is proposed by using Monte Carlo method. The proposed risk assessment process is tested in an integrated transmission and distribution test system. The results of numerical simulation reflect the validity of the proposed assessment method.

articleTitle: Research on Verification Technology of Partial Discharge Ultra High Frequency Detection System of Combined Electric Appliance
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Scientific and effective verification GIS UHF partial discharge detection system, to ensure the safe and reliable operation of GIS equipment has a vital role. The verification method and sweep frequency calibration method of GIS partial discharge UHF verification system simulator are studied in detail. The verification method of GIS partial discharge UHF verification system based on GTEM chamber is proposed, and the calculation method of the three item performance indexes of the average effective height, the system sensitivity and the dynamic range of the UHF sensor is studied. The verification system is developed according to the verification method. An experimental study on UHF partial discharge detector with TWPD-2623 type was carried out through verification system. The accuracy of the verification method and the effectiveness of the verification system are verified through research. This paper has important guiding significance to GIS UHF partial discharge verification system network testing.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting of Buildings Based on Data of Mobile Base Station
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the establishment of large-scale buildings, the rapid increase in power consumption has had a major impact on the reliability and economy of the grid operation. Therefore, it is very crucial to make effective short-term load forecasting for building electricity. At the same time, as a new type of big data, data of mobile base station has been applied to military, transportation and so on. But in the power system, the data has not been applied.
