This paper proposes a multi-dimension hierarchical grey relational analysis method, in order to introduce data of mobile base station into building short-term load forecasting. The data is divided into meteorological dimension and mobile base station dimension. The grey relational analysis algorithm based on entropy weight method is used to analyze the horizontal and vertical associations. And the more relevant variables are selected as the input variables of load forecasting. Eventually, the effectiveness of the method is verified by an example.

articleTitle: A ZVRT Control Method for Controlling Output Current of Inverter
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a control method for zero voltage ride-through of inverter output current is proposed for the problem of off-grid of photovoltaic power station in single-phase drop of grid voltage. The method gives a reference value of the current positive and negative sequence according to the requirement of the zero-voltage traversing standard during the voltage drop, thereby avoiding an overcurrent problem that may occur during the fault of the inverter output current, and ensures the stability of the DC side voltage during the voltage drop. At the same time, this paper uses a second-order complex filter on the extraction of positive and negative sequence components to improve the extraction efficiency of positive and negative sequence fundamental waves. Finally, a photovoltaic grid-connected model is built on the MATLAB/Simulink platform to verify its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Model-Free Adaptive Controller for VSC in AC/DC Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Model-Free Adaptive Control (MFAC)technology is used to design VSC controllers for power supply in urban networks. The MFAC technology not only does not require the mathematical model or any other priori data of the controlled system, but can achieve superior control effects. In this way, the weak regulation or system instability caused by the model inaccuracy under great disturbance is prevented. When PI controller can't achieve a desired control effect, MFAC can improve operation conditions in which the system parameters could be varied drastically caused by the faults at AC sides. Based on the IEEE-13 node distribution network model, an AC/DC distribution network model is used to test the controller. Through the simulation of this system under both normal and abnormal operating conditions, the effectiveness of the designed MFAC controller is verified.

articleTitle: Internal Fault Analysis and Optimization Design of Main Protection Scheme for Large Condenser
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large condenser (300Mvar) has the possibility of inter-turn short-circuit in stator windings. Absence of protection against inter-turn short-circuit will be a serious threat for the safe operation of the condenser. Using the Multi-Loop analysis method, internal fault analysis and optimization design of main protection scheme are carried out for two kinds of condenser with different cooling modes. The analysis shows that different main protection schemes should be selected according to the difference in the number of branches per phase of the large condenser. Compared with the main protection scheme based on traditional electromagnetic current transformer, the complete or incomplete split phase transverse differential protection based on flexible optical current transformer will completely solve the problem of imperfect stator winding inter-turn short-circuit protection for large turbo-generator. And the new scheme has very small influence on the generator design and manufacture, thus guaranteeing the safe operation of generators.

articleTitle: Coordination Optimization for Energy Storage Configuration Based on Fusion of Multi-Level Objective
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The choice of energy storage capacity often requires consideration for many factors. The importance of various factors is different, resulting in large differences in operational effect. Take many factors into consideration, a multi-level objective fusion method of energy storage capacity coordinated configuration is presented in this paper. According to the importance degree of the objective, the hierarchical setting of model is established. The multi-attribute decision method based on fuzzy entropy weight is used to screen the satisfactory solution of Pareto solution set. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated by the optimization results on actual case.

articleTitle: Evaluation on Global Energy Interconnection Development of Main European Countries Based on 3D Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For a long time, the world energy development depends on fossil energy excessively, thus making problems such as resource shortage, climatic change and environmental pollution become increasingly obvious, and the living environment of human being is under great challenge. Therefore, it is imperative to promote energy system to transform towards green and low-carbon style. The strategic conception of constructing global energy interconnection obtained increasingly extensive recognition, and planning research, technical discussion, policy design, cooperation and communication, and other relevant jobs are implemented in different ways at different levels. The interconnection trend of regional power grid is increasingly accelerated, and the SuperSmart Grid, Interconnected Power Grid of Northeast Asia and the “Desert Solar Energy Plan” of transmitting power from North Africa to Europe are under active research and promotion. To reflect the development status of global energy interconnection all over the world intuitively, the research in this thesis proposes 3D evaluation model of global energy interconnection development. Based on this, the quantification is conducted targeting development situations of global energy interconnection in main European countries, which provides reference for further defining improvement direction and key development points and better promoting transnational and transcontinental power grid interconnection and clean energy development.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Nano-Carbon Fiber Grounding Grid Considering Short Circuit Current Distribution-Part II: Applications in the Grounding Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the first part of this paper, the calculation method of grounding parameters of nano carbon fiber grounding grid have been analyzed under the condition of split current distribution. In this paper, the calculation methods of ground potential increase, grounding grid potential difference, contact potential difference and step potential difference of nano-carbon fiber grounding grid after considering the distribution of short-circuit current are studied, and the control strategies of various performance indexes are studied. The research results show that: due to the high resistivity of carbon nanofibers material, the inner selfimpedance of the grounding grid is large, the reflux current and the shunt current have a great influence on the calculation of the grounding parameters of the carbon nanofibers grounding grids, and have the greatest influence on the potential difference within grounding grids.

articleTitle: Evaluation Index System for Clearing Models of Different Electricity Price Policies
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The electricity price policy of a region directly determines the operation of the electricity market in the region. The clearing model is the core problem of electricity price policy and marginal clearing pricing and high-low matching pricing are two popular mechanisms of electricity price clearing. The innovation of this paper is to propose a complete evaluation index system for the clearing model of different electricity price policies. The index system evaluates the operational effects of the electricity market from five aspects of market economy scale, market structure benefits, market security, environmental friendliness and social welfare. In this paper, the clearing models are presented. And then, the evaluation index system for the clearing model is proposed. Finally, it is introduced that the application of the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and the entropy weighted TOPSIS. Based on the actual trading results, each evaluation index is calculated. The marginal clearing pricing and high-low matching pricing are evaluated by the AHP and the entropy weighted TOPSIS, respectively. It is verified that the evaluation index system proposed can effectively evaluate the clearing model of different electricity price policies.

articleTitle: Power Losses Minimization In Radial Distribution Networks By Capacitor Allocation Using Hybrid Evolutionary Computation Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The current research presents a framework to solve the shunt capacitors' optimal allocation and sizing problem in radial distribution networks (RDNs) by a hybrid algorithm, named as Differential Evolution Cuckoo Search Algorithm (DECSA) which combines two efficient optimization methods, namely, Differential Evolution (DE) and Cuckoo Search algorithm (CSA), together. Loss sensitivity factor (LSF) is employed to determine the preferred capacitors' installation positions. The hybrid algorithm DECSA is developed to calculate the capacities and to solve the objective function by minimizing the real power losses while taking into account the permissible limits of nodes' voltages. Finally, the standard IEEE-33 bus power system is utilized to validate the evolved algorithm, results show that a good enhancement in finding the optimal reactive power flow is well achieved.

articleTitle: A Novel Integrated Energy System Decision Model Based on Minimax Regret Criterion
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of integrated energy system, amount of electrical equipment are synchronized to the power grid, making the operating conditions of distribution network rather complicated, so as to the requirement of power system operation and management being improving. However, the refined management of electrical energy has always been a difficult problem, because electricity are not able to be stored on a large scale, not to mention some renewable energy cannot be predicted accurately. In order to reduce the stochastic effect of new energy generation, such as photovoltaic, this paper introduces the concept of minimax regret criterion to model an integrated energy grid energy management system to improve the efficiency and economic benefit. Meanwhile, both operating conditions and maintenance requirements are taking into consideration so as to make the total energy cost minimum and the local distributed power utilization maximum. The time- domain rolling method is applied to solve this model. At last, a study case is used to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi source Co-optimization Approach for wind power system based on power generation flexibility margin
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is widely known that co-optimization between multi-type power sources is an effective measure to smooth stochastic fluctuations in renewable power and improve the level of renewable energy accommodation. In this paper two indices called upward-regulation flexibility margin and downward-regulation flexibility margin are put forward from the viewpoint of balance between operational flexibility supply and demand, which are used to optimize the limited flexible resources to deal with the adverse effects of large-scale renewable energy. On this basis we formulate a wind-hydro-gas-thermal coordinated optimal model in which the renewable energy accommodation and total cost are taken as the objective, All case studies have been solved using CPLEX 12.3. The aim of this paper is to promote the renewable energy accommodation and also the system efficiency from both the economic and security point of view. The reasonableness and effectiveness of the proposed methodology is validated by case study.

articleTitle: Economic Dispatch of Off-Grid Photovoltaic Generation System with Hybrid Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An off-grid photovoitaic(PV) generation system with hybrid energy storage is proposed, and the mathematical models of the key components are built. By which energy supply and demand performance of the system are analyzed, and a coordinated control strategy of energy management is proposed, which is based on the constraints of equipment parameters, self-wastage and the impacts of the capacity in the system. Using Matlab software, a simulation platform for the off-grid PV microgrid with hybrid energy storage is constructed. Taking a microgrid for case study, Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the dynamic economic dispatch.

articleTitle: A Voltage Integrated Strategy in DC Distribution Network Based on Droop Control
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC power distribution technology has become the focus of attention because of its small line loss, high power supply capacity, saving a large number of DC/AC commutation links and controllable components. In this paper, the multi-terminal DC distribution network containing distributed generations is taken as the research object. Firstly, the voltage droop control method of DC distribution network is discussed. The purpose of optimizing voltage is achieved by voltage deviation compensation, and then controller structure at converter station is designed. Secondly, the voltage integrated control strategy is proposed. The voltage adjustment mode is divided into normal voltage regulation, accident voltage regulation and emergency voltage regulation according to the magnitude of DC voltage deviation. The main converter station acts as a balance node during the normal voltage regulation. During the accident voltage regulation, the battery is switched from the standby state to the voltage droop control to maintain the DC voltage. In the emergency voltage regulation, measures such as reducing power of the wind turbine and photovoltaic unit or cutting off some loads are adopted. Finally, simulation model of the six-terminal low-voltage distribution network is established on Matlab/Simulink, and the effectiveness and real-time performance of the voltage integrated control strategy are verified.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of an Axial-flux Half Air-core Compensated Pulsed Alternator Used for Energy System Integration
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Novel Compensated Pulsed Alternator (NCPA) is one of the most promising development direction on the field of the Energy System Integration (ESI). The basic topology of the Axial-flux Half Air-core Compensated Pulsed Alternator (AHACPA) has been designed in this paper and the basic structure of AHACPA is analyzed by using finite-element method (FEM). Then, the magnetomotive force, partial saturation, leakage factor, compensated disk thickness and designed parameters is optimized to achieve high fundamental value of the air-gap flux density and Increase energy storage density. Most simulation results were in line with designed value.

articleTitle: Research on Features of Residential Loads and Establishment of Feature Library
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The visualization of residential electricity consumption is the basis of energy-saving work, whose key is to understand the load and power consumption features of typical domestic electrical appliances on the user side. By analyzing various types of load features, some features with higher identification are selected as the main contents of load feature library. By constructing the electric data acquisition platform in the laboratory, the typical appliance power consumption data is collected to extract load features using a certain mathematical method, and then the load feature library is formed. Finally, a visual interface of load feature library is constructed by MATLAB in order to facilitate the invocation and analysis of load features and lay a foundation for subsequent load identification.

articleTitle: Power Analysis on RSM Schemes in Cryptographic Chips
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The lightweight mask scheme is a new tendency of the mask countermeasures in Cryptographic Chips. RSM is a lightweight scheme with high security and low cost. With RSM scheme, we carry out a cryptanalysis on DPA Contest V4 and propose several profiled and non-profiled power analyses against the RSM and RSM-Like schemes. Furthermore, we propose MCPA, which is based on the cluster model to classify the power/EM traces according to the value of different mask bytes. MCPA only relies on the types of the mask sequences. The results of experiments on the reference traces show that our analysis is effective. We could recover the mask sequence and the round-key for the first round in AES-256 with about 100 power/EM traces. We also give some suggestions on the possible improvement of the RSM scheme to destroy the condition of SCA with different implementations.

articleTitle: Analysis of the contribution of large-scale interconnection to greenhouse gas emission reduction in Northeast Asia
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The benefits of cross-border interconnection is proposed in this paper. The current situation of cross-border interconnection and power trade in Northeast Asia is analyzed, as well as the opportunities and challenges of strengthening interconnection in the medium and long term. Using Times model and IEA scenario, the scale of cross-border interconnection in Northeast Asia is analyzed, which can optimize the power structure, promote the development of renewable energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Operation Optimization of Distribution Network with DPVG High Permeability
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The connection of distributed photovoltaic power generation (DPVG) to the distribution network will cause voltage fluctuations on the one hand, whereas, it can provide voltage support by using the remaining reactive power on the other hand, then reduce network losses, improve system security, and reduce investment in some reactive devices. This paper proposes a multi-objective operation optimization scheme for distribution network with DPVG high permeability. Firstly, based on the analytic hierarchy process, the comprehensive optimal evaluation index of photovoltaic operation at different times is proposed. Then the objective function of three indicators are established: the curtailment of photovoltaic power, the network loss, and the voltage deviation of the grid-connection node. The barebones multi-objective particle swarm optimizer (BB-MOPSO) with less control parameters is used to find a number of feasible optimization schemes for the DPVG access to distribution network considering suppression of voltage fluctuations, network loss and the curtailment of photovoltaic power. The optimal evaluation plan for the time period is determined by combining the comprehensive evaluation indicators of the analytic hierarchy process. Finally, take the case of the three DPVGs with large output fluctuations installed in the IEEE-33 distribution network end node as an example to verify the validity and rationality of the proposed model and method.

articleTitle: An Improved Droop Controller for Three-phase Multi-junction Inverters in the Micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Three-phase multi-function inverters (TPMFIs) are able to generate active power and improve the power qualities of micro-grid simultaneously. However, to cope with the frequently switching of loads in micro-grid, the self-adaptive control of the output power of the TPMFI is also required. Therefore, an improved droop controller is proposed in this paper. The proposed controller concludes a modified allocation strategy of output power for TPMFIs in micro-grid, and a switching controller for power quality detection function. By adopting the proposed droop controller, the TPMFIs in the micro-grid could compensate the power quality problems in real time and self-control the power output at the same time. Verified by Matlab/Simulink simulations, the proposed droop controller for TPMFIs could guarantee the stability of microgrid and enhance the power quality of micro-grid at the same time.

articleTitle: Day-ahead market model under uncertainty environment: A probabilistic constrained programming approach
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasingly penetration of renewable generation resources has brought intermittence and uncertainty to the operation of electric power market. Those stochastic characteristics of renewable generation could potentially jeopardize security operation of power system, if not addressed properly. Therefore, it is desired to have day-ahead market model could handle those uncertainties during the generation scheduling process. Correspondingly, a dynamic probabilistic constraint based day-ahead resource scheduling model is proposed to minimize the economic costs including operation cost and carbon emission cost. The numerical study results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Design of a Home Energy Management System Based on Cloud Service
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasingly serious energy and environmental problems, the proportion of new energy in total energy consumption increased continuously, the application of new energy in the home micro-grid can effectively alleviate the energy crisis, then the monitoring of energy in the home microgrid is becoming more critical. Based on the traditional home micro-grid, a home energy control system was designed which covers the home micro-grid architecture, the network communication control, and the human-computer interaction. The supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) was designed to monitor the working status of each component in the home micro-grid through various communication methods such as WIFI and RS485. For the current power load which has no communication ability, a smart socket based on WIFI was designed for the monitoring of home appliances and power supply equipment. The working data of the underlying device is upload to the cloud server built by the intelligent gateway and the human-computer interaction interface, the database storage system for running data, and the human-machine interface adopts the WeChat public number which can avoid many developments, then effectively reducing the cost of operations for user learning. The cloud-service-based home energy management system can effectively promote energy utilization and make home energy management more intelligent.

articleTitle: Convex Relaxation of Chance Constrained Two-stage Unit Commitment
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integration of massive renewable generation brings significant technical challenges to the power system operation. Especially, the determined unit commitment solution is no longer applicable for the power system with high penetration of renewable generation. In this paper, we develop a two-stage chance constrained unit commitment (CCUC) model regarding the renewable energy output as random variables which are represented by Gaussian mixture model (GMM). Resorting to convex relaxation technique, the uncertain model in second stage is converted to a tractable deterministic model and can be solved efficiently. Numerical tests on a modified IEEE-24 node system demonstrate the proposed method feasible and efficient.

articleTitle: Voltage Risk Assessment of Distribution Network with Photovoltaic Intergration Based on Parallel Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage fluctuations in distribution networks are usually caused by the stochastic volatility of photovoltaic generation system and load. The traditional deterministic power flow calculation method is difficult to assess the voltage risk. Moreover, traditional serial computing technologies cannot provide rapid voltage risk assessment of large-scale distribution networks. To address these problems, the probabilistic characteristics of PV generation and load fluctuations are first analyzed. Then, the corresponding probabilistic model is established based on the Newton-Raphson algorithm. Finally, an indicator to evaluate voltage risk is proposed by using the Monte-Carlo simulation. In order to meet the computing speed requirement imposed by large-scale distribution networks, a parallel computing platform based on Apache Spark is designed, and a parallel implementation of the Monte-Carlo simulation on Spark Resilience Distributed Datasets (RDD) is established. Simulation results based on real-world data illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed voltage risk assessment for large-scale distribution power networks and its computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic DC Impedance Selecting Method and Its Application in Variable Heating Load
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Photovoltaic DC power supply has the advantage of application in a thermal load. The impedance selecting method of photovoltaic DC power supply is of great significance to improve the utilization rate of photovoltaic. An impedance selection method for the thermal load of photovoltaic DC power supply is proposed and applied to variable thermal load. Based on the analysis of the matching characteristics of photovoltaic internal resistance and impedance, the corresponding relationship between the internal resistance and load resistance of photovoltaic power supply is simulated and analyzed, also a variable heating load system is designed. The experimental results show that the utilization ratio of the system can be effectively improved. Using photovoltaic DC power supply to supply impedance load, it can save the investment of power conversion and other intermediate links, it can automatically track the maximum power output of photovoltaic on the DC level. This structure is simple and easy to generate, the system has a practical application value in the combined heat and power system.

articleTitle: The Switching Time Research of BLDCM for Fuel Pump
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The brushless DC motors for Aviation fuel pump use Hall position sensors to get the position of rotor in motors. The rotors' switching time would be advanced or delayed because of the angle error in Hall position sensors. In order to ensure the motor run reliably, the switching time has to be determined accurately. By numerical analysis, this article compares the perfect switching time with the advanced switching time and delayed switching time. Meanwhile, we prove the phase influence to rotors and propose the electric potential methods to confirm the perfect switching time. This method is validated by the Magnet software simulation.

articleTitle: Cooperative Optimal Operation Strategy of Household Electric Heating
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Heating system is an important part of home life. Electrical heating system replaces the cogeneration heating system for the reason of new requirements for environment protection and new energy to be grid-connected. Although many old coal-fired boilers are replaced by electric boilers, but there are still many difficulties for all residents to use the centralized heating system. For those areas that do not have the conditions for deployment of central heating system, residents there can only use their household heating system. This paper will present and discuss a smart home heating model with consideration of the random fluctuating temperature in Xinjiang. The proposed model could control the peak load, improve the user's temperature effect and reduce the running electricity cost as well. Finally, the simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed cooperative optimal operation model.

articleTitle: Resistivity Measurement and Inversion of the Current Path into the Ground for HVDC Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: HVDC transmission in the earth-return current has a large penetration depth which is difficult to measure the resistivity. A method for hybrid measurement and inversion of a wide range of resistivity of this path is proposed. A combined application of the four-point method and the magnetotelluric method is investigated which can measure the earth resistivity more effectively that covers the surface to the depth of hundreds of kilometers below the ground. In the inversion processing of measurement data, the paper puts forward an artificial bee colony global optimization inversion method embedded with local conjugate gradient search for the global optimization method. It is a more efficient hybrid inversion scheme.

articleTitle: Influence of UHVDC in Qinghai Province on Peak Operation of Northwest Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a research about the impact on peak operation of northwest main power grid under the Qinghai UHVDC has been done. It applies a 8760-hour grid operation simulation to analyze new energy abundant rate, coal consumption and reliability of both Northwest and Qinghai power grid under different grid structures, with or without Qinghai UHVDC and different complementary operation modes, such as long-term trading only, short-term trading only and hybrid trading. A conclusion demonstrates that the new energy abandonment rate could be decreased when the complementary operation runs intensively (i.e. independent operation, long-term trading operation, hybrid trading operation, short-term trading only)between Qinghai and Northwest main power grid.

articleTitle: Study on Operation Optimization Strategy of Ground Source Heat Pump Heating System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: “Transform coal heating to electric heating” is an important part of the electric power alternative strategy. The electric heating has an incomparable advantage over other heating systems, which makes it widely recognized. Using ground source heat pump for electric heating brings more social and economic benefits. On the basis of studying the method for calculating the thermal load of users and the principle of chance-constrained programming (CCP), the two-layer operational optimal model of ground source heat pump system is established, which aims to minimize electricity consumption and maximize the thermal comfort. The improved PSO algorithm is used to resolve the model to obtain the optimal control strategy of ground source heat pump system and the load distributive strategy of heat pump units. The analysis of examples-, a campus heating building heating system, shows that the model and the control strategy proposed in this paper can improve the energy efficiency of electric heating system on campus and lower the cost of electricity consumption without reducing the thermal comfort. This approach is instructive and referential for the operation of electric heating system on park buildings.

articleTitle: Full-scale Experimental and Theoretical Research for Double-circuit and Single πAccess Line of the 110STJ New Type Tower
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the resource shortage problem of the power transmission corridors, a new design of power transmission line is necessary. Double circuits and access other lines with single π type of the 110STJ is a new type tower that used in China for the first time. The tower with height call 24m, height 38.4m and weight l8.3t, was subjected to tests under nine operation conditions(including 90 degree of wind, broken wire, ice-covering and so on) based on the standard DL/T899 −2012 “Loading Tests on Tower and Pole Structures of Overhead Line”. The Experiments show that the displacements of tower 110STJ meet the relevant standard of deformation, and the stress of tower 110STJ did not exceed the member's carrying capacity respectively. Meanwhile, compared with the conventional similar general tower, this new type has good economic efficiency and social benefits. So it can meet the safe and reliable operation of the line, and can be applied widely.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Combined Cooling Heating and Power in China
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an important technology for multi-energy complementarity at user end, Combined Cooling Heating and Power (CCHP) is a key element in Energy Internet. By developing a CCHP economic analysis model, this paper conducts economic analyses on CCHP projects for industrial and commercial customers. Sensitivity analysis on various impact factors finds out that natural gas price plays a decisive role in the economics of a CCHP project, which has pointed out a clear path to accelerate the development of CCHP.

articleTitle: A Two-stage Stochastic Optimization Approach for Distribution Network with Load Control
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the extensive access of distributed energy resources (DER) and the development of load control technology, the distribution network is gradually becoming more and more initiative, and the economy of power grid can be effectively improved through reasonable scheduling. For this purpose, a two-stage stochastic optimization approach for distribution network with load control is established. The scenario analysis is used to characterize the uncertainty of DER. The first stage of optimization generates a day-ahead power purchase curve and load adjustment curves and calculates the corresponding costs; In the second stage, the mathematic expectation of the difference between the actual purchased electricity in each scenario and the day-ahead purchased electricity is calculated to obtain the reserve costs. The mathematical nature of the model is a large-scale nonlinear mixed integer programming problem, which is difficult to solve. By using the second-order cone (SOC) relaxation technique, the above model can be transformed into a mixed integer second-order cone programming (MISOCP) form, which can be solved effectively. Finally, the simulation analysis of the custom IEEE 14-bus system is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on Fair Allocation Method of New Energy Power Stations Dispatching Plan
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, China's industry of photovoltaic and wind power generation has developed rapidly. With the increase of installed capacity, the consumptive problem of new energy power generation is becoming more serious. It is worthwhile to research that how to ensure the fairness of dispatching opportunity between new energy power stations while electrical power system can not consump new energy power generatin preferentially. This paper analyzes the resource's factors of new energy power generation can be influenced, and set up a comprehensive ranking index system for new energy stations. Then the fair allocation method for dispatching of new energy stations is proposed based on comprehensive ranking. Finally, the feasibility of the dispatching mode is verified based on the existing data.

articleTitle: Integrated Reliability Analysis of Control and Information Flow in Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, according to the electricity business process including collecting and transmitting power information and sending control instructions, a coupling model of control-communication flow is built which is composed of three main matrices: control-communication, communication-communication, communication-control incidence matrices. Furthermore, the effective path change between two communication nodes is analyzed and a calculation method of connectivity probability for information network is proposed when considering a breakdown in communication links. Then, based on Bayesian conditional probability theory, the effect of the communication interruption on the energy Internet is analyzed and the metric matrix of controllability is given under communication congestion. Several cases are given in the final of paper to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method for calculating controllability matrix by considering different link interruption scenarios. This probability index can be regarded as a quantitative measure of the controllability of the power service based on the communication transmission instructions, which can be used in the power business decision-making in order to improve the control reliability of the energy Internet.

articleTitle: HVDN Line Switching for Alleviating Transmission Congestion with the Integration of Electric Vehicles and Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transmission congestion is considered as a serious security problem that limit the efficiency of the transmission systems. Due to the lack of controlling measures in some part of the transmission network, much load shedding amount and controlling cost would be required to alleviate the congestion. As more and more renewable energy resources integrate into the grid, the transmission lines are prone to be overload. Whereas in high voltage distribution network (HVDN), each substation usually has one or two reserve lines that connect to another power supply point thus greatly enrich the operation flexibility of HVDN. By changing the topological structure of HVDN, the load in transmission network can be greatly redistributed. In order to improve the transmission efficiency and reduce the total controlling cost, a generator rescheduling scheme considering line switching of HVDN was proposed in this paper. The model consists of a generator rescheduling model and a second order cone programming (SOCP) based HVDN line switching model. An urban test system in China was utilized to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. Numerical results show that utilizing the HVDN line switching to transfer the load dramatically reduce the load shedding amount and controlling cost.

articleTitle: Application and Research of State Grid Assets Automatic Inventory Based on Cellular Narrow Band and Low Power WAN Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traditionally the fixed assets of power equipment take a long time to take inventory, have a wide range of inventory, consume a lot of manpower, and it is difficult to check. The grid assets change frequently. Equipment assets are also changing at the same time as the inventory check. It is easy to leak, repeat, and multiple count in the way of account inventory. The inventory effect of assets is not good and cannot accurately reflect the quantity and value of physical assets. Based on the deficiencies of the traditional manual counting method, this paper proposes to establish a power Internet of Things intranet through wireless communication Internet of things technology with low power and wide coverage (LPWAN), combining mobile terminals and NB-IOT low power WAN. By using the active Internet of things (IOT) electronic tags and radio frequency read-write device, the asset electronic tags identified by the front end are transmitted to the IOT application network, realizing the interconnection between the sensing layer and the application layer, and verifying the accuracy and convenience of the wireless inventory of power grid assets. It has greatly reduced the amount of manpower and comprehensively supported the unified linkage of asset and equipment management. The most important thing is to realize the major technological breakthrough of “Dynamic consistency of the ledger and objects” of fixed assets.

articleTitle: Mechanism and Quantitative Analysis of Harmonics for Grid-Connected Inverter During Asymmetrical Grid Fault
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the condition of asymmetric fault of power grid, the voltage of power grid has negative sequence component, which seriously affects the quality of output voltage and current of grid-connected inverter. Based on the analysis of model and control strategy of grid inverter under asymmetric fault, this paper studied the influence on the output voltage, the output current and the voltage on DC bus made by negative sequence component, revealed the mechanism of grid inverter output current harmonic component and quantitative analysis of each order harmonic, put forward the measurements to restrain the harmonics and voltage fluctuation on DC bus. The effect of negative sequence voltage and the mechanism of harmonic generation are validated by PSCAD simulation and results.

articleTitle: A Detailed Study of AC Interference on Metal Pipelines due to Double Circuit Power Lines
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The electromagnetic interference between Electrical Power Lines (EPL) and nearby Metallic Pipelines (MP) has been an important research subject over the last decades. The proximity between various types of EPLs and MPs is unavoidable nowadays. This interference may result in currents and voltages on MPs that may pose a serious threat to operating personnel and equipment. In addition, the integrity of the MPs may be threatened due to corrosion. In this paper, based on the transmission line model of pipeline-earth circuit, the analytic expressions of inductive coupling voltage generated by the normally operating Ac transmission line were obtained for different terminal loads of the oil/gas pipeline. Then, the influence of some important parameters, such as the phase sequence, parallel length, soil resistivity, separation distance and the different loading between the two circuits were revealed by the proposed method. The manuscript provides detailed graphs and numerical data that may be useful for engineers and researchers for evaluation of the interference level or in selecting and applying proper protection measures.

articleTitle: Electromechanical Transient and Electromagnetic Transient Hybrid Modeling and Simulation of Back to Back MMC-HVDC Project
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the construction of back to back MMC-HVDC project connecting Chongqing and Hubei power grid, the higher requirements has been put forward for large-scale power electronics simulation and modeling technology. The traditional electromagnetic or electromechanical transient simulation program has been unable to meet the requirements of large scale AC / DC construction in China for digital simulation.In order to study the dynamic characteristics of this projects, an electromechanical transient and electromagnetic transient hybrid model of back to back MMC-HVDC project is proposed. We discussed simulation techniques from aspects of modular multilevel converter efficient modeling, control model of MMC-HVDC and hybrid simulation interface selection.Based on the above research, the simulation of the back to back MMC-HVDC project shows better accuracy of the hybrid model, which was realized in the PSD-PSModel electromechanical transient and electromagnetic transient hybrid simulation program. The proposed control model could provide strong theoretical support for analysing the dynamic response of relevant MMC-HVDC project.

articleTitle: The Simulation Analysis and Research of the Electromagnetic Influence of the 500kV AC Transmission Line On the Seismic Station
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the mechanism and restriction of high voltage transmission line's electromagnetic influence, this paper conducted simulation analysis and research for the actual engineering scheme's electromagnetic influence to seismic station by CDEGS simulation tool. The result is used to verify the safety and reliability of the scheme.

articleTitle: Modelling of SOFC Coupled Energy Flow and Material Flow
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the sustainable development of the environment, the Fuel cell is more and more popular in power generation because of its high efficiency and high capacity. Among them, the Solid Oxide Fuel Cell (SOFC) owns the highest efficiency and is one of the most potential candidates. To optimize and control the SOFC system, building a detailed model of SOFC is very important. Thus, a SOFC stack model which coupled material flow and energy flow was proposed. In this model, it includes transport processes, the electrochemical and chemical reactions is simulated and evaluated in this paper. This model is based on the Bond Graph theory, so it simulated the energy conservation between chemical energy and electrical energy, electrical energy and thermal energy, chemical energy and thermal energy etc. It is a transient model and has a distribution along the gas channel. First, the theory and dynamics of SOFC model were proposed. Second, the energy flow and material flow in SOFC was described and the SOFC based on Bond Graph model was proposed. Finally, the SOFC stack was simulated in this paper.

articleTitle: A Novel Acquisition and Processing Framework of Electric Vehicles' Wireless Sensory Data
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the implement of wireless sensory network, data acquisition methods and related data processing methods have been widely used. This paper introduced a novel acquisition and processing framework in the aspect of electric vehicles' (EVs`) wireless sensory data. The case of electric taxi cabs in Shenzhen, Guangdong is used to verify its validity. The proposed method is proved to be effective in terms of charging behavior recognition and traveling data aggregation.

articleTitle: A Simulink Model for Artificial Waves in Building Tidal Power Research Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper has presented a Simulink model to help set up an artificial environment in tidal power research. Different from traditional methods, artificial waves are able to be controlled. The model made it possible to do tidal research in every single type wave condition. Artificial waves reduce interferences of the laboratory and help energy integration research go further. Instead of doing research offshore, indoor laboratory circumstance is better and safer.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Three Control Strategies of Hybrid Excited Flux-Switching Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper compares three control strategies of hybrid excited flux-switching machine (HEFSM). First, the topology, operating principle and mathematical models of HEFSM are introduced. Then vector control, direct torque control based on hysteresis comparison and SVPWM are analyzed in detail. Finally, detailed simulations of three control strategies are carried out based on Matlab/Simulink. The steady-state and dynamic performance of three control strategies are compared and analyzed comprehensively. Some conclusions are drawn at last.

articleTitle: Exploration on the Development Model of Energy Internet in Large Region
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of energy Internet, the transformation of energy industry is coming. It is worth paying attention to the development of regional energy Internet. The paper puts forward the development route of energy Internet in large region based on the concept of Internet development and the current provincial energy status. This paper put forward opinions on the large region energy Internet development model from the two aspects of frame erection and planning method. In addition, this paper puts forward the energy normalization method and energy optimization mathematical model which can provide a new idea for solving all kinds of problems on planning energy independence.

articleTitle: An Optimal Control Based Approach for Improving Renewable Energy Utilization in a Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the increasing energy demand and environmental concern, efficient usage of the renewable energy sources becomes the focus in power systems. The microgrid (MG) is becoming important as it can integrate various types of renewable energy effectively in a small area. The coordination control of various distributed units in a microgrid is one of the most challenging research areas. The frequency in a microgrid is frequently disturbed by the intermittency of renewable energy generations and time-varying load, thus it is essential to develop a cost-effective method to maintain the frequency stability. This paper proposes an optimal control based on power line control with the emphasis on improving renewable energy generation utilization while reducing the deviation of frequency. To illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, numerical simulations using MATLAB are conducted on as-bus microgrid.

articleTitle: Electric Demand Evaluation Method for Central Asian Countries Considering Spatio-temporal Variations of the Urban Light
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The cross-border interconnection between the power system of Xinjiang regional in China and those of the five Central Asian countries provides a platform for an initial realization of the global energy interconnection. In this paper, first, the history of the power system interconnections in Central Asia is reviewed. Second, the possibility of the interconnection between Xinjiang power system with the those of Central Asia is discussed. In the end of the paper, using DMSP stable lights database, the spatio-temporal model dataset of big cities light tree is established, and the power demand of five Central Asian countries and Xinjiang city is evaluated. The example shows that the result of the proposed method is better than the traditional regression method that simply based on the change of the total power demand.

articleTitle: Research on Open Phase Protection Strategy for New Generation of Large Capacity Synchronous Condenser
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An open phase protection strategy for the new generation of large capacity synchronous condenser is studied. The coordination logic of protection after open phase fault occurs is analyzed according to the way that the synchronous condenser is connected to power grid. The difference of sensitivity between open phase protection and breaker failure protection and the possibility of failure protection refusal are pointed out. The de-excitation strategy of open phase protection is put forward through site test and simulation. The comparison and analysis of the test results prove that the strategy can effectively solve the problem of breaker failure protection refusal when open phase fault occurs, effectively reduce the harm of open phase fault to synchronous condenser and power system, which possesses the feasibility of Engineering implementation.

articleTitle: Network Reconfiguration with High Proportional Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of network reconfiguration of distribution networks with high proportional Distributed Generation(DG). Firstly, this paper studies the types of Distributed Generation and their characteristics, discusses the influence of distributed power supply to distribution network, and studies their computing model. Secondly, the forward and backward substitution method is introduced to calculate the load flow. Then, the reconfiguration model of distribution network is established, and the objective function of Pareto multi-objective optimization is to minimize the loss of the net and voltage deviation and to maximize reliability. This paper uses the Prim's algorithm to generate the radiation network and uses the binary particle swarm optimization algorithm to achieve network reconfiguration. At the same time, the strategy of randomly initializing velocity vectors is adopted to prevent the local optimal. At last, the optimization analysis of the 33-node of the distribution network is carried out, and good results are obtained, which verifies the validity and convergence of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Integral Test System for Transformer Calibrator Based on Machine Vision and Servo Control
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an automatic test system for power transformer calibrator based on machine vision and servo control technology. The software and hardware architecture of the system includes an automatic test module, a servo-driven vision module, and a standard power module. We propose a machine vision algorithm based on artificial neural network to realize the automatic reading of the display data of the tested calibrator. Through the servo drive platform, the smart camera is moved to the best position for capturing images, and the computer visual recognition is used instead of manual to complete the automatic reading and parsing of the display data. The system can realize automatic test of multiple devices at the same time. The practical application shows that the system designed in this paper can meet the requirements of practical application, replace the manual test with machine, improve the test efficiency and stability of results, and have certain development prospects.

articleTitle: Calculation Method of Secondary Circulation Current for MMC-UPFC Based on Simulated Annealing Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The modular multilevel converter (MMC) based unified power flow controller (UPFC) is the newest flexible AC transmission system technology at present, which can realize the adjustment of active power and reactive power with voltage regulation, series compensation and shift equalization. With secondary circulation in the MMC bridge arm during UPFC running, a method for calculating secondary circulation current of modular multilevel converters is proposed, which establishes a calculation method of secondary circulation current by simplifying averaging control to be double proportional regulator, based on capacitance volt-ampere characteristic and equivalent switching function. The topological structure of MMC-UPFC is analyzed, and the specific process of the above model is displayed based on understanding the reason of producing secondary circulation current. In order to improve calculation accuracy, correction model of secondary circulation current is established, and the optimal parameters are obtained by using simulated annealing based on least squares. An important conclusion that secondary circulation current is associated with K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">V1</sub> and K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">I1</sub>, and it increase with the increase of K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">V1</sub> and decrease with the increase of K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">I1,</sub> is obtained by analyzing the above model, which provides a theoretical basis for suppressing secondary circulation current and selecting power device for UPFC. Finally PSCAD simulation results show that the method can accurately calculate secondary circulation current, which verifies its validity and feasibility.

articleTitle: Large-Scale Unit Commitment by Memetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes the Memetic algorithm to solve the problem of large-scale unit commitment (UC), which makes the global and local optimization methods combined. During the global search process of genetic algorithm (GA), the guided local search (GLS) is introduced in the process of global search. The local extremum is removed in each iteration and the cost objective function is repaired in time to change the terrain of the search space and avoid falling into the local optimal solution. Simulation results show that the method is effective and improves the computation efficiency to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Two-Level Charge and Discharge for Electric Vehicles Considering Wind Power Utilization
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The optimal charge and discharge schedule of EVs is studied under distribution network considerring wind power. Markov decision process is adopted to model the randomness of supply and demand. Two-level scheduling model of electric vehicles with electric vehicle agents are adopted. The electric vehicle agents are responsible for collecting the real-time charging-discharging demand of electric vehicles in the region and reported to the upper dispatching center. The goal of the upper dispatching center considers the power losses in the distribution network, load variance and the matching degree between EV charging-discharging and wind energy. The goal of the lower agent considers the EV charging-discharging fees and EV charging battery losss costs. When deciding the optimal charging strategy, two-level Rollout methodis adopted considering the the effects on future decisions by the current decisions. Finally, the optimal results under four different strategies are simulated on the IEEE 30 nodes distribution network system.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Dispatching Approach on Power System Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The power fluctuation of system is intensified and the flexibility is reduced due to large scale variable renewable energy sources (VRES) are integrated into the grid. This paper firstly summarizes the existing evaluation metrics and optimal dispatching approaches about the flexibility. Secondly, an evaluation metric named system flexibility interval is established and it reflects the range of power fluctuation that system can tolerate. Then, this paper proposes a dispatching approach of improving system flexibility by optimizing the day-ahead dispatch scheme of the units considering that the actual fluctuant power may deviate far from the predictive value. The proposed approach aims to raise the flexibility of system to reduce operational risk. In the example analysis section, the feasibility of the proposed approach is tested well based on the modified IEEE39 system. The result shows that the system is more flexible and the economic cost increases very little when using the dispatching approach proposed in this paper than conventional approach.

articleTitle: Frequency Domain Analysis Method of Forced Power Oscillation Induced by Doubly-fed Induction Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the maximum power tracking control strategy, a small-signal model of single-infinite system for doubly-fed induction generator is established. A dynamic frequency analysis method is proposed to study the mechanism of forced power oscillation of doubly-fed generator. The transfer function expression of electromagnetic power variation and wind speed disturbance is given as well as the method of calculating each parameter matrixs, and the amplitude-frequency characteristic curves of the transfer function under all wind conditions are obtained. The effects of different frequency wind speed disturbances on electromagnetic power output are analyzed in two scenarios where the average wind speed is higher or lower than the rated wind speed. In the above two scenarios, the ratios of the amplitude of electromagnetic power fluctuation to the disturbance of wind speed are consistent with the amplitude-frequency characteristic curves, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed analysis method.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control of Distributed Photovoltaic Cluster Based on MPC
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to deal with the impact of distributed photovoltaic cluster access on the security, stability and economic operation of the distribution network, this paper builds a three-layer control architecture of distributed photovoltaic cluster based on the analysis and summary of the meaning and characteristics of distributed photovoltaic cluster. The cluster-layer optimization control strategy is studied in detail, and a coordinated optimization control method of distributed photovoltaic cluster based on model predictive control is proposed. This method takes into account the fluctuation of photovoltaic output and load demand, and uses multi-step rolling optimization to solve the active and reactive power output of various controllable devices in the system. The simulation analysis of the improved PG&E69 node system verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed optimization control method.

articleTitle: Control Strategy of an AC-DC Hybrid Microgrid Based on Virtual Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Virtual synchronous generator (VSG) provides a friendly grid-integrated method for renewable energies. This paper presents a control storage of an islanded photovoltaic-diesel-battery microgrid, in which the VSG is used as the interface between the AC bus and DC bus. The basic control structure of the VSG and its active power-frequency characteristics are discussed in detail. Besides, a practical control method for the VSG to regulate its output power is proposed on base of moving average method to make full use of the photovoltaics output power and simultaneously reduce the adverse effect of its intermittency on the system stability. Simulations based on Matlab/Simulink and experiments based on a VSG prototype developed in the laboratory proved the proposed method to be effective and verified the improvement of the VSG on microgrid dynamic frequency characteristic.

articleTitle: Research on Measurement Method of Broadband Multi-frequency Signal in Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Recent years, with the widespread application of power electronics technology in the power grid, the pollution of harmonic and inter-harmonic of power grid caused by it have become more and more serious. In this paper, a real-time broadband multi-frequency signal measurement system based on synchronous phasor measurement unit (PMU) is proposed to estimate the synchronous harmonic and inter-harmonic phasors in the power system. In the proposed measurement system, the original signal is acquired by high-speed synchronous sampling technology. The calculation of the fundamental wave phasor is based on the model recommended by the IEEE Std C37.118.1-2011 to meet the requirements of the dynamic and static measurement performance. The calculation of harmonic and inter-harmonic phasors is extracted by the fast fourier transform (FFT) algorithm with Hanning window. The correction algorithm of frequency, amplitude and phase is given to compensate the spectral leakage and the picket fence effect caused by the discrete signal FFT. The feasibility and accuracy of the proposed measurement method are verified by MATLAB simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Resilience-Oriented Load Restoration in Distribution Systems Considering Distributed Energy Resources
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Micro-grids(MGs) with distributed generation (DG) provide a resilient solution in the case of major faults in a distribution system due to natural disasters. A resilience-oriented load restoration models that the energy will be supplied by DGs to hold maximum loads satisfying operation constraints is proposed in this paper. The virtual node and virtual branch are introduced to guarantee the topology of distribution systems. The outputs of the patchable and dis-patchable DGs and the sustainable power supply capacity will be considered. For the nonlinear characteristics of the proposed mathematical model, the piecewise linearization method is used to linearize the power flow constraints. Hence, the load restoration model for the distribution system is transformed into a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) problem. Numerical results based on modified IEEE-33 distribution test systems validate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Security Constrained Unit Commitment with Wind Power Scenarios Sampling
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasing demand for clean and sustainable energy has significantly increased the share of wind power in power generations. However, at the same time, this poses incremental risk on the operation of power systems due to the intermittent and stochastic characteristics of wind power. To handle this issue, we in this paper propose a new framework to address the uncertainty in security-constrained unit commitment (SCUC)model. First, typical wind scenarios are identified and screened out by Principal Component Analysis (PCA)and Clustering by search and find of density peaks. Then, typical scenarios are used to determine the on/off status of generators by solving a two-stage optimization problem. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified using the IEEE 118-bus testing system.

Author Keywords: clustering by search and find of density peaks

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Main Protection Based on Leakage Inductance Transformer Mathematical Mode
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Digital ratio brake differential protection is the core element of power system relay protection applied in transformers. Regarding the digital ratio brake differential protection, the paper establishes a mathematical model of transformer based on leakage inductance. The magnetic circuit equations of the transformer under normal operation and fault are calculated. Then a simulation model of transformer differential protection is developed combing with the above mathematical model, based on the MATLAB/Simulink embedded function module. The simulation model mainly includes the ratio differential protection of ratio braking characteristic, differential speed break protection, primary model system and other functions. The simulation result shows that the ratio brake differential protection can operate its logic function correctly and has the better speed, reliability and sensitivity. The computer simulation of power system relay protection has very important practical significance.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Automated Demand Response Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Demand response is an important part of smart grid construction and an important way to link demand side management. The research on the hardware-in-the-loop simulation of demand response is conducive to guiding the development of demand response from the theoretical level and solving the problem of insufficient experience in the pilot application. Under the situation of open-loop power supply, new business and service modes of automatic demand response have emerged. The application of automatic demand response simulation system has important guiding significance for practical engineering.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Simulation Test Method for Precision Load Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Precision load control is an important part of UHV AC-DC grid system protection, and it can also be used as a precise switching device for distributed energy, micro-grid and other systems. Through the classification, grading and sub-regional management of load resources, the real-time precise control of the interrupted load of the classified users can be realized by the direct dispatching of the dispatching, which can avoid a large number of overall pull-off of the substation or the line, and reduce the social impact of the grid fault. At the lowest level, improve the defense capability of large power grids. In order to ensure the stability and reliability of the precision load control system, the Precision load control system needs to be fully verified before it is put into use. In this paper, a set of simulation test environment is developed for the characteristics of precise load control system devices and complex test systems. The test environment is based on the actual software and hardware architecture, for internal communication characteristics, research test methods, customized test case drivers, and simulation. Various operating conditions under full load operation, comprehensive verification and assessment of the functional performance of the precision load control system to ensure the stability and reliability of the precision load control system. The proposed simulation test method has certain reference significance for the simulation test of precise load control system and new energy safety and stability control system.

articleTitle: Icing Monitoring System of Transmission Lines Based on Image and Stress
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to reduce the effects of conductor dancing, insulator flashover, and broken towers caused by icing disasters, solve the problem of traditional line icing detection methods and existing icing monitoring devices. An online ice monitoring device based on conductor coupling energy-acquiring technology and lens heating technology was developed. A high reliability and automatic icing monitoring and warning method was realized by combining the stress method equivalent icing thickness calculation model and the icing image recognition result. The pilot application in a 500kV transmission line can accurately monitor and warn the icing, and the practical application effect is good.

articleTitle: A Disturbance Analytical Methods of Chaos Synchronization and Extension Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a chaotic synchronization (CS) and hybrid neural network algorithm extended (ENN) classification of power quality monitoring and analysis. CS-based detection method for the extraction of the power system three basic characteristics, ENN clustering method to detect the signal status, such as voltage sags, voltage swells, interruptions or harmonics. Prove its validity by three different chaotic systems. Simulation results show that the presence or absence of noise regardless of chaotic systems using this method have shown a high detection accuracy and low computational cost, improved noise robustness. The future development of handheld power quality analyzers and real-time detection device has a certain significance.

articleTitle: A Single-Ended Fault Location Method Based on Distributed Parameter Model for Half-Wavelength AC Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing demand for ultra-long distance and ultra-high power transmission, half-wavelength transmission technology has attracted the attention of many experts and scholars. However, most scholars mainly focus on the steady-state operation characteristics, protection scheme and other aspects, less attention to fault location. A Single-ended Fault Location Method based on distributed parameter model is proposed in this paper. Under the distributed parameter model, the voltage and current at each point along the line can be calculated through the initial electrical quantity. Because the length of the half wavelength line is too large, a calculation point is set at a certain distance at every interval to reduce the computation. By comparing the voltage values of the calculation points along the line, the point with the smallest voltage is the point nearest to the fault point. Using the voltage and current of the point, the differential equation is constructed, and the fault location is accurately calculated by solving the equation with the least square method. RTDS simulation proves that this method is suitable for half-wavelength line, and it is not affected by fault location and fault type, and has better ranging performance.

articleTitle: DG Capacity Assessment in Distribution Network Considering Uncertainties Using Multi-Parametric Programming
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the penetration of distributed generation (DG) growing in actives distribution network (ADN), the operational uncertainties are raised as well as reversal power flow in ADN. In order to adequately dissipate the DGs in the distribution networks, the study of distributed power capacity assessment is indispensable for DGs' planning and construction. This paper proposes a new multi-scenario optimization method by introducing the multi-parametric programming. The random parameters are analyzed in the parameter space, and the parameter space is divided into several critical regions. In this way, the optimal result can be represented as functions of random parameters in each critical region. The tests on the IEEE 33 buses system shown the proposed algorithm correct and efficient.

articleTitle: Development of a Broadband Capacitive Voltage Divider for Measuring Nanosecond Impulse
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rise time of nanosecond impulse voltage is very short, and the wave tail time can reach up to several microseconds. So, it is necessary to develop a broadband capacitive voltage divider for measuring common nanosecond impulse voltages accurately. Based on actual requirements, a compact voltage divider with discrete structure was developed for measuring output voltage of multichannel synchronous triggering system in the paper. Based on theoretical calculation and measurement, the parameters of voltage divider were optimized. The results show that the damping resistor should be smallest possible to ensure the response time and the overshoot of square wave should be damped at the same time. The transmission cable should not be too long and usually does not exceed 0.4m. Under requirement of waveform overshoot, the optimal length of transmission line should be confirmed through repeated calibrations and waveform comparisons. The calibration results show that by selecting proper damping resistor and transmission line, the response time of voltage divider is smaller than 4.6 ns, the voltage ratio is 2026 and the frequency band is between 9.2 Hz to 76 MHz, which can meet the measurement requirements for nanosecond impulse voltage with long wave tail accurately.

articleTitle: A Shunt Active Power Filter with Enhanced Performance Using Novel Current Detection Strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Non-commonality of the assessment method due to the diversity of member types and characteristics seriously causes deviation in overall and accurate diagnosis of smart grid demonstration project. Taken multilateral participant into consideration, the proposed method models the cost and benefit, according to the direct and indirect value flow, which is based upon the relationship between devices, service and added value. The application of value-tracing in a practical case shows that, compared with conventional power grid benefit calculation methods, value flow analysis makes smart grid assessment more precise and more actual because it calculates indirect value of multiple subjects and members.

articleTitle: Modeling Analysis and Experiment of Electrothermal Coupling Characteristics of Large Current and High-Speed Breaker
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
