abstract: High speed breaker is one of the research hotspots in the field of DC Large current power system in recent years, its core function is to realize low temperature rise path connection and sub-millisecond short circuit protection. In a power system with several thousand amperes of steady flow, the on-state low temperature rise is an important basic performance of the highspeed breaker, especially for the temperature rise at the cavity directly affects the service life of the explosive and has a great influence on the engineering practicability of the high-speed breaker. In order to solve the problem of on-state temperature rise of the high-speed interrupter, this paper establishes an electrothermal coupling mathematical model with conductive and insulated conductive components. ANSYS - multi physics is used to numerically solve the model, the influence of heat sources such as contact resistance and bridge resistance on the temperature rise is analyzed, the influence law of convection heat transfer coefficient on the temperature rise is discussed, the influence law of the area, thickness and thermal conductivity of the thermal insulation layer on the temperature rise of the cavity is emphatically discussed. A prototype of the high-speed breaker was developed, by comparing and analyzing the 3 kA through-flow temperature rise calculation and measured data, it was found that the error was within the allowable range of the project, thus proving the correctness of the mathematical model and theoretical analysis. A high-speed breaker solution with an overall resistance of only 13.3μΩ, a temperature rise of 30k for the terminal copper bar, and a temperature rise of 40k for the cavity was obtained, which effectively solved the engineering problems of the target power system.

articleTitle: Method for Extracting Typical Characteristics of Regional Grid with Scale Distributed PV Based on Time Series
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Because the output of solar photovoltaic has obvious randomness, volatility and uncontrollability, when the scaled PV is distributed into the grid, the load characteristics of the regional grid will undergo an essential change, which will bring a series of problems to the grid, such as load flow, system peaking and FM control, power quality, and system security. Based on the massive data information of regional distributed PV power, the idea of data mining is drawn, and extracts the typical characteristics of regional scale distributed photovoltaic output is extracted. Firstly, the paper analyzes the large-scale photovoltaic output characteristics of an example area, and considers that its output characteristics have obvious characteristics according to meteorological conditions. Then, the number of clusters is determined by meteorological conditions, and the typical PV output of regional grid based on k-means clustering algorithm is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the actual data.

Author Keywords: regional grid with scale distributed PV

articleTitle: A Method to Inspect the Implementation of Electricity Price Based on Deep Learning Variational Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method for performing electricity price execution inspection by using a variational autoencoder technology in deep learning. The variational auto encoder based anomaly detection algorithm(VABAD) can be used both as a discriminant model and as a feature of the generation model, which effectively solves the calculation problem of multiple heterogeneous parameters of current electricity price inspection implementation. The reconstruction probability is a probabilistic measure that takes into account the variability of the distribution of variables. It is used by autoencoder based anomaly detection methods. Experimental results show that the proposed method has been validated and compared to the existing approaches. The databases used in this paper come from Power Marketing System that occurred in Liaoning, China in 2015.

articleTitle: An Improved Pricing Method of Peak Load Responsibility for Provincial Transmission and Distribution Networks Considering Power Backflow
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A set of pricing method of provincial transmission and distribution network in various voltage levels is proposed in this paper, considering the power backflow caused by a large number of new energy access. Aiming at the complex power transmission relationship between different voltage levels in the case of power backflow in the provincial power transmission and distribution network, a partial voltage level power balance model considering power backflow is proposed. This paper analyzes the problems of cost allocation under the phenomenon of power backflow, improves the peak load responsibility method, defines the cost of power transmission and distribution at source load point, and conducts cost allocation based on the degree of mutual use between different voltage levels. The effectiveness of the pricing method is proved, taking the transmission and distribution network of X province as an example for simulation calculation. The results of the example show that the method can effectively recover all transmission and distribution costs of the power grid, and can reflect the influence of power backflow on the transmission and distribution costs of all voltage levels.

Author Keywords: provincial power transmission and distribution price

articleTitle: Research on Disassembled UHV Transformers Field Tests of No-load and Short Circuit
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For huge mass and size of 1000kV(UHV) transformers, it is hard to be transported to substation, especially in mountain areas. The disassembled transformer is manufactured to reduce the difficulties and cost of long distance transportation with bridge reconstruction, road widening, rent of special vehicles. Field assembling conditions are often worse than those in factories, which becomes threaten to the quality of assembling. It is necessary to test the quality of assembled 1000kV transformers on site. No-load and Short circuit tests are considered as the effective method to test the flaws of iron core, magnetic shielding, winding conductivity. However, conducting those tests were rare and difficult for demands of power source, sophisticated system and inflexibility on site. For those, this paper introduces the main techniques and equipment research details for 1000kV transformers field no-load and short circuit tests being conducted.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Electric Vehicle Charging Station Based on Gravitational Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The growingly serious problem of environmental pollution, resource scarcity and others are bringing a global attention to the electric vehicles (EVs). This paper is to develop an optimal plan of the number of different charging stations. Firstly, this plan will work out the number of charging stations, according to the number of EVs in the planning area. Under different number of charging stations, the plan aims at a minimum overall social cost, which considers the mutual benefits of charging stations and EV users, and also considers the influence of charging stations upon the distribution network. Finally, this ultimate plan is to minimize the overall social cost among different number of charging stations. This paper is to solve this nonlinear programming problems employing gravitational search algorithm. The test case proved the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of large capacity synchronous condenser on distance protection and its countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper analyses the impact of large capacity synchronous condenser (SC) on distance protection. A two-machine system model with SC is established in PSCAD, and numerous simulations in various conditions are carried out. The simulation results show that the installation of SC has adverse impacts on the measured impedance. Aiming at the problem that distance protection can not operate correctly, a new line protection scheme adapted to SC access is proposed. In this scheme, the fault distance is estimated based on two-terminal data and a new root identification method is employed. The new scheme can judge inner and outer faults correctly, and improve the reliability of line protection in the presence of large capacity SC.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of PD Direction Finding Based on Stereo Ultrasonic Array Sensor of EFPI
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The partial discharge ultrasonic array positioning technique combines the sensor array with the array signal processing method. In this paper, the Extrinsic Fabry-Perot Interferometric optical fiber ultrasonic sensor was used. It has the high sensitivity and is not affected by electromagnetic interference. And take full advantage of the EFPI sensor what can be placed in the oil to improve the array structure. First a four-element EFPI ultrasonic sensor array of regular tetrahedral structure was designed, which was placed in the fuel tank to detect the local ultrasonic signal. Then, the MUSIC algorithm was used to measure the local discharge source; and compared result with the 2×2 planar array. Finally, the correction is performed for the position error of the array element. The results show that the EFPI sensor stereo array can detect the partial discharge signal with high SNR in the oil, and has higher direction finding accuracy than traditional planar arrays. Especially in the aspect of array blind zone, the stereo array can effectively realize spatial multi-angle source direction finding. And TCT algorithm is used to correct the position error of the array element, which improves the direction finding accuracy, and satisfy the actual project needs.

articleTitle: Mechanism and Solutions for Control Fault of Multiple Converters Connected in Practical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In industrial engineering, application scenario with multiple converters connected to the power system is normal, however it is investigated at ports and container yards that converter control error occurs sometimes when more than 5 cable reel RTGs (rubber-tire gantry cranes) are running. This paper simulates and reproduces this special case, and analyzes the mechanism, which is the instability of the inner loop and over-limit modulation of converter when units feeding power to the grid. An equivalent analysis method of multiple converters connected is proposed, to theoretically analyze the modulation of converter, corresponding to the grid voltage, active power, reactive power and other factors. Some feasible solutions and advice are given, which provide reference for engineering operation and the distribution power system design, with a general significance to similar practical engineering of multiple converters paralleled.

articleTitle: Application of Distributed Partial Discharge Detection Technique Synchronized with AC Withstand Voltage Test of High Voltage Cable
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper researches distributed partial discharge detection technique synchronized with AC withstand voltage test of high voltage cable. Distributed partial discharge detection uses selective frequency current method and optical fiber and 3G technology to realize synchronous on-line monitoring of PD signal. There are suspected partial discharge defects in a XLPE power cable in Liaoning Province. Combining signal amplitude, frequency spectrum and time domain diagram, the defect is considered to be inside of GIS terminal. It is found that there are insulation defects on the surface of epoxy material after disassembling inspection, which is consistent with analysis results. It is considered that, the cable PD measurement synchronized with voltage withstand test has guiding significance for effectively evaluating cable construction and insulation.

articleTitle: Capacity Planning Method for Heat Storage Tanks in Thermal Power Plant Based on Dynamic Complete Information Game
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to reduce the serious wind power curtailment in the northern region and mitigate the contradiction between thermal power plant and wind farm, and with a bilateral contract market to trade peak-regulating power, this paper applies the dynamic games of complete information to establish a heat storage tank capacity planning model. Then the grid search method is used to find the Nash equilibrium point, and the decision schemes of the two plants are optimized. The results show that the heat storage device can not only increase the flexibility of the thermal power plant but also consume the abandoned wind effectively. However, the peaking electricity price will also affect the actual profits of the two parties. Only when the peaking electricity price is reasonably formulated can the two plants harvest the greatest benefits. The conclusions of this paper can provide reference and basis for planning heat storage capacity and formulating peaking electricity price.

articleTitle: Study on Seismic Stability of Steel Structure Main Control Building
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This Improving the ability of the power system to cope with earthquakes is an important factor in current power stability. The main control building of Chaoyang-Yuzhou 220kV substation is taken as the research object, and the three-dimensional integrated model of the prefabricated steel structure main control building is built using finite element software ANSYS. Finite element software ANSYS and finite element numerical method are applied to carry out comprehensive study on the member mechanical behavior under uniaxial loading effect and the hysteretic behavior under cyclic loading effect. Researches show that under the unidirectional loading and cyclic loading effect, through the analysis on the member's skeleton curve, it is recommended to control the axial pressure ratio below 0.4, and take small flange width-to-thickness ratio to guarantee the bearing capacity of the member, effectively improve the seismic safety of the structure, thereby ensuring the structural safety and normal operation of the equipment during the earthquake.

articleTitle: Status and Prospect of Bad Data Identification in Smart Substation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Smart substation is an important part of smart grid and the source of measurements. Local bad data identification inside smart substation is an effective solution to improve the accuracy of the basic data of power grid. The computing architecture and basic concepts of substation bad data identification are explained. The research status of substation bad data identification methods is summarized, including rule-based sequential identification, artificial intelligence based data identification and substation generalized state estimation. Finally, the future research of substation bad data identification is prospected.

articleTitle: Characteristic Gas and Production Law of Natural Ester Insulating Oil under Electro-thermal Faults
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The natural ester has a widespread future at the application prospects in high voltage power system whose safe operation are effected by the fault diagnosis technology. At present, the characteristic gas and gas production law of natural ester at different electrical and thermal faults are not clear yet. In this paper, an experimental platform was built to simulate the electro-thermal faults under different voltage and temperature conditions. The characteristic gas and gas production laws under the above fault conditions were tested and analyzed. The results show that the characteristic gases of natural ester oil under different electro thermal faults are carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, hydrogen, ethylene, ethane, acetylene and methane. The three gases of carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide and hydrogen have the most gas production. The production of carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, hydrogen, ethane and acetylene varied more obvious under partial discharge faults at different temperatures. The production of carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, hydrogen, ethane and methane varied more obvious under spark discharge faults at different temperatures. The production of carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, hydrogen, ethane, acetylene and methane varied more obvious under high energy faults at different temperatures. Therefore, six types of characteristic gases, such as carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, hydrogen, ethane, acetylene and methane, and their gas production rules can be used to judge the types of electro thermal faults. The above research can provide characteristic gas data for the natural ester oil fault diagnosis method based on dissolved gas analysis.

articleTitle: Design of HVDC Subsynchronous Damping Controller Based on Chaos Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The subsynchronous oscillation of HVDC system may be induced under certain conditions. Based on the chaotic optimization algorithm, which can be used to optimize the parameters of the controller and avoid falling into local optimum, this algorithm is used to design additional sub-synchronous damping controller. By using this algorithm, the optimal parameters of the controller in different operating modes are found by taking the damping ratio as the objective function, so as to suppress the sub-synchronous oscillations. Finally, a HVDC project is taken as an example model, and PSCAD/EMTDC simulation program and matrix beam algorithm are used to verify the effectiveness of the damping controller.

articleTitle: An Improved Method of Internal Circulation Suppression Strategy for Single-Phase Ground Fault
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Because the upper and under bridge arm voltage of each phases are inconformity with each other based on MMC-HVDC, resulting in the internal circulation of converter. Circulation will cause each phase converter arm current distortion, so it is important to suppress the circulation. The usual method for inhibition circulation inhibits the internal circulation of converter under the normal operation condition. Firstly, it analyzes the method of inhibiting circulation under normal circumstances. Then, it focuses on the effects of unbalanced current under fault condition on the internal circulation and DC current through the AC system single-phase ground fault analysis and designs the additional controller to improve the traditional inhibition circulation strategy under fault conditions. Finally it verifies the the feasibility of theoretical analysis and improvement measures throught the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Operational Risk Evaluation of Distribution Grid Based on Sensitivity Ideology with Distributed Photo Voltaic Generation Centrally Accessed
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the aggravating of environmental damage and energy shortage, it becomes a trend that distributed photovoltaic generation centrally accessed to distribution grid. Due to its vulnerability to weather, and the original power supply mode with a single power source is altered to the one with duplicate supply, which will change the power flow, the distributed photovoltaic generation increases the randomness of operational state, thus changes the operational risk of distribution grid. First, influence factors which caused by centrally accessed distributed photovoltaic generation are introduced. Then aiming at the characteristic that distributed photovoltaic generation is accessed in a single-point way, a method which uses probabilistic power flow algorithm based on sensitivity ideology is proposed to evaluate the operational risk. Finally, a case study is conducted to demonstrate the evaluation method proposed can provide standards for planning centralized access of distributed photovoltaic generation.

articleTitle: An Advanced Anode Supported Solid Oxide Fuel Cell Flow Field Design with Pressure Equalization Slots
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a innovative three dimensional anode-supported Solid Oxide Fuel Cell (SOFC) model with pressure equalization slots is developed by Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) methods. The pressure equalization applied in microreactor is introduced to SOFC flow field design optimization. The comparison between traditional parallel gas channel design and advanced design is finished, including the flow uniformity and cell performance parameters. Finally, the optimized SOFC model with pressure equalization slots has stronger performance than traditional planar SOFC model with parallel gas channels, which is able to be used as the future SOFC model design and optimization.

articleTitle: Capacity Optimization Analysis of Dispersed Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integration and local consumption of dispersed wind power generation is an effective solution to wind power discarding of large scale of centralized wind farms, increasing the utilization efficiency of the wind source greatly. So far, there is no specified standard issued, determining the installation capacity of dispersed wind farms. The unique criterion to determine that whether the power generated by the wind farms could be consumed locally is the valley load, which ensures the uniqueness of the power flow direction through the transformers, to which the wind farm is connected, relaxing the pressure of dispatching and operating. However, the aforementioned criterion is too harsh, assuming entirely opposite of the load curve and wind farm output power curve, which weakens the utilization efficiency of wind source and leads to great discounting of the economy of the wind power investment. Hence, an optimization method for dispersed wind farm installation capacity connected to power networks of 110kV or below is proposed in this paper, which forecasts the output power curves of the newly installed wind farm according to high positive correlations among wind farms near to each other and determines the actual consumption level of the dispersed wind farm according to load curve and the wind farm output power curve, combining reasonable wind power discarding strategy. The result of some real wind farms in Jiangsu shows that the installation capacity of the dispersed wind farm is increased effectively, raising the annual profit of the wind farm greatly.

articleTitle: Calculation of Reaction Force for the Gas-Blast Type Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to explore the calculation method of the arc chamber gas reaction force and provide support for the design of the high-voltage circuit breaker mechanical transmission system, four calculation formulas of the reaction force micro-element under the four gas-solid interface conditions were derived, a test calculation case was designed and the effectiveness of the calculation method was verified. The no-arc simulation calculation model of the 252kV SF6 arc chamber was established, and the pressure distribution and the gas reaction force were obtained, the simulation results showed that: with the piston moving, the pressure inside the compression chamber increased first and then decreased, the max pressure of 1.86 MPa occurred at 0.029s; similarly, the reaction force changed with the same trend, the max reaction force of 1.95×104N occurred at 0.03s, which showed that under no-arc condition, the pressure load of the compressor chamber dominates the reaction force for arc chamber.

articleTitle: Pre-processing and audit of power consumption data based on composite mathematical statistics model
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the promotion of intelligent power consumption information acquisition system, power companies can easily obtain a large number of real and effective data sets from the acquisition system. These data sets can help power companies fully grasp the user's power consumption and then analyze user behaviors and power consumption characteristics. However, due to signal interference and other factors, in the currently running acquisition systems, some “dirty data” is inevitably mixed in. Due to the huge amount of data collected by the power system, the total amount of these contaminated data cannot be ignored, and the data extraction and analysis work caused a great deal of interference. Traditional outlier detection methods rely on the intuitive judgment of experienced staff. This paper attempts to design a power data preprocessing model based on mathematical statistics and using detection methods commonly used in mathematical statistics. This can help power grid workers improve the efficiency of auditing original abnormal data and optimizes the quality of the data sets.

articleTitle: Capacitor Voltage Balancing Control Strategy for Converters in 500kV Sunan UPFC
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The series and shunt converters of 500 kV Sunan Unified Power Flow Controller (UPFC) substation adopt modular multilevel converter (MMC) structure, but the inaccurate sampling of bridge arm current in low power mode will affect the sub-module capacitor voltage balancing. To overcome this defect, a capacitor voltage balancing control strategy with arm current senseless is proposed, and the submodule capacitor voltage is used to fit the real-time bridge arm current to determine the charge and discharge state of the submodule. A single-loop MMC-UPFC simulation model is built by using MATLAB/Simulink software. The simulation results show that the proposed capacitor voltage balancing control strategy has good control effect in low power mode, which provides a theoretical basis for practical engineering applications.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Effect of UHV Series Compensation Capacitor on Distance Protection
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The use of a series compensated capacitor causes damage to the intrinsic impedance of a power transmission line and affects operation actions of protection such as distance, etc. For this problem, a model whose operation mode is the same as the one at a site is built. The effect of the series compensated capacitor on directional circle characteristic impedance relay distance protection is summarized by inputting actual parameters and via simulation analysis. The position of different failures and protection action logic and method under different capacitor compensation degrees are studied by using the software PSCAD; the FFT transformation of data is made by using MATLAB, and then the spectrum characteristics of data are further analyzed; the use of a series compensated capacitor bank reduces the range of distance protection; and possible protection malfunction under special conditions in case of an external or reverse fault is pointed out. Spectrum characteristics are studied and discussed in a failure state. When the positive direction of a capacitor bank suffers a short-circuit failure, there is no low-frequency current component; on the contrary, when the rear of the capacitor bank suffers a short-circuit failure, the low-frequency component accounts for a certain ratio. Finally, the countermeasure and solution to series compensated protection are studied according to the characteristics of line protection with the series compensated capacitor added.

articleTitle: Research on Ge-Nan HVDC Transmission System Based on LCC-D-MMC Configuration
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: LCC-D-MMC hybrid HVDC configuration is applied to the capacity-increasing improvement project of the Ge-Nan HVDC system. Due to the lack of practical engineering experience, the key technologies of LCC-D-MMC hybrid HVDC configuration need to be further studied and demonstrated. In this paper, the system structure with LCC-D-MMC configuration was introduced and a brief review of advantages and disadvantages was given from the economic cost, technical challenges and system performance aspects. The optimal access scheme for this system was selected and analyzed. Secondly, detailed analysis including the reactive voltage, transient stability and thermal stability of the control strategy and startup scheme for the hybrid system were given. Finally, the over current stress before and after pole block of MMC-HVDC pole-to-pole fault was calculated theoretically and verified by simulation. The simulation MACH control system was used to simulate the virtual machine in the PSCAD/EMTDC, and the simulation results show that the scheme was feasible.

articleTitle: Research on IGBT Series Optimization Method Based on Gate Voltage Control
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: IGBT devices are widely used in power devices such as photovoltaic inverters, wind power converters, flexible DC converter valves, and unified power flow controllers due to their advantages of easy drive control, fast switching speed and large capacity. The existing flexible DC converter valve, DC circuit breaker, unified power flow controller and other equipment voltage levels have reached 500kV, usually requires a large number of power electronic devices or series stacking of half-bridge components, which has met the needs of high voltage applications, so IGBT The series technology is still of great research significance for improving the compactness of the device and further improving the voltage level of the equipment. Based on the IGBT gate active voltage control method, this paper proposes a reference voltage optimization method, which can further reduce the IGBT switching loss and improve the voltage balance, and improve the applicability of the method. Finally, the correctness of the method is verified by IGBT series experiment.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Dielectric Loss Overproof of Dry-type Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Dry-type current transformer is widely used in the power grid of 110 kV, this paper mainly introduces the structure and characteristics of dry-type current transformer, analysis the physical meaning and influence of dielectric loss. According to the experimental data and theoretical analysis and after experimental verification, we eventually get the causes of the dielectric loss exceed the standard of dry-type current transformer. We will provide effective cases for the experimental analysis of dry-type current transformer.

articleTitle: Multi-Source Dynamic Coordinated Control Strategy for DC Microgrid Based on Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The DC microgrid can provides an effective solution for integration of various loads, distributed generations(DGs),and distributed storages. With the expansion of DC microgrid capacity, coordinated control between multiple distributed generations has become a research hotspot. The conventional droop control has low accuracy of load current sharing due to the inconsistent parameters in the DC microgrid. To solve this problem, based on the fuzzy algorithm, this paper designs a distributed hierarchical control structure of DC microgrid, and sets corresponding control strategies at each layer to achieve multi-source dynamic coordination. Firstly, the influence of line resistance on load current sharing is analyzed in detail. Then, the fuzzy controller is designed to dynamically change the virtual resistance. Finally, the secondary compensation control is used to eliminate bus voltage deviation. The simulation model is built by Matlab/Simulink and the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the designed control strategy.

articleTitle: Abnormal Activity Detection based on MCRF
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Abnormal activity detection based on MCRF (Multiple Conditional Random Fields) model is proposed. The advantage of MCRF model is the ability of combining more Features of abnormal activity and utilizing adaptive contextual information. Several features subsets can be formed through more features extraction. Then we made use of CRF (Conditional Random Fields) model to each feature subset and got CRF units. Finally, we combined all the CRF units to produce MCRF model which was utilized to detect abnormal activity. The experimental results indicate that the detection accuracy rate of this method is better. And the time of Model training is reduced by Parallel Processing.

articleTitle: A Validity Test Methodfor Transmission Betweens and Transmission Sections Based on Chain Attack Analysisand Line Outage Distribution Factors
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The identification of transmission sections is used to improve the efficiency of monitoring the operation of the power grid. In order to test the validity of transmission sections identified, an assessment process is necessary. In addition, Transmission betweenness, an index for finding the key transmission lines in the power grid, should also be verified. In this paper, chain attack is assumed to check the weak links in the grid, thus verifying the transmission betweenness implemented for the system. Moreover, the line outage distribution factors (LODFs) are used to quantify the change of power flow when the leading line in transmission sections breaks down, so that the validity of transmission sections can be proved. Case studies based on IEEE 39 and IEEE 118 -bus system proved the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Saturation Load Forecasting Based on Long Short-Time Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The number of factors affecting the level of electricity consumption are gradually increasing. To analyze the influence of these factors on the saturation load, a multi-input saturation load forecasting model based on long short-term memory network is proposed in this paper. The model can deal with the uncertainty and time correlation of saturation load forecasting. Historical load information is saved in the long-term memory cell in the model, and the load information is updated according to the short-term factor input. Firstly, this paper takes six factors as the input of the model, and Adam optimization method is selected to do model training. Next, combined with the saturation load criterion, the optimized model is used to forecast the future annual maximum load and electricity consumption, and then the final saturation time and scale can be decided. Finally, an example shows that compared with the traditional prediction model, the model in this paper can do prediction with higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Path Optimization of UAV Patrol and Relay Process
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the optimization of search path planning in the process of multi-UAV relay mission. The purpose of search path planning is to determine the specific location of unknown ground mobile personnel and network them so that the UAV can carry out relay tasks. For UAV relay communication interrupt, distortion and other issues that may occur, analysis of the communication network information transmission route selection, selection of communication time delay as the performance index, by changing the path choice of UAV to improve the performance of communication network. The simulation results show the effectiveness of improving the performance of communication relay and communication network.

articleTitle: An Analytic Method to Calculate Thévenin Equivalent Parameters Using Single-Time Wide Area PMU Measurements
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents an analytic method calculating Thévenin equivalent (TE) parameters with single-time measurements. TE model of power systems is used in static voltage stability estimation. However, identification of TE parameters faces with accuracy issue currently. In this paper, we derives analytic expression of Thévenin equivalent parameters using single-time wide area measurements. It can avoid the accuracy issue caused by system disturbance. The simulation results on New England 39-bus system proves the effectiveness and accuracy of proposed method.

articleTitle: Zero Sequence Admittance based Fault Location in Low Resistance Grounding Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High fault transition resistance and the integration of distributed generations (DGs) make it difficult for single phase-to-earth fault location in distribution systems. This paper presents a method for single phase-to-earth fault section location in low resistance grounding system based on the measured synchronized zero sequence admittance. The measured zero sequence admittance is calculated by local PMU and then be sent to the operation center. The upstream or downstream of the fault point is judged based on the measured admittance angle. This fault section method is not affected by fault transition resistance, and can be suitable for different grid connected transform grounding modes of DG. The feasibility and accuracy of this proposed method is proved by the PSCAD simulation results.

articleTitle: A Novel Coordinated Control Strategy for VSC-MTDC System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage source converter based multi-terminal direct current(VSC-MTDC) syetem has great advantages in renewable energy grid connection. In order to realize additional functions such as frequency support and reasonable power distribution, in this paper, a coordinated control strategy for voltage source converter based multi-terminal direct current system based on Multi-Agent System (MAS) is proposed. Firstly, a multi Agent cooperative control system for information interchange of multiple converter stations is established, The strategy regards VSC as the interface of AC and DC system, and establishes the coupling relationship between frequency in AC system and voltage in DC system. The frequency support of AC system is realized by transferring the frequency value between agents and adjusting the power distribution between VSC in real time. At the same time, Agent monitors the local VSC load rate and communicates with each other, adjusts the active power distribution in time to avoid the VSC load situation. After that, the complete control scheme of converter station based on MAS is given.Finally, based on DIgSILENT/Powerfactory power system simulation software, a 6 terminal VSC-MTDC system have been built, the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy in power grid which can control frequency effectively and allocate the active power reasonably is verified by the simulation model.

articleTitle: A Novel Inter-Country Integrated Power Generation-Transmission Expansion Planning Model: Case Study on North-East Asia
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The unbalanced distribution of energy resources and power demand in Northeast Asia determines that the optimal resources utilization needs to break national boundaries and realize transnational power transmission. In this paper, a novel inter-country integrated power generation-transmission expansion planning model is proposed to solve the issue of source-grid coordination planning in different countries in the interconnection area. Taking Northeast Asia as an example, the optimal planning results of transnational transmission capacity and installed power generation capacity in various countries are obtained under different development scenarios. The results show that the power source structure of exporting countries will impact the economic competitiveness and potential scale of interconnection.

articleTitle: A New Research on Intelligent Protection and Positioning Integration Method of Single Phase Grounding Fault in Small Current Grounding System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a method of intelligent protection and location integration for single-phase grounding fault in small current grounding system, which can quickly transfer the grounding current at the grounding fault point and make the current at the grounding fault point tend to zero. The arc cannot maintain and extinguish, thereby protecting the personal safety of the staff. At the same time, the fault location is carried out according to the principle that the zero sequence electrical parameters on different lines and the zero sequence electrical parameters of each line after the active grounding of the fault phase bus before and after the single-phase grounding fault. Finally, through PSCAD/EMTDC and Matlab simulation, the feasibility and effectiveness of this method are verified from different ground resistance, initial phase angle, and fault distance in small current grounding system.

articleTitle: An Improved Measurement Method for Wideband Multi-Frequency Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Interharmonics will generate severe mutual interferences and result in measurement errors in wideband multi-frequency signal measurement. Furthermore, the parameters of fundamental wave can also be impacted by its adjacent interharmonics. Under asynchronous sampling condition, the side lobe leakage of fundamental and harmonic components will make the interharmonic components more complicated. To address this issue, this paper proposed a method for wideband multi-frequency signal measurement. First, the multi-interharmonic model was established, and the spectrum separation and measurement (SSM) algorithm was introduced. Then, a quasi-synchronous sampling method can be achieved based on SSM. The complexity of interharmonics is reduced by using the quasi-synchronous sampling process, which can greatly inhibits the fundamental and harmonic interferences. The proposed method has been validated by the synthetic signal. The results show that the dense interharmonics can be identified and measured with relatively high precision.

articleTitle: A Novel Data-Driven Robust Method Applied to OPF with Uncertain Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the arrival of the big data era, the wind power accommodation has an alternative solution. Meanwhile, the traditional stochastic optimization or robust optimization methods may result in uneconomic or conservative decisions in dealing with the uncertainty problems. Based on this, it is proposed to apply robust optimization of data driven to optimal power flow under the participation of wind power, and the model is improved on the basis of integrated 1- norm and infinity norm. The final example analysis also proves the validity and practicability of the model.

articleTitle: Study on the Effects of Different Measures in Promoting Renewable Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale renewables integrated into power grid has been an inevitable developing trend worldwide. This paper studied investment and operational costs of power system with high penetration of renewables by using the improved time series system production simulation analysis method. The supply cost of the whole system are taken as objective, and the curtailment of wind and solar generation is considered in optimization process by using a punishment function. Three different regulating measures, i.e., by increasing regulation depth of interconnection lines, by increasing capacity of energy storage and gas-fired power units, and by increasing deep-shaving ability of thermal power units, are considered and studied to show economical differences of the system while meeting the large-scale renewables integration requirements. Research results show that to build more energy storage and other flexible power units is an expensive way to solve intermittent and fluctuant problems caused by renewables integration. And the way to make good use of the regulating potential of thermal power units and cross-regional connecting lines can get the same effects with lower costs.

articleTitle: Adaptive Updating of Power System Transient Stability Prediction Model Based on Data Inheritance
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transient stability prediction using machine learning algorithms has been highly concerned. Existing researches have made great progress in simplified scenarios, while these simplifications cannot be made in a practical problem. Considering two typical characteristics of power systems: time-varying and data-increasing, two methods of prediction model updating are proposed in this paper. Transfer learning is applied to adding samples to a time-varying system with insufficient training samples. Incremental learning is used to update the prediction model with constantly increasing training samples. Both two methods make the prediction model more robust in a dynamic power system. In IEEE 39-bus system, the proposed methods are tested in angle and frequency stability problem respectively. Results show that transfer learning makes more accurate prediction in a time-varying power system than traditional method and incremental learning enables model updating to be fast enough to be applied online. More importantly, the proposed updating methods can be further investigated for practical application.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study on Application of Integrated Energy System in Cold Regions: A Case Study in Tianjin
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the benefits on energy-saving and environment-protection, many other countries are applying integrated energy systems for sustainable development. Such trend can also be found in many regions of China. Some studies on the feasibility of integrated energy systems could be found with aspects of design, plan and simulation, however there has been few specific case study available for that under cold climates. This paper presented a case study of Tianjin and proposes an available research method and relevant evaluation index, and obtains the applicability results of PGUs with diverse capacites under four typical building types, areas, three feed-in electricity prices and three natural gas prices in cold regions.

articleTitle: Fault Location in Active Distribution Network Based on Convariance Matrix and PMU Data
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Fault diagnosis and location of distribution network is a difficult problem. With the integration of the distributed generation, the multi-source of the fault current makes the problem more complex. This paper proposes a fault diagnosis method based on synchronized measurement information matrix, which includes two procedures: 1) to detect the occurrence of the fault; 2) to locate the fault section and determine the fault type. Firstly, the local covariance matrix is defined by introducing sliding window based on synchronous phasor information. Then, a local information covariance matrix is constructed by taking each PMU's data as a sample at a certain moment to detect the occurrence of the fault. The fault segment is located and the fault type is determined via improving the local covariance matrix. Finally, a simulation example is used to verify the effectiveness and reliability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Influences of Large Scale Wind/Solar Integration on Distrabution System Transient Stability
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the construction of distributed energy in China has entered a period of rapid development. The stability influence of large-scale access of distributed generation (DG) to distribution network can't be ignored. Firstly, it analyzes the torque and speed characteristics of double-fed induction generator (DFIG), and it is studied that the influence on the transient stability of distribution network. Secondly, based on the extended equal-area criterion (EEAC), the influence of wind power and photovoltaic (PV) connection on the transient stability of distribution network is theoretically analyzed. The output power of DFIG and PV is equated to the mechanical power of synchronous generator, and the control function of DFIG and PV is considered at the same time. Based on this, the influence of DFIG and PV integration on distribution network transient stability is analyzed. Finally, the correctness of the mechanism analysis is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Adaptive traveling waves based protection of distribution lines
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Single-phase-to-ground fault in power distribution system with neutral point non-effectively grounded has different fault characteristics compared with other short-circuit faults. Single-phase-to-ground fault will not lead to over current but generate travelling waves information. Overcurrent protection for other short-circuit faults can't be applied to protect single-phase-to-ground fault. In this paper, a fast identification algorithm for single-phase-to-ground fault based on traveling wave is proposed. The proposed algorithm can accurately identify single-phase-to-ground fault from other short-circuit faults. Based on the algorithm, adaptive protection of distribution lines is presented using travelling waves and overcurrent.

articleTitle: Analysis of Renewable Energy Accommodation Capability of Shanxi Power Grid Based on Operation Simulation Method
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper introduces a method for renewable energy accommodation capability calculation based on operation simulations. Load and renewable power output characteristics are analyzed in detail. On this foundation, screening methods for typical scenarios of load and renewable power output in operation simulations are proposed. Finally, combined with the planning of power source and power grid, the renewable energy accommodation capability of Shanxi power grid is evaluated using above method.

articleTitle: Direct Power Control Strategy of Single-Phase MMC with Harmonic Control Capability
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, the research of MMC is mainly focused on the field of three-phase DC transmission. In this paper, the expression of MMC in dark coordinate is established, and the direct power control strategy of single-phase MMC is deduced and the resonant controller is introduced in the power loop. At the same time, considering the control of harmonic current by MMC, a frequency-adaptive power splitter is designed to obtain the expectation of compensation. Finally, a simulation experiment is designed in Matlab / Simulink. It is proved that the single phase MMC with direct power control is not only flexible in power control, but also has the ability of harmonic control.

articleTitle: Dynamic Environmental Economic Dispatch Model of Combined Cooling Heating and Power Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the uncertainties of wind and photovoltaic power output and cooling, heating and power load forecasting values in micro-grid, the cooling, heating and power balance and power rotation reserve constraints with uncertain variables are expressed as chance constraints in this paper. And they are solved by transforming them into corresponding clear equivalence classes. Besides, under the electricity market time-sharing tariff policy, a scheduling model of grid-connected microgrid combined cooling, heating and power system is established, which considers both the economy and environmental protection of dispatching and the benefits of cooling and heating. The multi-objective processing method based on satisfaction index takes into account economic and environmental goals. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the validity of the model by analyzing the micro-power output plan and the corresponding dispatching scheme of cooling, heating and power loads.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Multi-Carrier Energy Networks Considering Liquid Air Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy storage technologies are crucial to the future integrated energy system (IES) in the context of energy internet (EI). Liquid air energy storage (LAES) technology has been widely researched and implemented in the United Kingdom, since there are no special restrictions on geography compared to other technologies. However, there is little attention on LAES in China. In this paper, a linear programming model for the optimal scheduling of multicarrier energy networks considering LAES is established based on the concept of cryogenic energy hub, that is LAES-HUB. The results show that the daily operation cost of LAES-HUB model is 43735.28 RMB, which is even higher than the energy networks works without LEAS. LAES can achieve load shifting through peak and off-peak operations, providing an auxiliary function for energy balance in multi-carrier energy networks.

articleTitle: Condition Assessment of Power Cable Based on Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process and Set Pair Analysis Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power cable is one of the most important components in energy internet and energy system integration. To provide a decision support for maintenance of power cable, this paper proposes a method for comprehensive operation condition assessment of power cable based on fuzzy analytic hierarchy process and set pair analysis approach. An evaluation indicator system of cable condition was established, and the operation state was divided into four ranks, including normal, attention, abnormal and serious state. Then the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process and set pair analysis approach were introduced for the condition assessment of power cable. Operation condition assessment of power cable was conducted with the proposed method through an actual example, and the result corresponds well with the actual situation.

articleTitle: A Distributed Algorithm for Resource Allocation in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this study, we study the distributed resource allocation problem over undirected network in smart grid with continuous-time communication. Each generator is accompanied by one private convex objective function. Furthermore, all generators are required to converge to the global optimal solution through cooperation. Therefore, a fully gradient-based decentralized method is designed to deal with the above optimization issue. Furthermore, a constant step-size control gain of gradient is given, which can ensure the achievement of the global optimizer. Moreover, a sufficient condition is presented, which guarantees that above designed algorithm can obtain the global optimal solution. At last, we present an application simulation of resource allocation problem in smart grid to explain the feasibility for above proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the Transformer Load Capacity Evaluation Method Based on Hot Spot Temperature Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The evaluation of transformer load capacity is of great significance to its safe and economical operation. The transformer load capacity is closely related to its hot spot temperature. In this paper, finite element simulation method is used to calculate the transformer hot spot temperature. The temperature field of transformer under different load factors is calculated and the relationship between the transformer load coefficient and the hot spot temperature rise is studied through simulation results, and the load capacity is evaluated according to the temperature rise limit of the transformer.

articleTitle: Operating Characteristics and Influence on Power Grid with Distributed Electric Heating Considering Load Transfer
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the issue in vigorously developing distributed electric heating in the north, high simultaneity of electric heating load is easy to cause seasonal power supply insufficiency of grid, load transfer characteristics of three types of distributed electric heating equipment, such as direct heating type, heat accumulation type and air-source heat pump, is compared, and influence of different load transfer characteristics on load rate and voltage quality is analyzed. The heat load is simulated through Markov chain Monte Carlo model. Taking typical village electric heating topology as example, load transfer characteristics of different type of electric heating device is simulated and analyzed on Power factory software platform. Result of simulation proved that load transfer optimizes grid voltage level and transformer load rate.

articleTitle: Research on Planning Difficulty and Decoupling Method of Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper clarifies the relationship between integrated energy system, smart grid and energy internet. And the paper proposes that integrated energy system is the realization form of energy internet at the current stage, and further describes the composition and basic principle of integrated energy system. Then the paper summarized research results, summarized experience of micro grid demonstration project and other projects, put forward basic idea of essential demand, broke the routine for planning, construction and operation of integrated energy system, focused on essential demand of regional energy utilization, gave main steps of demand analysis, and expounded basic method of decoupling analysis. Finally, the paper suggested that the academic community pay attention to research of key theories and technologies, and the state encourage the development of integrated energy service industry.

articleTitle: A Chinese Word Segmentation Model for Energy Literature Based on Conditional Random Fields
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Chinese word segmentation is one of the foundation and core tasks for Chinese natural language processing. Although some achievements have been made for Chinese word segmentation system in general domains, it is far away to meet practical requirements in energy domain. We focus on Chinese word segmentation standard and segmentation technology in the energy domain which consists of 13283 energy basic terms. This paper firstly proposes a conditional random field segmentation model. Then, the character features, character type features and conditional entropy features which influence the word segmentation performance are chose and described. Finally, the proposed model is tested on the dataset of the State Grid energy literature and compared with current word segmentation tools, such as the Harbin Institute of Technology's Language Technology Platform and the Tsinghua's THU Lexical Analyzer for Chinese language processing tools. The F1 value of the best result of the proposed model is 0.8319.

articleTitle: Research on the Modeling Method and Turn-to-Turn Short Circuit Monitoring Method for the Dry-Type Air-Core Reactor
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Lightning and switching may result in a turn-to-turn shout circuit fault of the dry-type air-core reactor, which would have an effect on the safety of the power system. In this paper, an air-core reactor circuit model is established base on the partial element equivalent circuit (PEEC) method, and a method using the waveform relaxation(WR) algorithm to solve the circuit model is adopted. Some examples are provided which demonstrates the accuracy and the efficiency of the proposed model and method. Based on the proposed method, a monitoring method based on the shifting of the resonance frequency is proposed and validated in this paper.

articleTitle: Improvement on Application of Gray Correlation Analysis in Intelligent Transformer Area Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the voltage eigenvalues of the intelligent electricity meter, a new method, which will improve the gray correlation analysis, for recognizing the transformer area is proposed. This method will overcome the existed disadvantages and implement the intelligent recognition through analyzing the correlation of line voltages between the unrecognized or cross-zone electricity meter and the recognized electricity meter. The test result shows this method is able to accurately identify the transformer area under complex and complicated environmental conditions which is of great practical value.

articleTitle: Assessment of Required Dynamic VAR Reserve Near HVDC Converter and Case Study
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The short-term voltage stability (STVS) is usually weak near HVDC converter, so the dynamic VAR devices are required to improve its STVS. In this paper, the approach to assess the requirement of dynamic VAR reserve near HVDC converter is studied. Firstly, an index to evaluate short-term voltage stability (STVS) is proposed. Secondly, the method of calculating the reactive power output ability of the dynamic VARs in transient process is proposed. Thirdly, the method of dynamic VAR reserve planning is proposed. Lastly, a case study based on actual power grids are presented.

articleTitle: Overview of Storage System and EV Aggregation Charging Behavior in Energy Market
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Electrical vehicle (EV) technology is gaining popularity; it is because of many factors like reduction in carbon and green gas and usage of vehicle batteries as a storage element in the power system. However, the increasing usage of auxiliary loads i.e. EV and heat pumps creates adverse effects on the grid. Flexibility of power consumption due to uncertainty in modern day grid requires some storage elements. In this paper an overview of modern day grid is presented. Moreover the charging scheduling of Aggregators EVs battery is addressed. The mathematical formulation for generalization of EV, battery energy storage system (BESS) is presented with the constraints. Finally the case study for multi aggregator charging schedule generation is presented which can also be extended to a generalized modelling of storage system with different new energy sources in the future. The required results and the proposed mathematical modelling shows the effectiveness of the solution towards a more modern day grid friendly environment.

articleTitle: Study on Electromagnetic Interference of Electronic Transformer Under Operation of 330kV GIS Disconnector
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous increase of the voltage grade in the substation, the switch operating overvoltage, especially the very fast transient overvoltage (VFTO), and the electromagnetic interference of the transformer in the substation caused by VFTO has attracted more and more attention. Based on a new generation of intelligent 330kV substation demonstration project, which has the highest voltage level in China, this paper analyses the physical process of the generation and propagation of VFTO in the high voltage substation by combining the simulation calculation with the test detection. Taking the high frequency transient model of the acquisition unit based on Roche coil as an example, the signal waveforms of the Roche coil port under VFTO are obtained. By comparing the simulation data and the signal waveforms of the measured merging unit, the high frequency electromagnetic interference characteristics of substation equipment under VFTO are reflected.

articleTitle: Wind Power Accommodation Optimization Considering Voltage Safety and System Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase of wind power penetration, the influence of large-scale wind power integration on the static voltage security of power network is ever-increasing. In this case, accommodation level of wind power will directly lead to the change of the voltage level at each node in the network. In order to meet the static voltage safety of the power network, energy saving and emission reduction by the integration of wind power, a multi-objective wind power accommodation optimization model is proposed in view of the safety of network voltage. In this model, the optimal cost of energy consumption and the highest voltage security are taken as the targets, and the multi-objective quantum particle swarm optimization (QPSO) algorithm is used to obtain the optimal wind power accommodation level. The model is analyzed and verified based on IEEE-30 bus. The results show that the model is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Start-Up of Virtual Synchronous Machine: Methods and Experimental Comparison
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A modern grid is smarter mainly in the advance in information and communication technologies, while the power processing mechanism does not make a big difference. To make a modern grid smarter, the grid control should be improved to process the power in a smarter way. Therefore, it is easily foreseen that virtual synchronous machines, which emulates the synchronous machines based on power converters, may have big potentials in a future energy internet. This paper uses the Synchronous Power Controller with emulated and improved synchronous machine characteristics for renewable generation systems and proposes two start-up strategies. The proposed strategies are explained in detail, verified and compared by experimental results.

articleTitle: Two-Step Optimization for Limiting Three-Phase and Single-Phase Short Circuit Current
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuously increasing capacity of modern power system, the problem of excessive short circuit current is becoming more and more severe. Not only three-phase short circuit current (TSCC), but also single-phase short circuit current (SSCC) has exceeded the upper limit. In this paper, a two-step optimization method to limit both of TSCC and SSCC is proposed. Different characteristics of various limiting measures have been analyzed. The limiting measures for TSCC can limit SSCC. However, the limiting measures for SSCC have no effect on TSCC. The configuration for TSCC limiting measures is optimized using adaptive hybrid PSO algorithm firstly, which considers the cost and grid tightness at the same time. After this step, the excessive TSCC should be eliminated. Based on the obtained optimal configuration for TSCC, the optimization for SSCC continues, which makes a two-step short circuit current limiting method. The optimal configuration for SSCC limiting measures is obtained using hybrid integer programming with minimum cost as the objective. Given the limiting effect of TSCC limiting measures for SSCC and high calculating speed of hybrid integer programming, the optimization for SSCC might be omitted in many actual cases, which makes a faster optimization speed therefore is more suitable for online application. The effectiveness of the proposed two-step optimization method is validated by the cases of two actual regional power systems.

articleTitle: Survey of DC Side Fault Characteristics in VSC-MTDC System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Analyzing the characteristics of the fault in VSC-MTDC system can help to quickly identify the kind of it and eliminate its effect in time, in order to avoid further damage of the whole system, which protect the grid operating safely. In this paper, a four-terminal VSC-MTDC simulation platform was built for study based on Matlab/Simulink. Different kinds of faults were set on the DC line, and their fault characteristics were compared. Particularly the single pole grounding fault with the highest frequency of occurrence is studied in detail, including the effect of DC side capacitance, smoothing reactor, grounding resistance and the location of faults on the line, which provides a reference for the future design of grid code requirements related to VSC-MTDC system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Harmonic Characteristics of Asymmetric Bridge Arm Parameters in MMC
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) have many advantages over traditional voltage source converters. It is used more and more widely. However, it is inevitable to run in an unsatisfactory situation actually. The asymmetry of the bridge arm inductance parameter causes imbalance in the operating conditions, which causes harmonic problems on the AC side and the DC side in turn. In this paper, the average switching function theory is used to establish the harmonic mathematical model of bridge arm voltage and phase-to-phase circulation for analyzing the phase voltage and DC current of the AC port. It shows that asymmetry of the single-phase bridge arm inductance will cause the asymmetrical odd-order harmonic in the circulation, and asymmetry of phase bridge arm parameters causes asymmetrical even harmonic. The harmonic amplitude is positively related to the asymmetry. The asymmetry of bridge arm introduces DC component and even harmonics such as second harmonic into the AC port; The fluctuation on the DC side is mainly based on fundamental frequency, double frequency and triple frequency. The simulation results verify the correctness of the proposed mathematical model and the law.

articleTitle: DC Voltage Control of AC/DC Hybrid Distribution Network with Low-Speed Distributed Wind Energy Conversion Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to promote the development of low-speed wind sites close to the load center, an AC/DC hybrid distribution system with low-speed distributed wind energy conversion systems (LD-WECS) was constructed in matlab/simulink. An improved control strategy was proposed to solve the DC bus voltage fluctuation caused by low-speed and high-turbulence wind. In the improved control strategy, the hybrid energy storage system (HESS) was installed in front of the DC bus of wind energy conversion systems (WECS), and the feed forward control based on the predicted wind power was used to control the output power of HESS, maintaining the power of DC bus, therefore, DC bus voltage will be more stable. The results show that the improved strategy can stabilize DC bus voltage under high-turbulence wind speed effectively.

Author Keywords: low-speed distributed wind energy conversion systems

articleTitle: Start-up and Shut-down Strategies of Hybrid LCC/VSC DC Grids
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The line commutated converter based high-voltage direct-current (LCC-HVDC) technology has been widely used for transferring bulk power over long distances in the past decades. In recent years, the voltage level and power capacity of voltage source converter (VSC) based HVDC technology have experienced a great development which provides a possibility of building hybrid LCC/VSC dc systems. In this paper, a four-terminal hybrid LCC/VSC dc grid with two LCCs as the rectifiers and two VSCs as the inverters is proposed. The start-up and shut-down control strategies of this hybrid systems have been proposed with the consideration of the inherent characteristics of the two technologies. The proposed strategies can mitigate the voltage spikes and current surges during the start-up and shut-down processes. The proposed dc grid model and control strategies are developed and validated in PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power Control of the Grid-Side Converter of DFIG Based Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: During the grid fault, the rotor-side converter of the doubly-fed wind turbine exits the operation under the protection of the rotor and cannot generate reactive power. For this problem, this paper analyzes the mathematical model and reactive power regulation capability of the grid-side converter, two effective control models are proposed to ensure that the wind farm can still provide reactive power to the grid and keep the system running stably during the fault. In this paper, a three-machine nine-node system including a doubly-fed wind farm is established in the DIgSILENT /Power Factory simulation software, the simulation results show that the traditional unit power factor control mode of the grid-side converter can not meet the reactive power demand of the power grid during the grid fault. However, the two control methods proposed in this paper can generate more reactive power and achieve rapid recovery of voltage, which improves the transient voltage stability of the wind power access system to a certain extent. Finally, the two control methods of the grid-side converter are analyzed and compared from the aspects of reactive power regulation capability and dynamic response characteristics, and the best control method is proposed.

Author Keywords: Voltage and power outer loop control mode

articleTitle: Research on Field Electromagnetic Compatibility Test Method of System Level for Electronic Transformers
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The existing current standards for electronic transformers are formulated based on the equivalent of traditional electromagnetic transformers and secondary side protection equipments. In this situation, Although these products have can passed the type test, but there are still a large number of electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) problems still appeared in actual operation. In this paper, based on the actual field application, the interference mechanism of the AIS isolating switch and the electromagnetic transient process on the electronic transformers is simulated. The interference model of the transient electromagnetic field to the secondary side of the electronic transformers and the transmission cables are obtained. Then, a field system-level EMC test method of electronic transformers is proposed. This method is based on the actual equipment and wiring conditions in substations, and the anti-strong electromagnetic disturbance ability of the electronic transformers is evaluated under the condition of “conventional” or “unconventional” operations. Finally, Finally, the field application of system-level electromagnetic compatibility test was carried out in the 330kV Xinsheng Substation, and the fault electronic transformer was tested, which proved the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A Data Mining Method for Extracting Key Factors of Distribution Network Reliability
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Owning to the intelligence and complexity of modern distribution network, determining and applying the key factors to improve the reliability of distribution network effectively and correctly is a difficult task. Based on acquired data of distribution network, a data mining method for key factors extraction of distribution network reliability is proposed in this paper. The factor analysis is used to reduce the dimension of raw data matrix, and effective factors of distribution network are found. The association rules mining is used to analyze the relevance between effective factors and reliability indices and the key factors are determined. Case study shows that the proposed method is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Grid Connected Photovoltaic Power Generation Station and it's Influence on Dispatching Operation Mode
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
