abstract: As a new type of energy, photovoltaic power generation needs to be connected to the power grid by special lines or public lines, which will change the management mode and power flow structure of traditional power grid, especially bring a lot of technical and management difficulties to power quality, relay protection, automatic safety devices, equipment maintenance and power outages. As the photovoltaic power generation technology come to mature now, the connection of photovoltaic power generation is still in the stage of exploration and the access method, access capacity, access location, voltage level, protection configuration, automatic device configuration and monitoring control technology of photovoltaic power generation is not yet mature to State Grid Corporation of China. Therefore, it is very important to research how photovoltaic power generation connects to the grid and its influence on power dispatching.

articleTitle: Design and Practice of Integrated Platform for Operation and Management of Fast Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, quite a few of the instructive policies have been pioneered by Chinese government to support the development of electric vehicles. It is widely admitted that the convenience of charging facilities plays a pivotal role in the popularization of electric vehicles. The rapid development of electric vehicles stimulates new requirements for the data processing of the comprehensive platform for the operation and management of charging facilities. With the advancement of the computer's memory technology, the data stored in the electric vehicle re-transmission system also rises geometrically. This paper analyzes the technical details and optimization methods of the feasible scheme based on the fast-charging station operation management integrated platform system.

articleTitle: Voltage Sag Severity Assessment Based on Multiobjective Decision Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage sag has gradually become one of the most important power quality problems with the large number of sensitive devices being put into use. In this paper, Monte Carlo simulation method is used to evaluate the risk of node voltage sag. Under different line fault probability models, the sag indicators are divided into the basic parameters of the network and the load side through the state performance and response mechanism. The subjective weight of each indicator of voltage sag is determined by fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (AHP). Then the various sags and target decision matrices are calculated through the characteristics of the temporary monitoring parameters. The objective decision matrix is transformed into a relative membership matrix by dimensionless processing and the objective weight of each index is determined by the method of maximizing deviation. Finally, comprehensive weights of each index can be obtained by combining subjective weights and objective weights. Weighting the comprehensive weight of the indicators obtained by each observation point and the severity of each indicator, the risk degree of the voltage sag at each observation point can be sorted. Four monitoring points were selected for actual measurement analysis and the results proved the feasibility of the method by using Matlab Simulation.

articleTitle: Modified Single-Ended Fault Location Method for Single-phase-to-Ground Faults in T-Connected Line
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: T-connected transmission lines has increased for renewable energy connection with grid and load development. Due to the influence of transition resistance, system operation mode and other factors, the error of single ended fault location method is too large, especially when applied on T-Connected lines. The paper proposes modified single-ended fault location method, which based on one end electrical quantities and single ended fault location results at two other ends, to achieve accurate fault location. Simulation studies show that the method is correct and easy to be implemented in the field without the need to install new devices.

articleTitle: Mechanism Design for Medium and Long-term Electric Quantity Security Check Adapted to Decentralized Trading
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Medium and long-term market is an important part of power market construction in China. The most noteworthy feature of medium and long term market is that the transaction in the form of electricity energy. Bilateral transactions represented by direct purchase of large consumers are the main trading modes. Bilateral transactions are essentially decentralized decisions. Benefit-seeking behavior in the market may lead to extreme operation mode of power grid, resulting in transmission section overloading or exceeding the limit while would affect the security operation of power grid. It is important to study electric quantity security check to evaluate whether energy contract is feasible and how to further adjust the trade. This paper presents a novel mechanism for medium and long-term trade security check adapted to decentralized trading. A two-step checking system for ex-ante energy limit calculation and ex-post transaction security check is proposed, and a checking mode with annual security check as the main and monthly security check as the supplement is proposed. Some key technologies related to this mechanism are introduced. A case study based on actual data of provincial power grid indicates the effectiveness of proposed mechanism.

articleTitle: Power Distribution Network Topology Reconstruction Based on Adaptive Lasso
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The growing distributed energy resources bring great challenges to the power distribution network operation. In order to control the power distribution network better, a clear and correct topology is needed. We consider the problem of reconstructing the topology of the power distribution network given the voltage magnitude data measured from smart metering devices. The adaptive Lasso algorithm is adopted to obtain the correlation coefficient matrix. Because the sufficient condition is hard to satisfy, a supplementary rule is used to improve the accuracy. The algorithm does not need the prior knowledge of distribution, such as branch information and incidence matrix, and only use time-series voltage magnitude data. Case study indicates that the proposed algorithm performs well in the radial and loopy distribution networks.

articleTitle: The Modeling and Simulation of the CCHP System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the combined cooling heating and power (CCHP) system is modeled and simulated in steady condition. The CCHP system is one of the typical representatives of distributed energy resource (DER), which is considered to be a useful supplement to the current power system. The model of the CCHP system is built and the micro gas turbine, lithium bromide refrigerator and waste heat boiler are respectively modeled and simulated in this paper. Some parameters can be obtained in simulation, including output power of the micro gas turbine, generator efficiency, export residual gas temperature, efficiency of lithium bromide refrigerator etc. This paper is concluded with a comparison on the output efficiency of this modeling CCHP system by the variety of proportion of gas to the lithium bromide refrigerator and a research on the economic benefit of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Grounding Current Distribution in HVDC System Operating in Monopolar Mode
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the comprehensive promotion of HVDC project, the electromagnetic effect in the power system became more complicated than ever. During monopolar operation of HVDC system with ground return, there exists a DC loop between the earth and AC system, and the grounding current returned may enter into neutral points of transformers. It causes DC bias of transformers and influences the operation of transformers. To solve this problem, typical grounding electrode model and earth model have been built in the ANSYS simulation environment in this paper. Then, using the finite element method, the surface potential distribution and the influence of resistivity on it have been studied. Simultaneously, the potential field and the zero sequence current flowing into AC system have been solved with field-circuit coupled method. In addition, the interaction between adjacent transformers and the impact of the distance between the grounding pole and the converter station on the zero-sequence current calculation have been studied. Finally, combined with the experimental phenomenon, some practical suggestions and viewpoints have been put forward in this paper.

articleTitle: A Storage Assignment Method Based on Genetic Algorithm for Electric Power Warehousing System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An order storage assignment problem (SAP) is to find an effective way to locate products in a warehouse in order to improve the operational efficiency of warehousing system. Since SAP is an NP-hard problem, many heuristic algorithms have been proposed. We analyzed the influence of product weight on the stability of the shelf, as well as the influence of the frequency of products entering the warehouse and the time required to arrive at the warehouse on the efficiency of the warehousing operation. An optimization model based on shelf stability along with inbound and outbound efficiency was proposed and genetic algorithm is used to solve the model. The validity of the model and its solution method is verified by experiment. The results show that the model can effectively reduce the storage time and increase stability of the shelf.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Optimization of Integrated Energy System Based on Importance Scenario Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The regional integrated energy system refers to a system that contains a variety of heterogeneous energy sources such as oil, natural gas, electric energy, heat, and wind energy in a certain area. As we know, wind's uncertainty and volatility challenge the operational optimization of integrated energy systems. In this paper, the importance scene method is used to model the randomness of wind power output, and a mixed integer programming model of regional integrated energy system including capacity and energy storage equipment is established. Finally, the important scenario analysis method is applied to the random operation optimization problem of regional integrated energy system. The effectiveness of the method is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: An Optimal Configuration of Multiple Measurements in Distribution Network Based on Graph Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The optimal configuration scheme for multiple measurements of distribution network is currently an most important research content. From the mathematical point of view, the selection of measurements is difficult to ensure the observability of the whole system. From the perspective of cost, the selection of quantitative measurements is difficult to guarantee the lowest cost. Therefore, it is necessary to find a configuration method of the measurement while satisfying both requirements. In this paper, a graph theory-based algorithm is adopted. By introducing DC power flow, promote active power to ensure observability of phase angle, while reactive power can ensure observability of voltage amplitude, then according to the graph theory, to select the measurement configuration. Finally, a set of optimal measurement configuration sets is obtained by the algorithm. In practical applications, by installing this set of measurement configuration sets, the observability of the entire system can be guaranteed, and the cost of the installation measurement configuration set is minimal, achieved the desired result. this kind of configuration method has strong engineering application value.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Anti-Strong Magnetic Interference for Intelligent Miniature Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the intelligent miniature circuit breaker is prone to misoperation and refusal under strong magnetic interference, the intelligent miniature circuit breaker control system, DC motor, switching power supply and other related modules that may cause magnetic interference are analyzed, and specific Optimized design. An optimization design method for anti-magnetic interference of control system based on micro-switch and Hall switch dual-mode detection is proposed, which is realized from both hardware and software. The optimized design method of DC motor antimagnetic interference and the optimized design method of output power anti-magnetic interference of switching power supply are proposed, which improves the anti-magnetic interference ability of DC motor and switching power supply. The effect verification experiment shows that the optimized intelligent miniature circuit breaker has excellent anti-magnetic interference performance, high stability and high reliability, and completely solves the problem that the intelligent miniature circuit breaker is prone to misoperation and refusal under strong magnetic interference, it has a strong promotion and application value.

articleTitle: Construction and implementation of power equipment infrared thermal image database based on curve analysis method
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of irregular operation, fragmentation of information, low coverage of operating equipment, unsatisfactory evaluation method and difficult to effectively guide operation and maintenance in infrared thermography and atlas diagnosis, the basic concept, theoretical basis, influencing factors and matters needing attention of infrared thermometry are expounded. It is proposed to construct the infrared thermal image database covering the transformer, transmission and distribution equipment as a unified software platform, and to store, classify and inquire according to the equipment type, voltage level, defect type, etc. The whole process of infrared temperature measurement is standardized and standardized. Intelligent identification and analysis method of atlas are expounded represented by curve analysis method that extracts important parameters from source atlas, and uses fuzzy logic, artificial neural network and support vector machine to realize the preliminary judgment of the result, which greatly improves the evaluation efficiency and diagnostic level. The infrared atlas analysis of transformer annular tubes is carried out.

articleTitle: Analysis of harmonic transmission characteristics in HVDC system
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Harmonic is an important factor threatening the safe and stable operation of HVDC system. This paper firstly analyzes the mechanism of harmonics caused by converter transformer. Then., the whole process that harmonics transfer back and forth between the AC system and DC system through the converter is studied by switching function method., which shows the frequency of harmonics is changed systematic after commutation. The analysis method of Harmonic Multi-infeed Interaction Factor for harmonic transmission characteristics in multi HVDC(DC/DC) system is proposed in this paper. Research shows the induced harmonic magnitude from remote DC converters are relative to the electrical distance. PSCAD simulations verify the methods and conclusions.

articleTitle: Research and Application on Microgrid Integrated Energy Service Technology for Modern Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the low degree of traditional agricultural electrification technology in tea withering, and remote tea plantation mechanization in energy supply reliability and power quality requirement being high, a main technical roadmap was put forward. It's integrated electrification technology such as microgrid, electric vehicles, ac-dc power distribution network, and other electric power replacement technology. Respectively, all seasons for black tea withering moveable new energy work vehicle, microgrid multi-energy complementary coordination optimization technology, and microgrid high reliability power technology research and application were carried out, which aims at building integrated a new mode of energy service oriented modern agriculture. Engineering application shows that this model can make full use of new energy by multi-energy complementary, with the microgrid stability and supply quality improved, the economic benefit of modern agriculture increased also sustainable. It provided a replicable and propagable electrification integrated energy service sample.

articleTitle: Research on the Fault-induced Inrush Current of the Converter Transformer and Its Impacts
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper analyzes the mechanism and variation of a new inrush phenomenon (which is defined as fault-induced inrush current) caused by the unidirectional continuity of the converter valve when the asymmetric fault occurs on the valve side of the UHV converter transformer. Taking a converter transformer in UHVDC transmission system as an example, the influence of fault-induced inrush current on the operation characteristics of the differential protection is analyzed. The results show that the fault-induced inrush current is easy to cause miss-operation of converter transformer differential protection in the event of transferring fault on valve side.

articleTitle: Control Strategy for Parallel Inverters Based on Virtual Impedance in AC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper investigates the issues of the power coupling caused by multiple parallel inverters in low -voltage AC micro-grid. In terms of the application conditions of traditional droop control, the influence of control parameters on the equivalent output impedance of the system is analyzed. Due to the limitations, the droop control strategy based on virtual impedance is applied and demonstrates the impact of virtual impedance value on output impedance characteristics. In order to compensate for the voltage drop brought by virtual impedance, an improved control method based on PI controller is proposed, which can realize the distribution of the load power according to the capacity of the inverters while maintaining the stability of the AC bus voltage. The effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed control strategy are verified on the MATLAB/Simulink platform.

articleTitle: A Parameter Identification Algorithm for Turbine-governor System in Regional Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the Fibonacci tree optimization (FTO) algorithm is introduced to solve the problem of the overall parameter identification of the turbine-governor system in the regional power system. The Fibonacci tree optimization algorithm has the characteristics of global and local optimization. When using for parameter identification, the global optimization ability and convergence rate of FTO are improved by weakening the multi-peak optimization of the algorithm. It can improve the adaptability of the algorithm to parameter identification. Based on frequency response curve of a simulation regional power system, the algorithm is used to identify the parameters of the simulation turbine-governor system of the regional power grid. The results of simulation show that the FTO algorithm has a good performance using for parameter identification.

articleTitle: Study on Formulation and Hydrophobicity of Polyurethane Filled with DC Post Insulators
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A new type of post insulator which filled with polyurethane is introduced in this paper. At present, this kind of insulator is used in ±800kV HVDC transmission project. The new formulation and hydrophobicity of polyurethane used in post insulator are studied in this paper, which providing important theoretical basis for the design of polyurethane used in post insulator, laying an significant foundation for the safe and stable operation of UHVDC transmission projects, and providing an magnitude guarantee for the safe and efficient construction of the global energy Internet. To improve the reliability and insulating property of the post insulator used for DC transmission, a novel ameliorative formulation which could be used for post insulators was proposed. The present accidents often lead to the carbide channel, which is related to pore size, pore distribution uniformity and static contact angle of polyurethane foam (PUF). The formula which can reduce the pore size of rigid polyurethane foam and enhance pore uniformity is exploring. By studying different proportions of raw materials and Nano fillers, a proper ratio of ingredients to form foaming samples was found and the samples were detected by light microscope, SEM and contact angle goniometer.

articleTitle: Characteristic Analysis of Single-Phase Earth Fault Under Different Grounding Modes of Neutral Point
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Faults in the distribution network are mainly divided into single-phase ground faults and short-circuit faults. The process of short-circuit fault is relatively simple and the features are obvious. However, the process of single-phase ground fault is complicated. Therefore, this paper mainly analyzes the transient and steady state of distribution line when ground single-phase fault occurs under different grounding conditions of neutral point status. In this paper, the equivalent phase transformation of the single-phase ground fault of the distribution line is carried out to analyze the phase voltage, line voltage and zero-sequence voltage, zero-sequence current, transient zero-sequence current, positive sequence sum in the steady state process under different neutral conditions. The characteristics of the negative sequence current. It lays the foundation for distribution network fault analysis and test simulation.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Power System with Large-Scale Wind Power Connected Considering the Time-Sequence Characteristic of Wind Power Ramp Event
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A power system risk assessment model considering the time-sequence characteristic of wind power ramp events is pro-posed in this paper. By sampling the possible shutdown time and operation state of conventional units, the effect of time-sequence relation between wind power ramp events and the outage of conventional units is considered. In the evaluation process, the correlation between time intervals is taken into account, and the operating risk of the system is assessed by with times of frequency off-limits and loss load expectation. This assessment result the impact of wind power ramp events on system operation risks and provides guidance for the dispatcher to take preventive and control measures, which has practical application and reference value.

articleTitle: Forecasting Method of Photovoltaic Output Power Based on k-Means/KPCA/PSO-BP
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the forecasting accuracy of photovoltaic (PV) output power, a forecasting method is proposed based on k-means, KPCA and PSO-BP. Firstly, wavelet threshold de-noising algorithm is used to pretreat PV output data. Then, the k-means clustering algorithm is applied to divide the forecasting model into four sub models under different modes. The Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA) method is used to reduce the dimensionality of the input space. Neural network algorithm is optimized based on Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). Finally, the PV output power forecasting model based on k-means /KPCA/PSO-BP is established. The example data is used to verify the forecasting model, the results show that it can forecast the PV output power accurately in different modes and have good forecasting performance.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Gas Storage In Natural Gas System Considering N-1 Failures of Pipelines
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In natural gas transmission system, maintaining all load nodes, especially the nodes with gas-fired power plants, within their required operational pressure ranges under N-l failures of pipelines is a challenging problem. In this paper, considering the slow dynamics of gas travelling, the transient model of natural gas network is used to represent the dynamic evolutions of mass flow rates through the branches and pressures at nodes after the occurrence of N-l failures of pipelines, including the pipeline connecting directly or non-directly with source node. For a specific storage candidate installation site, the determination of its optimal capacity to cope with a specific pipeline failure is formulated as a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) problem. Considering all N-l pipelines failures and storage candidate installation sites, the optimal planning of gas storage, including its optimal capacity and installation site, is then obtained. A test natural gas network with 25 nodes and 26 branches is established and the effectiveness of the optimal gas storage planning model is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Integrated Service Penetration Technology Cross Security Region
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the power dispatching automation system, production control security region and management information security region adopt forward and backward isolation devices for physical isolation, with the enhancement of the functional relevance between the security regions and the expansion of the system functions, one-way synchronization of production control security region to management information security region has been unable to meet the requirements of application expansion of supervisory control. In accordance with the principles of safety protection standards, it is urgent to establish a data transmission mechanism that can cross the forward and backward isolation, realize service penetration cross the security region. In this paper, a scheme of integrated service invocation across the security region is proposed, which can be invoked by the service bus that can be transparent and unaware service bus, encapsulate cross domain service protocol, establish virtual access, and complete service invocation. Through the signature verification technology, the service message is tampered in the communication, the communication security of the service invocation is guaranteed, the rights of the service are obtained through the authorization and the security of the service invocation cross the security region. The integrated service invocation technology cross the security region has been applied in Jiangsu Province, Beijing and Hangzhou. It provides a safe and stable support for the construction of the grand operation system, and provides a powerful guarantee for the efficient operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Analysis of ULFO Including Hydro Governor Effects and Additional Controller Design for Asynchronous Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper applies an electromechanical transient model to the analysis of ultra-low frequency oscillations (ULFO) in Chongqing-Hubei asynchronous power systems. The electromechanical model of Back to Back MMC-HVDC is established firstly. Emphasis is put on the contribution of hydroturbine governors to UFLO and additional damping controller design. The prolonged oscillations in the simulation is analyzed with power system analysis software package (PSASP) model, while additional controller in rector converter station is designed that proves to be effective in damping out the ultra-low frequency oscillations.

articleTitle: Feature Selection Method for Power System Transient Stability Status Prediction Considering Class Imbalanced Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power system transient stability status prediction (TSSP)has class imbalanced characteristic, including the imbalance of sample size and class importance. Therefore, a new feature selection method is proposed for TSSP. On the basis of analyzing the imbalanced characteristic of TSSP., the basic criteria of feature selection are put forward., and then the index of class weighted accuracy is proposed as the evaluation index. Under the guidance of the new evaluation index., the wrapper method combing sequential forward search and extreme learning machine is utilized for TSSP feature selection. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified on Northeast Power Coordinated Council (NPCC)48-machine 140-bus system.

articleTitle: Application Research of Small and Medium-Sized Three-Phase Asynchronous Motor Energy Efficiency Testing System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The promotion of energy-efficient motor is a trend in the development of modern industry, with the improvement of motor efficiency requirements, the corresponding energy efficiency testing technology must continue to progress. Comparing with traditional analog or digital instrument manual detection methods of energy efficiency, GB/T 1032 test method to a series of type tests on the motor being tested to determine the efficiency of the loss and then the motor efficiency is calculated based on the application of the technology energy feedback energy-saving efficiency test system as a platform. The automatic test system uses a DC motor as measured motor load, at the same time as a generator. DC motor will issue of electric power gave back to the power grid, realize the assessment process of high efficiency energy saving. Experiments show that, the maximum efficiency of the motor about in the vicinity of 70% rated power, active power from the grid absorption system accounted for only about 20% of the tested motor capacity, thereby saving electric energy.

articleTitle: Determination of Optimal Configuration Point for DSTATCOM in Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When the upper power grid fault happens and a voltage sag occurs on the power supply side of the distribution system, different configuration points of the Distribution Static Synchronous Compensator(DSTATCOM) in the distribution system lead to different effects of overall improvement on the grid voltage. Aiming at the above problems, this paper presents an effective method for determining the optimal configuration point for DSTATCOM in radial distribution system. This method focuses on ensuring normal power supply within the maximum range of the distribution system. Firstly, the influence of DSTATCOM connected to distribution system voltage is analyzed, and the conclusion that the optimal configuration point of DSTATCOM is directly related to the line reactance and voltage sag amplitude is obtained. Then, under different parameters of the line reactance and the voltage sag amplitude, the voltage data of each bus in different cases is obtained. Combined with these data, the Euclidean distance between the voltages of each bus before and after compensation is used as the compensation effect evaluation standard. Finally, the IEEE 33 buses Distribution System model is built and the effectiveness of the method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A Flexible Virtual Capacitance Control Strategy for DC Micro-Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Compared with AC grid, DC micro-grid has little inertia. Therefore, when the system suffers from transient disturbance, it is easy to cause DC voltage mutation and even system instability. In the AC system, the inertia can be developed by applying virtual synchronous generator(VSG) control to the converter. A flexible virtual capacitance(FVC) control strategy for DC micro-grid is proposed by analogizing the correspondence of variables between AC and DC systems. Potential “inertia” in DC micro-grid can be developed with the proposed control strategy, and the system stability can be improved by restraining the mutation of DC voltage.

articleTitle: Research on Configuration and Switching Strategy of AC Filter for Shaoshan Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the configuration of AC filter in Shaoshan converter station is analyzed in detail. Then, combined with the reactive power control function, the individual switching modes of the AC filter are compared and analyzed, simultaneously, an improved investment strategy for the average input of the filter is proposed, which reduces the impact and influence of the fault of AC filter busbar in the station on the AC system. The method proposed in this paper has certain reference significance for the design and operation of UHVDC transmission engineering.

articleTitle: Research on OPF and Reliability Evaluation of VSC-MTDC System Considering Wind Power Connection
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the characteristics of clean energy integration in the Energy Internet, this paper proposes an optimal AC/DC power flow algorithm of multi-terminal flexible dc transmission system considering wind power connection. Combined with the analysis and research on the reliability evaluation system of comprehensive energy system, a simulation model of VSC-MTDC system is established to calculate the power flow distribution. By analyzing and comparing the calculation results before and after the OPF of the VSC-MTDC system, the effectiveness of the optimization method proposed in this paper is verified, which provides theoretical basis and data foundation for the further development of energy Internet.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Contract Energy Management in Industrial Parks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Contract energy management is a new form of energy saving at present. This article introduces the meaning and application mode of contract energy management, and analyzes the energy consumption and distributed functional system of industrial park. Then the methods and suggestions on the application of contract energy management to industrial park are given.

articleTitle: Life-Cycle Low Carbon Simulation of Smart Distribution Network Considering Power Loss
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to cope with today's climate change and energy crisis, green and low-carbon is an inevitable trend in the electric power development in the future. Smart distribution network is one of the important means in reducing carbon emission of the power system. The research on the relationship of the carbon emission in different stages of the life-cycle of smart distribution network is significant for the green environment-friendly and low-carbon development of the power system, as also the research of the methods to reduce carbon emission. Currently, most of the calculation theories of carbon emission are based on the lossless network, but the practical power system is lossy, so it is necessary to study the calculation method of the carbon emission flow in the full life-cycle of smart distribution network with the consideration of power loss. In the background of low-carbon power system, this paper analyzes the influence of distributed generators (DGs), energy storage systems (ESS), EV chargers on carbon emission of smart distribution network. Considering the access of DGs, ESS and EV chargers on smart distribution network, a life-cycle theory of carbon emission flow is proposed. Suggestions for the low-carbon operation mode of smart distribution network is proposed. The IEEE 33-node distribution system is used to validate the feasibility of the method. An example of a practical smart distribution network in Shanghai is taken at the end.

articleTitle: Design of an Anti-Offset Inductively Coupled Power Transfer Device Based on S/LCC Compensation Topology
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In an inductively coupled power transfer (ICPT) system, the sensitivity of the coupling coefficient to position makes it necessary to operate on devices with almost no offset. In this paper, an anti-offset ICPT device has been proposed, which has a good anti-offset effect. The device consists of DD coil, S/LCC compensated resonant converter and a DC-DC converter. In order to verify the analysis and design a 1 kW prototype with a 200 mm gap was fabricated and tested. From DC 40V input to DC 40 V output, the total efficiency is 82.3%.

articleTitle: A Practical Approach to Generating Trend Data of Power Grid Operation for Pre-dispatching System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Pre-dispatching of power automation system can quickly and accurately simulate the operation of power grid in the future and evaluate by means of analysis. It provides technical support for dispatcher's actual operation. When there are significant changes or emergencies, pre-dispatching can be triggered. This enables dispatchers to grasp the operational risks of power grid ahead of time. In such a process, the trend data of power grid operation is the foundation of pre-dispatching. In this paper, a practical method of trend data generation is proposed based on real-time data, planning and forecasting data, combined with risk analysis and early warning function services. It can provide continuous running data for the nucleus calculation module of pre-dispatching. A basic data environment for pre-dispatching is constructed.

articleTitle: A Cost-Emission Optimization Strategy of Home Integrated Energy System Based on Integrated Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the promotion of multi-energy household equipment, electricity, natural gas, and solar energy are tightly integrated into home integrated energy system (HIES). This paper focuses on an operational strategy that optimizes operating cost and emissions to tackle the household load scheduling problem. Based on Integrated Demand Response (IDR) of integrating electricity, natural gas and solar energy, the strategy is proposed to schedule household load under the premise of satisfying user comfort. In the proposed strategy, the system operating cost models, emissions models and operational constraints are established. Real-time electricity price and static gas price parameters are used in the operating cost calculation process. Two cases are studied under different user satisfaction. Detailed simulation results show that this strategy not only reduces the operating cost and emissions of HIES, but also achieve mutual complementarity between electricity and natural gas and improve user comfort.

articleTitle: Research of Metal Oxide Arrester on-line Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Metal oxide arrester (MOA) is an important overvoltage protection device. However, some MOA will deteriorate gradually under operating voltage, and some will get wet due to structural problems. These two failures can lead to increased leakage current in the arresters, and accidents can happen even when the power system is severe. The first harmonic current and high harmonic current of the resistance are two fault eigenvectors reflecting the MOA performance. According to the characteristics and requirements of the measurement of conductive leakage current, this paper puts forward the principle and realization of the insulation on-line monitoring, and chooses to monitor the harmonic analysis of the conductive leakage current. The paper uses digital processing programming to obtain the resistance leakage current by virtual instrument, and then obtains the resistance wave current and harmonic current. Based on Lab View, the design of the entire MOA insulation monitoring system is also finished, including the system hardware and monitoring software. The on-line monitoring system of MOA can detect and monitor the resistive leakage current and harmonic resistive currents in good condition.

articleTitle: Optimal Control Tuning of VSC-MTDC Using a Multi-Objective Hybrid PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a hybrid particle swarm optimization (HPSO) algorithm to optimize the parameters of DC voltage margin controllers in a voltage source converters multi-terminal direct current (VSC-MTDC) system is proposed. The proposed approach presents a multi-objective function with different time intervals using integral of time-weighted absolute value of the error (ITAE), such that the voltage margin controllers will provide a minimum undershoot, minimum overshoot and fast settling time performance. The performance of the proposed approach is tested on a three-terminal VSC-MTDC system in PSCAD environment through time domain simulations, and comparison to controllers optimized by SIMPLEX algorithm confirmed the favorable performance of the proposed HPSO-tuned controllers.

articleTitle: The sensitive information disclosure modes in electricity spot market abroad and their enlightenments for China
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Information disclosure mechanism is an important part in the construction of electricity spot market, whose core design is the sensitive information disclosure related to system security and market manipulation. First of all, the classifications of the sensitive information and the critical problems in the design process of disclosure mechanism were introduced. Then, the practical experience for different sensitive information disclosure are summarized in the foreign electricity spot market. At last, some suggestions for sensitive information disclosure, which are expected to play a certain role in the construction of China's electricity spot market, are put forward considering the native actual situations.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Reactive Power for Distribution System Considering Distributed Wind Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel planning method for reactive power in distribution system considering the randomness of distributed wind generator and load. The planning model is based on the chance constrained programming., in which the randomness of the distributed wind generator as well as the uncertainty of the load are considered. The objective of the planning model is to minimize the annual comprehensive cost, including the investment cost of reactive compensation devices and cost of power losses. The planning model is solved by adaptive genetic algorithm and probabilistic power flow method. The modified IEEE 69-bus distribution system is used to carry out the case studies, and the simulation results verify the feasibility of the model and the effectiveness of the solving strategy.

articleTitle: Charging Strategy for Hybrid MMC with DC Link Short-Connected
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the problem of voltage imbalance among different types of sub-module in VSC-UHVDC hybrid MMC group with DC link short-connected, a controllable pre-charging strategy was proposed. Firstly, the locked-charging characteristic of hybrid MMC group with HBSM and FBSM was analyzed, and the problem that different types of submodules can't be charged equally as well as HBSM can't be powered up were pointed out. Therefore, to pre-charge both sub-modules balanced and controllable, a strategy that switch-off some sub-modules in the special arms was proposed, and the selection criteria for arm and calculating method for sub-module's cut-off number were given. Finally, simulation in Matlab/Simulink was conducted. The results show that the controllable pre-charging strategy can effectively respond to the DC link short-connected start-up condition of hybrid MMC and has engineering feasibility.

articleTitle: Life Prediction of Electric Energy Meter Based on Electric Power Big Data
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the data of measurement of integrated production dispatching system(MDS), electric data acquire system and marketing system, this paper analyzes the field reliability data, failure mode, failure mechanism, external induced stress and their characteristics with time, and establishes the combined stress life prediction model of electric energy meter under different stress conditions. The life prediction model can predict the residual life, expose potential failures and provide technical support for the state replacement of the electric energy meter. In addition, it provides theoretical and data support for fast troubleshooting and failure priority handling.

articleTitle: Energy Storage System Planning Based on Cost Analysis in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of distributed energy in distribution network, the characteristics of intermittent and fluctuation greatly reduce the security of the distribution network, and the energy storage system can effectively alleviate this situation. In this paper, the method of storage battery configuration is studied from the point of cost analysis. First, the charging and discharging process of the battery is optimized. Then, the investment income model which aims at the maximum net income of the storage battery system is set up by considering the subsidy of energy storage policy, the electricity price subsidy, the investment cost and the additional benefit. Finally, the difference algorithm and the interior point method are combined to solve the model. In the example part, we consider and compare different battery configurations and the corresponding revenue. The results verify the feasibility of the proposed configuration method.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Building Hydrogen Comprehensive Utilization System Based on CCHP System of Hydrogen Fuel Cell
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper., a building hydrogen comprehensive utilization system based on CCHP system of hydrogen fuel cell was proposed., including hydrogen production process. The evaluation system., including thermal economy., technical economy and environmental protection factors., was built to evaluate the performance of the comprehensive utilization system. Taking an office building as a typical case., the performance of a P AFC-based and a SOFC-based system was calculated and analyzed. The technical economy in different provinces was also compared.

articleTitle: Research of Dynamic Time-of-use Tariffs for PEV Charging Stations Based on User Behavior Habits
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of electric vehicle technology and the constant improvement of the people environmental protection consciousness, the scale of electric vehicle is expanding constantly. However, without coordination of the charging, the power consumption of electric vehicles on a scale will lead to grid problems. This paper analyzed the daily behavior of electric vehicle users based on the economic theory of price impact on consumer behavior. The model of TOU price considering electric vehicles charging station was established and the impact for both EV station and power grid were considered, then use genetic algorithm to solve. The calculation example shows that the maximum peak load of the charging station is reduced by 106.64Mw and the optimization rate is 4.7%, and the average user cost of electric vehicle is reduced by 2.5756 yuan, which is reduced by 27.17%when the charging station carries out the time sharing price. The optimal time-sharing tariff solved by this model can effectively reduce peak value, shorten peak valley difference, achieve safe and stable operation of power grid, and significantly reduce the charging cost of electric vehicle users.

articleTitle: Power Equalization and Frequency Recovery Control Strategy Based on Adaptive Virtual Impedance
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the island AC microgrid system, suppressing the circulating current to achieve power sharing is a necessary condition for the stable operation of the AC microgrid system, however, in the actual system, there is an equivalent line impedance difference between different distributed generation units (DGs). Affected by this, the reactive power in the system cannot be equally divided. In addition, the traditional droop control strategy is poorly regulated, and the system frequency and voltage are biased. In this paper, based on the traditional droop control, an adaptive virtual impedance control strategy is proposed to eliminate the line impedance difference and suppress the circulating current. At the same time, the frequency recovery and voltage compensation links are added to achieve the error-free adjustment, and the active power can also achieve a better equalization effect. Finally, the simulation results verify the correctness and effectiveness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Short-term Power Load Probability Density Forecasting Based on PCA-QRF
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power load probability density forecasting generates the probability and fluctuation range of forecasting value, which can offer more decision-making information for the security, reliability and economic operation of power system. A scientific and reasonable usage of multi-source, heterogeneous and massive power load and meteorological data can efficiently improve the accuracy of power load forecasting, but it also render the model training more complicated. This will lead us to a short-term power load probability density forecasting model based on principal component analysis and quantile regression forests. The principal component analysis, by means of linear transformation, turns the correlation input variables into heterogenous principal component, which can reduce the complexity and improve the forecasting accuracy. Quantile regression forests algorithm can obtain the conditional distribution of forecasting value and it can also, by means of kernel density estimation, obtain the power load probability density forecasting result at any time.

articleTitle: An Optimization Model of Spinning Reserve Capacity Considering New Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of new energy, large-scale wind power grid and photovoltaic bring challenges to the reliable operation of the system. Based on the actual situation, this paper introduces LOLP for evaluating the reliability of the system, analyzes the uncertain factors of the system after the new energy grid connected to the network, and models the uncertainties of the unit fault outage, the load forecast deviation, the wind power forecast deviation and the forecast photovoltaic deviation respectively. Based on considering the uncertainty factors, the optimization model of spinning reserve capacity considering the access of new energy is established. Taking the IEEE 39-bus standard test system as an example, the results show the reliability and economy of the proposed model, effectively optimize the allocation of spinning reserve capacity after new energy is connected to the network, and provide technical guidance for optimal scheduling of spinning reserve capacity.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Grid Frequency Deviation Related to Correlation Considering Wind Speed and Wind Direction in a Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The risk assessment of frequency deviation in power systems caused by the wind power fluctuations is an essential issue on wind power integration, thus a more realistic wind power fluctuation simulation is necessary. To construct wind power fluctuations, not only time scale but also wind direction should be considered for the wind speed model with spatial correlation in a wind farm. In this paper, wind direction is added to the wind speed model on the basis of the second level wind speed with spatial correlation. Based on the Von Mises distribution and the Weibull distribution, the correlation of wind speed and direction is analyzed, and the sequences are obtained according to Monte Carlo Sampling, describing the correlation between wind speed and wind direction clearly. Then the wind power fluctuations with spatial correlation is available. Therefore, the frequency deviation resulted from the uncertainty of wind power fluctuations can be evaluated more accurately.

articleTitle: Influence of Load Models on Commutation Failure in HVDC Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper analyzes the essence of commutation failure of HVDC transmission systems, and points out that the load model has an important influence on commutation failure. The Commutation Failure Immunity Index (CFII) is used to quantitatively calculate the influence of the load type and percentage of the induction motor load on the commutation failure. It is proposed that the induction motor load can provide the rotary inertia to the system at the instant of fault, suppress the converter bus voltage drop and reduce the probability of commutation failure. The above discussion is verified by electromagnetic transient simulation.

articleTitle: Bi-Level Optimal Scheduling for Integrated Wind Farms and Power-to-Gas Facilities
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The coordinated operation between wind power generation units and power to gas (P2G) facilities is considered as a promising development direction. Given this background, a bi-level coordinated operation strategy for wind farms and P2G facilities is developed in this paper. First, the bi-level structure for the virtual power plant (VPP) consisting wind farms and P2G facilities is illustrated and the relationship between wind farms and P2G facilities is model by Stackelberg game theory. Then, a bi-level optimal operation model with the objective of maximizing payoffs of both wind farms and P2G facilities are proposed. Uncertainties associated with fluctuant outputs from wind power units are represented by numerous scenarios generated using the well-established Latin hypercube sampling and the number of such generated scenarios is then reduced. Afterwards, the proposed bi-level bidding model is reformulated as a single-level mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) problem using Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) condition and the disjunctive constraints. Finally, a case study based on the data derived from Nordic market is conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed model.

articleTitle: VSC-HVDC Power Control Strategy for Improving Voltage Stability of AC-DC Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a VSC-HVDC power control strategy for increasing voltage stability of AC/DC power grid. Firstly, the model of relationships between voltage stability of AC/DC power grid and the active and reactive power outpower of VSC-HVDC is built; And the optimal active power and reactive power of VSC-HVDC for increasing voltage stability are obtained by solving the Lagrange function; Then the VSC-HVDC power control strategy for increasing the system voltage stability is designed based on the optimal active power and reactive power; Finally, the strategy is proven to be effective by an example.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of AC Side Equivalent Harmonic Impedance of HVDC Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The AC side equivalent harmonic impedance of HVDC converter is the key to study the harmonic instability and the design of AC filter in HVDC transmission system. Based on the switching function method, this paper deduces a new model of AC equivalent harmonic impedance of converter by analyzing the harmonic transformation mechanism of 12-pulse converter and considering the repeated modulation of AC side harmonic through converter. Finally, using PSCAD/EMTDC electromagnetic simulation software, based on CIGRE HVDC system standard model, the improved time domain simulation calculation is used to verify the proposed method. The comparison between the results of mathematical model calculation and time-domain simulation shows that the new AC equivalent harmonic impedance model in this paper has has high accuracy in the low frequency range.

Author Keywords: AC side equivalent harmonic impedance of converters

articleTitle: Adjustable Rubost Reactive Power Optimization of Islanded Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy and the increasing uncertainty, the reactive power optimization of islanded microgrids face increasingly severe challenges. According to the topological structure of the meshed islanded microgrids, the power flow model is convex into a two order cone power flow model. Considering the uncertainties of PV active power and PV inverter reactive power, we establish an adjustable robust reactive power optimization model. Based on the strong duality theorem, the uncertainties in the robust model are eliminated and solved by linear robust optimization. Finally, we use the IEEE 33-bus system to simulated and tested reactive power optimization model which propose in this paper. The results show the robust optimization model still has good robustness after reducing the conservatism. It can ensure the stable operation of the system.

articleTitle: Crucial Power Transfer Interface Identification Based on Deep Learning and Bagging Strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the promotion of renewable energy, it has become a more challenging task to keep power systems in secure and stable conditions. In real applications, power transfer interfaces are usually used by operators to monitor and control power systems more efficiently. Therefore, this paper proposes a data-driven approach to identify real-time crucial power transfer interfaces whose security margins are relatively low. First, a deep learning framework is designed as deep features perform better in classification tasks. Then, a new loss function is developed to enhance the data-driven model's generalization ability. Furthermore, bagging strategy is adopted to balance the effect of the missing alarm and the false alarm. Finally, the proposed model is evaluated by the Guangdong Power Grid in China and the simulation results demonstrate that: (1) three corresponding improvements above have been proved, compared with existing methods; (2) the proposed model can identify crucial power transfer interfaces quickly and accurately, and reach the requirements for online applications.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method for Evaluation and Decision-Making of Distribution Network Planned Projects Based on Branch and Bound Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the traditional management mode of the distribution network, the marginal cost of large-scale investment to improve efficiency is becoming much higher, so the State Grid Corporation of China (SGCC) puts forward the concept of “unit planning”. Under this background, by aiming at the highest score, this paper constructs a problem-based method to evaluate the development level of the distribution network, and introduces the amount of planned projects, the total investment and others as constraints to construct the objective function. Aimed to solve the objective function, this paper proposes the implementation steps of scheme optimization by determining the corresponding data requirements and the processing methods of specific data. For improving the computational efficiency, the algorithm is optimized by combining the Branch and Bound Algorithm (BBA). It is proved that the proposed method can achieve the optimal scheme by the practical data of a certain city in Jiangsu Province in 2017.

articleTitle: Calculation Method and Error Analysis of Dielectric Loss Factor Considering the Influence of Harmonics
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Harmonics, which exist in power grid, introduce a large error in the measurement of dielectric loss factor, which cannot accurately reflect the insulation level. In this paper, a calculation method of dielectric loss factor considering the influence of harmonics is proposed. The influence of different harmonic content on dielectric loss factor is analyzed by calculating the dielectric loss factor under fundamental and harmonic conditions. The results show that the dielectric loss factor is related to the harmonic content and frequency. The higher the harmonic content is, the greater the dielectric loss factor will be. Particularly when the harmonic content reaches 10%, the difference in dielectric loss factor corresponding to harmonics of different frequencies will increase rapidly. The dielectric loss factor corresponding to the higher harmonics shows an exponential increase with the growing harmonic content. When the frequency reaches a certain value, it will have a great influence on the magnitude of dielectric loss factor, which introduces a large error compared with the dielectric loss factor under fundamental wave.

articleTitle: Analysis of DC Fault Protection on the Overhead Lines in Bipolar MMC-HVDC Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC fault is an important issue of high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission based on modular multilevel converter (MMC), especially the application of flexible DC transmission to overhead lines. This paper proposed a bipolar MMC structure and operating principle including full-bridge MMC fault equivalent circuit and the fast decay analysis formula of fault current. The full-bridge MMC system at DC pole-to-ground fault can avoid overvoltage and overcurrent due to fast-clearing characteristic of full-bridge MMC fault current. The bipolar HVDC based on MMC system is built on the simulation platform. The correctness and effectiveness of DC pole-to-ground fault analysis and protection scheme are verified by simulations.

articleTitle: Economic Benefits of DC Power Flow Controllers in Optimal Scheduling of AC/DC Hybrid System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper investigates the benefits of Direct Current Power Flow Controllers (DC-PFCs) on wind power delivery and system operating costs. A coordination scheduling model for AC/DC hybrid system including DC-PFCs is proposed. First., the power flow model of the DC-PFC is deduced and linearized. Then., to minimize total operation cost., a short-term scheduling model for AC/DC hybrid system with wind power integration considering the DC-PFC is established by determining operating parameters of conventional units., wind farms and the DC-PFC. AC/DC transmission network constraints and operation constraints of conventional units and the DC-PFC are incorporated into the model. IEEE-RTS system integrated with a 6-bus VSC-HVDC grid is applied to verify the effectiveness of method proposed. Results show that the DC- PFC can reduce system operation cost and improve the delivery of wind power effectively by optimizing the power flow.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy of AGC and AVC Based on Multi-Agent System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of the energy Internet, the coupling of active power and reactive power in modern power grid is increasingly inseparable, while the operation of automatic generation control (AGC) and automatic voltage control (AVC) is in the way of decoupling in the power grid. The operation of AGC and AVC will affect the control effect of each other as a result of the different targets, and even may cause the repeating regulation of equipment or other safety issues. According to the above issues, this paper establishes a coordinated control strategy of AGC and A VC based on multi agent system. By means of the establishment of three level multi agent architecture, the coordinated control of AGC and A VC is realized by classification and partition. The comprehensive coordination model of AGC and A VC is established in the organization level agent, and the AGC and A VC controls are synthesized based on the ultrashort term load forecasting for the advanced AGC optimization and the correction of AVC on account of the adjustment of active power. The independent and cooperative control strategy of voltage correction is set at the coordination level and the executive level agent to achieve the independent operation of the voltage correction, the independent cooperation between the intelligent bodies and the local compensation of reactive power. Finally, the simulation prove that, the proposed control strategy can improve the economy and security of the system operation and suppress the mutual interference between AGC and AVC.

articleTitle: Development of multi-function smart troubleshooting device for electric meter data collection
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the problem that the on-site operation and maintenance of power information collection has no unified standard and lack of technical means, the overall design scheme of the smart checking device for multi-function meter data collection fault is proposed. The carrier module card circuit and system software architecture are designed, and the design principle of the device is analyzed. The fault detection and discrimination methods of carrier module based on online and offline modes are proposed. The fault detection and discrimination methods of field meter and concentrator communication port are proposed. A portable and fully functional field acquisition fault diagnosis and analysis device is developed, which can effectively improve the work efficiency and technical level of on-site operation and maintenance personnel, and plays an important role in promoting the standardization and intelligence of on-site collection and maintenance work.

articleTitle: The Research and Application of the Power Spot Trading System based on D5000 System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper displayed the present situation of power spot trading market in China, and propose the construction idea and overall framework for a kind of new power spot treding system based on D5000 System. And, the detailed content are demonstrated. This system proposed in this paper is with remarkable contributions and effectiveness, which could give some positive implications for the construction of dispatching and control system.

articleTitle: Study on Cluster Measurement and Control Device of Intelligent Substation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper., a new type of cluster measuring and controlling device for the interval layer of intelligent substation is developed., which uses several cluster measuring and controlling devices to realize the whole station monitoring function. The selection of various hardware platforms is compared and analyzed., the appropriate main processor is selected and the peripheral design is carried out., and the composition of the new type of cluster measurement and control device is expounded. The test and trial results show that the developed cluster measurement and control device fully meets the requirements of intelligent substation monitoring system., and its performance exceeds the requirements of national standard., and can be completely compatible with the existing operation., maintenance and management mode of intelligent substation monitoring system.

articleTitle: Optimal Compensation Strategy of Demand Response Aggregator for Maximizing Social Welfare in Hierarchical Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In a typical hierarchical electricity market, there are three entities motivated by profit including the utility operator, demand response (DR) aggregator and end users (EUs). When an incentive-based demand response program (IBDRP) is implemented, the compensation strategy of an DR aggregator has significant impacts on the profits of the above three entities. In the existing literature, however, few of them take all of the entities' profits into consideration when the compensation strategy changes. To this end, we propose a multi-objective model consisting of three objective functions of the entities. The operator wants to minimize the operational cost. The aggregator needs to make a compensation strategy to maximize the difference between the revenue from the operator and the compensation to the EUs. Different types of the EUs reduce their load with different response strategies to maximize their profits. We turn the multi-objective model into a single objective model by weighting the three objective functions together, which becomes more tractable to be solved. The case study using a dataset from the Thames valley vision (TVV) verifies the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: The MonTe Carlo Method Application in Cost Risk Management of Pre-Transmission Line Project Based on Markov Chain
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the framework of traditional cost management and project risk management, this paper analyzes the characteristics of pre-construction cost management of transmission line project, identifies the risk factors affecting the project cost in the pre-construction stage, establishes a decision-making model for pre-construction cost management and control of transmission line project, which is based on traditional forecasting technology. In view of the shortcomings of Monte Carlo method, this paper proposes Monte Carlo method (MCMC) based on Markov chain to simulate, predicts the changes of transmission line price factors and ultimately realizes the risk control of transmission line project cost in the early stage of the project. The example and simulation results show feasibility and practicability of the method in transmission line cost forecasting and management in the early stage of the project.

articleTitle: Research on active fast switching principle and method of active distribution network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of voltage sag and short-term voltage interruption of sensitive load, an active fast switching method for active distribution network is proposed in this paper. First, the fast detection method of voltage sag and short-time voltage interruption is studied. Then, the structure and principle of fast switch based on eddy current driving are studied. The fast switch is used in the main power supply line breaker and the bus connection breaker, which can quickly switch the power-lost load to the backup power supply, greatly improving the switching speed. At the same time, the distributed power supply in active distribution network is used to support the bus residual voltage in the switching process, minimizing the impact of the voltage drop on the sensitive load as much as possible. The results of dynamic simulation test verify the superiority of the proposed active fast switching scheme.

articleTitle: Wind Power Correlation Analysis Based on Mix Copula
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind power is a new stochastic variable in the power system operation and dispatch, the correlation of wind power generation should be quantified to determine the variability of power flows, the system uncertainty and operational risk. This paper analyzes the characteristics of wind power first, and then improves a Mix Copula method to model the relationship between the wind power considering the correlation structure. The method constructs a Mix Copula which can describe the tail characteristic by linear weight, then uses the least square method to evaluate the parameter, the analysis results of two typical wind farms show that Mix Copula can accurately describe the correlation structure of wind power. What's more the correlation index and tail correlation index can be easily calculated based on the correlation measure theory of Copula.

articleTitle: Transmission Planning Considering the Influence of Wind-Storage System and Technical-Economic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The shortage of fossil fuels, wind power generation and energy storage equipment are developing so rapidly that make the large-scale energy storage equipment become an trend in the future grid. Seeing the wind-storage system as a whole, the transmission network planning will be inevitably affected by its output mode change. In this paper, a transmission network planning model which considers the influence of the wind-storage system will be established. An optimal operation mode of the wind-storage system will be calculated by the wind plant data from the Eastern Mongolia (according to the peak valley electricity price), and maximizing the energy conversion efficiency. Artificial Fish Swarm Algorithm (ASFA) and the improved Garver 6 node system are used to verify the transmission planning model which is included the influence of the wind-storage system. When the unit price of the energy storage equipment is determined, the corresponding optimal plan of different capacity coefficients is obtained, and the optimal capacity coefficient and the transmission planning under the different unit price are given when the unit price of the energy storage equipment is uncertain. The example shows that it is feasible to add energy storage equipment within a certain price range to effectively improve the economy of transmission network planning.

articleTitle: Damping Torque Analysis Based on Extended C1 ~ C15 Model with Consideration of Under Excitation Limiter and Damping Windings
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under-excited limiter (UEL) is one of the important auxiliary functions in generator excitation system. It has significant influence on the small signal stability of power system. However, the conventional analysis method based on Heffron-Phillips model does not consider the dynamic action of damping windings effectively. Based on the one machine infinite bus C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> ~ C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub> model including the damping windings, the extended C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> ~ C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sub> model with consideration of UEL is derived. The mechanism of the system damping weaken by superimposed type of UEL is proposed based on the principle of superposition and electromagnetic torque analysis method. The results show that the electromagnetic torque provided by UEL through the main excitation channel weakens the system damping and the electromagnetic torque generated by UEL through q-axis damper winding enhances system damping. The damping torque provided by UEL reduces as the boundary line slope of UEL increases until the positive to negative. The total damping torque of the system is greatly reduced as the UEL boundary line slope increases.

articleTitle: Research on unintentional off grid characteristics of microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of renewable energy generation technology and the influence of government support policies, more and more renewable energy sources are connected to the power grid.
