However, due to the volatility of wind power and photovoltaic (PV) power, the proportion of high penetration rate will affect the safe and stable operation of the power grid. Microgrid is composed of distributed generation equipment, electricity load, etc. It can realize small power network with basic balance of internal power and electricity. The microgrid is required to maintain voltage and frequency stability and have secure switching function of connecting on/off grid. The transformation of microgrid from grid-connected mode to off-grid mode mainly includes intentional off grid and unintentional off grid. In this paper, studies on the technical specification of grid-connected microgrid, and establishes a grid-connected model of distributed generation. Taking 400V microgrid laboratory as an example, the model of unintentional disconnection of microgrid is established, and the simulation analysis is carried out to verify the accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: The Impacts of AC Filters to Power Grid Harmonic in UHVDC Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The UHVDC converter station is usually equipped with multiple sets of AC filters and capacitors, which can filter out harmonics at the AC side and make compensation for the reactive power consumed by converters. The impedance-frequency characteristic of the parallel sets of AC filters and capacitors is complex, which can easily lead to harmonic amplification in some frequency ranges. Therefore, it is urgent to make research about the overall filtering performance and partial harmonic amplification of AC filter sets at present. The admittance-frequency characteristics of the AC filter sets are used to analyze the overall filtering performance and partial harmonic amplification of AC filter sets. A practical case of an UHVDC converter station is presented to analyze the impacts of AC filters to power grid harmonics, and the results of the ETAP simulation model verify the effectiveness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: A Flexibility Planning Methodfor Hybrid AC / DC Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of variable renewable generation in power systems., planning for the effects of variability will become more important. This paper analyzed the flexibility metric that reflects the flexibility variability in its time series and the flexibility of a system to manage periods of variability. The time series of system flexibility demand and supply scenarios are established based on the proposed flexibility metric. The timing characteristics of flexibility requirements and flexibility resources are integrated into the traditional coordinated DG and network planning through a bi-level planning model. The upper-level model is a multi-objective model aimed at maximizing the balance between the system flexibility demand and supply., and the social and economic benefits. The optimal scheduling strategies for various flexibility resources can be achieved by the multiobjective particle swarm optimization algorithm based on meshing. The lower model optimizes the location of DG and demand side loads., and the line expansion decision according to previously constructed flexibility requirement scenarios and flexibility resource deployment strategies. Through this new bilevel planning method., available flexibility providers from the resources., network., loads and storage are considering into the planning of distribution system.

articleTitle: Contract-based Incentive-Compatible Demand Response for Internet of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of energy Internet (EI) technology and distributed energy management, exploiting demand response (DR) by managing the charging and discharging behaviours of the Internet of electric vehicles (IoEV) has become a promising way to flatten out the peak load and reduce the level of volatility. However, there lacks an incentive mechanism in the city-wide deployment of IoEV-based DR. Therefore, we propose an incentive-compatible DR mechanism based on contract theoretical modeling. To maximize the social welfare, the contract is tailored for the unique characteristics of each electric vehicle (EV) type. The formulated optimization problem falls into the category of difference of convex (DC) programming, and is solved by using the iterative convex-concave procedure (CCP) algorithm. Finally, the relationships among social welfare, EV type, reward and discharged electricity are also elaborated via numerical results.

articleTitle: Analysis of Integrated Optimization Operation of Regional Electro-pneumatic System Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the comprehensive optimization operation problem of regional electric-gas interconnection system is focused on the coordination effect of demand response on the economic and safe operation of the system. By analyzing the principle of incentive demand response resources participating in system scheduling, a multi-segment function model reflecting the relationship between load reduction and demand response cost is constructed, and then the regional electric-gas interconnection system with gas generator and natural gas compressor as coupling objects is constructed. The characteristics of the dispatching operation, considering the system security constraints, the comprehensive optimization operation model of the regional electric-gas interconnect system considering the demand response is established to realize the economic and reliable operation of the integrated system. Finally, the validity of the proposed model is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Seamless Switching Control Strategy for Diesel Generator and Energy Storage Hybrid Emergency Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The hybrid emergency power supply system composed of a diesel generator and a battery energy storage system(BESS) will complete seamless switching from power grid to BESS at the moment of power grid failure. After a short term power supply BESS needs to transfer power to the diesel generator. In order to ensure the quality of power supply during switching process, seamless switching from BESS to diesel generator is needed. In this paper, the constant voltage and constant frequency control strategy is proposed to stable the frequency and amplitude of the output voltage when BESS works separately. After the diesel generator is put into operation, it provides stable voltage amplitude and frequency support for stand-alone system, therefore, only the power control of the converter is needed, and the output power is gradually reduced according to the reference value of the given power. Then the load is transferred to the diesel generator gradually, and seamless switching from BESS to the diesel generator is completed. The simulation model of the seamless switching process of the hybrid emergency power supply system is built in this paper. In view of the difference between amplitude and frequency of diesel generator voltage and their rated values in the quasi synchronization grid connection, a control strategy for timely switching control mode is worked out. The simulation results show that the control strategy can ensure the uninterrupted power supply for the load and the seamless switching from BESS to the diesel generator.

Author Keywords: constant voltage and constant frequency control strategy

articleTitle: Optimal Strategy of Reserve Allocation Based on the Cost of Expected Frequency
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The responsibility of the power system is to provide the energy to consumers reliably and economically. With the rapid growing of sustainable energy, the sufficient and economic reserve energy is the coping strategies for growing uncertainty and variable energy generation and consumption to some extent. But the reliability and economy are always in conflict in the power system. A chance-constrained programming optimization model is proposed in this paper to minimize the ratio of the total cost of reserve energy to the expected frequency, which is defined as the unit reserve cost of expected frequency (URCEF). The uncertainty factors such as outage of generation units and predicted-deviation of load is considered. The algorithm of mutation particle swarm optimization based on the improved fast sorting method is used to checking and determine the optimal strategy of reserve allocation. Merit of the algorithm is validated by its application to IEEE-30 bus system. Results show that reliability and economy of power system are all considered in this model and the reserve allocation can be obtained high-efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Classification Method of Multi-channel Business Demand in Power Marketing System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the promotion and application of smart energy meters and the rapid development of power marketing systems, the level of marketing measurement intensification and lean management has been greatly improved. With 95598 website, electric e treasure, handheld power, e-commerce, E-charging, WeChat, these six major electronic service channels as the platform, providing business and data support for marketing many application systems. However, with the increasing number of marketing services, such as insufficient design of interactive services, lack of process detection, and lack of effective scheduling, the article studies the automatic classification method of multi-channel power marketing services based on common feature groups, combing business relationships, and achieving unified accounts., unified configuration, unified management, etc. to support.

articleTitle: Voltage Secure Operational Ranges in Hierarchical Systems to Transmitted Large-scale Renewable Powers by HVDCs
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To guarantee secure operations in hierarchical systems with large-scale renewable powers, it's essential for the system and operators to determine a voltage secure operational ranges (VSORs) for each bus/station. However, the computation of the VSOR is really complicated especially for large scale systems. Therefore, a hierarchical computational method for the large-scale hierarchical systems is proposed in this paper, which takes into account the HVDC operations and different N-1 contingencies. The VSOR computation is fast and can be applied in hierarchical systems with large-scale renewable powers online, exchanging information between wind farms, wind integrated stations and power grids. The efficiency and accuracy of the VSOR computation has been observed using operation data of Western China Power Grid in case studies.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Analysis Based on Different Adjustment Strategies
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper considers a framework of electrical cyber-physical systems. Each bus and branch in a power grid is equipped with a controller and a sensor so that we can monitor and adjust the state of the grid. Recur to measuring the damages of disconnection fault, three kinds of generator output adjustment algorithms are proposed if there are cascading failures or splitting incidents. We compare the final results under the same initial fault based on these three adjustment algorithms then define the performance of these algorithms.

articleTitle: A Novel Method on Multi-Area Network Model Merging for Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to meet the demand of real time global network model for multi-area energy internet analysis and control, this paper presents a novel scheme on multi-area network model merging and obtaining the global model. An algorithm based on constrained state estimation is proposed for multi-region network model splicing. The network merging problem is translated into a state estimation model with boundary equality constraints. A predictor-corrector interior-point method is applied to solve the problem. Simulations are carried out on IEEE testing system and an actual power system, the results indicate that the proposed method can efficiently achieve online splicing of region power grid with different control centers.

articleTitle: Information access of distributed photovoltaic and influence on load forecasting
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents the rapid growth situation of distributed photovoltaic in Beijing-Tianjin-North Hebei Grid. With the necessity for information access of distributed photovoltaic output, this paper builds a load deduction system with the distributed photovoltaic through its structure and specific. In addittion, for the purpose of improving accuracy of load forecast, distributed photovoltaic output and grid load are forecasting separately.

articleTitle: Research on partial discharge image recognition and intelligent diagnosis of distribution switchgear
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the harm of partial discharge to the insulation of distribution switchgear cabinet, the decrease of power cut test quantity caused by the improvement of power supply reliability requirement and the influence of switchgear fault on main equipment of power grid such as transformer, the working principle and application scope of ultrasonic method, ultra-high frequency method and transient ground voltage method are introduced. The influencing factors of the results and the key technical points of the on-site detection are analyzed, and the example of ultrasonic partial discharge pattern recognition and state diagnosis of a switch cabinet is analyzed. The ultra-high frequency, transient voltage partial discharge detection method and infrared thermal image detection method are used to verify the results. Some suggestions are put forward combined with the power cut inspection and defect treatment, such as carrying out instrument calibration on time, adopting multiple methods for joint positioning, improving detection operation, spectrum recognition and fault diagnosis ability.

articleTitle: Study on Magnetic Field Generated by Simulated Disturbance Source of 110kV AIS Disconnecting Switch
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In air insulated substation (AIS), the arc produced by the disconnecting switch operation is the most serious electromagnetic interference source. It can produce electromagnetic radiation in space with high frequency, which will couple to the secondary equipment and affect the normal operation of the secondary equipment. To study the transient magnetic field caused by disconnecting switch operation, a large number of repeated tests in AIS are required. However, repeated tests are not allowed in AIS because it will affect the normal running of power system. So a simulated disturbance source system which can simulate the actual disconnecting switch operation was designed in this paper. Then the influence on the magnetic field by the bus parameters, gap spacing of disconnecting switch and power capacity was studied. The results show that the disturbance source system can produce magnetic field of 1.1 MHz to 1.9 MHz in frequency and 569A/m in maximum strength, which is coincident with the existing measured data of the disconnecting switch operation in AIS.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis and Optimization on Shunt Losses in a Multi-Stack VRFB System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Relative to conventional self-contained battery technologies, there are many advantages for VRFB using on large, utility-scale bulk energy storage application. During design the large scale VRFB system, the reduction of shunt current has always been focused on. The paper explored a stacks string model based on MultiSim™ software package to analyze and optimize shunt loss. Numerical analysis and optimization result express that the extra pipe resistance breaks the straight-line manifold voltage distribution, the degree of voltage redistribution depends on the resistance of stack feed piping, and shunt geometry optimization ranges are often limited by constrains and considerations.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Lubricating Oil Control System of Large Capacity Synchronous Condenser for UHV Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The lubricating oil system is an important auxiliary system of large capacity synchronous condensers for UHV converter station. Its configuration and control is related to the reliability of long-term safe operation of synchronous condensers. First, the causes of abnormal tripping faults in the switching process of the AC lubricating oil pump is analyzed. The optimization measures based on the original lubricating oil control system are proposed, such as increasing the interlocking of the AC lubricating oil pump hard circuit, modifying the execution sequence of the logical configuration of the distributed control system, in order to shorten the starting time of the standby AC lubricating oil pump. Finally, the static and dynamic test results show that the proposed optimization measures are effective, and the establishment speed of lubricating oil pressure in the process of AC lubricating oil pumps' switching is increased.

articleTitle: Research on the Elastic Processing Architecture of Distribution Automation Main Station Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When a large number of distribution terminals are connected, access information has poured into the distribution automation. To simply improve the performance of a single server, distribution automation main station can not meet the performance needs of applications. By introducing cloud computing technology, using its dynamic resource adjustment, high reliability and other characteristics, mass information processing capability elastic architecture about distribution automation main station is proposed. The validation environment based on the cloud computing platform is built. The cloud computing technology is tested and verified in the aspects of dynamic adjustment ability, single or multiple faults and recovery ability. The verification results show that cloud computing can be applied to distribution automation main station mass processing elastic architecture.

articleTitle: Analysis of ground wire fault in the section of incoming lines of electrified railway traction station
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The paper analyzes reasons for the failure of strain clamp hardware in the power supply line of an electrified railway traction substation, carries out strain clamp material test, grounding current measurement, arc simulation and other relevant tests, and the reasons for the fault are analyzed as follows: the contact surface is narrow between the strain clamp steel anchor and the U-shaped hanging ring because of the connection structure between them, which is likely to result in gap under the influence of vibration and other environment factors, thus giving birth to suspended potential and bringing about arc ablation under the joint effects of voltage, current and environment and melting and fracturing them gradually. The paper also proposes control measures and recommendations against the fracture fault of strain clamp hardware involved in the power supply line at the side of traction substation system. side power supply line of traction substation.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Time Scale Order Reduction of Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing number of photovoltaic systems connected to the grid, the entire power system faces the fact that the system model is increasingly complex and difficult to calculate and analyze. For this problem, we presented an improved method for constructing the simplified model of a photovoltaic system based on singular perturbation theory. The multi-time scale characteristics of photovoltaic system were divided, then the model was reduced by neglecting fast dynamics. A zeroth and a first improvement were obtained by adding correction terms. Time-domain simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method has the advantages of faster calculation speed and higher accuracy. In summary, the proposed method is effective and applicable to simplify the PV systems.

articleTitle: Simulation Method and Software Platform Development for Voltage Control of Distribution Network with Large-scale Photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: By combining with the latest theoretical results of distribution voltage control for distribution network, a voltage control simulation system based on. NET platform of distribution network containing a large number of photovoltaic power sources is designed and developed, which provides supplementary analysis for planning decision-making of voltage control. The system is developed in Microsoft Visual Studio 2010 platform integrated with the GIS plug-in component MapX. In the end, a modified IEEE33-69case is used to validate the feasibility of the proposed simulation system.

articleTitle: Risk Warning Strategy for Information Network of Global Energy Internet Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the requirement to ensure the security of GEI Information network, the risk warning strategy for information network based on big data technology which contains risk warning model and risk warning method have been explored. And a new GEI risk warning method system which consists of state early-warning method, threshold early-warning method, fast change early-warning method, trend early-warning method, evaluation early-warning method, related early-warning method, classified early warning method and ranking early warning method is proposed. The method can help to break the previous passive operation and maintenance mode after the failure occurs, and realizes the active operation and maintenance mode before failure occurs.

articleTitle: A Transient Reconstructed Current-Instantaneous Correlation Factor Based Fault Section Location Method for Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Fault location technique is a key technology of smart distribution network. It is helpful for the fast line repair and power service restoration in distribution systems. In this paper, a novel multi-agent system based fault section location method for active distribution network is proposed, which can be in common use under various system neutral operation conditions. The transient reconstructed current - instantaneous correlation factor (TRC-ICF) of a line section is used to detect and locate the fault. There are three levels of agents in this method: local agent, regional agent and central agent. The local agent can collect the current information and obtain the transient reconstructed current data by information processing. The regional agent can detect fault in the section of its charge by computing and judging the TRC-ICF of the section based on the transient reconstructed current data sent from the local agents. The central agent monitors the operation of the whole system, and outputs the fault location result by integrating the fault determination results of all the regional agents. The proposed method has been verified by a series of MATLAB/Simulink simulations.

articleTitle: A Numerical Observability Analysis Method for Combined Electric-Gas Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: More and more researches are focused on integrated energy system (IES) in recent years since IES can improve the efficiency of consuming energy. State estimation (SE)is fundamental to achieve controllability of a system. And observability analysis, which analyzes whether SE can be done or not by using the measurement data, is the first step for SE. The combined electric-gas network is a kind of common form of IES. In this paper, a combined electric-gas network steady-state model is formulated and the coupling elements, which are gas turbines, are also formulated in the model. Then a numerical method for observability analysis is proposed to analyze the combined electric-gas network. The observability analysis method is applied in a 16-node combined electric-gas networks system and the numerical results proved the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Wind Power Load Forecasting Based on Incremental BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind power load forecasting is an important part of energy internet, which is the basis of rational arrange the power grid operation plan. As a kind of time series data, wind power load data has the characteristics of time series and large quantity. To overcome the deficiency that the latest information of time series has great influence on the accuracy of wind power load forecasting, this paper proposes a method of adding and deleting hidden nodes of BP neural network to realize the incremental learning of BP neural network training. By dynamically adding and deleting the number of hidden layer neurons and training the latest time series information in BP neural network, this method can improve the effect of network training and avoid the convergence of traditional BP neural network to local minimum. By comparing the wind power load forecasting results of batch training BP neural network and incremental BP neural network with real wind power load, the results show that the wind power load forecasting accuracy based on incremental BP neural network is higher.

articleTitle: A Probabilistic Harmonic State Estimation Method for Distribution Network Connected by Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The classical harmonic state estimation model is no longer applicable in the wind power connected power system. On the one hand, the violent fluctuation characteristics of harmonics make it difficult to accurately estimate the harmonic. On the other hand, the estimated result at a single moment can not represent the level of violently fluctuating harmonics. A method employing both semi-invariant and the least squares method is proposed to estimate the harmonic under the condition of distributed wind power access to distribution network. Firstly, semi-invariant is used to convert the estimation of the harmonic current at each moment into the estimation of the semi-invariant of the harmonic current at a large number of moments. The least squares method is used to estimate the half-invariant of harmonic currents. The Gram-Charlier series are used to calculate the probability density and probabilistic characteristic quantities of harmonic currents based on the half-invariant. Simulation results on the IEEE 13-bus test system show that the probability harmonic state estimation method can adapt to the randomness and intermittency of the harmonics injected by the grid-connected wind farm, and effectively estimate the probability distribution and probability eigenvalue of the harmonic current.

articleTitle: Simulation and Optimization Model for Energy Efficient Building and Environmental Assessment
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This research article, presenting the optimization techniques simulations and optimized model of a single family house to understand the energy requirement and consumption in houses and buildings. Objective is to making the houses and building most energy efficient by reducing the heating losses, like transmission losses, ventilation losses, increase the thermal comfort, and mainly focused on environmental impact because the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission by human activities swirly damaging the environment. In our optimized model, three different types of software Pleiades + COMFIE, CONTAM and RET Screen are used. By using these tools, we calculate the heating losses, transmission losses, ventilation losses, thermal bridges, of complete house. We also calculate the internal gain, solar gain, total heating load, water and electricity consumption. For achieving energy efficient model and best optimal scheduling, we use eight different techniques. The results we achieved significantly reduce energy consumption specially heating load and increases thermal comfort. In our proposed model we also introduces renewable energy sources like solar PV panel and integrate this with our house to minimize the energy dependency on fossil fuels, and this will help us to reduces the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission. Calculation also performs for the life cycle assessment and comparison between different materials there CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission, environmental impact, life cycle analysis and recycling of waste.

articleTitle: Reactive Power and Voltage Control in VSC-HVDC Connected Wind Farms Considering Stochastic Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind power changes instantaneously during the control interval of automatic voltage control (AVC) system. To enhance the control effect in voltage-source-converter-based high-voltage direct-current (VSC-HVDC) systems with wind farms integration, this paper proposes a reactive power and voltage control scheme considering the stochastic deviation from baseline wind power. The uncertainties of wind power during the control interval are characterized by state-based generated scenarios. Through a scenario-based optimization, the reduced scenarios are used to optimize expected network losses while the extreme scenarios ensure the voltage security. Case studies based on Monte Carlo simulation show the proposed method decreases the voltage bounds violations with acceptable network losses. In addition, the balance between economy and robustness can be adjusted by parameters in the control scheme.

articleTitle: AC/DC Power Flow Algorithm Considering Various Controls Transformation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the power flow solution of AC/DC systems, the problem of how to describe the transformation of HVDC system control method effectively must be considered for operation and analysis of actual power system. In this paper, the conversion conditions of control modes of HVDC system are presented, especially the mutual conversion of control variables of rectifier side and inverter side, and the program for power flow are presented, which based on the method of equivalent power and principle of alternant decouple solving in AC/DC system. The control effect and mutual conversion of the main control modes in HVDC system are considered in this program. The DC circuit in the EPRI-36 was modified as an example for detailed calculation and analysis through the function of user program interface (UPI) of power system analysis software package (PSASP). The AC bus voltage of rectifier side and inverter side are regulated, and calculating the power flow for the corresponding operation state. The result shows that this algorithm can deal with transformation of operating mode caused by the change of operating conditions and are favorable to power flow calculation and simulation of large scale power systems.

articleTitle: Operating Level Evaluation Approach of Protective Devices Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Protection system is the first defense line to ensure the safe operation of power grids, hence it is of great significance to study its reliability. Currently, the research on protection system reliability mainly focuses around misoperation and fail-to-operation, yet it does not effectively take advantage of defect data which may occur in greater probability. This paper analyzed defect data of protection devices and estimated the parameters of two-parameter Weibull distribution as well as the reliability function, failure rate function and mean time between failures. The study case shows that it could supply new ideas for reliability assessment of protection systems and reference for maintenance optimization from the point of view of defect information.

articleTitle: WPT Charging System Based on Variety Excitation Source
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless power transfer (WPT) technology, lots of research work has been carried out. However, most of the research work mainly focuses on system topology, reactive power compensation, design of electromagnetic coupling coils and methods of system efficiency improvement. Research on the charging efficiency of WPT system with battery as load is rare. In this paper, WPT charging system with low frequency excitation sources is proposed. The excitation sources are 100Hz sine wave, triangle wave and square wave pulse power supply respectively. Using Simplorer and Maxwell co-simulation, Electromagnetic field analysis of the different placement modes (coaxial, horizontal misalignment, non-parallel) of the electromagnetic coupling coils are carried out. The relationship between system efficiency and the distance between electromagnetic coupling coils is analyzed. Finally, the lithium battery PNGV model is adopted as the system load, which makes the system charging process closer to the actual charging situation.

articleTitle: Study on the Electricity Replacement Potential in Japan and South Korea Under the Northeast Asia Grid Interconnection Scenario
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The paper studied the potentials of electricity replacement in different industries in Japan and South Korea from 2020 to 2050. Based on the influences analysis about main factors in secondary industry and electric vehicle development, an improved BASS model (Bass Diffusion Model), relevant to the diffusion of new product was proposed. Through a model-based study, the amount of electric energy replacement in Japan and South Korea from 2020 to 2050 was predicted under the Northeast Asia Grid Interconnection Scenario.

articleTitle: A Novel Control Strategy of Modular Multilevel Converter Based on Instantaneous Power Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rapid response characteristics of the power electronic device may aggravate the subsynchronous oscillation, which is closely related to the controller of modular multilevel converter (MMC). When a subsynchronous frequency component is fed into classical d/q decoupling controller, the output signals of the converter will include multiple component of sub-and super-synchronous frequency under such situation. In order to solve the problem that classical controller may increase power oscillation, a new controller based on instantaneous power theory is designed, without phase-lock loop and d/q coordinate transformation. Two different control strategies are simulated separately by MMC-HVDC electromagnetic model on PSCAD/EMTDC and the results show that the use of the proposed control strategy suppresses power fluctuations effectively and improves stability of HVDC system as well.

articleTitle: Asset Efficiency Correlation Factor Analysis Based on Constrained Utilization Maximum Estimation Model
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, asset efficiency has become important in power system planning. However, there are a great many factors that influence the power network asset efficiency. It is essential to develop a method to find the key factors and take measures to improve the asset efficiency. This paper proposes constrained utilization maximum estimation (CUME) model to reflect the asset efficiency. Gray relation analysis (GRA) has been used to calculate the relevancy to the related factors. A case study has been given as an example to indicate that the proposed method could reflect the potential relationship between asset efficiency and operating index.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability of Regional Energy Internet Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes two redundant communication system of regional energy internet based on parallel redundancy protocol and high availability seamless ring topology. Since the failure of communication components is sometimes affected by the same factors, the concept of common cause failure is considered when analyzing the reliability problem. Reliability block diagram considering common cause failure factor is used for reliability analysis of proposed communication topology, and the actual reliability is obtained which has important reference value to the planning and designing of energy internet communication system.

articleTitle: Study on Gas Liquefaction of HVDC Gas-insulated Bushing in Alpine Region
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of new energy sources and the global energy interconnection, high-voltage direct current (HVDe) equipment has been used in worldwide. The HVDe gas-insulated bushing installed in the alpine region has the risk of low-temperature liquefaction of the gas, which seriously affects the safe and reliable operation of the power equipment. In this paper, the temperature distribution model of vertical, horizontal and inclined casings containing gas flow is established by the coupling method of temperature field and airflow field. The gas flow and temperature distribution inside the bushing are obtained. On this basis, the temperature distribution model of a vertical bushing with different heater power is studied, and the power of the heating belt is reasonably optimized. The operation power of the heating belt is reduced while ensuring that the gas does not liquefy. Improve the operational reliability of HVDe gas-insulated bushing in alpine regions.

articleTitle: Research on Power Voltage Characteristics of MMC-HVDC grid based on MMC Control
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, DC power and voltage characteristics in MMC-HVDC grid are analyzed. Coupling between DC voltage and power in MMC grid under power imbalance is proposed based on MMC converter response, and time-varying curve of DC voltage is analyzed. A simplified model of four-terminal MMC-HVDC grid is built, and simulations of DC voltage change under power imbalance is done. Analyses and simulation results show that, under fixed control response; a positive proportional relationship exists between power variation and DC voltage variation. Time-varying curve of DC voltage can be calculated by a first order differential equation.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Nano-Carbon Fiber Grounding Grid Considering Short Circuit Current Distribution-Part I: Selection and Calculation of Parameters
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to its excellent corrosion resistance and the electrical conductivity is superior to other nonmetal materials, carbon nanofibers material has become the development direction of the grounding material. However, as a new type of nonmetal grounding material, the electrical properties of carbon nanofibers material has not been fully studied. In addition, the existing rules are based on the metal grounding grid, and the resistivity and thermal stability of carbon nanofibers material are different from the metal materials, therefore, reasonable calculation of grounding parameters and evaluation of carbon nanofibers grounding grid is of great significance to the application and promotion of carbon nanofibers and nonmetal grounding material. Due to the high resistivity, low permeability and low coefficient of thermal stability of nano-carbon fiber material, the evaluation method of nano carbon fiber grounding grid is different from that of metal grounding grid. This paper analyses safety assessment methods of nano-carbon fiber grounding in detail from the conductor cross-sectional area and equivalence, the short-circuit current calculation and the grounding parameters calculation, to provide reference for the evaluation of nano-carbon fiber material and various non-metallic materials. At the same time it lays a foundation for the application of nonmetal material in power frequency grounding field.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of an Organic Rankine Cycle with Different Working Fluids for Heat Recovery from an Internal Combustion Engine
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Internal Combustion Engine (ICE)waste heat resources mainly include jacket cooling water heat and exhaust gas heat. However, jacket cooling water heat is usually ignored due to its low temperature in the bottoming cycle which uses Organic Rankine Cycle (ORC)to recover waste heat from an ICE. This paper establishes an optimization model of an ICE-ORC bottoming cycle to maximize the ORC net power output for different ICE rated power outputs with different working fluids. Moreover, three different ICE-ORC bottoming cycles are considered: a simple cycle with the use of only exhaust gas as the ORC thermal source, a cycle with the use of exhaust gas as the ORC thermal source and jacket cooling water preheating working fluid, and a cycle with a specific jacket cooling water circuit which includes a splitter and an exhaust gas heat exchanger. The results demonstrate that whether it is necessary to recover jacket cooling water waste heat depends on the property parameters of working fluid, each ICE-ORC bottoming cycle has a suitable working fluid to obtain maximum ORC power output respective, and the maximum ICE-ORC bottoming cycle efficiency could be increased by 16% using pentane as working fluid compared with single ICE generator set.

articleTitle: An Assessment Model of Progress and Risk for Substation Construction Under the Background of Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of the economy, the main grid of the city can't meet the load demand, and it is urgent to improve the structure of power supply and capacity of the grid, which will provide guarantee for the construction of a world-class city integrated energy internet. Substation project construction plays a key role in the improvement of the main grid structure. The risk of power grid construction exists in every stage of the life cycle of the construction project, and risk of progress is particularly prominent. A assessment model of progress and risk for substation construction based on the method of decision tree is proposed in this paper. On the basis of typical critical path of substation construction project, the article analysis the influence of the risk factors on the progress of the project by use of decision tree method, the dynamic index is constructed to modify the early reward or lag penalty when calculating the profit and loss value of risk conditions, which makes the evaluation result more practical. Quantitative evaluation index is constructed and the feasibility of this model is illustrated by the actual case of substation construction in Tianjin. Model evaluation results can be used to evaluate the risk factors and provide guidance for the substation construction manager of progress risk management decisions.

articleTitle: Method for Debugging the Polarity of the Mutual Inductor for 1,000 kV EHV Regulating and Compensating Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the polarity test of the CT for 1, 000kV ultra-high voltage(UHV) infrastructure projects, the polarity layout method and test program of a main transformer, etc. were discussed under 3/2 complete serial connection mode in an all-round manner. The protection of 1, 000kV bus difference, circuit breakers, lines and high resistance, the polarity of a metering device CT and the receiving method of a secondary circuit were discussed; and a reasonable point polarity method was provided before actual production. The polarity configuration of CTs at the low-voltage side of an ultra-high voltage transformer body bushing, common windings, a voltage regulation-compensation transformer, a house transformer and a main transformer, and the calculation logic of protective devices were studied. The effect of essential factors such as actual wring, equivalent impedance, etc. on polarity were analyzed, and the adverse factor of voltage regulation position was pointed out. When the polarity at the high-voltage side of the housing transformer was being studied, it is strongly interfered by electromagnetic coupling. The selection scheme of CT secondary circuit was studied according to the requirements of different ultra-high voltage protective devices, and the point polarity measures of the voltage regulation-compensation transformer were explored according to protection calculation logic. When the polarity of the main transformer and the auxiliary transformer for a compensation transformer were being tested, the cause of interference among three phases due to the Y/Δ wiring method at HV and low sides of the main transformer was mainly discussed.

articleTitle: Convex relaxation algorithm for chance constrained wind farm capacity assessment
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale wind power penetration brings significant technical challenges to the power system operation. For the convenience of planning and construction, the beforehand study of wind farm capacity assessment is necessary. Considering the uncertainty of wind power output, the chance constrained capacity assessment model is built to determine the maximum penetration level for all wind farms. Convex relaxation of chance constrained optimization with the random variable described accurately by gaussian mixture model (GMM) is implemented and finally, the assessment model is converted into a convex optimization problem, which is handled efficiently. With a pre-defined confidence level, the effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated in numerical test on a modified IEEE-24 node system.

articleTitle: An LVRT Control Strategy of Photovoltaic Systems Under Unbalanced Faults
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The successful integration of PV systems into grid requires an effective control strategy that can operate well under both normal and abnormal grid conditions. In this work, an L VRT strategy is developed for grid-integrated PV system under unsymmetrical faults. The developed strategy contains, among many functions, the power set-point computation scheme to realize the grid code provisions, the PV power reduction model to prevent the dc-link over-voltage, the current amplitude limiting function for protection of converter overload, and novel current reference computing scheme to secure the smooth function of PV system. Several simulations are undertaken to explore the success of the developed method in MATLAB/SIMULINK and the findings confirms the strategy performs well.

articleTitle: Fast Voltage Stabilization Evaluation Method for HVDC Project with Weak Contact Channels in Sending Terminal Based on Short Circuit Capacity
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the initial operation stage of some HVDC transmission systems in China, the DC power supply and some electric equipment has not put into service; the power transmitted by HVDC project all comes from AC system; Therefore disturbances from both AC and DC system can cause serious voltage stabilization problem. On the one hand, if the components connecting AC and DC system loss, the connection between the two system will be further weakened and the voltage in converter station may be unstable. On the other hand, when large disturbance occurs in DC transmission system, the bus voltage of converter station may experience severe transient overvoltage resulting from the surplus of reactive power. This paper proposes a fast evaluation method of voltage stability for HVDC power grid with weak contact channels in sending terminal based on short circuit capacity. The method formulates the relation between short circuit capacity and static voltage stability limit as well as that between short circuit capacity and bus voltage. Taking Zhalute-Guanggu HVDC as an example, this article analyzes the mechanism of transient overvoltage and voltage instability at converter bus and evaluates the voltage stability of the project using the proposed method. The computing results verify the correctness of the analysis method. The method described in this paper is concise and effective enough to be applied to other high-capacity HVDC system.

Author Keywords: HVDC transmission with weak contact channels

articleTitle: A Power Prediction System for Photo-Voltaic Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a frequency domain identification-based power prediction system is developed for the photovoltaic (PV) power plant. A first-order plus dead time (FOPDT) model of the PV power plant is first identified using the daily PV power plant operating data. Given the identified FOPDT model, we do discretization to obtain an FOPDT-based iterative calculation formula for the PV power prediction. Finally, a portable Power Prediction software of Python is developed using the resulting iterative calculation formula. In numerical experiments, we showcase the effectiveness of the Power Prediction software by applying it to real data.

articleTitle: Calculation of Transformer Core Heat Generation Based on Finite Element Coupling Calculation Model
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to accurately calculate the core loss of the transformer, based on the analysis of the traditional finite element analysis method and the Steinmetz formula, an E-ψ method model is proposed to calculate the core loss of the transformer and the node element. Taking a 20kHz, 50kV, 60kW high-frequency transformer as an example, a three-dimensional model is established to calculate the core loss of the transformer. By comparing the measured data of transformer core loss with the figures calculated. By edge-nodal coupled E-ψ method, NFEM, EFEM and Steinmetz method, he comparison results show that: the E-ψ edge-nodal coupled method has higher accuracy than results calculated by Steinmetz model, edge finite element method and node finite element method.

articleTitle: An Efficient Recoverable Concealed Data Aggregation Scheme for Direct Load Control
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The non-intrusive load monitoring method is used to simplify the detection process of direct load control command execution in direct load control mechanism. In the process of non-intrusive load monitoring data uploading in wireless sensor network, the data aggregation scheme based on homomorphic encryption is used to protect the security and privacy of user data. A recoverable data aggregation scheme which is suitable for direct load control is adopted to overcome the shortcoming that the utility can only retrieves the aggregated result, not individual data, which can realize verifying user identity and data integrity, meeting the needs of power companies for further operation on user data. To solve the shortcoming of limited resources on wireless sensor nodes, a differential data transmission method is proposed to reduce communication overhead.

articleTitle: Redundant and Fault-tolerant Method for Medium Voltage Transformerless PCS
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to demands for highly reliable energy storage converter system, a modular medium voltage transformerless structure with redundant fault-tolerance is designed, which specifies its treatment procedure of redundant tolerance faults. The reliability and redundant fault-tolerance of the modular system is analyzed. Simulation and experiment results show that the system can satisfy the requirement of redundancy and fault-tolerance.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Compressed Air Energy Storage System and its Application in Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing application of energy storage technology in power grid, the traditional chemical energy storage technologies such as kinds of batteries have exposed the problems of low capacity, high cost and short service life. Compressed air energy storage system (CAES) provides a promising large-scale and low-cost energy storage solution. In this paper, the key technologies of compressed air energy storage system are analyzed, and an new economic model is established, which takes into account the life cycle cost, direct income and potential income, to analyze the economic efficiency of compressed air energy storage system. At the same time, a control model of compressed air energy storage system based on filter is proposed and the simulation proves that it is effective in the application of stabilizing wind farm power output fluctuation. The research in this paper can provide a reference for the pricing and operation of compressed air energy storage system in power grid.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Scheduling with Distributed Energy Resources Based on Power Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of distributed energy resources (DER) in distribution network, system operations such as peak shaving and voltage stability face more challenges. Battery energy storage (BES) has been widely accepted as the most potential application to cope with the challenge of high penetration of DER. To cope with the uncertainties and variability of DER, a stochastic distribution network scheduling method is proposed. The overall economy is achieved by fully considering the cell degradation, DER, electricity purchasing and active power losses. DER power scenarios are generated to consider the uncertainties and correlations based on the Copula theory. Finally, numerical studies for the day-ahead distribution network scheduling in the IEEE 123-node test feeder are presented to demonstrate the merits of the proposed method. Results show that the problems caused by DER are greatly alleviated by capturing the uncertainties and correlations.

articleTitle: Discrete-Time Tool for Stability Analysis of the VSC-based DC Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With an increasing application of power electronics converters and direct-current loads in distribution systems, the dynamic behavior of the system with nonlinearities is becoming of a particular interest. In this context, a discrete-time modeling approach is presented in this paper in order to study the stability of VSC-based AC/DC systems. The investigated system is defined through discrete-time modeling approach in this paper, and the eigenvalues of the discrete state space matrix are used to describe the dynamic characteristics. According to the proposed method, the stable boundaries can be predicted, and this method can also be effectively applied to the parameters adaptive optimization. The accuracy of the proposed method and the theoretical analyses are validated through time-domain simulations.

articleTitle: Power Load Modeling Considering Load Low-voltage Releasing Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a novel load model structure considering multi-level low-voltage release characteristics is proposed. In the proposed model, three-level low-voltage release characteristic parameters are introduced into the existing synthesis load model (SLM) to simulate the load low-voltage release characteristics during disturbance. Next a load model parameter calculation method considering load multilevel low-voltage release characteristics is proposed. Calculating the per-unit value of a single device type real load power relative to the total load node real power, and using the per-unit value as a weighted factor for polymerization, the each stage action voltage and low-voltage release average delay time constant in the synthesis load of low-voltage multi-level release characteristic parameters can be derived. Then based on the percentage of actual load losses after disturbance, multilevel low-voltage release proportion parameters is determined by fault fitting method. These three parameters can be further revised iteratively to make the error between actual load loss and calculation load loss to be minimum. Thus the low-voltage multi-level release characteristics of the load is accurately simulated. The practical calculation case of Shanghai power grid shows that low -voltage multi-level release characteristic parameters generated by the proposed load model structure and the proposed method for determining the load model parameters, can well describe the load low-voltage multi-level release characteristics.

articleTitle: An Improved Fast Harmonic Load Flow Method for Distribution Network Considering Distributed Generators
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper introduces an improved backward/forward sweep algorithm for harmonics flow calculation in the distribution network. The harmonic current of some branches which do not connect with harmonic sources was normally ignored in the common harmonic backward/forward sweep algorithm. Then the results obtained by the common method are inaccurate. In this algorithm, the branches are sorted by layers based on special hierarchy characteristic of the radial network. According to the network layers, the location conditions of the harmonic sources in the tributaries of the network are divided into three types. Parts of the ignored forward harmonic branch currents are calculated according to these harmonic source types. Then, the rest of ignored harmonic branch currents are obtained by an additional current forward sweep. After the branch currents are obtained, the harmonics bus voltage can be easily obtained from the sending end to the receiving end based on the Kirchhoff's Voltage Law. By using this method, the accuracy of the result of harmonic backward/forward sweep algorithm is improved. This conclusion can be proved by the test results.

articleTitle: Green Time-Sharing Electricity Price Mechanism and Optimization Based on Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a green time-sharing electricity price mechanism including time-sharing electricity trading and green certificate trading, and constructs a green time-sharing electricity price with the peak-to-valley difference as the optimization goal, taking into account the benefits of power generation enterprises, power grid enterprises, power sales enterprises and power users. Optimize the model. The optimization results show that the green time-sharing electricity price can better mobilize the enthusiasm of power users to change their electricity habits, and promote the development of renewable energy while cutting peaks and filling valleys.

articleTitle: A New Type of UHVDC Converter Valve Operating Synthetic Test Circuit
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Building energy Internet and speeding up interconnection of power grids has gained wide attention and recognition. UHV is the most advanced transmission technology in the world, and it is the core and key of building energy Internet. UHV converter valve is the core device of UHVDC transmission project and its capacity is very large. In order to reduce the test capacity, the synthetic test method is a suitable choice in the operating test of the converter valve. In order to satisfy the requirement of operating test, the voltage/current waveform on both ends of the test valve must be reproduced correctly to improve the equivalence of the test. Considering the existing synthetic test circuit can not fully take into account the equivalence of each test item, a new synthetic test circuit is presented in this paper, which can correctly reproduce the voltage and current waveform of the actual operating of the converter valve, especially the low voltage operation test part, and greatly improve the equivalence of the operating test. Through the simulation of power system simulation software, it is proved that the design of the new synthetic test circuit is feasible and can provide reference for the development of the UHV converter valve operating test device.

articleTitle: Numerical Accuracy Analysis of Multi-scale Transient Simulation in AC-DC Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the simulation of diverse transients in ac and dc networks, a multi-scale transients modeling method, which is based on the Hilbert transform and frequency shifting is presented in this paper. It can use different time steps to simulate electromagnetic and electromechanical transients separately within the same study. The simulation scale and simulation speed have been greatly improved by using larger simulation step size in the electromechanical subsystems. To demonstrate the accuracy of a system with different time steps, a formal mathematical analysis validation method is presented. Using this validation method, the proposed modeling method is demonstrated to have better accuracy. Then, a large and complex network with kinds of power electric equipment can be easily, accurately and quickly simulated. The proposed methods are thoroughly demonstrated in a numerical example under steady state and faulty conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Impacts of Photovoltaic Connected to Rural Grid Considering Time-varying Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the promotion of photovoltaic (PV) poverty alleviation projects in rural areas, integration of large-scaled photovoltaic will certainly have impacts on safe and stable operation of the power grid. According to field research, this paper sorts out the typical interconnection forms of PVs for photovoltaic poverty alleviation areas. The software DIg SILENT PowerFactory is used for the simulation of the rural distribution network while considering connections from PVs at different penetration rates and interconnection forms. The paper fully considers the time-varying characteristics of the photovoltaic power and load power output. Calculation and analysis of practical engineering in northern China are carried out in this paper. After analyzing the impacts on voltage, consumption and lines under different scenarios, the maximum integration capacity of the PV generation in photovoltaic poverty alleviation areas can be obtained. Analysis results show that the main factor limiting integration capacity of centralized integration is local consumption. The main factor limiting integration capacity of decentralized integration is voltage deviation.

articleTitle: Study on the R TDS Simulation Platform of Parallel Injection Hybrid Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To ensure the dynamic compensation performance of the parallel injection hybrid active power filter (IHAPF) input into the grid, established the Real Time Digital Simulation (RTDS) loop simulation system of the parallel IHAPF using on-line simulation software. The switch frequency of Parallel HIAPF is up to several kHz, conventional RTDS model library can't achieve high frequency simulation, for the modeling difficulties of the parallel IHAPF, using RTDS small step model approach. Introducing the small step modeling approach of the parallel IHAPF in details, and summarized the key and difficulty of modeling, the 35kV substation closed-loop simulation results verify the correct of model. The modeling approach has a significant guiding for the closed-loop RTDS modeling of high switching frequency equipments.

articleTitle: Dynamic Behavior of Doubly Fed Induction Generator Considering Protection and Control Strategy During Symmetrical Faults
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Control and protection strategies take significant effect on dynamic behavior of doubly fed induction generators (DFIGs) during failure, thereby raising a conundrum for relay protection design especially as the penetration of DFIGs based wind turbines (WTs) increases. This paper takes a mathematical viewpoint, considering protection and control strategies, and analyzes the dynamic behavior of DFIG under two different faults as well as the fault steady-state model. The analysis and calculation proceed in the s-domain (complex frequency domain), and thus complex feedback loops are able to be processed. Dynamic behaviors of DFIG are studied with the math model, and fault current expressions reveal the influence of voltage dip, rotor speed as well as control parameters.

articleTitle: Analysis of Magnetizing inrush characteristics of electrified railway and its influence on grid voltage
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper analyzes the mechanism and properties of traction transformer inrush currents, combining with the characteristics of electrified railway traction transformer, then the factors that affect the inrush currents magnitude and the characteristics of the inrush currents were studied using MATLAB simulation modeling. The simulation result matches the theoretical analysis and actual engineering parameters, which verifies the validity of the model. Moreover, the analysis result indicates that it is feasible to study the traction transformer inrush currents influence on power quality of power grid common connection points using voltage fluctuation and voltage dip as measurement parameters.

articleTitle: A Three-stage Contingency Screening and Ranking Method for Voltage Stability Assessment of Large-Scale Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A three-stage progressive contingency screening and ranking method (CS&R) is proposed in order to improve the efficiency of voltage stability assessment (VSA) for large-scale power systems. In stage 1, a new index is established to select the key contingencies rapidly from an initial list of contingencies. In stage 2, the critical contingencies are identified from the obtained key contingency set by combining sensitivity-based load margin estimation method with the minimum singular value method. In stage 3, the critical contingencies are ranked according to their load margins obtained by using curve fitting method. Besides, the unstable contingencies are identified and ranked with contingency parameterization continuation power flow (CP-CPF) tool. Finally, performance of the proposed method is demonstrated on two practical power systems.

articleTitle: A New Method for Fast Location of Cable Faults Based on Mobile Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Cable fault location is an important part of cable repair, and its speed and accuracy directly affect the time limitation. In order to improve the positioning speed and precision of cable fault, a mobile terminal based on mobile interconnection technology is developed. The mobile terminal can directly view the cable path and no longer need to print paper drawings, when the bridge method is applied, the automatic reduction and actual fault location of the cable equivalent length can be quickly carried out in the mobile terminal. Finally, the fault distance obtained from the bridge method and the traveling wave method is directly located in the cable path of the mobile terminal, and the location of cable path and fault point can be quickly and precisely located.

articleTitle: Load Flow under Power Converter Control Studies in MVDC Shipboard Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Future electric shipboard power systems with the requirements of high quality, reliability and survivability are intended to be implemented by the adoption of Medium Voltage DC (MVDC) architecture. As different types of power converters and AC/DC power distribution involved in the same system, the performance of the MVDC system under various steady-state operating conditions needs to be well-evaluated so as to take the appropriate operations whenever necessary. This requires the power flow solution of the system to be precise and efficient. In this paper, the models of the power converters including rectifier, buck converter and inverter are studied, and a Newton-Raphson based AC/DC load flow method is presented to analyze the performance of the MVDC shipboard power system under power converter control. Different from the existing work which most of them mainly focus on AC-DC conversion, we principally emphasis on analyzing the impact of DC-DC converters on the system.

articleTitle: Collaborative Optimization of Distributed Energy Network Considering Billing Distribution
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To deal with the limitation of single integrated energy system (IES) in the complementarity of both energy supply and demand, integrated energy network, which consists of multiples IESs, has received increasing attention. In this paper, a collaborative optimization model of network is formulated to schedule the energy management considering the interchange of electricity and heat among IESs. Furthermore, a billing distribution mechanism is proposed to allocate the overall cost of network to each IES in order to guarantee the stability of energy network. Simulation results show that the proposed approach can reduce the daily cost of each IES.

articleTitle: Partitioned Day-Ahead Economic Scheduling of Large-Scale Farm Park Considering Demand Side Response
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: From the perspective of demand side response of farm load, we mainly focus on the day-ahead economic dispatching of large scale farm parks. To begin with, large-scale farm parks are divided into farming areas and living areas according to their load type, the power-adjustable load model of the farming areas and the time-shiftable load model of the living areas are established respectively. Futhermore, the different characteristics of demand side response of the two types of loads are discussed in the sub-scenario, it is found that the two types of loads all participate in the demand side response is economically optimal. Meanwhile, The above analysis conclusions are verified by numerical simulation. These conclusions can provide reference for the economic optimization scheduling and operation of large-scale farm parks with demand side response.

articleTitle: Industrial Park Energy Trading and Management Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Studying energy trading and management under the background of energy internet is of great significance to all parties involved in the market. First of all, this paper expounds the framework of the industrial park's energy internet, and introduces the electricity consumption and electricity sales plan of the large users and grids under the energy internet. Secondly, the power trading model of power grid and large users is proposed. Based on game theory, a repeated game model between power grid and large users is proposed, which is combined with effective set algorithm and particle swarm optimization algorithm. Finally, through the analysis of the example, the big user purchase strategy and grid revenue under the background of energy internet are simulated. According to the analysis of the results of the example, the relevant conclusions are drawn at the end.

articleTitle: An Improved Frequency Modulation Method for Fault Ride Through of MMC-HVDC Systems Connected DFIG Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the transient characteristics and Fault Ride Through (FRT) capabilities of MMC-HVDC systems connected DFIG wind farms, their dynamic behaviors during the FRT are analyzed in detail. An improved frequency modulation method is proposed to suppress the oscillation of the DC voltage of the MMC-HVDC system caused by DFIG stator current's DC component. An auxiliary power reduction control strategy is designed for wind farms to increase the FRT performance of the whole system. Simulation results show that the proposed schemes can significantly suppress the oscillations of the DC voltage of the MMC-HVDC and improve the FRT capability of the system.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic-load model based-on load and power supply correlation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation has become a nonnegligible part of hybrid power generation in regions with sufficient solar energy or countries. Aiming at the correlation of light intensity and load fluctuations, this paper proposes a new photovoltaic-load model method for building correlations. The non-parametric kernel density estimation method was used to analyze the probability distribution of light intensity and node load, and the corresponding bandwidth was obtained. The correlation between light intensity and node load was analyzed by using Kendall rank correlation coefficient. The load nodes were divided into strong light intensity related nodes and illumination. There are two types of weakly correlated nodes; for the node with strong light intensity, the Copula function is used to establish the photovoltaic-load correlation model. For the weakly correlated nodes of light intensity, the Latin hypercube sampling method was used to establish the load fluctuation model. Finally, the 220kV system in B city is taken as an example to verify the practicability and effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Testing Platform for Fault Diagnosis and Location Algorithm in the Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To test fault diagnosis algorithms in the active distribution network, this paper proposes a simulation testing platform based on phasor measurement units (PMUs). The platform is built in the MATLAB/Simulink software, which implements an open data source in COMTRADE format. The PMU model suitable for power distribution grid is constructed via different algorithms, which provides the voltage/current phasors of the recording waveform. The platform offers both Stateflow and MATLAB Function for diagnosis algorithm development to reduce the time of modeling. The efficiency of the platform is improved by using S-function and C-code generation. We convert the fault diagnosis algorithms module into a dynamic-link library (DLL) to enhance the portability of the algorithm. The platform provides an efficient way to test and verify new algorithms for fault diagnosis and location in the distribution power grid.

articleTitle: Improved Model of CHP System Considering Heat Exchanger Capacity
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Combined heat and power (CHP) system, with the feature of cascade utilization of fuel energy, has been promoted over the world. The coupling characteristic in heat and power output makes the control of CHP complex. Thus, it is necessary to model the CHP properly to realize accurate control. In this contribution, the heat exchange theory is applied into the modelling of waste heat boiler. Base on the waste heat boiler model, a CHP model considering heat exchanger capacity is proposed. In order to enhance the solvability of the model, a simplification is made to convert the non-convex constraint into the convex constraint. Finally, a case is carried out to study the impact of different heat exchanger capacities on the heat exchange effect. The feasible region and cost function of the improved model are compared with those of the conventional model. Moreover, the validity of the simplified model is verified.
