articleTitle: A fast calculation for the surface electric field distribution and onset corona voltage of HVDC transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Understanding and improving the electromagnetic environment of HVDC transmission lines is a basic work for the surface of the electric field distribution and the study of corona initial voltage. It is useful for the design and operation of actual circuit. As a new favorite in the field of power transmission, the shaped line will play an important role in the future line construction. An accurate calculation method for the field intensity distribution on the surface of the shaped wire and round stranded wire was put forward in this paper. This method can obtain the direction of the maximum surface field strength, and apply the corresponding onset corona criterion, the onset corona voltages of the shaped wire are quickly calculated. At the same time, the method is applicable to the calculation of field strength and corona of traditional round stranded wire.

articleTitle: Operational Risk Evaluation Model of Simplified Distance Protection
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to ensure the safety of DC operation in UHV AC/DC hybrid receiving end power grid, a simplified setting method of distance protection is proposed in this paper, which gives priority to ensuring the rapidity and sensitivity of distance protection to remove faults. However, it may cause the loss of selectivity of distance protection and lead to the overstep tripping of AC power grid. To solve this problem, a risk assessment model and a risk grading system for simplified distance protection method are proposed. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation analysis of a practical example of Shandong power grid.

articleTitle: Fast DC Bias Calculation for UHV Transformer on Load
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale construction of UHVDC power grid in China, the importance of UHV transformer in power system is increasing. High voltage direct current (HVDC) and geomagnetic storms cause DC bias of transformer, thus affecting the reliability of power supply. Aiming at the low efficiency of DC bias calculation for UHV transformer, starting from the characteristics of the field-circuit coupled principle, the two-dimensional simulation model of UHV transformer is established to improve the solving speed of magnetic field, and the correctness of the model is verified. Based on the two-dimensional magnetic field model, the computational workload of the circuit model is further reduced by applying a variable step strategy. The results show that the calculation method can complete the DC bias calculation of UHV transformer on load in a short time, and the calculation accuracy can be guaranteed, so as to predict the safe and stable operation of power system.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Noise Filtering for DFT-Based Synchrophasor Measurement in Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To improve the operation security and stability of power systems, the distribution-level synchrophasor measurement techniques have been developed rapidly. However, the signals in distribution systems are heavily corrupted by noise which will deteriorate synchrophasor measurement accuracy. This paper preliminarily investigates the noise in distribution systems according to the field measurement results. Then the two-stage noise filtering method is proposed based on the median filter and mean filter. According to the additive problem caused by median filter, the corresponding compensation coefficients are derived. Finally, numerical tests verify the effectiveness of the proposed filtering and compensation method under different conditions.

articleTitle: A Novel Sequence-phase Coupled Model for Active Distribution Network based on Modelica
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The analysis of active distribution networks is the basis of Energy Internet control and management. As the penetration of distributed renewable energy into distribution networks has increased, traditional applications, such as OpenDSS, are not suitable for analyzing networks that contain distributed generators (DGs). For distribution network calculation, three-phase DGs are often modeled in sequence frame, while the three-phase unbalanced distribution networks are usually modeled in phase frames. Hence, this paper represents a novel model that could deal with both frames by load flows in a sequence-phase coupled frame. The steady state analysis model presented in this paper is implemented using an open source language called Modelica. Tests on the IEEE testing systems are carried out and the results demonstrate the advantage of the model.

articleTitle: Typical Scenario Reactive Power Optimization of Active Distribution Network Based on Limit Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the power output of new energy farm in active distribution network is highly uncertain, the forecast error may lead to the insufficient reactive power capacity of the power grid when scheduling mechanism formulates the scheduling strategy according to the predctive power of new energy farm. The limit theory is introduced to establish the relationship between the active output power and the reactive power range of new energy farm. The power output of new energy is divide into different typical scenario based on the K_means clustering method, and the probability of each scenario is determined according to the historical data. The adjustable capacity range of new energy reactive power under each scenario is determined based on the limit theory. A typical reactive power optimization model, which considers the uncertainty, is established. The simulation result obtained by a actual 48 nodes network show that the proposed method can more accurately determine the reactive power range, and it can reduce the power loss of network and make the voltage level reasonable when regarding the new energy farm as a reactive power source.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Influence of HVDC Commutation Failure on Current Differential Protection
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The commutation failure is one of the most common faults in HVDC transmission systems. After the commutation failure, the distortion of the fault characteristics has an impact on the current differential protection, which may cause the braking amount in the fault zone to be greater than the action amount, causing the protection rejection. In this paper, a HVDC transmission model is built based on PSCAD/EMTDC as a simulation tool. Simulation verification shows that when high-resistance grounding occurs in the transmission line near the DC inverter station, commutation failure of the inverter side may cause current differential protection rejection. High resistance grounding occurs in the remote area of the inverter station. The DC does not commutation failure. The current differential protection can operate correctly.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicles and their Impacts on Integration into Power Grid: A Review
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The exponential rise in electricity demand has become the primary reason of generating electricity from various new sources. Up until now, fossil fuels were the major source for generating power but it has changed drastically in recent years. Vehicles commonly used in today's world run solely on fossil fuels (i.e. gasoline, diesel, liquefied petroleum etc.) and their prodigious usage hints at the current over reliance on them. Fossil fuels are non-renewable and consequently, the existing transportability prototype is rendered untenable. Effects of energy shortage, meteoric decline in fossil fuel reserves along with environmental issues have diverted attention towards Electric vehicles. Electric vehicle is now the center of the attention and is termed as the future of transportability model. Use of Electric vehicle gives multiple advantages that include more use of renewable energy, less use of non-renewable energy sources, clean environment and energy storage options. Electric vehicles are capable of serving a dual purpose in terms of distributed storage units and loads both upon their integration with the power grid. Increased use of EVs, despite solving several problems has brought with it some new problems for power system and the grid. In this paper a brief review of Electric vehicles and their effects on power quality and power grid has been presented. In addition to this, a detailed review of impacts of EVs charging and discharging to grid is presented too.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Power Forecasting: Models and Methods
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integration of PV power brings many economic and environmental benefits. However, high penetration of PV power brings many challenges for power system operations and planning, mainly due to its uncertain and intermittent characteristics. The output power of PV system is subjected to ramping, since its dependence on solar irradiance and other meteorological factors changes frequently. One of the possible solutions to balance these challenges is power output forecasting. This paper presents a comprehensive and systematic overview of existing research works on PV power forecasting. Major factors that influence the output of PV power generation and PV power forecasting are discussed. The research progress of statistical methods for photovoltaic power forecasting in recent years is also investigated. In addition, model selection strategy and assessment indicators are analyzed. The effect of model input, the potential benefits of hybrid methods, and the effect of parameter selection in PV power forecasting are further explored.

articleTitle: Predicting Switch ON/OFF Statuses in Real Time Electromagnetic Transients Simulations with Voltage Source Converters
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power converters in system-level real-time simulations are usually emulated by using an L/C associated discrete circuit (L/C-ADC)in a fixed time-step simulation. However, there are several potential inaccuracies in L/C-ADC based simulation results: unrealistically high virtual loss especially at high PWM frequencies, fictitious current oscillations between the Land C represented devices, and limitations in the impedance ratio between OFF and ON switch representations. Therefore, there are potential benefits from using switched-resistance representations of electronic switch devices. Fortunately, such simulation has recently become feasible due to the higher performance of newer computer processor cores. However, the switched-resistance representation of switches requires reliable prediction of the ON/OFF statuses of the switch devices before each simulation time-step. This paper describes a method for highly reliable prediction of ON/OFF switch statuses for voltage source converters with switched-resistance switch representations in fixed time-step simulation. Real-time simulation results are presented for systems containing 2-level and 3-level voltage source converters. The technique could be practised in non-real-time simulation for much more complicated converters.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Prediction of Power Systems Based on Deep Belief Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposed a transient stability prediction method based on deep belief networks. Synchronously sampled values provided by phasor measurement units (PMUs) of the generator rotor angles collected immediately after clearing a fault are utilized as the original data. A novel data pre-processing method are used to obtain the statistical features called trajectory cluster features as inputs to a deep belief networks. The number of the input features is independent from the scale of power systems. Studies on the New England 10-machine 39-bus system indicated that more accurate and more robust predictions could be made through the proposed method. The accuracy and robustness of the method was extensively tested under different load levels, network topology and incomplete measurements, which indicated that the proposed method was effective.

articleTitle: An Overview of Virtual Power Plant Development from the Perspective of Market Participation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an energy management mode for aggregating and unified control for multiple distributed energy resources and demands, the concept of Virtual Power Plant (VPP) emphasizes more on their external characteristics which is evidenced by the fact that many of the existing studies about VPP are related to market participation. Therefore, this article will focus on summarizing VPP participation in various types of power market. In terms of market in different time-scale, this paper compares the characteristics and demands from the Medium Term Market (MTM) to the Real Time Market (RTM). Moreover, different target of VPP in the Energy Market (EM) and Ancillary Service Market (ASM) are also displayed. Furthermore, three types of combined market are carefully analyzed, in which the market mechanism, target of VPP and general optimization model are introduced. Finally, a novel VPP concept, Multi-energy Virtual Power Plant (MVPP) is introduced which is arising with the emergence of integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Optimized Operation of Multiple Energy Interconnection Network Based on Energy Utilization Rate and Global Energy Consumption Ratio
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of the energy internet, the types and forms of energy utilization are becoming increasingly diverse. In this paper, the concept of multi-energy system is redefined. Based on this, the multi-input and multi-output model of the system is established. At the same time, a general evaluation system suitable for multi-energy is also given. The energy utilization level of the system is evaluated by the energy efficiency and the global energy consumption ratio. Finally, taking the energy utilization of a college campus as an example, the energy allocation of the system is optimized to obtain the optimal energy ratio. It aims to provide advice for the planning and design of energy transportation and provide a reference for mitigating the energy crisis.

articleTitle: Short-term load forecasting of power system based on similar day method and PSO-DBN
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Short-term load forecasting is an important part of the energy management system (EMS) and the basis for the safe operation of the power system. In view of the problems of high dimensionality, long time and general precision in load forecasting of existing artificial intelligence algorithms, this paper proposes a short-term load forecasting method based on particle swarm optimization and deep belief network (PSO-DBN). The characteristics of this method are: (1) Calculate the similarity according to the date distance, the type of the week and the meteorological characteristics, and select the similar day according to the similarity; (2) Replace the traditional historical daily load with the similar daily load as the partial input of the algorithm. Improve the prediction accuracy; (3) Construct the DBN prediction model to overcome the problem that the support vector Machines (SVM)training time is long and the BP neural network method is easy to fall into the local optimum; (4) Optimize the weight by usingPSO to optimize the DBN algorithm. Further reduce the degree to which the algorithm is affected by the initial value and reduce the number of iterations. The simulation example demonstrates the effectiveness and good engineering application value of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Placement and Configuration of Hybrid Energy Storage System in Power Distribution Networks with Distributed Photovoltaic Sources
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper exploits the optimal allocation and configuration of hybrid energy storage devices consisting of battery and supercapacitor in power distribution networks with distributed renewable generators. The multi-objective optimization model is firstly formulated to determine the placement of the storage devices with the aim to minimize the bus voltage fluctuation and the required energy storage capacity whilst meeting the operational constraints. The multi-objective optimization is transformed into single objective optimization through using the target value normalization, linear weighted aggregation and analytic hierarchy process (AHP), and addressed using linear weighted particle swarm optimization (PSO). Further., the optimal capacity configuration problem is studied to minimize the annual cost and meet the constraints., e.g., instantaneous power balance., energy spillover ratio. The optimal capacity configuration is determined through the simulated annealing particle swarm optimization (SAPSO). Finally., the proposed optimal placement of capacity configuration solution is evaluated through case studies using the IEEE 14-bus test distribution feeder and the numerical result clearly confirms its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration Planning of Electricity-Heat Synthesis System Considering Heat Storage in Buildings
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: How to configurate the integrated energy systems is the essential issue for urban policy makers and energy planners. It's crucial to investigate the optimal planning approach to configurate appropriate energy supply units and energy storage devices. Presents methods emphasize various conventional & renewable energy sources and mature energy storage technologies such as a battery, molten salt heat storage, compressed air energy storage and so on. The heat storage capacity of the heat transfer networks and buildings are usually ignored during the planning stage. Based on traditional mathematical optimization methods, an innovative optimal configuration planning methods are introduced with consideration of the heat storage capacity of the buildings in the heating area. The principle of the planning method is decreases the total energy supply costs and reducing the renewable energy curtailment. The overall life-cycle cost is employed to evaluate the economic benefit of the integrated energy system, while the renewable power consumed in the integrated system is applied to reflect renewable energy curtailment reduction. Firstly, the heat-electricity synthesis system and energy storage system in a broad sense is introduced. Then, using the Genetic Algorithm to handle the mathematical optimization problems, the optimization models are analyzed in detail. Finally, a case in Beijing is studied with the proposed optimal configuration method. It concludes that as an optimal configuration planning method with consideration of heat storage in buildings, the proposed method shows outstanding advantages in renewable energy curtailment reduction.

articleTitle: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Intelligent Patrol-Inspection System Applied to Transmission Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Ensuring stable and reliable operation of Ultra-High-Voltage transmission lines is an important issue in the construction of energy Internet. Based on extensive investigation and development of key technologies in lab, this paper proposes an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Intelligent Patrol-Inspection (UAV-PIS) system applied to transmission grid, focusing on the integrated application of UAV intelligent line inspection technology. The construction elements and operation mechanism of UAV-PIS as well as the data flow diagram is pointed out, and the feasibility of three key technologies is well discussed.

articleTitle: A Tight MISOCP Formulation for the Integrated Electric-Gas System Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: with in the energy sector, the increased share of natural gas power plants has intensified the interaction between the electric network and the natural gas (NG) network. This paper proposes a day-ahead economic dispatch model for integrated electric-gas system (IEGS) considering the dynamic state of NG network. Weymouth gas flow equations are convexified by their second-order cone (SOC) relaxation forms. Therefore, the proposed model is converted into a mixed integer second-order cone programming (MISOCP). Then the multi-slack-node NG flow method with the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm is designed to provide a tight relaxation and find exact NG schedules. The proposed model is compared with mixed integer linear programming (MILP) model based on a piecewise linear approximation method with optimal breakpoints. Numerical cases demonstrate the superiority of the proposed IEGS model over the MILP-based one.

articleTitle: A Sequential Coordinated Attack Model for Cyber-Physical System Considering Cascading Failure and Load Redistribution
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the massive deployment of cyber technologies in smart grid, the power system becomes more vulnerable to malicious cyber-physical attacks. Therefore, it is of great significance to analyze the reliability risk of cyber-physical system under malicious attack. This paper proposes a sequential coordinated attack framework for the cyber-physical system. It comprises the physical attack on the lines and cyber-attack by load redistribution (LR). More specifically, the cascading failure is also incorporated in the physical attack model and a new LR attack is proposed to cooperate with the physical attack in this paper. Then a Q-learning based solution algorithm is proposed to identify the optimal coordinated attack scheme. Finally, case studies on IEEE-39 bus system demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm and compare the effects of coordinated attack and cascading attack.

articleTitle: An Optimization Model for Capacity Planning and Ordered Discharging of Centralized Charging Stations
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a new optimization model is proposed for capacity planning and ordered discharging strategies of centralized charging stations. The proposed method is divided into two stages: firstly, the operating states of the battery pack are analyzed at each moment by combining with the distribution modes, then the first stage planning can be processed, where the model aiming at minimizing the construction cost of centralized charging stations can be solved by simulated annealing particle swarm optimization (SAPSO); Next, in order to maximize the peaking effect of the centralized charging station, the cost function aiming at minimizing load variance is proposed, and the discharge power of each time can be obtained by using yalmip. Finally, simulation results are presented to verify the usefulness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Lean Management of Line Loss in Municipal Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the level of line loss management and realize the importance of lean management of municipal power grid enterprises, the method of lean line loss management is proposed, which aims at the current situation of the comprehensive evaluation of line loss management in the municipal power grid enterprises. Constructing multi evaluation sequence information matrix, we optimize the singular value of the network to solve the inconsistent problem of the current line loss management evaluation conclusion and accurately measure the level of municipal power grid. To address the problem of line loss management, we find out the weakness of it, and guide the management construction through analysis. Finally, we evaluate the line loss management level of 61 enterprises of municipal power grid, and illustrate that the proposed method can effectively guide line loss management and achieve lean management of line loss.

articleTitle: Microgrid Power Optimal Control with Markov Decision Process by Using the Specific Policy of Wavelet Packet-Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to formulate an brand new optimization model, and determine comprehensive optimal operating strategies for microgrid in order to significantly reduce the unbalanced power. This paper presents a microgrid power optimal dispatch control scheme by using markov decision process (MDP). To decrease the exchange power of PCC and smooth the fluctuation, the reward function of MDP is established based on improved entropy. The decision process gets the optimal policy and optimal entropy value through policy iteration. To reduce the policy set, a specific stable policy of wavelet packet-probability fuzzy control has been proposed, which is used as the mapping from state set of state of charge (SOC) of energy storage to action set of charge/discharge power of hybrid energy storage. Case study is tested and the results show that the unbalanced power can be significantly reduced and the fluctuation can be decreased by using the proposed optimal model and specific stable policy.

articleTitle: A Distributed Economic Dispatch Strategy for Combined heat and power generation System using Consensus Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the defects and flexibility of traditional centralized optimization methods, this paper adopts a method in a distributed manner to deal with the economic dispatch problem (EDP) of a cogeneration system. Heat price and electricity price of every unit are taken as the consistency variables, a consensus-based algorithm of electricity price and heat price is employed to solve the problem of traditional centralized economic dispatch in the form of a distributed way. Relative simulation results of several examples are given. The validity of the consensus algorithm in a distributed mode applied to solve the EDP in a combined heat and power (CHP) generation system can be demonstrated by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Screening of Zero-Value Insulators Infrared Thermal Image Features Based on Binary Logistic Regression Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The zero-value insulator is one of the important reasons causing line failures. The key part of detecting zero-value insulators by infrared thermal imaging is to pick up the sensitive infrared thermal image character parameters. A method based on binary logistic regression analysis is proposed to screen the infrared thermal image characteristics of zero-value insulators in the paper. First of all, the infrared thermal image was denoised with the combination of wavelet transform and mean filtering method, and the contrast of the image was enhanced by histogram equalization method. Then the image was segmented to binary image by maximum variance method. After the minimum enclosing rectangle around the disc surface of insulator string was intercepted automatically, 13 texture features of rectangle area were extracted. Finally, 14 characteristic parameters consisting of pollution class and texture features were screened by binary logistic regression analysis and 7 parameters among them having significant influence on the classification result was gotten. The experiment shows that the proposed selection method is simple, and can effectively screen characteristic parameters.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Benefit Analysis for Integrated Energy Systems Projects Based on AHP-fuzzy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Significant changes have been occurred to the energy supply and consumption mode of China. Nowadays, establishing integrated energy system has become the key method to build modern energy system with the characteristics of clean, low-carbon, safe and high efficiency. The research subject of this paper is to achieve the optimization and comparison of Integrated Energy Systems projects. The basic structure of Integrated Energy Systems was presented in the first place. Second, the comprehensive benefit evaluation indexes system was designed according to basic characteristics of Integrated Energy Systems projects. A comprehensive benefit evaluation model based on AHP-fuzzy theory was built and put into case study in the end. More importantly, the comprehensive benefit of different Integrated Energy Systems projects can be obtained to provide decision basis and reference to project optimization and selection.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment of Offshore Wind Farms Considering Severe Weather Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Growing energy demand promotes the development of wind power. The number of wind farms being built is increasing dramatically around the world. Compared with onshore wind farms, the maintenance of offshore wind farms (OWF) is more difficult due to the potential adverse operation conditions. Therefore, the reliable operation of OWF are major concerns for utilities. In traditional reliability assessment methods, wind turbine failure and repair process are considered under normal conditions, which can't evaluate the reliability level of OWF accurately and comprehensively. In this paper, a time-varying reliability parameter model of OWF components affected by weather intensity is established. Further, a reliability assessment model based on Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) method for OWF is proposed. The proposed model is able to fully consider the influence of severe weather and simulate weather intensity, component failure and repair process simultaneously, which makes the obtained reliability evaluation results strongly associated with actual operation conditions and more accurate. The case study verifies the effectiveness and performance of the proposed model.

articleTitle: An Analysis and Calculation on the Problems of CVT Caused by Capacitor Element Breakdown
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the equipment problems of capacitor voltage transformer (CVT) caused by capacitor element breakdown and the analyzed situation towards these equipments, this research made tests on the CVT and calculated the tested data, capacitor element numbers, and capacitance theoretically, and finally put up with the fluctuation value range for detecting the secondary voltage of CVT and the strategies for operation and maintenance, which will improve the problem-finding probability of CVT by detecting secondary voltage.

articleTitle: Power Big Data Apriori Parallel Algorithm Based on Posterior Double Threshold
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low computational efficiency of traditional power data, this paper proposes a posteriori double-threshold power big data Apriori parallel computing method based on Boolean matrix. The Boolean matrix is used to compress and store data, and the removal rate is introduced to pruning the data. The double-threshold parallel computing method is used, and then the lifting degree is used to verify it. The Boolean matrix-based posterior dual-threshold power big data Apriori parallel computing method is used to solve the problem of low efficiency of traditional power big data calculation. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm can effectively improve the computational power and computational efficiency of power big data.

articleTitle: Two-stage coordinated scheduling strategy of a distribution network considering energy storages
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, considering the forecast error of wind power, a two-stage coordinated scheduling strategy considering energy storages is proposed. In the first stage, according to the day-ahead forecast information of wind power, the day-ahead dispatch model is established based on the wind power scenarios, in which the aim is to minimize the expected daily operational cost of the distribution network. In the second stage, based on the latest short-term forecast information of wind power, the energy storage participates in the intra-day scheduling to minimize the power deviation. The simulation results show that through the two-stage coordinated scheduling strategy, the energy storage can not only reduce the operational cost of the distribution network, but also smooth the power fluctuations and improve the flexibility of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Application of Modified BFA for Fault Location in Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a new bionic swarm intelligence optimization algorithm, bacterial foraging algorithm (BFA) has been successfully applied to many engineering problems. We proposed an application of modified bacterial foraging algorithm (MBFA) for fault location in distribution networks. Using the optimization mechanism of the algorithm, a mathematical model of fault location is constructed, and solved the fault section. Simulation examples show that this method can be reliable positioning when whether single-point of failure occur or multiple points of failure occur, and when the information is distorted this algorithm also has a good fault tolerance. The MBFA is compared with the traditional BFA. The proposed algorithm is superior to the traditional BFA in terms of convergence, accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Parameter Coordination of Fault Isolation Unit in DC Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The high voltage DC circuit breaker (DCCB) is the key to the development of DC distribution network, but the interrupting capacity and reliability of DCCB need to be improved. A type of fault isolation unit for DC system is proposed in this paper, consisted of smoothing reactor, resistive superconducting fault current limiter (R-SFCL) and hybrid DC circuit breaker. This combination could reduce the level of the demand of operation time and interrupting capacity of DCCB, so as to improve the ability to isolate short-circuit faults effectively. The topology and interrupting process of DCCB are analyzed in this paper. On this basis, the influence on commutation process and the stresses of the whole machine, which is caused by the parameter selection of DCCB snubber branch, is studied. A simulation model composed of the devices mentioned above in PSCAD/EMTDC was built to analyse the millisecond-level interrupting process and the microsecond-level current commutation process. The rationality of the parameter selection method of the DCCB snubber branch and the necessity of installing the R-SFCL in the DC power distribution network are verified, which provides a theoretical basis for the coordinated application of hybrid DC circuit breaker and resistive superconducting DC current limiter.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis and Control of Two-Stage Three-Phase Photovoltaic Grid-Connected System with Phase-Locked Loop
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a small-signal model of two-stage three-phase photovoltaic grid-connected system including phase-locked loop (PLL). Using the eigenvalue analysis, the dominant oscillation mode of the system under weak grid conditions is determined and the results show that MPPT control parameters have relatively little impact on system stability. Based on the interaction between PLL and inner current loop, an additional control method is proposed to suppress the dominant oscillation mode. It is further proved by eigenvalue analysis and time domain simulation that the proposed method is correct. Then the lower limit values of the additional control coefficient under different PLL gains are given.

articleTitle: Mutation Assessment Model for the Potential of Clean Energy Development
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Assessment model for the potential of clean energy development should be proposed because which is important for more efficient clean energy development. Introduce the mutation theory into the assessment of the development potential of clean energy and establish a model for the evaluation of the development potential of clean energy. Through the example analysis, the validity of the established evaluation index of the potential of clean energy development is verified, and the validity of the model of mutation evaluation of the potential of clean energy development is verified.

articleTitle: Agent-based Integrated Resource Strategic Planning Model
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: IRSP (Integrated Resource Strategic Planning) is based on the national electricity development strategy. It unifies the supply-side resources and demand side resources for optimization across the country. However, as the power system embraces an increasing number of participating entities and transaction methods, system operations are likely to face more and more complicated situations. Traditional IRSP can no longer meet the system operation requirements considering the reliability and load characteristics. A bi-Ievel coordination optimization integrated resource strategy planning model was established to meet the requirements of reliability and mid-long term planning, among which the efficiency power plant production simulation was incorporated into the integrated resource strategy planning. Finally, further studies the development status of conventional power sources and energy efficiency power plant promotion situations in China during 2018-2035 was studied.

articleTitle: Supplementary Frequency Regulation Strategy Considering Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As more and more renewable energy is connected to the grid, the volatility and intermittent nature of the output make the frequency control of the power system more complicated. Due to the low climbing rate and slow response speed, the traditional generator set cannot vanish the influence of renewable energy on the system frequency in time. In this work, we propose that based on fast response characteristic, electric vehicles response to the high frequency components of the regulation signal, and distribute the signal to every vehicle according to battery state of charge. The simulation result shows that the method could effectively restrain the frequency deviation of system.

articleTitle: Study on Decomposition Gas Explosion of Transformer Oil Under Arc
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The transformer may generate arcs under abnormal conditions. Some explosive gases, such as hydrogen, ethylene may be generated when decomposition reactions occurred. Those gases will explode when they touch an ignition source. This workfocus on the explosive pressure generated by these explosive gases under different conditions is by calculation method. The data analysis revealed the explosion overpressure rules when the gases exploding in the transformer room. This work can be reference for the research and analysis of gas explosion occurs in whole household substation.

articleTitle: Condition Monitoring of On-Load Tap-Changers in Converter Transformers Based on Vibration Method
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The proper operation of On-Load Tap-Changer (OLTC) in converter transformer is essential for the safety and stability of HVDC system. Since a well-defined series of vibration signals are produced as its signature, it's extremely desirable to indicate the inner connections and differences among these signals of each condition. The mechanical vibration theories of OLTC are analyzed first. Based on an improved EMD method aimed at reducing aliasing effect in the analysis of nonstationary and nonlinear signals, the frequency of OLTC vibration would be effectively extracted. Meanwhile, some common faults such as contact looseness have been set and the characteristics of each condition are clearly identified both in time and frequency domain. The results can distinguish the fault pattern from the normal one effectively and efficiently, which is also applied in the real OLTC in converter transformer. It will provide theoretical basis and practical guidance for condition monitoring and fault diagnosis of OLTC.

articleTitle: A Control Strategy of the Isolated Power Supply System Based on VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The interregional power supply is one of the important applications of VSC-HVDC (voltage source converter based high voltage direct current) technology. But if some faults occur on the weak AC connection lines near the VSC-HVDC convertor stations, it may cause isolated operation of the nearby power system with the VSC-HVDC system, which will threaten the safe and stable operation of the power system, and even cause DC block. To improve the operation stability of the isolated system, a control strategy combined the preventive control and emergency control for the isolated power supply system based on VSC-HVDC is proposed, after analyzing the ride-through and the recovery characteristics of the VSC-HVDC system. In this method, the control ability of the VSC-HVDC and the generators in the isolated power grid are fully considered. And at last, the effectiveness of the method is verified by an actual power grid simulation.

Author Keywords: Combination of preventive control and emergency control

articleTitle: Demand Response of Electric Vehicles for Building Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Building integrated energy system (BIES) is the terminal node of the regional integrated energy system (IES), which is coupled with a variety of energy networks such as electricity, gas, heat and transportation, and it can use energy resources more efficiently. Based on the controllable load characteristics of electric vehicles (EVs), a demand response (DR) model of EVs for BIES is investigated in this paper. By establishing the model of BIES with EV access and the pricing mechanism of energy operator in building, a DR model for the operation of BIES with EVs is proposed. Taking a typical day in winter as an example, the simulation and verification of the proposed DR model are carried out. The simulation results show that BIES promotes the efficient conversion and utilization of energy at the end-user level and improves the system's acceptability for the charging loads of EVs. The DR of EVs can increase the space and flexibility of the coordinated operation of the heat and electricity in IES, improve the utilization of photovoltaic, reduce the user-side heat, electricity load energy costs and the charging cost of the owners significantly, and it also has the peak shaving effect to the system during peak hours.

articleTitle: Graph Database and Graph Computing for Cyber-Physical Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Cyber-physical Power System (CPPS) presents a typical coupling graph structure composed of nodes and lines/links on both physical side and cyber side. With the rapid development of smart grids and coupling between cyber networks and physical networks, the CPPS network becomes larger and more complex. Since the natural graphic features of CPPS networks and its analysis methods are mostly inseparable from the graph theory, the application of graph computing systems and graph database will greatly help the analysis of CPPS problems. First, the representative graph computing systems are briefly introduced in this paper. And then, considering two-layer coupling structure of CPPS, the architecture consisting of the graph database and the graph computing system for CPPS is proposed.

articleTitle: Progress Evaluation of Power Grid Projects Based on Investment, Construction, and Costs Accounting Progress
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the power grid construction project was taken as the research object, and the matching between the project investment progress, construction progress, and cost accounting progress was analyzed. The main reasons for the mismatch between the three progresses were summarized in the aspects of external environment, planning, project construction, and costs accounting management. On this basis, a project whole progress evaluation model based on the matching degree of investment, construction, and costs accounting progresses was constructed, and the overall implementation progresses of some typical power grid construction projects were evaluated. The research results laid a solid foundation for strengthening the monitoring capabilities of the whole process management of power grid construction projects.

articleTitle: Island Partition of Distribution Network with Distributed Generations Based on Matrix Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To improve the distribution network reliability with distributed generation (DG) under fault conditions, Islanding operation has become an important operation mode. This paper proposes a matrix algorithm for island partition of distribution network. Aiming at characteristics of distribution network and demand of island partition, this paper presents two objective functions which are the average number of layer and the average number of degree. This paper expounds in detail determination methods of node and branch priority level. Base on all above, the matrix algorithm can take tie switch, load importance, load controllability, node layer, node degree and load capacity into account. Finally the analysis case shows that the proposed method can effectively solve the issue of power island partition of distribution network and has practical value.

articleTitle: Dispatch of Electric Vehicles to Participate in New Energy Consumption Strategies
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Load dispatch of electric vehicle (EV) is considered as a promising approach to promote the integration of new energy. In order to accommodate more new energy by dispatching dispatch of electric vehicles to participate in new engrgy especially in wind power consumption strategies. Firstly, according to the scheduling ability, the load of EV is divided into three categories: disordered charging load, adjustable charging load and adjustable charging/discharging load. The vehicle driving behavior model is used to simulate the travel rule of EV. Secondly, the model of the EV condition matrix and the EV's controllable charging and discharging capacity could be set up. Charging and discharging load of the EV is used as the variable in the unit commitment. Finally, a unit commitment model is proposed for optimal coordination of wind power generation and charging load of EV. Cases studies show that with the proposed unit commitment model the wind curtailment could be decreased as well as the cost of Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G).

articleTitle: Pressure Simulation and Experimental Study of Basin Insulator Considering Sealing Ring
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to investigate the influence of the size of the sealing groove on the hydraulic strength of the basin insulator, the water pressure simulation model of the basin insulator considering the sealing ring was established and tested. The uniaxial tests, biaxial tests and shear tests were carried out on the rubber material of the sealing ring, and the parameters of Mooney-Rivilin model, Neo-Hookean model, Yeoh model and Ogden model were fitted to the experimental data, which showed that Ogden model had a good fitting result. The whole simulation process was divided into assembling process simulation and pressure simulation, which solved the initial model interference problem. The influence of groove width on the hydraulic strength of the basin insulator was studied by simulation, the results showed that the hydraulic strength of the basin insulator was about 3.0MPa under the condition of 7.3mm groove width, and the maximum stress occurred at the groove bottom of the sealing groove; when the groove width was 7.5mm, the hydraulic strength of the basin insulator was about 3.7MPa, and the maximum stress occurred at the corner of the convex surface of the basin insulator. The simulation results were verified by experiments, which showed that the hydraulic strength of the basin insulator was 2.9 MPa when the groove width was 7.3 mm, the relative error between simulation and test was 3.4%, and the hydraulic strength of the basin insulator was 3.9MPa when the groove width was 7.5 mm, the relative error between simulation and test was 5.1%, which proved the rationality and effectiveness of the simulation method.

articleTitle: Development of Power Source for Underground Cable Online Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the power supply problems of the wireless network on-line monitoring system of underground power cable, an energy-harvesting coil, which uses the magnetic field around the cable, was developed. The energy harvesting coil using Mn-Zn ferrite material of high initial permeability as its core, is designed to be cylindrical structure, which can be applicable to the power cables with different voltage levels. Through the theoretical calculation, software simulation, and the experiments, the structure of the harvesting coil, the core material, the number of coil turns, and the output circuit management can be confirmed. In this way, 35kV underground power cable can be safely operated within the range of 20-700A, with the output power of 25-100mW.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Flow Calculation Using BFGS-Based Optimisation Scheme
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The problem of optimal power flow is considered. The method of search of an optimal mode from the point of view of both minimised production and transmission costs is proposed. Proposed optimisation takes into account the operation mode's constrains on voltage and power. The nonconvexity of the optimal power flow problem is demonstrated and the efficient global and local optimum search method is suggested. The proposed method enables the constraints incorporation using the L-- BFGS- B optimisation algorithm. The stochastic modification of the global optimisation algorithm of the Lipschetz function was used on the initial stage to impower the L-BFGS-B method. The influence of renewable energy generation on the optimal power flow problem is discussed. Two illustrative examples on Irkutsk grid and IEEE 118 buses scheme demonstrate the efficiency of proposed method.

articleTitle: Steady-State Voltage Stability Analysis of AC-DC Hybrid Power System with VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Several high voltage direct current transmission systems based on voltage source converter (VSC-HVDC) have been put into operation in recent years. Research on voltage stability analysis technology has practical significance. In this paper, by analyzing the operational characteristics of voltage source converter, and considering the effect of reactive current constraint on the dynamic reactive reserve of the converter station, a processing method for reactive current constraint based on bi-directional switching logic is presented. On this basis, the load margin of AC-DC hybrid power system with VSC-HVDC is computed by continuation power flow method (CPF), and an approach to identify limit-induced bifurcation point caused by reactive current over-limit is provided. The influences of different control modes and control mode shift of VSC on the voltage stability margin are analyzed. Simulation results on the modified IEEE 39-bus standard system verify that the proposed method is reasonable and effective.

articleTitle: Output Power Modelling for Dynamic Behavior of Doubly-Fed Variable-Speed Pumped Storage Power Station
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The doubly-fed variable-speed pumped storage (DFVSPS) is an effective method to balance the fluctuation of renewable energy generation and is an important means of frequency and voltage regulation of power grid. Firstly, this paper introduces the model and the control strategy of the DFVSPS unit of generating mode and pumping mode. Secondly, by analyzing the dynamic behavior of the pumped storage power station, the mathematical model of output power of the DFVSPS is established, which includes start-up stage, load increasing stage, steady stage and shutdown stage of generating mode and pumping mode. Thirdly, the output power model of DFVSPS and the simulation example are established in MATLAB/Simulink. At last, the proposed power model is verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: A Deadbeat Control Algorithm Based on Adaptive Prediction Theory for Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Deadbeat control as a discrete system control method is widely used in active filter control system. But without the prediction deadbeat control is actually a difference a beat or two beats control, for this, the paper proposes a prediction based on adaptive line enhancer for active filter deadbeat control, accurate predicts system state after two beats with the historical datas. Theoretical derivation proves the adaptive prediction method' s robustness is optimal in the sense of H∞, experiments demonstrate that the proposed method is correct and feasible.

articleTitle: Modeling of Heating Water Network for Regional Multi-Energy System and its Operation Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: How to make operation strategy for regional multi-energy system with less energy loss and small cost is worth studying. Optimal operation model of regional multi-energy system is built based on heating water network model, considering heating loss of hot water pipes caused by temperature drop and power consumption of circulating water pump caused by water flow. The corresponding algorithm is introduced to achieve the solution of the model built in this paper. Finally, a supposed multi-energy system is used to conduct a simulation, and the results show that the proposed optimization model of making operation strategy for regional multi-energy system can further reduce energy loss and operation cost.

articleTitle: An Improved Robust Optimization Algorithm for Short-Term Scheduling with Wind Power Integration
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Fully considering with the randomness of wind power, an improved robust optimization algorithm is proposed for addressing short-term scheduling. An uncertainty set is introduced to reflect the variation range of wind power, and the temporal and spatial correlation is taken into account to characterize the cluster effect of wind farms. Besides, a robust optimization model of the proposed problem is established, and it is composed of a master problem for the short-term scheduling in the predicted case, and two sub-problems which are security checking and an economic dispatching for maximizing the utilization of wind power. The mentioned issue is solved by mixed integer programming and column-and-constraint generation (C&CG) algorithm. Case studies on the modified IEEE 39-bus system reveal that the proposed robust method can improve the accuracy of the model and reduce calculation time as compared to the conventional robust approach.

articleTitle: Optimal Prevention and Control Strategy Against Preconceive Faults in Electric Cyber-Physical System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Widespread application of advanced computer technologies in control system and information system will make the power grid more vulnerable to various cyber-attacks. This paper proposed a quantitative risk assessment of the cascading failure caused by the cyber-attacks on the overall systems of electric cyber-physical system (ECPS). Then, the attack tree model and the severity of overload lines are used to judge the Severity of the N-1 static security test. Lastly, an optimal model can be used to find the best adjustment of generator plan and load shedding to minimize the risk value of N-1 fault state. The proposed methods are tested based on IEEE14-bus, and the simulation results validate that the proposed methods are effective. This study offers new insight into preventing and mitigating the cyber-attacks.

articleTitle: Study on Enhancement of Heat Dissipation Capacity of Radiating Substrate with Graphene Composite Coating
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, graphene composite heat dissipation coatings with different proportions were prepared and applied to carbon steel substrate. The SiC diode is encapsulated on the substrate of graphene composite heat dissipation coating and traditional anticorrosive coating respectively, and then use the method of positive buck to test junction temperature and thermal resistance. Found that under the condition of the same SiC diode power, coated graphene composite thermal coating substrate encapsulation of SiC diode junction temperature than encapsulated in the traditional coating anticorrosive coating substrate most reduced 10°C, thermal resistance was reduced by 16.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, most showed that coated graphene composite cooling coating substrates better heat dissipation performance.

articleTitle: An Automatic Implementation Scheme of in-Field Power Frequency Series Resonance System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The power frequency series resonance system is widely utilized high voltage generator for testing the high voltage apparatus. The conventional resonance system, however, is bulky and less automated. An automatic implementation scheme of resonance system, which applies the optimized inductance tuning method, capacitive compensation scheme and improved line-shape iron core design, for the convenience of in-field test is propose in this paper. The results of simulation and practical applications prove the advantage of this scheme.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Small Capacitive Current Interruption of a 550kV Single-Break SF6 Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The prediction of breakdown voltages in capacitive switching tests of high-voltage circuit breaker is a challenging issue<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. In order to analyze the small capacitive current interrupting ability of a 550 kV single-break SF6 circuit breaker, based on mass, momentum, energy conservation equation and Laplace equation, the no-load air flow field and electric field are calculated by finite volume method. According to current beam theory<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup>, the critical breakdown voltage curve and the breakdown margin when arcing time is 0 ms, 0.5 ms and 1 ms are calculated and analyzed. The results show that the minimum value of breakdown margin appears in the throat gap.

articleTitle: Scenario-Based Scheduling Model of Electricity and Natural Gas System Considering Multi-Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To alleviate environmental problems, natural gas is gradually replacing fossil fuels, which makes the electricity and natural gas system important. However, there are many uncertain factors in the electricity and natural gas system. In this paper, these uncertainties such as wind power, electric loads and natural gas loads are analyzed based on scenario analysis. Further, in order to obtain the optimal economy, the unit commitment are determined first and then the day-ahead scheduling model is established. Testing results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Development and Application of Precise Control System for Pumped Storage Power Station
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The precise control system of the pumped storage power station developed in this paper is based on the analysis of the large amount of historical operation scenes of “source-network-load-storage”. It fully excavates the characteristics and occurrence rules of the abandoned wind/water period, and breaks the contradiction between peak load regulation of the power grid and the problem that the regulating capacity of the pumped storage power station has reached its limit. The energy stratified filling method for pumped storage power station precise control is proposed to cope with the contradiction between the increasing fluctuating power supply and the increasing user terminal load, and to realize the coordination and optimization of various resources such as hydropower, thermal power, wind power, pumped storage power, tie line and short-term load forecasting curve in the energy internet. Enhance the overall capacity to absorb and flexibility.

articleTitle: Short-circuit Fault Location method for Smart Distribution Network Considering load estimation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As more and more DGs plugging into low voltage side of the distribution network, the traditional distribution network is transformed from single-supply radial network to multi source network, which makes the overcurrent protection cannot be reliably realized by traditional protection devices and theories. Based on the application of synchronous phasor measurement technology in the smart distribution network, this paper analyzes the characteristics of the current phase difference in the sections with loads or branch lines quantitatively. Based on the above, this paper then proposes a novel auto-adaptive fault location and monitoring method based on section load estimation. At the same time, this paper analyzes the impact of different load types on the proposed fault location method. Verification of the proposed method has been carried out by simulating in the PSCAD, and the simulation results indicate that the short-circuit faults can be located and recognized accurately with fast speed and self-adaption.

articleTitle: Research on the Evolution of Power Supply Mode of Park Based on Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the acceleration of the opening process of the distribution side, the power supply modes of various types of industrial parks have undergone great changes. Therefore, it is significant that we study the evolution mechanism of the power supply mode which plays an important role in forecasting the electricity distribution patterns of park and formulating strategies of the relevant principals' market participation. This paper firstly proposes a method of the research on the evolution of power supply mode of park that based on Apriori algorithm. Then through mining the association rules of the typical features of the regional power supply and the participating ways of the main users, we have analyzed the evolution mechanism of the power supply mode. At last, the effectiveness of the method is verified by the actual data of a certain province in Northwest China.

articleTitle: Risk Control Cyber Physical System for Active Distributed Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Open information environment and high variability and uncertainty of active distributed network (ADN) make it an urgent need to make up the vacancy of ADN risk control system. This paper is the first to apply cyber physical system (CPS) into ADN risk control. The new method raised in this paper, two-stage risk control and one-stage risk alarm, can solve the conflict of accuracy and speed of risk control under different operating environment. Distributed collection and control system meets the needs of control terminal plug and play. Self-locking function prevents the power system from information system disaster automatically. New system designs, including risk state classification according to time dimension, risk status conversion protocol and parallel control, improve the heterogeneous physical problems of CPS. Real-time risk emergency control strategy implements rapid and effective real-time risk control. This is the first realization of unified model with multiple risk indicators and different aspects of risk management. The system proposed also realizes the good coordination between cyber and physical system. This paper puts forward a feasible active risk self-management system for ADN Jor the first time, which may provide advices and ideas for the construction and development of smart grid.

articleTitle: Exploration on the value innovation of Energy Internet demonstration park
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of Energy Internet, Energy Internet demonstration park has become the focus of international academy and industry. In this paper, main characteristics and objectives of Energy Internet demonstration park are analyzed and the architecture of Energy Internet demonstration park composed of the physical layer, information layer, and operation layer has been proposed. Moreover, both the old and new value of multi-energy complementary is summarized and discussed. Finally, numerical analysis of the demonstration Park is used to explore the value innovation mentioned above.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Control of Sub/Hyper Synchronous Oscillation in The Area of Large Scale Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the sending terminal, ±800kV UHVDC transmission system in Hami area of Xinjiang is a complex system that wind power and photovoltaic power in combination with thermal power are bundled and transmitted out, which faces a relatively higher risk of sub/hyper synchronous oscillation than elsewhere. In view of the shortcomings of the existing sub/hyper synchronous oscillation detecting and alarming of power grid, an improved and optimal scheme is proposed. Based on the proposed scheme, three safeguards and two platforms will be developed. At the same time, considering the shortcomings of the existing stability control system, an oscillation positioning method and an improved cutting scheme are proposed, respectively, and three safeguards for the stability control system are proposed. The improved detecting, alarming and control system can monitor oscillations in real time, alarm in time and suppress as quickly as possible, ensuring stable operation of power grid.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of PEMFC Systems Based on Decision-making Tree Classifier
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For purpose of solving the problem of fault diagnosis of the evaporatively cooled fuel cell system, a novel fast fault diagnosis method for an evaporatively cooled fuel cell system based on decision-making tree classifier is developed in the paper. The normalization method is utilized to filter the original datum. The decision-making tree classifier is used to classify the preprocessed data. It can effectively improve the diagnostic accuracy of the model. Example analysis shows that the novel approach can rapidly recognize two health states of membrane drying fault and hydrogen leakage fault. The diagnostic accuracy of the algorithm is 98.50%. The method proposed in this paper is suitable for online failure identification of evaporatively cooled fuel cell systems with large data samples and multi data dimensions.

articleTitle: Air conditioning system optimization scheduling algorithm considering building energy storage characteristics
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the comfort level of power consumers when their air conditioning systems participate in demand response and linearize the energy optimization problem of the air conditioning system to reduce the difficulty of solving it, an air conditioning system optimization scheduling algorithm considering demand response is proposed. This algorithm considers the energy storage characteristics of the building where the air conditioner is located and establishes a new air conditioning system optimization scheduling model; by introducing a new temperature variable, the energy optimization problem of air conditioning system is transformed from nonlinear optimization problem to linear programming problem; allowing the air conditioner to operate in a constant temperature mode within the user-specified time to improve user comfort; further reduce the minimum scheduling time interval of air conditioning to improve the scheduling flexibility of the air conditioning system; finally, according to the outdoor temperature of a region on the typical days in different seasons, a contrast experiment between 4 different scheduling strategies was implemented using Matlab. Simulation and experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can greatly improve the user's comfort while reducing the user's electricity bill.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Protection Scheme for the Construction of New Energy Plant Station
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve remote operation and illegal communication of the system manufacturer, a powerful technical monitoring method is proposed to identify this kind of illegal network channel. Here, we first analyze the commonly characteristics of the used remote operation and maintenance software protocol, and then design a network channel detection method to improve the information security management ability of the new energy plant.

articleTitle: Aggregation Modeling of Wind Farms Based on Multi Machine Representation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the uncertainties of wind turbines clustering results and equivalent model caused by the changes of operating scenarios in wind farms, an aggregate modeling method for wind farms based on multi-machine representation is proposed. Firstly, based on the Markov property of wind speed, the probability transfer matrix is established to characterize the seasonal and daily characteristics of wind speed. Secondly, the two-step method is used to aggregate and classify wind turbines according to wind speed and operation characteristics of front-end speed-regulating wind turbines. According to Fisher criterion, the clustering results were analyzed by probability analysis and regression test in order to merge the groups with higher correlation. Finally, the highest probability of each quarter as the final clustering results, so as to get the wind farm aggregation model. Compared with the output characteristics of the detailed model, the proposed modeling method and the aggregation model can more comprehensively characterize the operation characteristics of wind farm. Thus, the adaptability of the equivalent model is improved effectively, and the uncertainty of the clustering results of the equivalent model is solved.

articleTitle: Frequency Fast-Response Function Improvement of the Generation Units Using Turbine Cycle Storage Tanks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Frequency fast-response functions of the generation units are very important control functions during certain power grid under-frequency or over-frequency abnormal conditions. The proposed frequency fast-response method is based on the changing the condensate flow using the existing turbine cycle condensate storage tanks. As an example, fast decreasing of the condensate flow to the deaerator feedwater storage tank will lead to the decrease of the steam extraction flow to the low pressure feedwater heaters and result in the increase the power output of the unit to support the frequency fast response function under grid abnormal conditions. A theoretical analysis method for evaluation of the fast frequency response under above situation is put forward. Based on the design parameter of the full load condition heat balance diagram, the fast frequency response characteristic of the unit can be calculated. An example of the proposed frequency fast response scheme is provided for a 350MW generation unit. It is shown that under the condition of grid under-frequency abnormal operation condition the condensate flow to the deaerator can be decreased about 40%-55%, and a 2.7%-3.7% of the unit output can be expected under full load condition. It is also shown that for the condensate flow maximum change conditions, the calculated operation duration is more than 5 minutes, which provides a reasonable period for change the coal combustion and operation of the boiler systems to adapt to the grid power change request from the power frequency deviation. The theoretical analysis results also give some operation limitation for future site application.

articleTitle: Fixed Cost Allocation Based on Current Electromagnetic Fields on Power Market
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The compensations among the customers themselves are commonly caused in the transmission fixed cost allocation on power market. This paper proposes a method for the transmission fixed cost allocation based on the magnetic field due to current on the line. The intension of electromagnetic field for the generator or load is identified. And according to this, the usage for the network by the generator or load is determined. So the transmission fixed cost is allocated to each generator and load based on this intension of electromagnetic field of themselves. A five-bus example identifies the efficiency of this method. The presented method due to physical theory of electro-magnetic field eliminates the subsidy between the users of power grid.

articleTitle: The Power Flow Calculation Based on Impedance Specifications for Low-Voltage AC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the controller of the current-source inverter in low-voltage ac microgrid, this paper proposes a power flow calculation method based on impedance specifications. In low-voltage ac microgrid, the distributed generators (DGs) based on P/Q controller are always applied to improve energy efficiency and realize low-carbon economy. Furthermore, the characteristics of P/Q controller have several impacts on the power flow calculation. The source impedance model of the current-source inverter is built by small-signal method and the equivalence among the source d-q frame impedance matrix, the source sequence impedance matrix and the source abc phasors impedance matrix. What is more, the power flow calculation method based on source abc phasors impedance matrix is proposed. Eventually, the power flow calculation based on impedance specifications is tested on PG&E 69-bus test case systems and modified IEEE 14-bus test system.

articleTitle: Active Management of Distribution Network with High Permeability Distributed Energy Based on Rolling Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A large number of distributed energy access to the distribution network, which brings great risks to the safe and reliable operation of the power grid. According to the regulation characteristics of distributed generation, flexible load, reactive power regulating equipment and other adjustable resources in distribution network in terms of time scale and control function, combined with the requirements of operation economy and reliability of distribution network, the prediction error caused by the randomness and fluctuation of large-scale renewable energy output is considered. The multi-time scale multi-objective coordination optimization method is adopted to realize the active management of distribution network with high permeability distributed energy.
