In order to reduce the influence of renewable energy and load uncertainty on the operation of regional distribution network, the method optimizes the adjustable resources in distribution network from two stage of day-ahead and short-term, and realizes the safe, reliable and economic operation of distribution network with high permeability.

articleTitle: Research On Grid Planning of Power System Including UPFC
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Unified Power Flow Controller (UPFC) has been applied in our country and deployed in Nanjing and Suzhou, Jiangsu province. Suzhou's project has the highest voltage level and the largest capacity UPFC project in the world. These installed UPFC have an impact on power grid planning, but there is few research on it. How to make the use of the high voltage and large power flow control ability of UPFC to reduce the planning cost and improve system reliability is an urgent problem to be solved. In this paper, the grid expansion planning including UPFC is studied to achieve economy and reliability at the same time. Firstly, the basic principle of UPFC is introduced, and the influence of UPFC on grid planning is analyzed. Taking the newly added UPFC parameters and N−1 constraints into account, the mathematical model of power network planning with UPFC is established, and the genetic algorithm is improved to solve the problem. Finally, an example of grid planning with UPFC is given. The planning results show that considering the reliability will increase the cost of new lines, but it can better maintain the safe operation of the grid and reduce the comprehensive cost. Installation of UPFC and proper adjustment of its parameters can significantly reduce the cost and improve the reliability.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Control Strategy for Forward flyback Converter with Improved Efficiency as an Interface to Low Voltage Renewable Sources
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Forward Flyback converter, having few component count, soft switching feature and high conversion efficiency, caught the eyes from both academia and industries. Several control strategies, such as critical conduction mode, fixed off-time control and so on, have been proposed to realize either soft switching or high conversion efficiency. However, when the converter operates at full load range, not a single control strategy can both achieve high efficiency and limit switching frequency range. The paper proposed a hybrid control strategy to take full advantages of different control methods in order to realize high overall efficiency while maintaining a reasonable switching frequency range. A 300W prototype was built to verify the proposed hybrid control strategy and the proposed method can achieve 1.5% efficiency higher than the traditional control strategy at light load or extremely light load. The CEC efficiency reached up to 97.79%, which is 0.4% higher than the CRM operation mode. The experimental results validated the feasibility of the proposed hybrid control method.

articleTitle: Flexible Adjustment Method for Power Grid with High-Proportion Clean Energy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the influence of the access of high-proportion clean energy into the power grid, a comprehensive regulation model for such multiple energy as hydropower, thermal power, time-shiftable load, battery energy storage, electric thermal storage and nuclear power as well as the tie line and frequency was proposed. Through combing the operational characteristics, the operation process of power grid was divided into normal regulation domain, abnormal regulation domain and emergency control domain, and the unconventional peak regulation of thermal power unit was classified into the abnormal regulation domain. The flexible adjustment precaution calculation and monitoring method for the power was established, which could provide the basis for the monitoring and control of the operation of power grid. The results show that the characteristics of each stage in the operation of power grid are different, and the required adjustment variables are also different. Similarly, the characteristics of each operation variable are different. Therefore, the division of three operational domains is in line with the actual operation of power grid.

articleTitle: Multiple Scenarios Microgrid Equivalent Modeling Based on the Uncertainty of Distributed Generations
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The paper proposes a novel microgrid equivalent modeling methodology to decide the optimal equivalent model of microgrid in grid-tied mode based on the uncertainty of distributed generations. The uncertainty of the outputs power of distributed generations, such as PV and wind generation, make the microgrid operates different conditions. As a result, the equivalent model of microgrid will change based on the different operation condition, however, there are relationship between each other. The uncertainty characteristic of distributed generation follows Gaussian distribution, and the operations condition of microgrid will be divided into 24 scenarios in one day based on the different probability statistics of distributed generations. Multi-Scenario technology contains, Latin hypercube sampling and scenario reduction techniques, are used to deal with the uncertainty of distributed generations. The algorithm was applied into a microgrid test system, and the test results show that the new method can simplify the relationship of different operation scenarios of microgrid. And the influence of uncertainty fluctuation of distributed generations can be effectively suppressed in microgrid equivalent modeling.

articleTitle: Transient Modeling and Verification of Current Source Photovoltaic Virtual Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the promotion of virtual synchronization technology, photovoltaic (PV) virtual synchronous generator (VSG) gradually develops from micro-grid field to bulk power grid. Active control of frequency response and voltage regulation of VSG can support the grid operation friendly. Based on control principle of current source PV VSG, the PV VSG transient model was established in this paper, which was validated to be accurate based on multi-test condition data, and it is provided basic support for stability analysis of VSG connected with bulk power grid.

articleTitle: Overvoltage and Restriction of 1000kV Long-Distance Transmission Lines in Weak System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power frequency and switching overvoltages may be high for long-distance transmission lines in the weak power systems, such as Southwest ultra high voltage (UHV) AC power grid at initial stage. On the other hand, discharge voltage of air gap decreases significantly with decrease of air pressure, and the cost of line insulation at high altitude occupy a large proportion in the UHV transmission project. Therefore, it is necessary to further restrict overvoltages in order to avoid large increase of insulation cost at high altitudes. Simulation models were established and overvoltage calculations were carried by using Electromagnetic Transient Program (EMTP). It is found that overvoltages are particularly serious when the weak system side is a switch station (or the unique main transformer is out of service). Under this condition, power frequency overvoltages could be limited by installing high voltage (HV) shunt reactors on the bus. Moreover, selection of the minimum air gap for 1000kV transmission lines under switching overvoltages is based on the statistical switching overvoltage level of 1.7p.u. according to the existing standards. However, in high altitude areas, the minimum air gap could be reduced (e.g. based on the statistical switching overvoltage level of 1.6p.u.) on the basis of deeply restricting switching overvoltage, thus effectively reducing the sizes of line towers.

articleTitle: Based on PSCAD the Study of RSFCL Modeling Method
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rapid development of the power system leads to the rapid increase of the short-circuit current level of the system, and the superconducting current limiter is the most ideal current limiting device. In this paper, the electromagnetic transient model of the resistive superconducting fault current limiter(RSFCL) is built on the electromagnetic transient analysis program PSCAD / EMTDC, and the modeling method of the analog circuit module and the modeling of the digital circuit module are analyzed and compared by simulation.

articleTitle: Modeling of Two-Phase Unsymmetrical Induction Machine Based on Shifted Frequency Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Recently, the power system transients simulation concept, namely, shifted-frequency analysis (SFA), has received considerable attention. It has been used to perform accurate and efficient transients simulation by using dynamic phasors in the published literature. In this paper, a new two-phase unsymmetrical induction machine is presented by using the shifted-frequency analysis. The electrical variables are represented based on dynamic phasors. Then, large time-step sizes can be used for the proposed model so that efficient transients simulations of the machine are achieved. Simulations have been carried out to validate the proposed model. The analysis of the simulation results shows that the proposed SFA model is nearly 71 times faster than the EMTP-type model when simulating the transients whose Fourier spectra are around the fundamental frequency.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Multi-objective Planning Strategy for Electric Vehicle Charging Stations Considering Power-loss Sensitivity in Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The continuous development of electric vehicles (EVs) is based on sufficient charging facilities, thus reliving the “range anxiety” of EV owners. Since a rational siting and sizing of EV charging stations can not only reduce the investment and operation cost, but also improve the economical power system operation, a multi-objective planning strategy is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a sensitivity index of system power loss to each node's voltage is established to identify the candidate sites of EV charging stations. Subsequently, the siting and sizing model of charging stations is developed with the minimization of the construction cost as well as the maximization of income for utilities. Non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm II (NSGA-II) is employed to calculate the Pareto solution set for the model. Finally, a method based on fuzzy clustering is proposed to select the optimal solution which satisfies the decision-makers most from the Pareto set.

articleTitle: Improved Control Strategy of Bi-Directional Buck/Boost Converter with Constant Power Load
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper is based on the study of Bi-directional DC/DC converter, aimed at resolving the question of constant power load with negative impedance characteristics, researched the output impedance of the converter and proposed a virtual impedance method to improve the cascade system's stability, virtual impedance consists of virtual resistor, and locates at the converter output capacitor branch. The stability of the cascade system is analyzed by using the impedance theory. Simulink results verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the controller design.

articleTitle: Data Adjustment of Power System Based on Kalman Filtering and Adaptive Filtering
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of the infrastructure in power system, the modern power system possesses a distinctive feature of giant amount of data sets. This causes a serious problem about how to get a better quality of the data gathered from the measurement system. This paper proposed a dynamic system error adjustment method based on the combination of Kalman filter and adaptive filter to focus on the voltage phasor information. The most distinguishing part is that the calculation cost is small and is suitable for on-line computation, which is able to apply during the data transmission and can provide relatively reliable real-time decision foundation for operation and maintenance staff. The combination of adaptive filtering and Kalman filtering shows a better adjustment effect and tracking performance compared to traditional EKF and it is proved using a MATLAB/Simulink simulation of an actual 85-node power system to acquire actual value and measurement value of certain random selected nodes.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage Rise Risk Assessment Model and Method for Distribution Network with Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed generation (DG) has great influences on the operation of distribution network. Voltage rise is one of the important influences. To evaluate the potential voltage rise risk of distribution network with DG, a modified 2-point estimate method is proposed to calculate the probabilistic load flow so that the probabilistic statistic values of voltages can be obtained. Combing with theory of semi-invariant and Cornish-Fisher series expansion, the probability distribution function curves and the probability of voltage rise are obtained. The probabilistic evaluation index and evaluation criterion for voltage rise risk of the distribution network with DG are proposed in the paper. Finally, the rationality and effectiveness of voltage rise risk assessment method are verified with IEEE 39-bus distribution network. The simulation results show that the voltage rise risk in distribution network with DG is related to the access capacity and location of DG.

articleTitle: Multivariable Feedback Linearizaton Scheme for New Excitation System Based on Full Controlled Device
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Excitation system based on full controlled devices converter(FCDES), has not only the ability of ordinary excitation system but can also supply more damping to the synchronous generator and increase the stability of power system through injecting reactive current to the grid. But as the increase of variables and the change of the system structure, the whole system becomes much complicated and harder to design the control scheme. For this complicated nonlinear system, this paper first analyzed that it's equivalent to compensating reactive power in grid side with the compensating shunt impendence. Based on this conclusion, this paper deduced a third-order model of this kind of excitation system. And with the main goal of controlling the rotor angle as well as the terminal voltage, a MIMO nonlinear control strategy was designed through this model. The simulation results show that, comparing to the linear control scheme (AVR+PSS), this nonlinear scheme has better effect in enhancing the system's damping, with the compensation capacity increase, and better effect can be achieved; when system parameters changed, still has a good performance and better suitability.

articleTitle: Adaptive Droop Control of Multi-Terminal MVDC Distribution Network for High Solar PV Penetration
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The MVDC distribution network has attracted numerous power system applications including renewable energy (RE) integration. Currently, there is growing interests in solar photovoltaic (PV) penetration in the distribution network. However, the PV grid penetration poses great challenges in the operation control of the distribution network in which the MVDC network can be a solution. In this paper, an adaptive droop-based DC voltage control strategy is proposed for increased PV penetration in the MVDC distribution network and validated in PSCAD/EMTDC. The results show that the proposed droop control accurately regulates the DC voltage hence the power flow in the network than the conventional droop control at 26 and 52% PV penetration. This provides the proposed strategy with a greater capacity to control higher PV penetration prior to possible PV power curtailment which is often the last resort. Future studies will extend the MVDC distribution network to encompass wind power and the proposed adaptive droop control strategy enhanced with the model predictive controller (MPC) or fuzzy-logic controller for better response and flexibility.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Data Transmission Security Channel Protocol for Intelligent Equipment in Modern Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing mutual interaction between smart grid and users, intelligent acquisition terminals and mobile operation terminals are widely used and accessed. The types of data transmitted in the network are more complex, and the requirements for information security protection are higher. Currently, the general security protocols for power systems do not meet the new requirements. This paper studies ISO/IEC 9798 series of standards, combines key agreement, entity authentication and hybrid algorithm technology, designs a secure channel protocol for high-security data transmission, and analyzes its complexity and time performance. Finally, it is completed based on security chip. Data transmission test shows that it has the characteristics of high security and flexible protocol, and can effectively meet the security and real-time requirements of data communication.

articleTitle: Research on Pilot Protection Based on Equivalent Sequence Impedance of DFIG Wind Power Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The clean renewable energy integrate into distribution network with high penetration has become one of the main trends in the development of power grid, which has changed the original single power grid structure of the distribution network. In particular, unlike the synchronous generator, the distributed wind power presents different fault transient characteristics, making traditional current protection difficult to adapt. Protection of Active Distribution Lines Should Be Re-researched. The characteristic of the equivalent positive negative sequence impedance amplitude characteristic is different from them of the traditional synchronous power supply by analyzing the fault characteristics of doubly fed induction generator(DFIG). Therefore, the principle of pilot protection based on the difference of the magnitude of the equivalent sequence impedance between the two sides of the distribution line is proposed to identify the fault area. The simulation model of distribution system with DFIG is built on the EMTDC/PSCAD electromagnetic transient simulation software. The simulation results show that the proposed method can operate correctly with different fault type, fault resistance, fault position and DIFG output, and it can adapt to various operating conditions sensitively and effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Wind Power Output Reconstruction Technology Based on Multiple Time Scales
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A wind power time-series model is needed in order to make the research about wind power integration. First, the importance of constructing wind power model is introduced; then, a wind speed time-series model based on auto-regression moving average (ARMA) is put forward, which is followed by short-term wind speed forecasting; finally, a method using Markov chain Monte Carlo method (MCMC) is proposed to set up wind power time series model. Through a real case and analysis the validity of the proposed model is verified, which is able to meet the requirements of simulated wind power output data in wind farm planning and provide practical value for researches like wind power capacity benefits and reliability estimation of power systems integrated with wind power.

articleTitle: Phase-Selection Control Rectifier Technology of Multi-phase Synchronous Generator for Wide Speed Range Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a phase-selection control rectification technology to regulate AC-DC rectifier voltage ratio and output a constant DC voltage for multi-phase synchronous wind generator operating in a wide speed range. A novel rectifying bridge topology consisting of six diodes and six thyristors is presented when taking a six-phase shift of 60°generator as an example. By selectively turning on and off the thyristors, four kinds of AC-DC rectifier voltage ratios can be obtained. On the one hand, four constant terminal voltages of six-phase generator are output by regulating the excitation with PID control at different wind speeds, on the other hand, the appropriate rectifier voltage ratio between AC side and DC side is realized by means of phase-selection control. Finally, the DC voltage could be maintained stably in a wide speed range. The simulation verified that the phase-selection control rectification technology can maintain the stability of the DC voltage when wind turbine operates in a wide speed range.

articleTitle: Location Model and Algorithm of Solid State Transformer Considering Distribution Network Reconfigu ration
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the problems in location and operation of solid state transformer (SST) under the comprehensive consideration of distribution network reconstruction and distribution network planning. In order to better play the role of solid state transformers in improving voltage quality, reducing losses and providing sufficient reactive power compensation, this paper proposes a bi-Ievel optimization model. The objective of the upper level problem is to find the optimal network structure, and the objective of the lower level problems is to realize the optimal location selection of solid state transformer. To cope with the reconfiguration problem of electric distribution networks with solid state transformer, a modified bacterial foraging algorithm (MBFA) with variable-speed social learning is proposed to improves the solution speed and optimization precision of the model. Finally, taking the example of 10kV distribution network as an example, the power loss and voltage quality under different scenarios and the convergence of the model under different algorithms are compared to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: The Reform of Brazil's Power Market and Its Enlightenment to China's Power Market Construction
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Brazil is located in southeastern of South America and is the country with largest land area in South America. Hydropower is the main source of power. This paper introduces the Brazilian power industry reform process and highlights two phases of reform over the past 20 years. The first phase occurred in the 1990s, when there was no opportunity to fully implement the reform plan, and the reform was in a state of idleness. Then, the state began to intervene and planned the second phase of reform, which was implemented in 2004. Under the new market mode, the government has re-emphasized medium and long-term planning, and has introduced some new mechanisms. Now, the market operates stably and provides valuable experience for China's power market construction.

articleTitle: Design of Distributed PV Grid Power Constrained Production Control
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The output power of the PV module changes with variability of light intensity and temperature. In order to avoid the peak power exchange between the microgrid and the public grid and reduce the fluctuation of the photovoltaic power system, the PV grid connected power control system is designed on the basis of the PV grid model, and the MPPT and constrained production control are designed in the DC/DC link. the output of the inverter is adjusted by the constrained production control. The power balance is maintained in the network. The vector control technology based on the self commutation power device is adopted in the design of the DC/AC link, and the grid is connected with the double closed loop control strategy, and compose the whole photovoltaic grid connected power control system is constructed. Finally, the system model is built in MATLAB/Simulink, which proves the correctness of the model and control strategy of the PV grid connected power constrained production control system.

articleTitle: Research on A Novel Multilayer Equalization Circuit for Battery Pack Based on Game Theory Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The application of modern energy storage is the cornerstone of the development of energy Internet technology, and energy storage components play an important role. However, the use of lithium batteries as energy storage components is also facing application challenges, among which the impact caused by battery inconsistency is particularly critical. A forced equalization circuit is proposed in this paper, which can transfer energy from any battery to other batteries in the battery pack, thereby reducing the inconsistency of each energy storage unit and prolonging the life of the battery pack. The Nash equalization based on the complete information game strategy is used to optimize the control of the circuit. In theory, the low loss is achieved while fast equalization. Finally, the simulation model is built to verify the working principle and equalization strategy of the circuit. The results show that the control method using Nash equalization can effectively improve the circuit efficiency.

articleTitle: Framework and Function Design of an Intelligent Network Planning Software for Power Distribution
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distribution network planning is used to scientifically guide the development of distribution networks. The smart software to actualize Distribution network planning is significant for improvement of result scientificity, as well as efficiency of planning work. This paper reviews the characteristics of well-known distribution network planning softwares including IPSA, DPlan and SINCAL. The development trends of distribution network planning software are also analyzed. As a conclusion, the continuous improvement of informatization and intelligence of distribution network planning is the future trend, in the circumstance of the continuous application of new technologies such as data management, distributed processing, display and interaction, artificial intelligence, and the actualization of new functions such as accurate load forecasting, distributed power generations planning, and differentiated planning strategies. An intelligent planning software scheme of function and architecture for distribution network is proposed. The functions of intelligent planning software are attributed by eight modules: diagnosis of power distribution situation, power demand forecasting, network planning and substation allocation, mathematic calculation, investment estimation, input and output benefit analysis, planning results management, and graphic display. The functions of the above modules are designed in detail. The framework of the intelligent planning software is given. The proposed structure of the distribution network planning function is holonomic, and these functions can realize the closed-loop operation from the analysis of current distribution network problems to the proposal of the network planning scheme. The research results can provide reference for the power planning researchers to study the intelligent planning function of the distribution network and can be used as top-level guidance for the network planning software design.

articleTitle: Multilayer Heat Conduction Model in High Temperature Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of social industry and technology, energy field is developing rapidly. At the same time, we cannot ignore the safety and comfort of the protective clothing for staff who is inevitably working in high temperature environment. In order to design distinctive clothing, we need to study human thermal response under high temperature environment. Because of the particularity of the research environment, we place the thermal manikin whose internal temperature is controlled at 37 °C in the high-temperature environment of the laboratory to measure the temperature outside its skin. This paper establishes a heat conduction model of a five-layer heat insulation structure to determine the temperature change of the outer part of the thermal manikin skin. Then we compare the model calculation results with experimental test data to test its validity. This numerical model can be used as an initial calculation tool to carry out the thermal manikin experiment in high temperature environment, so as to realize the rapid prediction of temperature change and clothing performance.

articleTitle: Research and Control Strategy of Air-conditioning Load Model Based on Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Air-conditioning load as an important part of the peak load, its reasonable regulation can effectively improve system efficiency. The air-conditioning load is a typical thermostatically controlled load, and its thermal storage characteristics make it an excellent demand response resource with advantages of fast response speed and low cost. In order to achieve a reasonable dispatch for air-conditioning resources, based on the third-order air-conditioning model, aggregate the air-conditioning load using the Monte Carlo simulation method. On the premise of satisfying user comfort, a method of evaluating the adjustable capacity of air-conditioning is proposed by controlling the working temperature range of air-conditioning. The simulation results prove the feasibility of the method and provide a quantitative basis for the planning of day-ahead scheduling when the air-conditioning load participates in the demand response.

articleTitle: Research on Improvement of AC Line Distance Protection in AC-DC Compound Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In AC-DC compound power grid, the DC commutation failure due to AC fault can cause change in characteristics of AC grid fault, thus causing AC distance protection to operate incorrectly. The current measurement and the traditional distance protection impedance calculation result of the pure AC system and the AC-DC compound power system are compared, and the influence of DC feed on the distance protection is analyzed. The result shows that during the commutation failure, the DC system injects a large nonperiodic component into AC fault current, which causes the improper protection. Then, an improved distance protection combining distributed parameter line model and differential equation algorithm is presented. Finally, through the simulation experiment of PSCAD/EMTDC, it is proved that the optimization scheme can accurately and quickly distinguish the internal and external faults of the fixed point, and significantly reduce the influence on the ranging error of the transition resistance.

articleTitle: Two-Level Control Method for DPFC Series Units Based on PLC Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed Power Flow Controller (DPFC) is expected to be used for improving the performance of power flow control in AC transmission power system. In this paper, a two-level control scheme for DPFC series units is proposed. The two-level control system consists of an upper-level controller, multiple lower-level series unit controllers and unidirectional power line carrier (PLC) communication link. The reference value of series compensated voltage is calculated by the top-level controller according to the power flow ordered by dispatch center and transferred to series units via PLC communication link. A corresponding compensated voltage will then be generated in series units. Comparing the reference value of the compensated voltage with actual value, the modulation signal of converter in series unit will be modified through PI control. The model of an AC transmission system at high-level voltage involved with DPFC is built in PSCAD/EMTDC. The simulation results indicate that the proposed two-level control method for DPFC series units is flexible and effective.

articleTitle: Influence of traction transformer with different connection forms on power quality of the grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a large amount of data is collected and sorted out and a regional power grid was selected as the analysis object. Using MATLAB to build a typical model of public power grid, we analyzed the harmonic and negative sequence effects of different connection traction transformer under different operation modes. If the traction substation adopts the appropriate connection mode, as far as possible to ensure that the traction substation two power supply arm load balance, then the negative sequence generated by the current is very small and three-phase voltage balance. Comparing the harmonic and negative sequence effects of several connection modes of traction transformer on system bus, the conclusion that Scott connection has the best comprehensive performance is obtained. Therefore, in the actual operation, we should consider the characteristics of various connection modes of traction transformer in different operation modes, and reasonably dispatch, in order to reduce the negative sequence impact on the power grid.

articleTitle: Optimal Distribution Network Planning with CVaR Model Considering Renewable Energy Integration
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In consideration that the true generation characteristic of wind power is difficult to be described because of the limitation the existed forecasting method. As a result, the wind power integrated distribution network faces great challenge in economically and securely planning. Therefore, in this paper, the conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) model has been developed for distribution network planning from the perspective of risk aversion, considering the wind power forecasting error. In CVaR, the optimization objective including the cost of wind power investment, network loss and voltage deviation is formulated under several kinds of practical operation constrains. Then, in order to obtain the optimal solution, the Levy flight based particle swarm optimization (PSO-LF) algorithm is developed for the proposed model. The feasibility and effectiveness of CVaR model have been comprehensively evaluated on a modified IEEE 33-bus system for distribution network planning with uncertain wind power penetration.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Game Empirical Analysis of Incremental Distribution Network and Large Power Grid Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the extensive participation of social capital in incremental distribution network(IDN), the market position of power grid enterprise(PGE) operating traditional transmission and distribution grid has been affected. At present, the IDN as a low-voltage power grid must be connected to the high-voltage transmission network under the jurisdiction of the PGE to ensure power supply. This paper studies the conflicts of interest between IDN and PGE. With grid access as the entry point, a two-stage game model and related profit functions are established. Finally, the actual case is used to analyze strategic behavior in grid access of the IDN and the PGE.

articleTitle: Multi-Area Unit Commitment Model Based on Multi-Scenarios Risk Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A large number of studies have shown that the prediction accuracy of wind power is relatively low. Large-scale wind power integration into the power grid brings more uncertainty to the operation of the power system. On the one hand, the interconnection of power grid reduces the influence of wind power uncertainty on the operation of the power grid, but also increases the complexity of the day-ahead unit commitment. In order to obtain a practical and feasible unit commitment scheme in a limited computing time, it is necessary to screen typical scenarios to measure the operation risk of the power grid. On the basis of constructing the scene set of wind power, load prediction error and forced shutdown of the unit and the tie line, the risk consequences of various scenarios are quantified by the expected wind power curtailed (EWPC) and the expected energy not supplied (EENS) which are introduced into the objective function as the risk penalty. A safety constraint unit commitment model of multi-area power grid is established which have considered the multi-scenario running risks. A two-area 12-bus system is used to verify the correctness and validity of the established model.

articleTitle: The Relation Calculation Method of the Maximum Capacitance and Voltage Under the Condition of Restricted Frequency in 550kV GIS During Field Withstand AC Voltage Test
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to test whether the new GIS (gas insulated enclosed metal switch) equipment have operation conditions or not, at present, the effective way is to carry out field AC withstand voltage test. AC voltage withstand test is mainly the frequency conversion series resonance method. It is very important to accurately calculate the load carrying capacity of the pressure test device when it is necessary to spend a lot of time on the preparation of the field test. When the circuit is in the non-resonant state, it is difficult to determine the relationship between capacitance and voltage. In this paper, a method is proposed to calculate the relationship between the maximum capacitance and voltage under the condition of limiting frequency. The method has been applied to field experiments, and the method is proved to be correct and effective.

articleTitle: The Resonance Phenomenon and Analysis of Electric Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing number of the paralleled LCL chargers in charging station, many of them put up with the problems that some of the charging modules do not work. To solve the problem, a test is carried out in one chosen charging station, and the reason of the problems is analyzed, which is that a resonance occurs between LCL chargers and the grid, leading to a sudden change of reactive power. Then the mechanism of the resonance is analyzed based on the topology and control strategy of the LCL chargers. Finally a simulation model is built with Simulink to verify the correctness of the analyses above. The result shows that under the condition of grid-voltage containing some harmonics, the resonance may take place between paralleled LCL chargers and the grid, and the resonant frequency is decreasing while the number of the paralleled LCL chargers is increasing.

articleTitle: Parameter Sensitivity Analysis of Economic Operation Cost of CCHP-Typed Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The microgrid with CCHP(combined cooling, heating and power unit) and distributed generations can realize the cascade utilization of energy and improve the comprehensive energy efficiency. CCHP-typed microgrid has become a major direction of energy construction. In this paper, the operating characteristics of CCHP, gas boiler and electric refrigeration devices are analyzed, and then the economic operation cost function of CCHP-typed microgrid is established, considering the cooling, heating and power energy balace constraints in CCHP-typed microgrid. Parameter sensitivity analysis is carried out to study the effects of natural gas price, electricity price purchased from distribution network, affluence of cooling and heating supply of CCHP, and power variation of distributed generation on the economic operation cost. Moreover, the parameter sensitivity factor is introduced to evaluate the impact on operation cost of CCHP-typed microgrid. Finally, an example of CCHP-typed microgrid is established to verify and analyze the parameter sensitivity to the economic operation cost.

articleTitle: Research of Residual Current Transformer Fault Self-Diagnosis Based on Fractal Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on fractal theory, this paper analyses fault of residual current transformer, which is key components of leakage protector. A self-diagnosis method of the electronic residual current transformer is studied by the relationship of box dimension of residual current transformer output waveform between normal state and fault state and the effectiveness of the method is proved by experiments. The experimental results show that this method can accurately extract fault features and complete fault self-diagnosis of residual current transformers, providing a new way for fault diagnosis of residual current transformers.

articleTitle: Transmission Expansion Planning for Multienergy System with Integrated Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The growing demand for multi-energy facilitate the expansion planning for integrated energy systems. In this paper, we propose a co-planning model for integrated electricity and natural gas transmission networks considering integrated demand response. Energy hub is considered as the interaction of coupled electricity and gas energy and is modeled in power and gas flow calculation. Integrated demand is introduced an alternative measure to save expansion planning costs. To solve the complicated nonlinear problem, we apply genetic algorithm. Case study is applied to validate the performance of proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability Optimization of 1.8GHz TD-LTE Power Wireless Private Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The wireless private network carrying power business is a research hotspot in recent years. This paper researches the frame loss problem when 1.8GHz TD-LTE wireless private network carries power services, and studies a UDP power control system model based on 1.8GHz TD-LTE wireless private network communication, statistics the frame loss rate of power UDP control service when using wireless private network communication, analyzes the cause of frame loss problem, and proposes an optimization scheme of reducing data traffic of the control service and transmitting redundant packets at application layer to solve the problem of unstable reliability of power control services. The network tester IXIAXM2 is used to build the simulation experiment environment. The optimization method can effectively reduce the frame loss rate of the power control services based on wireless private network and improve the load-shedding success rate of the load control system, and reduce the impact of frame loss on power control services, thereby improving the reliability of the power control business.

articleTitle: Modeling and Technology Application for Transmission Line Fault
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to its wide geographical distribution, many points and long lines, the transmission line is affected by humanities, environment, geology and climate. Faults in the operation of transmission lines have both ontologies and external aspects. It mainly includes ice coating, dancing, lightning, tree damage, theft, bird damage, pollution flash and external damage. The data analysis of the internal and external causes of the failure of the integrated transmission line summarizes the fault law. In this paper, based on the time distribution of transmission line faults in different seasons, combined with the statistical application of design modeling technology, the fault analysis model of transmission line is established. The model can effectively guide the anti-accident struggle, strengthen the fault prevention and reduce the trip rate of the transmission line.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting Based on GA-PSO Optimized Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve accuracy of short-term load forecasting and solve low precision of the traditional single load-forecasting model and the shortcoming of common intelligent algorithms are easy to fall into local minimization in solving high-dimensional complex problems. In this paper, a short-term load-forecasting model based on the GA-PSO optimized extreme learning machine(ELM)is established. ELM connection weight and the hidden layer threshold are optimized with GA-PSO algorithm to avoid local optimal solution due to random initialization during the learning process, thus enhancing ELM forecasting performance. Finally, the practical example shows effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Comparisons of Different Dispatches to Promote the Consumption of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As renewable energy increasingly penetrates into power grid systems, new challenges arise to keep the systems reliable for system operators under uncertain circumstances, while ensuring high utilization of renewable energy. Due to the shortage in flexible resources and dispatching technology, the severe curtailment of renewable energy affects the sustainable development of renewable power. Many different formulations have been proposed for Unit Commitment (UC) problems, and many solution methodologies have been developed. However, considering that renewable energy characteristics and system scheduling were carried out separately by two sections, the existing study on UC separates the relationship of them. Based on the research of the impartial and open electrical dispatch model, this paper realizes four UC models with high penetration of renewable energy for comparison. To study the influence of renewable energy characteristics on model selection, this paper carries out case study on the real system, taking the northwest area as an example. The optimal models are compared by means of the solution analysis. The results provide some reference for operators to develop the level of UC schedule under fluctuation of renewable power and ensure the utilization of renewable power output.

articleTitle: A Smart-Community Demand Respsonse Load Scheduling Method Based on Consumer Clustering
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the multi-user daily load demand response problem of smart power utilization community in complex smart power environment, this paper proposes a clustering demand response analysis method that takes into account the user's power utilization behavior. Firstly, with the schedulable load and unschedulable load as constraints, this paper establishes a demand response model with minimum load fluctuation as the optimization target. Then this paper expounds the process of model solving. After clustering user behavior, this paper divides the user into different logical sub-regions. Finally, this paper solves the model by using the particle swarm algorithm. Simulation results verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi-Scenario Modeling of Power Grid Planning under the Access of Large-Scale New Energy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the access of large-scale new energy sources, the impact of multi-mode power supplies on the operation mode is gradually increasing. A multi-scenario model for grid planning under large-scale new energy access is established in this paper. In the general idea of the model, the cluster attribute variables that can describe the grid planning are first filtered from the large-scale multi-scenario data set. Then, the dimensions of the generator node and the load node of the characteristic variables in the multi-scenario data set are reduced using the principal component analysis method; taking each moment in the multi-scenario data set as a scenario sample and the active power of the generating set and the load node after the dimension reduction as attributes, the improved K-means algorithm is used for cluster analysis to select representative real scenarios from the clustering results as typical scenarios; the extracted typical scenarios are evaluated and analyzed according to the results of the power flow calculation.

articleTitle: A data-driven strategy for economic analysis of peak regulation based on cyber physical system
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the integration of wind and solar power energy, the power grid is facing the challenge of peak regulation. In this paper, we focus on the systematic method for applying cyber physical system on the economic peak regulation strategy of coal-fired power plants in the Northwest China power grid. A data-driven approach is applied to modeling the integrated performance of each device. The levelized cost of energy during peak regulation process is acquired by the economic analysis under various boundary conditions. The operational data, weather condition and grid load demand are considered simultaneously for giving the compensation price to the power grid in peak regulation process. The result shows that the net earned money for different compensate price ranges from −5,000 CHY/kWh to 30,000 CHY/kWh and the net earned money under any boundary conditions can be given by the cyber physical system.

articleTitle: Improvement of Substation Automation System Communication Protocol Based on Cobweb Network Topology
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A high reliable and deterministic network topology for Substation Automation System (SAS) network is required to guarantee the operation of substation in smart substation. In addition, to guarantee the communication reliability in terms of protocol, the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) 62439 standardizes several communication protocols for industrial communication networks. This paper designs a novel single network based on cobweb topology for SAS communication network, and proposes an improved communication protocol based on the IEC 62439. Improved reliability and determinacy of the proposed protocol are demonstrated through the novel single topology with the help of double attached (intelligent electronics device) IED. The recovery time and network latency, which are identified as the important factors of the protocol performance, are evaluated by the simulation. The OPNET modeler is used for modeling and simulation of message communication in SAS network under normal and abnormal working situation.

articleTitle: Limit Capacity Calculation of PV Generation System Based on Distribution Grid Operational Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is a challenge for the distribution grid with more and more PV generation connected. The limit capacity calculation of PV generation is the key for the problems of distribution grid. The paper proposes method for the calculation of limit capacity of PV generation in the distribution grid. The proposed model takes the maximum capacity of PV generation as the objective, and the operation constraints contain bus voltage deviation, line current, main transformer limit, reactive power compensation and power turning. Fish swarm algorithm is used for the calculation of the limit capacity of PV generation. The simulation of IEEE33 bus system shows that the proposed method can increase the grid-connected limit capacity of PV generation under the premise of meeting the constraints of distribution grid system. It verifies the rationality and feasibility of the proposed method, and provides a solution for the limit capacity of distributed PV generation connected into distribution grid.

articleTitle: Wind Power Generator Output Model Based on the Statistical Wind Speed Distribution Derived From the Historical Data
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind speed is continuously and randomly variating. The output of wind power generator is highly related to the wind speed. In practice, the original data available in the open access is usually not enough for evaluating a power system performance. In this paper, a wind power generator modelling method which is based on the statistical wind speed distribution from the historical data is proposed. This method can generate infinite samples by using Monte Carlo simulation.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault-Reconfiguration Scheme for the Active Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Active distribution system(ADS) plays a crucial role in integrating distributed generators(DGs). Therefore, it is necessary to quickly and effectively reconfigure ADS when it suffers from serious faults. In this paper, a two stage strategy is introduced to solve this problem. In stage one, the DG islands are divided dynamically according to their characters to guarantee the power supply of important loads. In stage two, a fault-reconfiguration strategy based on the imperialist competitive algorithm(ICA) is proposed to obtain the optimal reconfiguration scheme, which takes the load balance, voltage and capacity constrains into account simultaneously. Switches of loop and inferior solution identifying techniques are employed to improve the computation efficiency. The introduced approach can maximize the protection for important loads and restore power supply for black areas rapidly compared to existing methods. Simulation results of the IEEE 69-bus test system verified the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Linear State Estimation for Active Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Linear state estimation (SE) formulation play an important role in real-time distribution network management. The voltage magnitude, active power, and reactive power measurements are transformed to linear measurements with large initial node voltage errors when SE under a rectangular coordinate system. In order to solve this problem, a linear state estimation under a polar coordinate system is proposed to obtain a sufficiently accurate complex node voltage in the first stage, and then nonlinear measurements are transformed to linear measurements with the complex node voltage. Bad data identification can be embedded in this stage. In the second stage, linear SE under a rectangular coordinate system are used. The proposed two-stage linear SE is validated on balanced 33, 70, 84, 119, 874-node distribution networks and IEEE 13, 34, 37, 123 unbalanced test feeders.

articleTitle: Study on Fault Detection for Line Section in Active Distribution Network Based on the Generalized State-space Model
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Line fault in active distribution network should be detected and isolated timely in a section, or it may cause serious consequences in the system. In order to solve this problem, a novel fault detection method for the line section in active distribution network is proposed in this paper. This method is based on the fault characteristic of generalized state-space model (GSM) of the line section. The GSM is an internal characteristic description of power transmission line which can describe the intrinsic property of the line. When a line section is faulted, the system matrix of the GSM of the line section will be changed. The suggested method has been verified by MTLAB simulation. The simulation results show that the proposed method has good universality and robustness, it can detect all the types of fault in the line section of active distribution network and not be affected by the non-fault disturbance.

articleTitle: Optimization of A Micro Energy Network Integrated with Electric Bus Battery Swapping Station and Distributed PV
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With widespread application of electric buses, the issues of securing their environmental friendliness and keeping low impact on distribution network need to be addressed. An optimized micro energy network integrated with bus swapping station and PV power plant is efficient to support green bus system and high distributed PV energy penetration. In this paper, a mathematical model to optimize batteries recharging schedule for electric bus line of swapping mode is proposed, which combined with a status switching sequential process constraints of each bus. The model determines the optimal charging plan for the bus line under a certain standby batteries configuration, with the objective to minimization the operation cost of the micro energy network. The model is solved by using Monte Carlo optimization. Finally, case studies reveal that the proposed model can apprise the bus charging load curve reshaping ability and assist decision-making for conventional bus lines conversion to electric bus lines to improve integration of distributed PV energy.

articleTitle: Analysis of Advantage of the Connection of Energy Storage System to Distribution Network and the Impact on the Voltage Quality
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The peak-valley effect on the network load is increasing along with the increasing load of the distribution network. And the large-scale renewable energy which was combined to the grid has great impact on the power grid. They have serious effect on the reliability and economy of the working of power grid. The application of energy storage technology for the distribution network can not only reduce the investment in response to the increase of load peak, but also promote the development and the exploitation of renewable energy, which does a favor for the reliability and quality of power supply. The energy storage system (ESS)as the technical support to intelligent distribution network plays a more and more important role. In this paper, the advantages of ESS applied to power distribution network was evaluated from the point of the perspectives of the network update delaying, network damage reducing, reducing backup power for distributed generation, the reducing of reliability cost, etc. The effect of ESS on the voltage of distribution network was theoretical derived. so the result would provide supporting evidence to the optimization analysis on the locating and capacity of ESS, which produces the important reference for the ESS configured in the distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on Profit Distribution Strategy of Electric Vehicles Absorbing Wind Power Based on Cooperative Game
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studies the profit distribution of wind power, thermal power and electric vehicles in the power market, based on the cooperative game theory, the combined operation mode of wind turbine, thermal power unit and electric vehicle for electric vehicle charging and eliminating wind is designed. The optimal scheduling model under the three-party alliance, two-party alliance and non-alliance mode is constructed with the goal of maximizing the profit of the alliance. The profit results of different operating modes are used as the basis for distribution, Adopting Shapley value, Banzhaf value, and Solidarity value allocation strategy for three-party alliance profit distribution, And set the core theory and MDP indicators to determine the possibility of cooperation and the intensity of cooperation intention under each allocation strategy. The mixed-integer programming technique and CPLEX optimization software are used to simulate the simulation. The results show that the three-party joint model can promote the consumption and development of wind power, and the cooperation under the Shapely value allocation strategy can be established. The cooperation intentions of all members of the alliance are strong.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Grid Connected Microgrid Considering CCHP and Analysis of Energy Saving and Emission Reduction
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the combined cooling, heating and power (CCHP)supply, the grid connected microgrid can utilize clean energy such as wind energy, photovoltaic energy and the waste heat recovering of micro-gas turbine after power generation, and supply cooling and heating to users, so it has better energy saving and emission reduction effect. In this paper, an optimal economic operation model of microgrid with net present cost as the optimization objective is established for the microgrid system consisting of wind turbine, photovoltaic cell, micro-gas turbine, waste heat boiler, storage battery and cooling, heating and electric load. The optimal configuration scheme is obtained by using HOMER. The energy saving and emission reduction effects of the system are verified by comparing the optimal scheme and the situation that the load is only supplied by the grid. Through the sensitivity analysis of the waste heat utilization rate of the micro-gas turbine with the optimal scheme, the benefit of improving the waste heat utilization rate is illustrated.

articleTitle: Study on Insulation Design of High Power High Frequency High Voltage Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transformer insulation is very important to the safe and stable operation of high frequency transformer, especially the voltage grade of high frequency high voltage transformer is high, which presents higher requirements for the insulating properties. Using a high power high frequency high voltage transformer for dust removal as research object, the effect of different winding methods on the transformer winding insulation was studied, and the electric field of main insulation was simulated and analyzed. The results show that the change of winding structure can effectively improve the voltage distribution of winding and increase the breakdown voltage of insulation. The insulation paperboard-oil structure can meet the requirements of main insulation for high frequency high voltage transformer, which can provide reference for the insulation design of high frequency high voltage transformer.

articleTitle: The application analysis of ice-melting technical measures for OPGW
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The ice-melting for OPGW(optical fiber composited overhead ground wire) is a difficult problem in the field of ice disaster treatment, so the OPGW has been involved in the icing hazard for a long time. In this paper, ice-melting technology methods of OPGW are discussed, combined with ice-melting test, the effect are verified and the different efficiency is also analyzed. It can help people to adopt appropriate method to solve the problem of icing OPGW.

articleTitle: Real Time Evaluation Algorithm for Measurement Performance of Substation Voltage Transformer Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper introduces an online multidimensional evaluation algorithm based on Artificial Neural Network (ANN) for substation voltage transformers and implement it. Voltage transformers are widely used in voltage transformers for voltage measurement of 220kV and above. This type of voltage transformer has low error stability compared with electromagnetic transformers. For a variety of reasons, a large number of measuring transformers in the power grid operate over the period of over-test. In this paper, we design a multi-dimensional online evaluation algorithm for transformer performance based on ANN. The observation space is formed by the transformer output signal, and the mapping space is constructed by the physical correlation of the information in the transformer group, and the true value of the transformer is estimated. Based on the algorithm, the data output evaluation, state analysis and risk prediction system for multi-time-space data monitoring are established to realize online evaluation and risk warning of transformer measurement.

articleTitle: Energy Optimization of Rail Transit Power Supply System with PVs and Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to reduce the energy consumption of rail transit power supply, promote the local consumption of photovoltaic, and simultaneously, and improve the power supply flexibility of the system, this paper proposes an energy optimization method of photovoltaic and energy storage accessing to rail transit power supply system. Energy management model with minimal operating costs has been established. The constraints of power balance, the photovoltaic power, the battery state, photovoltaic and the grid transmission capacity were considered. A modified particle swarm optimization (MPSO) is used to optimize the solution. To verify the validity of the proposed method, an IEEE9 node system was used for the simulation test. The results show that the photovoltaic can be basically satisfied the traction load demand, when the light is sufficient and the passenger flow is small. Moreover in the load peak period, it is necessary to purchase electricity from the large power grid to maintain normal operation of the system.

articleTitle: Traffic-Aware Energy Management for EV Charging Aggregator Considering Spatial and Temporal Load Distribution
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering high penetration of electric vehicle (EV), flexible charging behavior may bring great influence on power security and traffic congestion problem. In this paper, a bi-Ievel optimization is proposed to co-optimize spatial and temporal charging load distribution. In upper-level for EV charging aggregator, an energy management method is proposed for considering both the energy supply side and demand side (charging power) and decide the optimal spatial charging load distribution. In lower-level for traffic assignment problem, the equilibrium spatial load distribution is decided. The numerical analysis is provided and corresponding results illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Power Flow Adjustment Capability Research of SSSC Accessed to Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, there is no operation experience of static synchronous series compensator (SSSC) that accessed to the power grid. So, it is necessary to study the operating characteristics of the power grid and the ability of static synchronous series compensator (SSSC) regulating the power flow. First, the vector graph model of the SSSC regulating the line power flow is established. Then several typical ways of SSSC accessing the 220kV transmission lines are analyzed. Taking the SSSC that located in a Tianjin 220kV line as an example to study the regulating power flow characteristics in the subarea grid by using the PSD-BPA software. The results show that under the same operation mode, for the double-circuit lines, the active power flow on the line installed with SSSC changes and the active power flow on the other line changes in the reverse direction. However the active power flow change of the section of the double-circuit lines has the same trend with that of the active power flow through the SSSC. The active power adjustment ability of the SSSC decreases slightly with the increase of the subarea load, but the influence the subarea load is little.

articleTitle: Multi-Energy Coordination Based on Multi-Agent System in Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The optimization strategy of integrating thermal and electrical complementarity has been more and more widely studied in Energy Internet (EI). The power system can be associated with the heating system by combined heating and power (CHP) system based on micro gas turbines (MT). Then the combined operation of thermal and electrical systems can be realized. In this paper, the integration of thermo-electric system in VPP was analyzed, and thermo-electric joint operation framework and strategy based on MAS was proposed. A multi-energy complementary coordination problem of VPP with the goal of maximizing income and minimizing compensation cost was built. An example is given to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm and strategy.

articleTitle: Selection Method of Measurement Data for the Parameters Estimation of Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accurate transmission line parameters are critical for power system analysis, operation, and control. In this paper, the influence of data selection scheme on estimation accuracy is study. Three factors affecting the data selection are analyzed, including the size of time window, number of data points used and data sorting method. With simulated data following operating mode, the influence of the factors on estimation accuracy and stability is checked with the least square estimation model. According to the analysis, a data selection scheme for transmission line parameters is proposed. Some transmission lines are estimated with field measurement data to verify the feasibility of the proposed data selection method.

articleTitle: Analysis of DC transmission line disconnection fault characteristics based on MMC-HVDC system under symmetrical monopole connection mode
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC transmission line disconnection fault is one of the common faults in DC side of MMC-HVDC system. Under the symmetrical monopole connection, the transmission line disconnection fault leads to the interruption of the power transmission of the flexible HVDC transmission system. During the period of transmission line disconnection fault, the submodule capacitor charges or discharges due to the function of the outer loop controller. The DC voltage of the faulty pole changes much comparing with the DC voltage of the healthy pole. The voltage of the two terminal AC side grounding reference point is no longer consistent, and the fault current with small amplitude but gradually increasing on the healthy pole DC line. There is a gradually increasing DC voltage offset component in the AC voltage of converter valve side. Finally, the validity and correctness of the transmission line disconnection fault analysis was verified by a two-terminal MMC-HVDC system which was established in PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Demonstration and Application of AC/DC Hybrid Power Supply System in Building
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To verify the practicability and operating characteristics of low-voltage DC power distribution system in building, an AC/DC hybrid power supply system was built by Haimen Power Supply Company and Nanjing Golden Cooperate DC Power Distribution Technology Co., Ltd. An operation management system was designed to carry out system control and condition monitoring. DC loads such as DC refrigerators, DC air conditioners, air purifiers, LED lamps, and projectors can be efficiently supplied in a variety of situations through reasonable control strategies, and the power supply structure for AC loads remain original. The traditional AC protection scheme is adopted on the system AC side while an integrated DC power distribution unit was adopted in the system, and complete DC protection functions including active protection and microcomputer protection were integrated. The results of the operation show that the AC/DC hybrid power supply system of the building is operating in a good condition. While making full use of solar energy, it effectively improves the power supply reliability and power consumption efficiency of buildings, and has practical application value.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Dispatching Optimization for Distribution Network Containing Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The economic and security of distribution network are more and more influenced by the integrated microgrid. The dispatching methods available for distribution network containing microgrid are all aimed at lowering the operation cost of microgrid. The distribution network, however, is usually ignored. In this paper, a comprehensive dispatching optimization method is proposed to lower the total operation cost of microgrid and distribution network. The optimization model for operating cost of microgrid and distribution network is established respectively. With PSO algorithm and two-point estimation method, the optimal exchange power between microgrid and distribution network of each model can be obtained, which makes an exchange power range. With this exchange power range included into constraints and the total operation cost of microgrid and distribution network as objective function, the comprehensive optimal exchange power can be obtained. Considering the operation state with the comprehensive optimal exchange power at each time interval, the optimal dispatching scheme could be defined. A modified IEEE 33-bus system is used as example to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch of an Island MG Including a Multiple Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integrated energy MG including electric heat and gas has become a significant part of energy internet. In order to reduce pollution from gas emissions and achieve the economic goal, the multiple energy storage system(MESS) is configured. It is very important to study the economic dispatch problem for an integrated energy microgrid(MG). Hence, this paper proposes a multi-objective optimization scheduling model for an island MG including a MESS. This island MG consists of a wind turbine (WT), a photovoltaic battery (PV), a fuel cell (FC), an electric boiler (EB), an electric storage, (ES) a heat storage (HS) and a gas storage(GS). Minimum economic cost and environmental cost are considered as the two objectives in the operation of this multiple energy source MG system. To solve this two-objective optimization problem, the multi-objective bacterial colony chemotaxis (MOBCC) algorithm is utilized to obtain the operation modes of the micro-sources and the Pareto optimal solution set. Simulation results show that the proposed method is effective and decision makers can choose the appropriate dispatch scheduling in this manner.

articleTitle: An optimized control access mechanism based on micro-service architecture
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of cloud technology and the continuous evolution of software architecture, micro-service has become a very popular software development architecture mode, which is more suitable for the situation of business expanding and rapid function iteration. This paper discusses the basic concepts and main features of micro-service architecture, and analyzes the shortcomings of the traditional architecture, so as to obtain the basic requirements of access control in micro-service environment. By studying the traditional access control technology, this paper analyzes its limitations and shortcomings in the micro-service environment, and proposes an access control optimization model based on RBAC.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Heating-Thermal Generators Flexibility Expansion on Promoting Renewable Energy Integration Based on Production Cost Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, renewable energy technology has been growing rapidly and playing an important role in power system. However, with the gradual expansion in the scale of renewable energy penetration, the phenomenon of renewable energy curtailment is becoming more and more serious. In this paper, Firstly, the key restraining factors of renewable energy penetration are summarized.
