Next, it focuses on the impact of heating-thermal plants transformation on promoting renewable energy integration and presents a mathematical model based on production cost, which is used to simulate the operation of power system. Finally, the computational results of three scenarios indicate that the flexibility transformation of heating-thermal units can greatly promote the penetration of renewable energy in winter. From the compare of those results, we also find that the effect of promoting wind and solar energy penetration is gradually reduced with the reduction of heating-thermal plants' minimum output level.

articleTitle: Improved Energy Structure Prediction Model Based on Energy Demand Forecast
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, with the outbreak of the energy crisis and the increasingly serious environmental problems, the energy consumption structure changes tremendously. Proportion of nonrenewable resources is declining year by year, while the renewable energy's proportion increases steadily. Therefore, it is necessary for a city to predict energy structure accurately, in order to make a reasonable development plan. Through increasing restrictions based on the energy demand forecast and the future energy plan, this paper introduces the Markov chain to set up an improved energy structure prediction model. Combining the data of the energy demand energy structure during 2003 to 2016 and the energy developing plan of a certain region, the proposed model is tested. The result verifies the feasibility of the model.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Microgrid on Power Supply Mode of Medium-Voltage Distribution Network Considering Reliability and Economy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The access of microgrid will directly affect the voltage quality and operation level of medium-voltage distribution network, resulting in the change of power flow direction and the formation of multi-source network. Based on reliability and economy, this paper quantitatively evaluates the influence of microgrid on typical power supply modes of medium-voltage distribution network, determines the optimal access location and capacity, and proposes a construction mode of medium-voltage distribution network suitable for microgrid access. Through the study, it is concluded that the microgrid connected to the radial overhead lines can significantly improve the reliability of power supply, and the farther the access point is, the higher the reliability is. At the same time, it is necessary to improve the economy of microgrid access.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Thunder Detection in Zibo Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Thunder is the main cause of line failure. Due to the complex and multi-branch characteristics of distribution lines, lightning protection has always been the focus and difficulty of the power sector. This paper analyzes the lightning accidents of the Zibo distribution line in 2016, and finds that the number of induced overvoltage lightning faults accounts for 80%, and the number of direct lightning faults is 20%. Combined with the lightning strike and lightning damage mechanism and the seasonality, weather, topography and other related laws of the region, a differential lightning protection measure for distribution network is proposed. By using both the grooming and blocking technologies, it effectively reduces the lightning and disconnection of the distribution line.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Production Simulation for Industrial Integrated Energy System with Power and Steam Loads
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To make full use of renewable energy, integrated energy system(IES) has been developing in recent years with a variety of energy coordination, in which the power system is the core. This paper improves the probabilistic production simulation (PPS) method which is widely applied to the evaluation of economic efficiency and reliability of power-only system and proposes a probabilistic production simulation method suitable for industrial integrated energy system. This paper briefly introduces the load probability density function (LPDF) considering photovoltaic energy, energy storage, steam load and the unit commissioning convolution calculation. Then, simplify convolution operations using image translation methods. The electricity purchasing from the utility grid and calculation method of reliability index as well as the unit output are given. Finally, Guangdong Mingzhu demonstration zone is taken as an example. Applying the model to the example demonstrates the advantages of the method in the economic evaluation and reliability assessment of integrated energy systems.

Author Keywords: image of equivalent load probability density function

articleTitle: Distributed Cooperative Droop Control for Seamless Islanding of an Autonomous Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The droop control under peer-to-peer (P2P) control mode, which does not need communication exchange and modes transfer, is more widely adopted recently. Especially, the distributed secondary control based on fully decentralized primary droop control attracts more attentions and deserves further investigation. Hence, a new distributed cooperative droop control is proposed to realize seamless islanding and maintain stability of the autonomous microgrid (MG) using pinning consensus of multi-agent system (MAS) in this study, it converts the secondary control to a pinning-based distributed control instead of a centralized control, and the control processing can be transformed into keeping track of synchronization, so as to reach the expected consensus through pinning and recover the frequency to rated value with zero steady-state error. Multiple cases are carried on to demonstrate the applicability and availability of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: An Overview of Ancillary Service Development in China: Status, Problems and Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Ancillary services are crucial to the stability and power quality of power systems. With the deepening of the new round of power system reform in China, the construction of ancillary service market has become an important part of the market-oriented reform. In this paper, a comprehensive discussion about the ancillary service in China is presented. The history and status quo of ancillary service are introduced. The market design of eight ancillary service market pilots is analyzed in detail. Following that, the challenges faced at the present stage and the corresponding political suggestions are put forward. This paper is conductive to promote the development of ancillary service in China.

articleTitle: CPS Optimal Control for Interconnected Power Grid Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The CPS standard can be more objective to evaluate the effect of control behavior in each control area on the interconnected power grid. The CPS standard is derived from statistical methods emphasizing the long-term control performance of AGC, which is beneficial to the frequency control of the power grid by mutual support between the various power grids in the case of an accident. Moreover, CPS standard reduces the wear of the equipment caused by the frequent adjustment of the AGC unit. The key is to adjust the AGC control strategy to meet the performance of CPS standard. This paper proposed a dynamic optimal CPS control methodology for interconnected power systems based on model predictive control which can achieve optimal control under the premise of meeting the CPS standard. The effectiveness of the control strategy is verified by simulation examples.

articleTitle: Influence of the Material Parameters on the Electric Field Intensity Distribution of 10kV Cable Elbow Connector
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Cable elbow connector is an important part of cable, but the cable elbow connector breakdown accidents often cause a great impact on the power system due to inadequate design, poor handicraft, insulation aging and environmental reasons. In order to find and overcome the shortcomings of cable elbow connector design, an axisymmetric model is established, and the electric field intensity distribution is simulated with finite element method. The relationship between the electric field intensity distribution and the material parameters is obtained by changing the electrical conductivity and relative permittivity of the material parameters and comparing the variation of the electric field intensity distribution. This paper analyzes the electric field intensity distribution of the cable elbow connector from two aspects of material and puts forward some corresponding optimization suggestion, which has a strong guidance and reference for improving the reliability of the cable elbow connector.

articleTitle: A Novel On-Line System for Monitoring the Oil Level of Capsule-Type Storage Tank of Power Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The oil level of the power transformer's oil storage tank is an important operation parameter. The oil level sensor based on magnetic resistance circuit and its hardware structure are designed. Based on the communication and monitoring technology of electric Internet of things, an on-line monitoring and control system is developed to realize remote measurement of the oil level. The control and operation personnel can obtain the real-time oil level value in the SCADA system, which improves the operational reliability and reduces the workload of personnel. Once the oil level is too high, too low or descending rapidly, the system will send alarm signals in time to the control and operation personnel to facilitate the timely response and take measures to reduce the probability of failure, which could ensure the safe and stable operation of equipment and power grid.

articleTitle: State-of-Charge Balancing Control Strategy Based on Discrete Consensus Algorithm for Battery Energy Storage in Islanded Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes state-of-charge (SOC) balancing control based on discrete consensus algorithm to improve the accuracy of power dispatch of the battery energy storage systems (BESS), reducing system cost and prolong the service life of the BESS in islanded microgrid. This has been achieved with hierarchical distributed secondary cooperative control based on discrete consensus algorithm, which modifies the BESS output power to reach a balanced SOC. The control structure has two layers. The cooperative control works as the secondary layer, obtaining equal SOC of the BESS of the grid through interchanges information of energy storage systems state of charge (SOC) with its neighbors. BESS control approach as the primary control layer, they are able to realize the output power sharing and the balancing discharge rate by regulating the virtual resistance. The simulation platform is built based on Matlab/Simulink software. The validity and feasibility of the proposed control strategy has been further verified by various simulation results.

articleTitle: A Fully Distributed Power Flow Algorithm with Exponentially Fast Convergence
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a fully distributed power flow algorithm is proposed. The method is composed of outer iteration and inner iteration. The outer iteration is identical to Newton's method, while the inner iteration solves the power flow correction equation using an exponentially fast converged distributed algorithm. The proposed algorithm does not need coordination infrastructure and each area in power systems only need to communicate less important information with neighbors. The numerical tests show that the method is able to converge with the same behavior as Newton's method.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Optimization Model of Park-level Integrated Energy System Participating in Power Peak Shaving
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the imbalance of source-load distribution and the randomness of the output of new energy in China, the peaking pressure of power grid is increasing. And the trouble of energy development is becoming more and more prominent. Under this background, it is proposed that to participate in power grid peak-shaving by optimizing the output of units in the multi-energy complementary park. The demand for peak-adjustable auxiliary service of power grid is the target of market regulation of peak-adjustment auxiliary service. How to maximize its own interests by participating in the power grid peaking under the current power market environment. This paper proposes an optimization model of comprehensive consideration of the demand of internal load and peaking of the park. And the feasibility and accuracy of the method are verified by the actual case.

articleTitle: Research on Transformer Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Rough Set Optimization BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The intelligent transformer fault diagnosis method can timely and accurately discover the equipment fault, which plays an important role in the safe operation of the transformer. This paper analyzes the research status of transformer fault diagnosis, and creatively introduces rough set theory and BP neural network into the field of transformer fault diagnosis. The rough set is used to filter and clear the redundant data as the pre-component, and effective data is normalized and processed. Then BP neural network is trained by sample data and a new type of transformer fault diagnosis method is established. The effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method are verified by practical examples.

articleTitle: Coordinated Development Evaluation on Integrated Energy Systems in China
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The coordinated development evaluation on integrated energy systems has not been studied. To address this problem, this paper proposes a framework to evaluate the coordinated development of regional integrated energy system. First, the indices to evaluate the development level of coal, gas, power system and heat supply system are given. And then, the interdependency indices and synergistic index are given. The Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is used to get the weight of different indices. Finally, comprehensive evaluation score is computed to evaluate the development level of coal, gas, power system and heat supply system. Based on that, the coordinated development level of integrated energy system can be got. Cases studies on some provinces in China prove the validity of the proposed methods in this paper.

articleTitle: New Sensorless Control for Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors of Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper addresses sensorless control of interior permanent magnet synchronous motors (IPMSM). Aiming at the sensor fault of electric vehicle, the sensorless fault-tolerant control technology was supplemented to improve the functional safety. Improved sliding mode observer (SMO) was constructed based on current state equation with the extended back electromotive force (EMF). Through bench calibration, motor parameters in the whole working area were identified and used by the observer adaptively, position estimation offset and system instability caused by the change of parameters were eliminated. The output of switching function was transformed from \pmbαβ frame to dq frame before low pass filter to avoid fundamental phase delay. In order to improve the dynamic performance of variables estimation, the execution frequency of sliding mode observer and switching function was higher than sampling frequency in DSP. The control method is validated with experimental results that show the effectiveness of the real-time implementation.

articleTitle: Effect of Harmonics on Symmetrical Components of Power Network Using Least Square Method
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This research work estimates the effect of harmonics on symmetrical components of power network using least square method. Symmetrical component analysis of power line faults has been considered an effective tool for the design and control of power devices since their introduction. Harmonics present in power system disturb the operation of analogue protective devices. Moreover, the harmonics deteriorate the power quality, increase power loss, decrease appliances life and ultimately decrease the reliability of power system. A microprocessor based technique to estimate the value of symmetrical components under abnormal conditions in the presence of harmonics is investigated and simulated. The given technique deploys method of least squares in order to estimate the magnitude of symmetrical components. Simulation of proposed model is carried out in MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Analysis of Synchronous Phasor Data Wireless Communication Technology for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the condition of a large number of distributed power sources connected to the distribution network, the application of synchronous phasor measurement technology can solve the problem of real-time monitoring and protection of the distribution network. This paper discusses the application of different types of wireless communication technology in distribution network, introduces the development of 5G mobile communication technology and its standards, and analyzes the requirements of synchronous phasor technology for communication bandwidth and delay in distribution network. The application of 5G mobile communication technology to WAMS communication in distribution network has also been put forward in this paper.

articleTitle: Stochastic Stability Analysis of the Power Systems Based on Lyapunov Function
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of new energy power systems, and the penetration of storage equipments and rechargeable equipments, it is imperative to study the stochastic stability of power systems. To determine the stability of the power systems, Lyapunov function played an important role. However, for nonlinear systems, there is no general method to construct Lyapunov functions, and the direct method gives sufficient conditions for the system, which makes it difficult to judge the stability of the system. In addition, if the Lyapunov function of the system exists, the Lyapunov function is generally not unique. In this paper, the equivalent stochastic model of two-machine power systems based on EEAC theory is taken as an example. The separable variable method is proposed to construct the Lyapunov function and then the weak stochastic asymptotic stability of the system is proved. The method is compared with the traditional Lyapunov first method to analyze the stochastic stability of the system. Finally, the case study is given and the stochastic response of the system is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Congestion Management in Cross-Region Grid Considering Spatially Transferable Characteristic of Data Center Load
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to mitigate the possible congestion of cross-region interconnected power grid, a congestion management method based on the workload migration among geographically distributed data centers is proposed considering the adjustability of data center electricity consumption. Through integrating this demand side resource and setting dispatch compensation and price signals, flexible allocation of network load among data centers in each region can be implemented to alleviate or eliminate congestion. Firstly, the realistic basis for the data center to participate in congestion management is introduced. Then, based on the power consumption model of the data center, a novel congestion management model that considers incentivizing the data center is established, and the incentive reward is determined by the remaining processing capacity of data centers and the transferred network workload. Considering the time differences of the use of electricity and the use of internet, the congestion management process is proposed. The case analysis shows the effectiveness of the proposed congestion management method.

articleTitle: An Improved Coordinated Control Strategy of VSC-MTDC Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, an improved coordinated control strategy of voltage-source-converters multi-terminals dc systems (VSC-MTDC) in the distribution network is proposed by combining the properties of droop control, modified double stage voltage margin and an undead-band voltage droop control. This approach has three benefits: First, the main converter with droop control characteristics associated with constant active power control can set the reference voltage for the dc system and it is convenient for the regulation of dc voltage and for restraining power variations. Second, several converters simultaneously shared the duty of dc voltage reference control with equal priority. Third, the combination of droop, modified double stage voltage margin and undead-band droop control minimize overvoltage and under voltage during the transient response, allows a smooth and better transition to a new operating point when the system is subjected to small and severe disturbances. Finally, simulations under normal and abnormal conditions and comparison to voltage margin and voltage droop control strategy verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Two RX Models of Doubly-Fed Induction Generators for Load Flow Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, two RX models of a Doubly-Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) are proposed for load flow analysis considering the wind speed Vw as the input data. The load flow problem of a power system containing DFIGs is discussed under two common control strategies: 1) to keep the power factor constant; 2) to keep the stator voltage constant. Based on the steady-state equivalent circuit of a DFIG, the RX1 model is presented, and the RX2 model is researched on the basis of the dynamic model of a DFIG. Compared with the conventional Newton-Raphson method, when using RX models in load flow analysis, the initial value problems can be solved more easily and suitably, and the computation accuracy is quite ensured. The proposed models are tested on the modified IEEE-30 test system, and the results show the availability of the two RX models.

articleTitle: Multi-Energy Market Game Analysis of Wind Power Participating in Bidding Competition
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the energy Internet framework, the use of multiple energy complementary features such as electricity and gas can help alleviate the adverse effects of random fluctuations in renewable energy such as wind power. First of all, in order to make up for the bidding bias of wind power suppliers in the market in the past, a market trading framework considering various energy sources such as electricity and natural gas is given. Secondly, establish a game model of the market and natural gas market in which wind power suppliers participate in bidding. Among them, in the recent market, wind power merchants and traditional power producers participate in bidding by means of supply function bidding; in the natural gas market, natural gas merchants also use the supply function bidding method. Participate in the bidding and using Monte Carlo simulation to simulate the actual output of wind power. Finally, the rationality of the theoretical model is verified by a case study.

articleTitle: Impact of Synchronous Condenser on Commutation Failure of LCC-UHVDC Transmission System Hierarchically Connected to Weak AC Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of Synchronous condenser (SC) on transient performance of LCC-UHVDC system hierarchically connected to weak AC grid which may exhibits consecutive commutation failures (CF) and longer fault recovery time under different fault conditions. The SC as a dynamic reactive power compensator is connected to AC busbar of LCC-UHVDC system in order to supply reactive power during various transient conditions. The LCC-UHVDC hierarchical connection mode along with SC is developed in PSCAD/EMTDC. The effect of SC on operating characteristics like CF and fault recovery performance of LCC-UHVDC system hierarchically connected to weak AC grid is analyzed under single and three phase to ground fault. The results indicate that SC increases AC system strength, which can effectively regulate AC bus bar voltage, mitigate the occurrence of commutation failure at inverter side and considerably improve the fault recovery time of LCC-UHVDC system under different fault conditions.

articleTitle: Impact of Cyber System Failure on Cascading Blackout of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Cyber system is indispensable in guaranteeing the security operation of power system, which reminds the need to analyze the impact of cyber system failure on power grid cascading blackout. According to different functions, the cyber system is divided into three parts, which are monitoring, controlling and protecting respectively. Then, the states of the cyber system and the physical system are sampled to simulate cascading outage based on failure probabilities of the power components and the failure model of the cyber system. Finally, the proposed method is verified on the IEEE RTS-79 system. The numerical results show that cyber system failure usually accelerates cascading blackouts, and the loss of blackouts increase with the increase of failure probability of cyber system.

articleTitle: An Improved Control Strategy Based on DC Control System to Mitigate Commutation Failure
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to reduce the commutation failure on the inverter side of traditional HVDC transmission, this paper analyzes the mechanism of commutation failure and the response of HVDC system before and after commutation failure caused by ac fault. Based on the shortcomings of dc control system, a traditional de commutation failure control strategy based on fault and current detection is proposed. Simulation results in PSCAD/EMTDC show that the proposed control strategy can restrain the commutation failure and improve the system recovery after commutation failure to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electric Heating Load Characteristics in South Hebei Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an effective way to solve environmental problems and achieve sustainable development, electric heating present broad application prospects. Based on actual electric heating data of South Hebei, the electric heating load characteristics are analyzed in this paper. Statistical analysis and correlation analysis are conducted, which show strong negative correlation between heating loads and temperature. The patterns of the electric heating loads are extracted by K-means clustering algorithm and 3 heating load patterns are acquired.

articleTitle: A transient profile forecasting method based on PMU measurements for monitoring and control of short-term voltage instability
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Recent years, the monitoring and control of short-term voltage stability has drawn much attention of researchers and operators of power system. First, this paper introduces an online maximum Lyapunov exponent calculating method based on phase rectification, the advantage of which over traditional methods is that the calculation results of the algorithm doesn't rely on parameter settings. Then, this paper proposes a transient profile forecasting method based on MLE. Transient profile forecasting is able to reduce the degradation of performance reduced by different types of time delays of monitoring and control of short-term voltage stability. At last, the simulation work is introduced.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Communication Network in Smart Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Real-time, reliable and integrated communication system is the key to the implementation and management of smart microgrid upper layers. In this paper, we propose a two-way communication system architecture for smart microgrids based on IEC 61850. Micro-power wireless technology and Ethernet are selected for this communication system. Furthermore, the communication data messages are classified according to their priorities. Then, a simulation model of smart microgrid communication system is established using a OPNET environment. On this basis, the effects of communication distance on system performance are analyzed. The performance of communication system is also discussed under constant and burst background flow, when Distributed Coordination Function and Enhanced Distributed Channel Access are used respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis in the Railway Power Transmission Line Based on the Modern Mathematical Methods
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The 10kV railway power transmission line simulation model is established by using MATLAB/Simulink software in this paper. Based on the characteristics of phase current difference, combined with zero-sequence current feature vector, BP neural network is established to classify faults. The fault location formula of overhead line-cable hybrid line is derived. The time of the mutation point in the fault traveling wave is detected by the phase-mode transformation method and wavelet transform modulus maximum method. Calculate fault distance to realize fault location. The simulation results show that the fault diagnosis method proposed in this paper can accurately determine the type and location of the fault in the railway power transmission line. These recognition results are not affected by fault inception angle, transition resistance and fault type.

articleTitle: Medium and Long Term Load Forecasting of Regional Power Grid in the Context of Economic Transition
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In allusion to the saturated trend of load growth in the context of economic transition, a saturated load forecasting method is proposed in this paper. In the proposed method, main indices which affect the power load growth are screened by gray correlation analysis and co-integration theory. According to these indices, regression model and support vector machine (SVM) are established. Then Logistic model and grey Verhulst model (GVM) are applied based on regional load growth. In order to improve the prediction precision, this paper proposes a combination forecasting model based on Multi-Attribute Decision-making and nonlinear programming algorithm. The comparison between the prediction result and the “13th Five-Year” planning report indicates that, the load growth forecast becomes gentle within a forecast range of the planning report, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Review Of The Mutual Influence Analysis Of AC/DC Hybrid Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuously development of the HVDC transmission technology, a great number of large scale HVDC transmission projects have been completed or under construction, along with more issues come to the surface. Faults or disturbances would act on the AC/DC hybrid power grids, especially for the multi-feedback DC power grid. In this paper, the mutual influence between AC and DC grids is studied and analyzed in depth according to the actual cases. It has two aspects which conclude the impact of DC system faults on AC systems and AC system faults on DC systems separately. Theoretical analysis and research are made and specific optimization measures are proposed for how to reduce the interaction between AC and DC transmission projects after faults or disturbance in AC-DC hybrid systems.

articleTitle: An Active Power Control Strategy for Large-Scale Cluster Wind Power with Nested Transmission Section Constraints Considering the Control Delay Effect
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is an important development form that large-scale cluster wind power access to the power grid in China. The active power control strategy for wind power with nested transmission section constraints has become an important way to improve the utilization of the transmission capacity. However, since the control delay isn't taken into consideration by the current active power control strategy, there exists a potential that section power flow exceeds its limitation. To this end, this paper firstly studies the control framework of cluster wind power and puts forward the calculation method of active power control delay for wind power. Then a calculation method of section warning value considering the control delay is proposed which is used to improve the current cluster wind power active power control strategy. Finally, the benefits of the proposed method are verified based on its actual application in a certain regional power grid in China.

articleTitle: FLECH Services to Solve Grid Congestion
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed energy resources (DERs) can offer many valuable services to the power system; however, increasing penetration of these resources may challenge the distribution grid due to insufficient capacity in peak hours. The services offered by DERs provides flexibility that needs to be used for the better operation of distribution grids. Identification of useful flexibility services has gained a lot of attention and different innovative concepts are being introduced. This study discusses one of the recently introduced flexibility service concept of FLECH and also reviews some of its uncovered aspects. Furthermore, this study addresses one of the aspects i.e. baseline formulation at the distribution level and provides the solution for it. It also provides a case study of the flexibility service i.e. PowerMax service. In the end, some illustrations from the case study are presented to understand the concept of FLECH.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting Wind Farm Output Power
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the output of the wind generation system depend on factors such as wind speed, air density and so on, and it is intermittent and hard to control, large-scale wind power connected to the grid have substantial impacts on the stability of power systems. The development of wind power forecasting technology reduce the negative impact of wind power. In order to improve the accuracy of the forecasting system, it is necessary to have a deep understanding of the output characteristics of the wind power generation system. This paper firstly analyzes the influence of the large scale wind power system connected onto the grid and then introduces the principle and the factors which affect the wind power output. Based on the history data of a 50MW wind farm and the statistical method, the paper qualitatively and quantitatively analyzes the wind power output performance, and describes the fluctuation range and fluctuation probability distribution of wind farm output power at different scales. Finally, the conclusions of this study will provide the output characteristics of wind farms under different meteorological factors and the fluctuation characteristics of wind farms at different time scales.

articleTitle: Research on Service Model of Protection relay Based on Occurrence Sequence of Petri Net
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The whole-services data model of protection relay support the service platform of protection relay, and the service model of protection relay is an important part of the whole-services data model. Object-oriented modeling methods such as UML provide a feasible technical solution for service modeling of protection relay. However, this method lacks strict semantics, and the accuracy of the model is difficult to verify. The model is prone to generate information ecology, and is not comprehensive. Petri net have strict mathematical definitions and the model can be validated by formal verification methods. Based on the service modeling requirements of protection relay, this paper proposes to establish the model with the application of Petri net, transform the Petri net to its corresponding occurrence sequence, formally analyze and semantically verify the occurrence sequence, finds and corrects the branch or process in Petri net that is inconsistent with the actual service, which improves the effectiveness of the service model of protection relay.

articleTitle: Dynamic VAR Planning in HVDC Receiving-End Power Grid Considering Short-Term Voltage Stability
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The short-term voltage stability (STVS) in HVDC receiving-end power grid is weak, and the dynamic VARs are required to be installed. Therefore, the issue of dynamic VAR planning is worth to be studied. In this paper, a method for dynamic VAR planning based on the method of approximate programming (MAP) is proposed. Firstly, a brief introduction of the MAP is presented. Then, the dynamic VAR planning problem is constructed, a short-term voltage stability (STVS) index is proposed, the optimization problem is linearized and the procedure of the proposed method is presented. Lastly, a case study on a modified IEEE 39 system is presented. The method proposed in this paper is simple in form and easy to solve, which has potential for practical applications.

articleTitle: Inter-Regional Energy Delivery Planning Considering Renewable Energy Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to accomplish a low-carbon economy, large-scale and long-distance inter-regional energy delivery from northern and western renewable energy bases to eastern load centers has been the key measure to decarbonizing the power sector of China. However, intermittent renewable energy sources bring uncertainties to energy delivery planning. This paper proposed an inter-regional energy delivery planning model considering the uncertainties of wind and photovoltaic, which aims to minimum overall social cost. Combined scenarios are built by studying the historical data of renewable energy's output. The numerical analysis is provided by solving the model with cplex. The corresponding results show the advantage of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Reconfiguration Strategy for Active Distribution Network Based on Classification and Regression Tree
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the hidden function relationship between the operating data of distribution network and the reconfiguration scheme, an reconfiguration strategy for active distribution network based on classification and regression tree(CART) is proposed. The CART algorithm is used for rules mining for the power flow data of the whole system and the corresponding reconfiguration scheme in different situations, and the decision rules are used to help selecting the reconfiguration scheme of distribution network. In the strategy, there's no need to solve the complex mathematical model of distribution network reconfiguration. Through the method of data mining, the rules which can help choose the proper reconfiguration scheme can be mined from the history database. This paper uses DIGSILENT to simulate the case in order to verify the strategy.

articleTitle: Single Phase Adaptive Autoreclosing Scheme Based on Continuous Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes an adaptive single phase auto reclosing scheme for EHV transmission lines using continuous wavelet transform (CWT). The CWT extract features from the faulted phase voltage waveform. The wavelet coefficients obtained by CWT can provide an effective signal representation of the voltage at the faulty phase. An index is derived by the sum of the energy of CWT coefficients. By assessing the index, temporary and permanent faults can be identified. In case of temporary fault, arc extinction instant can also be determined, which is used by protective relay to prompt auto reclosing signal. The reliability of the proposed algorithm is tested well under a diversity of fault conditions on a 500 kV, 320 km long overhead line using MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Study on Harmonic Transfer in a Two-terminal MMC-Based HVDC System Considering AC Background Harmonics
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the modular multilevel converter (MMC) has become the most attractive multilevel converter technology for medium and high power applications, especially for high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission systems and distributed power plants due to its outstanding advantages. However, MMC-based applications have some technical challenges such as circulating current, SM capacitor voltage balance, DC-side fault handling, etc that need further investigation. In the HVDC systems, harmonic issues receive considerable concerns from researchers and designers. This paper presents the analysis and simulation of the two-terminal MMC-HVDC system considering AC background harmonics. Harmonic transfer mechanism of the MMC-HVDC system under background harmonics is analyzed by using the average switching functions. The simulation results in PSCAD/EMTDC are agreeable to the theoretical analysis: the existence of background harmonics on the AC side of an MMC will generate the harmonic current on the DC lines and this harmonic in turn produces new negative- and positive-sequence harmonics on the AC side of the other MMC in the system. This gives an insight on the mechanism of harmonic propagation in MMC-HVDC systems, which is valuable to propose suitable solutions for mitigating harmonics or preventing potential resonance in these systems.

articleTitle: Power Grid Fault Diagnosis Based on Fault Information Coding and Fusion Method
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the differences of fault characteristics in the process of fault diagnosis, the paper proposes power grid fault diagnosis method based on integrated fault degree. This method firstly, the wavelet transform is used for electric parameters amplitude and energy characteristics of the information analysis, extract the key indicators; then, according to the amount of the digital information from remote communication system, calculating coding similarity by using fault coding theory; finally, determine integrated fault degree by using the improved D-S evidence theory and finding finally fault line by improved k-means clustering method. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme improves the accuracy of diagnosis, and has good application prospects.

articleTitle: PMU-based Harmonic Phasor Calculation and Harmonic Source Identification
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the generalization and application of PMUs, the approach of the measurement and calculation for the electrical parameters in power grid are greatly enriched. But at present, PMU can only calculate the fundamental phasor and the utilization ratio of hardware resources is low. Firstly, based on the calculation principle of PMU for fundamental phasor calculation, the algorithm of PMU to calculate harmonic phasor is proposed. Secondly, the accuracy of harmonic phasor calculated by PMU and harmonic phasor calculated by conventional Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) is compared when the signal frequency deviates from the rated frequency. Thirdly, the harmonic phasors calculated by PMU and conventional FFT are used for harmonic contribution determination (HCD). The feasibility of harmonic phasor calculated by PMU on improving the accuracy of HCD is analyzed based on the case study results. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified based on 18-bus distribution system. The case-study results show that the accuracy of the proposed method is good. The harmonic phasor data calculated by PMU is of great value for improving the accuracy of HCD.

articleTitle: Design of the Structure of the Rotor Containment Sleeve for High-Speed PM Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to high-speed of permanent magnet (PM) machines, large eddy current loss is caused by higher harmonics, so that the temperature of the permanent magnet rises rapidly, which may cause the permanent magnet demagnetization. As for the above problem, three schemes are designed for different protection measures based on a prototype of high-speed permanent magnet machine of 250kW, 65000r/min. Also based on 2D finite element method the eddy current loss of the three schemes is analyzed and compared. It is shown that the eddy current loss is least under the third scheme. The value of the eddy current loss is 1489.1W. The structure of the rotor containment sleeve of third scheme is with the inner carbon fiber thickness 1.5mm, the alloy steel thickness 0.6mm and the outer carbon fiber thickness 0.9mm. The internal magnet field of permanent magnet of the three schemes is analyzed and compared. It provides an important evidence for the research of rotor containment sleeve of the high-speed permanent magnet machine.

articleTitle: Prospect of 5G Communication Mode for Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The potential functions and application prospects of the fifth-generation mobile communications system (5G) are well adapted to the complex, diverse and demanding communication needs of the energy internet. This paper describes the research status, functional objectives, network architecture and application scenarios of 5G. Meanwhile the 5G network architecture of IMT-2020 (5G) Promotion Group was introduced. Then combined with the relevant research and progress in the field of energy, a reasonable energy internet architecture is proposed. Based on the analysis of 5G and energy internet, the 5G communication mode for the energy internet is prospected.

articleTitle: Ungrounded Fault Detection in Medium Voltage Distribution Network Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As medium-voltage distribution network substations often use the insulated neutral point, it will not cause obvious fault characteristics when single-phase bilateral non-grounded line breakage events happen. Therefore, it is still not possible to determine the fault by using the protection device in the transformers, and the disconnection can only be detected by the users or the inspection staffs. In this paper, we develop an intelligent system to detect disconnection based on electrical information system data and a variety of machine learning algorithms. After multiple comparisons, this method can significantly improve the predict performance, and can find out the main criteria for judgment. The evaluation vectors are {AVC, ACC, TPR, TNR} = {0.9727,0.9144,0.9154,0.9136}. This method can be applied to online diagnosis of disconnection fault in medium voltage distribution network to improve the reliability of power supply.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacity Design for Solar Combined Cooling Heating and Power System with Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the energy efficiency and achieve the purpose of energy saving ad pollutant emission reductions, a model of solar combined cooling heating and power (CCHP) system integrated with energy storage is presented. The indices of prime energy consumption, environment and economy are established and formed as a comprehensive evaluation index using the judgment matrix method. A two-stage optimal planning and design method is applied to optimize the capacity design and operation strategy of CCHP system. The simulation results demonstrate that the comprehensive performances of the solar CCHP system in prime energy consumption and pollutant emission are better than that of the separation production.

articleTitle: Research on Field Testing Method of Digital Energy Meters Based on Digital Reference Meter with High Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The principle of field testing for digital electric energy meters is analyzed, according to which a digital reference energy meter with high accuracy is developed based on high-precision frequency division pulse output technology, algorithm of dot product sum of interpolation re-sampling and high performance DSP. The test method based on the digital reference meter is applied field testing comparing with a set of calibration system. The results of the test prove high accuracy, efficiency and stability.

articleTitle: Model Management and Service Based Power Grid Multi -Agent Dispatcher Training Simulator
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The joint anti-accident exercises in multi-level dispatching and control systems using dispatcher training simulator (DTS)are distributed interactive simulation. It has many problems, such as wide cross domain, tedious training preparation, and complex communication etc. Based on model management service, DTS of multi-level and multi-area becomes reality. It is an effective way to study the distributed complex system such as DTS based on multi-agent theory. In this paper, the application of agent in DTS is divided into three stages. The first stage is part-role agent. The second stage is whole-roles agent. The last stage is functional-module agent. This paper puts forwards the simulation model of agent in three stages. The purpose is achieving two kinds of conversion, one is transforming dispatcher training into agent training, the other is transforming dispatcher from being evaluated into a decision maker. The new DTS with agent technology is verified feasibly and effectively comparing with the traditional DTS system.

articleTitle: A Capacity Planning Method for Wind Power Based on Cooperative Game Theory in Carbon Trading Process
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In low-carbon economy, carbon trading process is introduced to quantify the effect by actual economic value. Based on the cooperative game theory, the improvement strategies and cost benefit for both wind farms and the grid company are analyzed. Furthermore, a reasonable capacity distribution model of the alliance of wind farms and grid company is built to achieve the fairness of profit distribution. Finally, a practical example is given to illustrate that the alliance of wind farms and grid company is effective in increasing grid initiative in accommodating wind power.

articleTitle: Key Technologies and Prospects for Planning Methods of Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The research on energy Internet has made great progress, but many key technologies still lack substantial breakthroughs, and research on planning needs to be further developed. Firstly, this paper summarizes the connotation and structure of the Energy Internet; Then, it summarizes the key technologies of Energy Internet and its existing problems in the aspects of “Integrated Energy System” (IES) and “Cyber Physics System”(CPS). What's more, it analyzes the key directions in future planning research. Finally, this paper puts forward the idea of adaptive planning as the key point, such as planning model based on two-layer constraint, the preliminary construction and vision planning of energy internet based on complex networks, and the “source-network-load” comprehensive planning and transient process analysis of the ubiquitous smart distribution grid in transition of the Energy Internet. All is intended to provide reference and discussion basis for subsequent exploration work.

Author Keywords: Energy Internet; adaptive planning method; key technology

articleTitle: Hardware in Loop Simulation Test of Photovoltaic Virtual Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation is mainly connected to the grid by grid-connected inverter. Compared with the traditional synchronous generator, it has the advantages of flexible control and quick response, but there is also lack of inertia and damping. With the increasing of the permeability of the photovoltaic power supply, the rotating spare capacity and the moment of inertia in the power system are relatively reduced, which poses a severe challenge to the safe and stable operation of the power grid. The introduction of photovoltaic virtual synchronous generator makes the grid connected inverter have similar operation characteristics of synchronous generator and improve the stability of power system. In this paper, a hardware in loop simulation test scheme based on RT-LAB is proposed for PV virtual synchronous generator, and a simulation test platform is set up to study the testing method of the performance of the PV virtual synchronous generator. Based on this platform, the characteristics of the PV virtual synchronous generator, such as the inertia and the primary frequency modulation, are carried out. The test results show that the simulation platform is correct.

articleTitle: Energy Management for Internet Data Centers Considering the Coordinating Optimization of Workload and CCHP System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High energy consumption and high energy cost have been one of the most important challenges faced by large Internet data centers (IDCs). Combined cooling, heating and power (CCHP) system has brought new idea to energy supply for IDCs where the power supply is tight. Furthermore, geographically distributed IDCs can transfer load demand each other by geographical load balancing (GLB) technology through the data network. That is, IDCs, which are geographically distributed integrated energy systems, can be connected by data network. In this paper, an energy management model for the IDCs considering of the coordinating optimization of workload and CCHP system is established. A case study is given to verify the validity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of HVDC to Low Frequency Oscillation in Interconnected Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of UHV AC/DC hybrid power system in China, the power oscillation phenomena of the large inter-area mode are often observed in the daily operation of UHV AC transmission line. With huge economic benefits gained through HVDC transmission, the HVDC transmission also has an important impact on AC system damping characteristics and power oscillation. The power oscillation has become a serious threat to the safe and stable operation of UHV power grid. Thus, strengthening the research of HVDC is very meaningful. This paper focuses on the oscillation energy function of power system which contains HVDC transmission. Based on the analysis of multi-machine system, the oscillation energy characteristics are presented along with the low frequency oscillation of AC/DC hybrid power system, and the main factors affecting the oscillation energy of HVDC transmission system are obtained. Finally, a four-machine two-zone AC/DC hybrid system was built. The simulation results of low frequency oscillation energy in interconnected power system with HVDC transmission access verify the accuracy of the analysis.

articleTitle: High Performance Computing (HPC)for Advanced Power System Studies
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The paper presents a probabilistic study for advanced modern power systems based on a high performance computing (HPC)method supported by the Computational Shared Facility at the University of Manchester. The main outcome of this research is the contingency-based probabilistic load flow analysis of the WSCC 9 bus & IEEE 39 bus system as well as the use of parallel processing on HPC for running Monte Carlo simulations efficiently. With the advent of smart grid and widely application of renewable energy the modern interconnected power systems are becoming more complex and more uncertainties are produced. In order to obtain further information about the effect of the uncertainty for power systems, probabilistic studies are developed to perform the stability and security research. The High Performance Computing (HPC)is introduced as a powerful computation technique which enables large-scale computation tasks to be split to a number of small jobs which could be run simultaneously on parallel cores and get the results quickly.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment Method for Transmission-distribution Integrated System with Distributed PV
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the traditional risk assessment of power system, the analysis of transmission system and distribution system were conducted separately. However, the power supply reliability of the distribution network users is not only related to the reliability of the distribution network components, but also to the power supply capability of the transmission system to the distribution system. The risk assessment method of transmission and distribution system that conducted separately cannot reflect the impact of changes in the transmission network on the reliability of power supply in distribution system. In this paper, a risk assessment method for transmission-distribution integrated system is proposed. Risk assessment is carried out in the transmission system first according to the load state of the system to evaluate the operation risk of the transmission system, and to obtain the probability distribution of the bus power of the transmission network. The probability distribution of bus power of transmission network is substituted into the root node of distribution network. Considering the possible island operation mode with the distributed PV connected in the distribution network, the loss of load in the case of component fault of distribution network is analyzed, and the risk index of load loss of the system is calculated. Finally, correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are validated by a modified IEEE RTS and IEEE 33-bus system.

articleTitle: Batch Workloads Management for Data Centers Considering Nodes Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the growing number of data centers, energy consumption of data centers has become a nonignorable problem in the field of energy internet. In the existing studies on data center workload management, there is rarely any work focusing on the energy efficiency of operation nodes level. In this paper, a model of delay-tolerant workloads allocation among multiple nodes is proposed to minimize the operation cost. Correspondingly, the load ratio of operation nodes is introduced to measure the energy efficiency of data centers. Considering both power supply and demand response sides, a MILP based model is formulated to solve the problem using experimental data and the effectiveness and performance of the proposed approach are examined.

articleTitle: Design of PFC in Wireless Charging System for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A power factor correction (PFC) circuit is constructed, based on average period compensation method(APCM) in this paper. The cut-off frequency 2kHz and 10Hz are closed for current loop and voltage loop, and the phase margin of each loop is 80 degrees. By contrasting the THD of fundamental wave calculated to the 40th and the peak value of voltage ripple wave, PI values and transfer functions of both current loop and voltage loop are got. Then the input current and output voltage in PFC steady operation are simulated, and results are in accord with the small-signal model. In Simulink, the output capacitance is charged in advance and saturation controller is adopted, by which the overshoot of output voltage decreases by 6.3%, and the THD of input current is only 3.76%, which meet the demands for power-factor correction in wireless charging system for EV.

articleTitle: Design of Lean Management System for Equipment Assets Based on BOM Tree and RFID
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the management of capital assets owned by major enterprise, there exist some information disconnection including no information about equipment working conditions when bidding for them, no information about installation and debugging when the equipment was overhauled. Therefore, the paper proposes to establish a equipment management system based on BOM tree and RFID. Giving asset devices lifetime identity through RFID coding, which will be utilized throughout all procedures including planning and designing, bidding and procurement, construction building and so on. The paper develops some apps, such as engineering construction, warehouse management to realize data circulation throughout the equipment. Besides, with data analysis, the paper carries on equipment unit cost allocation and collection and supplier comprehensive evaluation, to guide equipment procurement and management, strengthen the whole process monitoring of asset operation status, improve the management level of asset lean management, and optimize the asset operation strategy of the company.

articleTitle: P-Q Coordinated Planning Method for Distributed Generation in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage problem brings challenges to the operation of the distribution network. This paper proposed a multi-objective coordinated active and reactive power (P-Q) optimization method for distributed generation (DG) planning with high penetration in distribution network to handle the voltage problem. Through this method, less network power loss and voltage deviation can be obtained by reducing the active output slightly and regulating the reactive output in DG locating and sizing. Meanwhile, the voltage quality of the system can be improved, thus the voltage problem can be solved in the perspective of network planning. To efficiently address this problem, a mixed-integer non-linear programming (MINLP) based multi-objective optimization approach of DG planning is proposed, which is validated via two typical distribution systems.

articleTitle: Research of Impact of the Direct Drive Wind Farm on Power System Relay Protection
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large capacity of wind power farm connect to regional distribution network which has single grid structure will influence many aspects, including protective device of the power grid and the set of setting value. Through the simulation software of Matlab/Simulink, this paper does a lot of simulations about ground fault, which occupying 80%~90% of the system fault, then analyzes the impact on grounding distance protection, after the large capacity of wind power plant connecting the power grid. We can conclude that after connecting wind power plant, grounding distance protection will affected more or less. The short-circuit current provided by the direct-drive wind power generator lager than the single phase fault, when the fault of the two phases connect to ground happens on the transmission lines. when in the large wind speed disturbance, it maybe lead to protection mistake. Finally, The more the number of the fault wind farms, the more affect of the relay protection.

articleTitle: An MMC Submodular Capacitor Voltage Balancing Scheme Based on Improved Bucket Sorting
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Submodular capacitor voltage balancing problem is becoming increasingly prominent with the rapid development of high voltage and large capacity modular multilevel converter (MMC). The traditional submodular capacitor voltage balancing strategy based on bubble sorting has high time complexity, quantities of comparisons, and consumes a lot of computing resources. A new submodular capacitor voltage balancing method based on improved bucket sorting is proposed in this paper. The scheme utilizes bucket sorting to divide capacitor voltage into different buckets, and then sort the elements in only one bucket by improved quick sorting which sets the Mth data as the reference value and just sorts on one side of benchmark. The strategy can accurately find sub-modules with the smallest or largest capacitor voltage, while time complexity of the algorithm is O(n). Finally, a 227 level one-terminal MMC is used to verify the effectiveness of proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on Fractal Butterfly Antenna Sensors Detecting Partial Discharge UHF Signal Propagating from GIS Placing Hole
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Detecting the Ultra-High Frequency (UHF) electromagnetic wave has been acknowledged as an effective method in the measurement of varied kinds of partial discharges in Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS). However, electromagnetic wave has been shielded completely owing to the steel flange around the insulator in recent years. Detecting the electromagnetic wave propagating from the placing hole in the steel flange becomes the only practicable method. The traditional sensors enter a bottleneck stage when they are used to detecting the electromagnetic wave propagating from the placing hole. The sensitivity declines a lot and output signal becomes weaker. At present, there are no relevant sensors, which are professionally applied in detecting UHF electromagnetic wave propagating from placing hole. By adopting the fractal technology, back cavity and loaded resistor, the UHF sensor of fractal butterfly antenna was developed based on the software of High Frequency Structure Simulator(HFSS). Equivalent height was tested in the platform of Giga hertz Transverse Electromagnetic(GTEM) chamber. Detection sensibility and validity was tested via an experimental platform of 220kV GIS. It is concluded that the fractal butterfly antenna sensor belongs to the linear polarized antenna. The available frequency range is concentrated in 0.8-2GHz. The average equivalent height of fractal butterfly antenna is twice more than the traditional sensors. Detecting sensitivity of partial discharge is lower than 20pC.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Distribution Equipment and Asset Management System Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distribution equipment and physical assets of a wide range, a large part of the distribution network equipment in the long-term operation in the outdoor environment, bear the role of mechanical load and power load at the same time, but also bear the natural external forces. The above factors will promote the aging of the components, corrosion and oxidation, if not timely detection and elimination of equipment components of the security risks, will affect or even endanger the safe operation of power systems. With the rapid development of wireless communication technology in recent years, RFID is more and more widely used as a radio frequency identification technology. The combination of RFID and power system asset management can greatly reduce the manual operation and improve the efficiency of material and equipment management. This paper designs an asset management system of distribution network equipment based on RFID technology, analyzes the system information security technology, adopts the lightweight security authentication protocol of two-way message mutual authentication to enhance the security performance, and finally gives an improved anti-collision algorithm for binary search to enhance the system's multi-tag recognition efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: A New Cascaded Multi-Level Phase Structure Suitable for High-Voltage High-Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A new phase-structure of cascaded multilevel is proposed for high-voltage high-power application. The proposed phase structure consists of identical half-bridge (HB) submodules (SM), which are divided into upper and lower arms like in a modular multilevel converter (MMC). The SMs in the lower arm are connected in opposite polarity to those in the upper arm. By such an arrangement, the proposed phase structure is capable of outputting AC voltage. As a result, the popular CHB-based converters can be replaced by converters based on the proposed phase structure, featuring the same output characteristic, but halved number of switches. It not only can be used in grid-connected single-phase or three-phase inverters, but also supply load as inverter. An application in STATCOM as an example is studied. The experimental results also prove the viability of the proposed phase structure.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Method of Renewable Energy Accommodation Capability Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid growth of installed capacity of renewable energy in “Three North” region of China, the problem of curtailment of wind power and solar power is increasingly prominent year by year. It is urgent to carry out the analysis of renewable energy accommodation. In this paper, a Renewable energy accommodation capacity assessment model based on long short-term memory network under TensorFlow framework is presented. First, the multivariate time series was screened by principal component analysis to reduce the data dimension. Secondly, the LSTM network is used to model the nonlinear relationship between the key factors affecting renewable energy accommodation capacity and the actual output sequence of renewable energy. Based on the actual examples, the effectiveness of the method for assessing the accommodation capacity of the renewable energy is proved.

articleTitle: An Interconnected Power Grid Active Power Control Performance Evaluation Method Considering Energy Storage Frequency Modulation
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the energy storage cooperatively participating in AGC of the interconnected power grid, this paper proposed energy storage acti power control performance evaluation standard. called ES (energy storage) standard, for multi-area power grid. The index was a combination of the basic ideas of both NERC's control performance standard (CPS)and unit control performance standard (UCPS). The ES standard used the energy output factor of energy storage to reflect the energy storage participation in the active control and constrained the power grids AGC behaviors with the energy storage cooperatively participating by generalized area control error. The standard evaluated two kinds of different AGC control objectives. It can be used to guide the energy storage active power control method. Finally, the comparative analysis was run for the active control guidance of the ES standard and CPS through simulation. The simulation results show that compared with the CPS, the ES standard promotes the energy storage balance the frequency fluctuations coordinately with AGC units in power grid. It is more adapt to evaluate the energy storage active power control performance.

articleTitle: Research on Check Method of Feeder Topology Model for Distribution Main Station
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Cooperative control between intelligent distributed Feeder Automation and main station centralized Feeder Automation can improve the performance of fault handling. At present, feeder side topology is derived from the automatic identification of distribution terminals. The main station side topology is imported by the incremental import of geographic information system or production management system, but there are some problems, such as the topology confusion. In order to realize the power supply technology of fault isolation and non-fault area restoration based on intelligent distributed Feeder Automation and main station reserve, unify topology model, this paper present a method that once the static topology or topology operation mode is changed, the agent terminal initiates the function of topology query and generates the feeder topology file which will be uploaded to the main station for checking. Finally, the main station side topology can be corrected. The feasibility of the check scheme is verified by experiments, which meets the requirements of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Diagnosis Method of Power Grid Fault Components Based on Fault Fingerprint Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When the power grid fails, a large number of remote signaling alerts and displacement information are uploaded to the dispatching terminal, which makes it very difficult for the dispatching personnel to make accurate judgements on the faulty equipment and faulty types in a short period of time. This paper purposes a method to form different fault fingerprints codes based on the remote signal displacement information of different faults and map the remote signal data to the fault diagnosis space. Using remote signal displacement data generated by different fault modes, Hoffield neural network is trained to correct remote signal misplacement or missing transmission data, and finally a fault diagnosis model is formed to realize the diagnosis of power grid fault elements in the fault diagnosis space. Through the test of the fault fingerprint data of the actual system, the validity of the Hoffield neural network information correction model and the fault diagnosis model for the diagnosis of grid fault components are verified.

articleTitle: Fast Transmission Network Expansion Planning Considering the N-2 Security Criterion
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This study presents a fast transmission network expansion planning method incorporating the N-2 security criterion. Robust uncertainty set is used to characterize the N-2 security criterion where the combined failures of generators, existing lines., and candidate lines are explicitly modeled., and hence a trilevel robust optimization model is derived. The upper level minimizes the construction cost., the middle level selects the worst-case N-2 contingency that maximizes load shedding., and the lower level minimizes the operation cost under the realization of the worst-case contingency. A duality-based column-and-constraint generation algorithm is applied to solve the proposed model. The computational efficiency of the proposed method is illustrated by a numeric study on the IEEE RTS 24-bus and IEEE 118-bus test systems.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Assessment of Integrated Energy System in Substation Area
publicationTitle: 2018 2nd IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The substation area integrated energy system provides energy support for the normal operation of the substation, and its energy consumption level has a significant impact on the grid loss. This paper analyzes the distribution of energy consumption of substation from three aspects: equipment, substation electricity and office electricity. The basis, index and weight of energy efficiency assessment are established by analytic hierarchy process, and a scientific and complete energy efficiency assessment of substation station area integrated energy system is formed. The system provides a reference for energy saving and consumption reduction in substations. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Influence of Harmonics on Each Converter Station in Multi-HVDC System
